def _frozen():
    """ACA_FREEZE=1 pins the time-driven breathing term.

    Same switch core.lighting already honors. Without it draw() reads
    time.time(), so two renders of the same pose two milliseconds apart are
    not the same image, and nothing can prove that a color refactor preserved
    the sprite. See tools/avatar_parity.py.
    """
    return os.environ.get("ACA_FREEZE", "") == "1"


def _debug_rig_env():
    """ACA_DEBUG_RIG=1 draws the rig anchors over every Player sprite."""
    return os.environ.get("ACA_DEBUG_RIG", "") == "1"


def _draw_rig_debug(surface, an):
    """Body anchor (white), shoulders (yellow), hand targets (green), weapon
    grip (magenta) and the arm/aim direction - polish pass Task 4 overlay."""
    pt = lambda p: (int(round(p[0])), int(round(p[1])))  # noqa: E731
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 255, 255), pt(an["body"]), 2)
    for k in ("shoulder_l", "shoulder_r"):
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 220, 40), pt(an[k]), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 110, 40), pt(an[k]), pt(an["hand_l" if k[-1] == "l" else "hand_r"]), 1)
    for k in ("hand_l", "hand_r"):
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (60, 255, 90), pt(an[k]), 2)
    g = an["grip"]
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 60, 220), pt(g), 2)
    dx, dy = an["arm_dir"]
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (255, 60, 220), pt(g), pt((g[0] + dx * 10, g[1] + dy * 10)), 1)


class Player:
    debug_rig = False       # per-instance / dev-console toggle (see _debug_rig_env)

    def __init__(self, x, y, max_hp=100, appearance=None):
        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, 32, 32)
        self.speed = 5
        self.angle = 0
        self.hp = max_hp
        self.max_hp = max_hp
        self.breathing = 0
        self.blink_timer = 0
        self.weapon_raised = False
        self.walk_cycle = 0.0
        self.was_moving = False
        self._step_timer = 0.0
        self._recoil_timer = 0
        self._recoil_offset = 0.0
        self._slide_timer = 0
        # ── Per-instance weapon rig (multiplayer) ───────────────────────
        # A mission picks the gun silhouette from the global
        # STATE.current_weapon, because a mission draws exactly one player.
        # A match draws several players holding different guns at once, so
        # the arena view sets this override per sprite. None means "read the
        # global", which leaves the whole campaign path byte-for-byte
        # unchanged -- the override only exists for the multiplayer case.
        self.rig_weapon = None
        # Same story for the weapon-swap animation. The campaign advances
        # STATE.weapon_swap_timer from its own per-mission update loop; an
        # arena has no such loop, so draw() advances this per-instance timer
        # when the arena arms it (see ArenaView.sync).
        self.swap_timer = 0
        self.swap_duration = 24
        # ── AEGIS i-frames (Pass E) ─────────────────────────────────
        # Per references/game-design.md "Invincibility Frames". After taking
        # any damage, the player is invincible for IFRAME_DURATION seconds
        # and the sprite blinks on/off at ~60ms windows so the player can
        # SEE that they were hit and that they are currently safe.
        # update_iframes(dt) must be called every frame from each mission's
        # game_update() to advance the timer + blink.
        self.invincible_timer = 0.0
        self.visible = True
        # IFRAME_DURATION is the total invincibility window in seconds.
        # 0.75s matches the AEGIS reference value and feels right for a
        # tactical shooter where the player needs time to reposition after
        # a hit. Tune via the constant below - never inline a magic number.
        self.IFRAME_DURATION = 0.75
        # BLINK_PERIOD_MS drives the sprite-flash cadence. 60ms ≈ 4 frames
        # at 60 FPS, so the sprite blinks ~8 times during the 0.75s window.
        self.BLINK_PERIOD_MS = 60
        # ── Cosmetic loadout ────────────────────────────────────────────
        # Resolved once here rather than per draw call: a match has up to eight
        # sprites on screen and the palette cannot change mid-frame. None is
        # the legacy look, so every existing Player(0, 0) site - campaign and
        # arena - keeps drawing exactly what it drew before.
        self.look = None
        self.set_appearance(appearance)

    def set_appearance(self, app):
        """Freeze *app* into the RGB roles this sprite draws with.

        Call on change only. The arena caches one Player per slot and reuses
        that slot as humans join and leave, so this has to be re-runnable on an
        existing sprite rather than only settable at construction; a sprite
        that kept the previous occupant's colours would be a cosmetic bug that
        reads as a cheat.
        """
        self.look = _appearance.normalize(app)
        self._rk = _appearance.resolve(self.look)
        self._rigs = self._rk["rigs"]
        self.look_key = _appearance.key_of(self.look)

    def take_damage(self, amount, force=False):
        """Apply damage to the player, respecting the i-frame window.

        Per AEGIS references/game-design.md. Returns True if damage was
        applied, False if blocked by i-frames. Callers may use the return
        value to decide whether to spawn blood particles / floating text
        / trigger hit-stop (a hit absorbed by i-frames should NOT produce
        a feedback burst, otherwise the player thinks they were hit).

        ``force=True`` bypasses i-frames - use ONLY for set-piece damage
        that the player cannot dodge and that the narrative requires to
        land (e.g. the Mission 2 sniper intro shot, the tanker blast
        during a scripted trigger). Tactical combat damage must always
        go through the default path so i-frames can do their job.
        """
        if not force and self.invincible_timer > 0:
            return False
        self.hp -= amount
        self.invincible_timer = self.IFRAME_DURATION
        # Force the first blink frame to be invisible so the hit is
        # immediately readable (otherwise the first 60ms shows the sprite
        # normally and the player doesn't realize i-frames started).
        self.visible = False
        return True

    def update_iframes(self, dt):
        """Advance the i-frame timer + sprite blink. Call every frame.

        Per AEGIS spec: visible = (int(timer_ms) // BLINK_PERIOD_MS) % 2 == 0.
        When the timer expires, visibility is restored to True.
        """
        if self.invincible_timer > 0:
            self.invincible_timer -= dt
            if self.invincible_timer <= 0:
                self.invincible_timer = 0.0
                self.visible = True
            else:
                # Blink: visible only on alternating ~BLINK_PERIOD_MS windows.
                timer_ms = int(self.invincible_timer * 1000)
                self.visible = (timer_ms // self.BLINK_PERIOD_MS) % 2 == 0
        else:
            self.visible = True

    def move(self, dx, dy, walls):
        ox, oy = self.rect.centerx, self.rect.centery
        self.rect.x += dx
        for wall in walls:
            if self.rect.colliderect(wall):
                if dx > 0:
                    self.rect.right = wall.left
                if dx < 0:
                    self.rect.left = wall.right
        self.rect.y += dy
        for wall in walls:
            if self.rect.colliderect(wall):
                if dy > 0:
                    self.rect.bottom = wall.top
                if dy < 0:
                    self.rect.top = wall.bottom
        # ── Footsteps: distance-based cadence, material-aware timbre ──
        moved = math.hypot(self.rect.centerx - ox, self.rect.centery - oy)
        if moved > 0.5:
            self._step_timer -= moved
            if self._step_timer <= 0:
                mat = material_at(self.rect.centerx, self.rect.centery,
                                  getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1"))
                prefix, count = footstep_prefix(mat)
                audio.play_random(prefix, count, volume=0.55)
                self._step_timer = 34.0 + _rng_legacy.randint(0, 8)
        else:
            self._step_timer = min(self._step_timer, 6.0)

    def rig_weapon_name(self):
        """Which gun silhouette to draw: "pistol" / "os12" / "k9_smg".

        A per-instance override wins when set, so a multiplayer process can
        draw a player holding the OS-12 the same frame it draws one holding
        the pistol. With no override this falls straight back to the mission
        global, exactly as every existing call site already assumed.
        """
        override = getattr(self, "rig_weapon", None)
        if override:
            return override
        return getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol")

    def barrel_tip(self):
        """World-space muzzle position - matches the gun drawing proportions."""
        a = self.angle

        current_weapon = self.rig_weapon_name()
        if current_weapon == "os12":
            arm_len = 16
            grip_offset = 4
            gun_len = 26
            muzzle_extra = 3
        elif current_weapon == "k9_smg":
            arm_len = 16
            grip_offset = 4
            gun_len = 18
            muzzle_extra = 5  # compact suppressor
        else:
            arm_len = 16
            grip_offset = 4
            gun_len = 17
            muzzle_extra = 2

        reach = arm_len + grip_offset + gun_len + muzzle_extra
        return (
            self.rect.centerx + math.cos(a) * reach,
            self.rect.centery + math.sin(a) * reach,
        )

    def draw(
        self,
        surface,
        offset_x,
        offset_y,
        walls=(),
        reload_active=False,
        reload_progress=0.0,
        melee_active=False,
        melee_progress=0.0,
        no_gun=False,
        is_moving=False,
    ):
        global STATE
        # Cosmetic roles, resolved at set_appearance(). Every colour in this
        # method reads through these names instead of a literal, which is the
        # whole customization surface. The values for the default appearance
        # are the literals this method used to contain - see
        # core.appearance.BASE_ROLES and tools/avatar_parity.py.
        rk = self._rk
        # Mission-scoped story outfit (M5: the President's black). Opt-in per
        # instance - only the M5 draw sets story_outfit, so shop/arena
        # previews (fresh Player(0, 0)s) never pick it up. Layered on top of
        # the resolved roles and cached per (look, outfit); the saved
        # appearance in self.look/self._rk is never touched.
        outfit = getattr(self, "story_outfit", None)
        mark = None
        if outfit:
            ck = getattr(self, "_outfit_rk", None)
            if ck is None or ck[0] != (self.look_key, outfit):
                ck = ((self.look_key, outfit), _outfits.overlay_roles(rk, outfit))
                self._outfit_rk = ck
            rk = ck[1]
            mark = _outfits.GAMEPLAY_MARK
        u = rk["uniform"]
        skin = rk["skin"]
        draw_x = self.rect.centerx - offset_x
        draw_y = self.rect.centery - offset_y

        if is_moving and not self.was_moving:
            self.walk_cycle = 0.0
        self.was_moving = is_moving

        self.breathing = 0.0 if _frozen() else math.sin(time.time() * 0.5) * 1.0
        draw_y += self.breathing

        # ── Walk bob ──
        if is_moving:
            self.walk_cycle += 0.12
        else:
            self.walk_cycle *= 0.85
        sway_offset = 0.0

        # ── Recoil ──
        if self._recoil_timer > 0:
            self._recoil_timer -= 1
            self._recoil_offset = -3.0 * (self._recoil_timer / 8.0)
        else:
            self._recoil_offset *= 0.8

        if self._slide_timer > 0:
            self._slide_timer -= 1
        self.blink_timer += 1
        blinking = 2 if (120 < self.blink_timer < 140) else 0
        if self.blink_timer > 140:
            self.blink_timer = 0
        a = self.angle
        d_x = math.cos(a)
        d_y = math.sin(a)
        perp_x = math.cos(a + math.pi / 2)
        perp_y = math.sin(a + math.pi / 2)

        arm_angle = a
        if is_moving:
            # Weapon hand lags behind direction changes
            arm_angle += sway_offset * 0.06
        if reload_active:
            p = reload_progress
            _cw_reload = self.rig_weapon_name()
            _is_os12_reload = _cw_reload == "os12"
            _is_k9_reload = _cw_reload == "k9_smg"

            if _is_os12_reload:
                # OS 12 mag-swap reload
                # 0.00–0.30: rifle tilts, mag drops
                # 0.30–0.60: held empty
                # 0.60–1.00: new mag rocks in, rifle returns
                if p < 0.30:
                    t = p / 0.30
                    arm_factor = 1.0 - t * 0.25
                    arm_angle = a + t * 0.45
                elif p < 0.60:
                    t = (p - 0.30) / 0.30
                    arm_factor = 0.75
                    tremor = math.sin(p * math.pi * 8) * 0.03
                    arm_angle = a + 0.45 + tremor
                else:
                    t = (p - 0.60) / 0.40
                    ease = 1.0 - (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t)
                    arm_factor = 0.75 + ease * 0.25
                    arm_angle = a + (0.45 * (1.0 - ease))
            elif _is_k9_reload:
                # K-9 suppressed SMG reload - compact PDW tilts inward,
                # stick mag strips out, palm-slap seats the fresh mag, then
                # the muzzle snaps back up. More mechanical than the pistol,
                # less heavy than the OS-12.
                if p < 0.22:
                    t = p / 0.22
                    arm_factor = 1.0 - t * 0.38
                    arm_angle = a + t * 0.62
                elif p < 0.58:
                    t = (p - 0.22) / 0.36
                    arm_factor = 0.62
                    arm_angle = a + 0.62 + math.sin(t * math.pi * 2) * 0.035
                elif p < 0.78:
                    t = (p - 0.58) / 0.20
                    arm_factor = 0.62 + t * 0.20
                    arm_angle = a + 0.62 - t * 0.22
                else:
                    t = (p - 0.78) / 0.22
                    ease = 1.0 - (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t)
                    arm_factor = 0.82 + ease * 0.18
                    arm_angle = a + 0.40 * (1.0 - ease)
            else:
                # Pistol reload (unchanged)
                if p < 0.25:
                    arm_factor = 1.0 - (p / 0.25) * 0.5
                elif p < 0.75:
                    arm_factor = 0.5
                    wobble = math.sin(p * math.pi * 4) * 0.08
                    arm_angle = a + wobble
                else:
                    t = (p - 0.75) / 0.25
                    arm_factor = 0.5 + t * 0.5
                    wobble = math.sin(p * math.pi * 4) * 0.08 * (1.0 - t)
                    arm_angle = a + wobble
        elif melee_active:
            p = melee_progress
            current_weapon_for_melee = self.rig_weapon_name()
            if current_weapon_for_melee == "k9_smg":
                # K-9 melee: a compact buttstroke / muzzle shove. It should
                # feel different from the pistol slap and from improvised melee:
                # pull the gun across the body, snap forward, then settle.
                if p < 0.22:
                    t = p / 0.22
                    arm_factor = 0.88
                    arm_angle = a + 0.58 * t
                elif p < 0.58:
                    t = (p - 0.22) / 0.36
                    punch = 1.0 - (1.0 - t) * (1.0 - t)
                    arm_factor = 0.88 + punch * 0.55
                    arm_angle = a + 0.58 - punch * 0.92
                else:
                    t = (p - 0.58) / 0.42
                    arm_factor = 1.43 - t * 0.43
                    arm_angle = a - 0.34 * (1.0 - t)
            else:
                if p < 0.25:
                    t = p / 0.25
                    arm_factor = 1.0 - t * 0.6
                    arm_angle = a - t * math.pi / 4
                elif p < 0.75:
                    t = (p - 0.25) / 0.5
                    arm_factor = 0.4 + t * 0.8
                    arm_angle = a - math.pi / 4 + t * (math.pi / 4 + math.pi / 3)
                else:
                    t = (p - 0.75) / 0.25
                    arm_factor = 1.2 - t * 0.2
                    arm_angle = a + math.pi / 3 - t * math.pi / 3
        else:
            arm_factor = 1.0

        surface.blit(_player_shadow, (int(draw_x - 18), int(draw_y - 6)))
        # ── AEGIS i-frame blink (Pass E) ─────────────────────────────
        # Per references/game-design.md. While invincible_timer > 0, the
        # sprite blinks on/off at ~60ms windows. The shadow is ALWAYS drawn
        # so the player can still read their position; only the body blinks.
        # All per-frame state above (breathing, walk_cycle, recoil, blink)
        # has already advanced by this point, so timing stays correct.
        if not self.visible:
            return
        body_w, body_h = 22, 14
        cos_b, sin_b = math.cos(a), math.sin(a)
        torso_pts = []
        for bx, by in [
            (-body_w // 2, -body_h // 2),
            (body_w // 2, -body_h // 2),
            (body_w // 2, body_h // 2),
            (-body_w // 2, body_h // 2),
        ]:
            rx = bx * cos_b - by * sin_b
            ry = bx * sin_b + by * cos_b
            torso_pts.append((draw_x + rx, draw_y + ry))
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, u, torso_pts)
        cloth_edge = rk.get("cloth_edge")
        if cloth_edge:
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, cloth_edge, torso_pts, 1)
        if self.max_hp > 100:
            kevlar_w, kevlar_h = 16, 12
            kevlar_pts = []
            for bx, by in [
                (-kevlar_w // 2, -kevlar_h // 2),
                (kevlar_w // 2, -kevlar_h // 2),
                (kevlar_w // 2, kevlar_h // 2),
                (-kevlar_w // 2, kevlar_h // 2),
            ]:
                rx = bx * cos_b - by * sin_b
                ry = bx * sin_b + by * cos_b
                kevlar_pts.append((draw_x + rx, draw_y + ry))
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, rk["kevlar"], kevlar_pts)
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, rk["kevlar_edge"], kevlar_pts, 1)
            for off in (-5, 5):
                sx1 = draw_x + perp_x * off - d_x * 5
                sy1 = draw_y + perp_y * off - d_y * 5
                sx2 = draw_x + perp_x * off + d_x * 5
                sy2 = draw_y + perp_y * off + d_y * 5
                pygame.draw.line(surface, rk["kevlar_line"], (sx1, sy1), (sx2, sy2), 2)
            ridge_w, ridge_h = 8, 8
            ridge_pts = []
            for bx, by in [
                (-ridge_w // 2, -ridge_h // 2),
                (ridge_w // 2, -ridge_h // 2),
                (ridge_w // 2, ridge_h // 2),
                (-ridge_w // 2, ridge_h // 2),
            ]:
                rx = bx * cos_b - by * sin_b
                ry = bx * sin_b + by * cos_b
                ridge_pts.append((draw_x + rx, draw_y + ry))
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, rk["kevlar_ridge"], ridge_pts)
        # The spine highlight and the two vest straps are arithmetic shades of
        # the uniform, not palette entries of their own. Left as arithmetic on
        # purpose: a palette retint propagates to them for free, and the
        # default palette produces the identical expression the sprite used to
        # compute from the config constant.
        pygame.draw.line(
            surface,
            (u[0] + 12, u[1] + 12, u[2] + 8),
            (draw_x - d_x * 5, draw_y - d_y * 5),
            (draw_x + d_x * 5, draw_y + d_y * 5),
            2,
        )
        for off in (-6, 6):
            vx1 = draw_x + perp_x * off - d_x * 3
            vy1 = draw_y + perp_y * off - d_y * 3
            vx2 = draw_x + perp_x * off + d_x * 3
            vy2 = draw_y + perp_y * off + d_y * 3
            pygame.draw.line(
                surface,
                (u[0] - 8, u[1] - 5, u[2] - 3),
                (vx1, vy1),
                (vx2, vy2),
                2,
            )


        test_arm_len = int(16 * arm_factor)
        test_arm_dx = math.cos(arm_angle)
        test_arm_dy = math.sin(arm_angle)
        test_grip_x = draw_x + test_arm_dx * (test_arm_len + 4)
        test_grip_y = draw_y + test_arm_dy * (test_arm_len + 4)

        test_gun_end_x = test_grip_x + test_arm_dx * 16
        test_gun_end_y = test_grip_y + test_arm_dy * 16

        min_t = float("inf")
        if not no_gun and walls:
            for wall in walls:
                wr = pygame.Rect(
                    wall.x - offset_x, wall.y - offset_y, TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE
                )
                clipped = wr.clipline(
                    (test_grip_x, test_grip_y), (test_gun_end_x, test_gun_end_y)
                )
                if clipped:
                    ex, ey = clipped[0]
                    t = (ex - test_grip_x) * test_arm_dx + (
                        ey - test_grip_y
                    ) * test_arm_dy
                    if t < min_t:
                        min_t = t

        raise_factor = 0.0
        if not no_gun and min_t < 16:
            raise_factor = max(0.0, min(1.0, (16.0 - min_t) / 16.0))

        # ── Weapon swap animation: lower the gun fully at midpoint, raise back up ──
        # An ARMED per-instance timer (multiplayer) wins and is advanced here,
        # because no per-mission update loop exists to tick it. With none
        # armed this reads the campaign's global timer, whose countdown stays
        # the mission update's job -- so the two never fight over the clock.
        inst_timer = getattr(self, "swap_timer", 0)
        if inst_timer > 0:
            swap_timer = inst_timer
            swap_duration = getattr(self, "swap_duration", 24)
            self.swap_timer = inst_timer - 1
        else:
            swap_timer = getattr(STATE, "weapon_swap_timer", 0)
            swap_duration = getattr(STATE, "weapon_swap_duration", 24)
        if swap_timer > 0 and swap_duration > 0:
            # Progress: 0.0 -> 1.0 across the full swap
            progress = 1.0 - (swap_timer / swap_duration)
            # Triangle wave: 0 at start, 1 at midpoint, 0 at end
            if progress < 0.5:
                swap_factor = progress * 2.0          # lowering (0 -> 1)
            else:
                swap_factor = (1.0 - progress) * 2.0  # raising (1 -> 0)
            # Use the larger of the two so wall-lower still wins if both apply
            raise_factor = max(raise_factor, swap_factor)

        self.weapon_raised = raise_factor > 0.15

        arm_angle = arm_angle - raise_factor * (math.pi * 0.35)
        arm_factor = arm_factor * (1.0 - raise_factor * 0.4)

        arm_len = int(16 * arm_factor)
        arm_dx = math.cos(arm_angle)
        arm_dy = math.sin(arm_angle)
        arm_perp_x = math.cos(arm_angle + math.pi / 2)
        arm_perp_y = math.sin(arm_angle + math.pi / 2)

        ls_x = draw_x + perp_x * 12
        ls_y = draw_y + perp_y * 12
        rs_x = draw_x - perp_x * 12
        rs_y = draw_y - perp_y * 12
        hand_x = draw_x + arm_dx * arm_len
        hand_y = draw_y + arm_dy * arm_len
        # Sleeve rim (story outfits only - the saved/shop looks carry no
        # cloth_edge role, so their sprite is byte-identical). A near-black
        # sleeve on a near-black M5 floor vanishes and the skin grip + gun read
        # as floating off the body (polish Task 4); the 1 px rim keeps the arm
        # visibly connecting shoulder -> hands without changing the geometry.
        if cloth_edge:
            pygame.draw.line(surface, cloth_edge, (ls_x, ls_y),
                             (hand_x - arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y - arm_perp_y * 3), 7)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, cloth_edge, (rs_x, rs_y),
                             (hand_x + arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y + arm_perp_y * 3), 7)
        pygame.draw.line(
            surface,
            u,
            (ls_x, ls_y),
            (hand_x - arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y - arm_perp_y * 3),
            5,
        )
        pygame.draw.line(
            surface,
            u,
            (rs_x, rs_y),
            (hand_x + arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y + arm_perp_y * 3),
            5,
        )
        if mark:
            # identity yoke: a thin KRAP-blue bar on BOTH shoulders, over the
            # sleeve roots, from just outside the head/curls to the shoulder
            # point (never far past the torso, where it read as a crossbar).
            # Guard troopers carry only a short red band on one sleeve.
            # Deliberately thin, no shoulder discs: fat blue blobs read as a
            # blue uniform at 32 px.
            for sgn in (1, -1):
                pygame.draw.line(
                    surface, mark,
                    (draw_x + sgn * perp_x * 9, draw_y + sgn * perp_y * 9),
                    (draw_x + sgn * perp_x * 13, draw_y + sgn * perp_y * 13), 3)
        grip_x = draw_x + arm_dx * (arm_len + 4)
        grip_y = draw_y + arm_dy * (arm_len + 4)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, skin, (int(grip_x), int(grip_y)), 4)

        if not no_gun:
            # Rig geometry lives in entities/weapon_rig.py so the Outfitter can
            # draw a gun finish with no body attached. The values passed here
            # are exactly what the inline blocks used to close over.
            _weapon_rig.draw(surface, self.rig_weapon_name(), {
                "grip_x": grip_x, "grip_y": grip_y,
                "arm_dx": arm_dx, "arm_dy": arm_dy,
                "raise_factor": raise_factor,
                "reload_active": reload_active,
                "reload_progress": reload_progress,
            }, self._rigs)

        # Head last, so the shell overlaps the barrel the way it always did.
        _adornments.draw_head(
            surface,
            _adornments.head_context(draw_x, draw_y, d_x, d_y, a, blinking),
            rk, _outfits.gameplay_head(outfit, self.look["head"]),
        )

        # Rig anchors of THIS frame, in surface space: one shared record the
        # debug overlay, the weapon-grid tool and the smoke check all read, so
        # "is the gun in his hands" is measured on the numbers the draw used.
        self.rig_anchors = {
            "body": (draw_x, draw_y),
            "shoulder_l": (ls_x, ls_y), "shoulder_r": (rs_x, rs_y),
            "hand_l": (hand_x - arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y - arm_perp_y * 3),
            "hand_r": (hand_x + arm_perp_x * 3, hand_y + arm_perp_y * 3),
            "grip": (grip_x, grip_y), "arm_dir": (arm_dx, arm_dy),
        }
        if self.debug_rig or _debug_rig_env():
            _draw_rig_debug(surface, self.rig_anchors)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Melee resolver - shared between both missions.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Mission 1 originally rolled its own melee block (range 48, ±60° cone
# required, wall-LOS check, damage 80, shake 8, 8 particles).
# Mission 2 had its own (range 55, no cone, no LOS, damage 75, no shake,
# 12 particles). The two had drifted on every axis. This function is the
# single source of truth.

MELEE_RANGE = 52          # split the difference: 48 (M1) vs 55 (M2)
MELEE_DAMAGE = 78         # split: 80 (M1) vs 75 (M2)
MELEE_CONE_HALF_ANGLE = math.pi / 3   # ±60° - must face the enemy
MELEE_PARTICLE_COUNT = 10  # split: 8 (M1) vs 12 (M2)
MELEE_SHAKE = 8            # M1 had this; M2 lacked it. Always shake on hit.
# AEGIS Pass F: hit-stop duration (seconds) on a melee KILL. Per the AEGIS
# spec, 50ms is the canonical "heavy strike" freeze; a kill deserves the full
# 50ms because the player just ended a threat and the freeze gives them a
# beat to register the kill before the simulation resumes. Non-kill melee
# hits do NOT trigger hit-stop - that would make every melee swing feel
# sluggish. Only the killing blow gets the weight.
MELEE_KILL_HIT_STOP = 0.05


def resolve_melee(player, enemies, solid_walls, blood_color):
    """Resolve a melee swing on the closest enemy in range, in cone, in LOS.

    Returns the hit enemy (so the caller can do per-mission cleanup like
    keycard drops) or None.

    Caller is responsible for:
      - decrementing ``STATE.melee_timer`` and clearing ``STATE.melee_active``
      - setting ``STATE.melee_hit_done = True`` after a hit (and resetting
        it to False when the swing ends)
      - any per-mission flags (e.g. ``is_commander`` keycard drop)

    The caller invokes this only when ``not STATE.melee_hit_done`` and the
    swing has reached its hit frame (timer <= 10).
    """
    if player is None:
        return None
    px, py = player.rect.centerx, player.rect.centery
    nearest = None
    nearest_dist = float("inf")
    for e in enemies:
        dx = e.rect.centerx - px
        dy = e.rect.centery - py
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist >= MELEE_RANGE:
            continue
        # Must be facing the enemy (±60° cone around player.angle).
        angle_to_enemy = math.atan2(dy, dx)
        diff = abs(angle_to_enemy - player.angle)
        if diff > math.pi:
            diff = 2 * math.pi - diff
        if diff > MELEE_CONE_HALF_ANGLE:
            continue
        # No wall between player and enemy.
        hit_wall = False
        for wall in solid_walls:
            if wall.clipline((px, py), (e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery)):
                hit_wall = True
                break
        if hit_wall:
            continue
        if dist < nearest_dist:
            nearest = e
            nearest_dist = dist
    if nearest is None:
        return None

    # Capture HP before the hit so we can detect a kill below.
    hp_before = nearest.hp
    nearest.hp -= getattr(STATE, "melee_damage", MELEE_DAMAGE)
    # on_hit signature in Enemy: alerts and turns to face the attacker.
    nearest.on_hit(px, py)

    # Shared particle burst + shake (deferred import to avoid circular).
    from fx import effects
    effects.burst(nearest.rect.centerx, nearest.rect.centery,
                  blood_color, MELEE_PARTICLE_COUNT)
    effects.shake(MELEE_SHAKE)
    # AEGIS Pass F: 50ms hit-stop ONLY on a melee kill (hp was >0 before,
    # <=0 after). Non-kill hits don't freeze - keeps the swing snappy.
    if hp_before > 0 and nearest.hp <= 0:
        effects.hit_stop(MELEE_KILL_HIT_STOP)

    return nearest

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\entities\weapons.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------


"""Player weapons: pistol, melee, molotov cocktails, fire zones."""
import math
import random
from engine.core import LEGACY_RNG as _rng_legacy  # RPE5 R6: named 'legacy' rng stream
import pygame
from core.config import (
    WIDTH, HEIGHT, TILE_SIZE, audio, Particle, Casing, C_BLOOD,
    ENEMY_HEAR_RADIUS, get_scaled_mouse,
)
from core.state import STATE
from fx.effects import spawn_particles, shake, hit_stop
from core.user_settings import SETTINGS
from entities.art_cache import get_shadow, get_glow
MOLOTOV_RADIUS = 92
MOLOTOV_DURATION = 300
# Per-frame damage inside the fire zone. A molotov actually deals damage
# from two sources at once - the molotov_fires loop in mission2.py and the
# FireZone in weapons.py - so per-frame values must stay modest or the
# total adds up to an instant kill.
#
# Tuned values: a standard IPA grunt (115 HP) standing at the centre of
# the fire dies in ~1.8 seconds. An enemy skirting the outer edge can
# escape with light damage. The player takes ~7-8 seconds of full-burn
# exposure to lose half their HP.
MOLOTOV_ENEMY_DAMAGE = 0.6
MOLOTOV_PLAYER_DAMAGE = 0.35


def _mission2_actions_blocked():
    """Hard safety gate for authored Mission 2 beats.

    The main loop also blocks input, but weapon functions can be reached from
    multiple paths.  Keeping this guard here prevents shooting/reload/molotov
    leaks during sniper/blackout/cinematic locks.
    """
    if getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "") != "MISSION2":
        return False
    return (
        getattr(STATE, "mission2_card", None) is not None
        or getattr(STATE, "mission2_stage", "") in {"sniper", "blackout", "done"}
    )


def _player_disarmed():
    """True when the player has no weapon at all (e.g. Mission 3's cell,
    before the chair breaks). Blocks ALL weapon actions."""
    return bool(getattr(STATE, "player_disarmed", False))


def _player_has_firearm():
    """True when the player has a ranged weapon (pistol / OS-12 / sidearm).

    M3's improvised weapons (chair_leg, shiv) are melee-only - they block
    shooting, reloading, molotovs, and weapon-switching. The player can
    only melee with them until they take a sidearm off a dead guard (which
    sets mission3_weapon to "sidearm" and re-enables ranged).
    """
    weapon = getattr(STATE, "mission3_weapon", "none")
    if weapon in ("chair_leg", "shiv"):
        return False
    if weapon == "sidearm":
        return True
    return not getattr(STATE, "player_disarmed", False)


class FireZone:
    """Persistent ground fire created by a Molotov impact."""
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        self.radius = 48
        self.life = 420
        self.max_life = 420
        self.damage_tick = 0
    def update(self, enemies, player_rect, audio_sys):
        self.life -= 1
        self.damage_tick += 1
        player_center = (player_rect.centerx, player_rect.centery) if player_rect else (self.x, self.y)
        if self.damage_tick >= 12:
            self.damage_tick = 0
            for e in enemies:
                if e.hp <= 0:
                    continue
                dist = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - self.x, e.rect.centery - self.y)
                if dist < self.radius:
                    dmg = 15 if dist < self.radius * 0.4 else 8
                    fire_mult = getattr(e, "fire_weakness", 1.0)
                    e.hp -= dmg * fire_mult
                    e.alerted = True
                    spark_count = 4 if getattr(e, "is_breach_enemy", False) else 3
                    for _ in range(spark_count):
                        STATE.particles.append(Particle(
                            e.rect.centerx + _rng_legacy.randint(-6, 6),
                            e.rect.centery + _rng_legacy.randint(-6, 6),
                            (255, _rng_legacy.randint(80, 210), 0)
                        ))
        if _rng_legacy.random() < 0.04 and audio_sys:
            audio_sys.play_3d("explosion", (self.x, self.y), player_center, base_volume=0.08)
        return self.life > 0
    def draw(self, surface, cam_x, cam_y):
        sx = int(self.x - cam_x)
        sy = int(self.y - cam_y)
        if not (-self.radius - 60 < sx < WIDTH + self.radius + 60 and
                -self.radius - 60 < sy < HEIGHT + self.radius + 60):
            return
        life_ratio = max(0.0, self.life / self.max_life)
        flicker = 0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(pygame.time.get_ticks() * 0.018)
        # Scorched irregular ground patch
        scorch = pygame.Surface((self.radius * 3, self.radius * 3), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        cx = cy = self.radius * 3 // 2
        rng = random.Random(int(self.x * 13 + self.y * 7))
        points = []
        for i in range(18):
            ang = i / 18.0 * math.pi * 2
            rr = self.radius * rng.uniform(0.75, 1.25)
            points.append((cx + math.cos(ang) * rr, cy + math.sin(ang) * rr * 0.72))
        pygame.draw.polygon(scorch, (10, 7, 5, int(115 * life_ratio)), points)
        pygame.draw.polygon(scorch, (45, 22, 8, int(80 * life_ratio)), points, 2)
        surface.blit(scorch, (sx - cx, sy - cy))
        # Low orange glow, not a giant perfect circle
        glow = pygame.Surface((self.radius * 3, self.radius * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for r, a in [
            (self.radius + 25, 24),
            (self.radius, 40),
            (self.radius - 20, 65),
        ]:
            if r > 0:
                pygame.draw.ellipse(
                    glow,
                    (255, 95, 20, int(a * life_ratio * flicker)),
                    (
                        self.radius * 3 // 2 - r,
                        self.radius - int(r * 0.45),
                        r * 2,
                        int(r * 0.9),
                    ),
                )
        surface.blit(glow, (sx - self.radius * 3 // 2, sy - self.radius))
        # Pixel flame tongues
        flame_count = int(9 * life_ratio) + 3
        for i in range(flame_count):
            seed = i * 31
            ang = seed * 0.77 + math.sin(pygame.time.get_ticks() * 0.004 + i)
            rr = self.radius * (0.15 + (i % 5) * 0.13)
            fx = sx + math.cos(ang) * rr
            fy = sy + math.sin(ang) * rr * 0.55
            h = int((18 + (i % 4) * 5) * life_ratio * flicker)
            w = max(4, h // 3)
            outer = [
                (fx, fy - h),
                (fx - w, fy + h * 0.25),
                (fx + w, fy + h * 0.25),
            ]
            inner = [
                (fx, fy - h * 0.6),
                (fx - w * 0.45, fy + h * 0.05),
                (fx + w * 0.45, fy + h * 0.05),
            ]
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (255, 85, 18), outer)
            pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (255, 205, 80), inner)
        # Smoke wisps
        if life_ratio > 0.2:
            for i in range(5):
                drift = math.sin(pygame.time.get_ticks() * 0.002 + i) * 12
                smoke_x = sx + int(drift) + (i - 2) * 12
                smoke_y = sy - 35 - i * 8
                sr = 7 + i
                smoke_a = int(32 * life_ratio)
                sm = pygame.Surface((sr * 2, sr * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
                pygame.draw.circle(sm, (45, 43, 40, smoke_a), (sr, sr), sr)
                surface.blit(sm, (smoke_x - sr, smoke_y - sr))
        if life_ratio > 0.15:
            for _ in range(2):
                smoke_x = sx + _rng_legacy.randint(-int(self.radius * 0.5), int(self.radius * 0.5))
                smoke_y = sy - _rng_legacy.randint(10, 35)
                smoke_r = _rng_legacy.randint(4, 10)
                smoke_a = int(40 * life_ratio)
                smoke_s = pygame.Surface((smoke_r * 2, smoke_r * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
                pygame.draw.circle(smoke_s, (50, 45, 40, smoke_a),
                                   (smoke_r, smoke_r), smoke_r)
                surface.blit(smoke_s, (smoke_x - smoke_r, smoke_y - smoke_r))
def _wall_blocks_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, solid_walls):
    for w in solid_walls:
        if w.clipline((x1, y1), (x2, y2)):
            return True
    return False
def _solid_walls():
    out = list(STATE.walls)
    for d in STATE.doors:
        if d.collision_rect:
            out.append(d.collision_rect)
    return out
def start_reload():
    if _mission2_actions_blocked():
        return
    if _player_disarmed():
        return
    if not _player_has_firearm():
        return   # melee-only weapon - no gun to reload
    current_weapon = getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol")
    is_os12 = current_weapon == "os12"
    is_k9 = current_weapon == "k9_smg"

    if is_os12:
        if (STATE.os12_spare_mags <= 0
                or STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag == STATE.os12_mag_size
                or STATE.is_reloading):
            return
        STATE.is_reloading = True
        STATE.reload_timer = 90  # heavier gun, slower reload
        audio.play("reload", volume=0.6)
    elif is_k9:
        if (getattr(STATE, "k9_spare_mags", 0) <= 0
                or getattr(STATE, "k9_ammo_in_mag", 0) == getattr(STATE, "k9_mag_size", 24)
                or STATE.is_reloading):
            return
        STATE.is_reloading = True
        STATE.reload_timer = 72  # unique SMG mag-pull / palm-slap reload
        audio.play("reload", volume=0.52)
    else:
        if (STATE.spare_mags <= 0
                or STATE.ammo_in_mag == STATE.mag_size
                or STATE.is_reloading):
            return
        STATE.is_reloading = True
        STATE.reload_timer = 60
        audio.play("reload", volume=0.6)

    if STATE.player:
        for _ in range(6):
            STATE.particles.append(Particle(
                STATE.player.rect.centerx + _rng_legacy.randint(-6, 6),
                STATE.player.rect.centery + _rng_legacy.randint(-4, 4),
                (160, 155, 140),
            ))
def handle_shoot():
    from entities.enemy_ai import enemy_hear_shot
    if _mission2_actions_blocked():
        return
    if _player_disarmed():
        return
    if not _player_has_firearm():
        # Mission 3 improvised weapons are melee-only. Let left-click use
        # the equipped chair leg / shiv instead of silently doing nothing.
        if getattr(STATE, "mission3_weapon", "none") in ("chair_leg", "shiv"):
            handle_melee()
        return   # melee-only weapon - no gun to fire
    current_weapon = getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol")
    is_os12 = current_weapon == "os12"
    is_k9 = current_weapon == "k9_smg"

    # Pick the right ammo/cooldown state for the active weapon
    if is_os12:
        ammo = STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag
        cooldown = STATE.os12_shot_cooldown
    elif is_k9:
        ammo = getattr(STATE, "k9_ammo_in_mag", 0)
        cooldown = getattr(STATE, "k9_shot_cooldown", 0)
    else:
        ammo = STATE.ammo_in_mag
        cooldown = STATE.shot_cooldown

    if (STATE.player_dead or not STATE.player
            or STATE.is_reloading or cooldown > 0):
        return
    if getattr(STATE.player, "weapon_raised", False):
        return
    # Block firing during weapon swap animation
    if getattr(STATE, "weapon_swap_timer", 0) > 0:
        return
    if ammo <= 0:
        audio.play("empty_click", volume=0.5)
        # Auto-reload (Gameplay → Auto-Reload setting) - only if user opted in
        # and the player has spare magazines.
        if SETTINGS.auto_reload:
            if is_os12 and STATE.os12_spare_mags > 0:
                start_reload()
            elif is_k9 and getattr(STATE, "k9_spare_mags", 0) > 0:
                start_reload()
            elif not is_os12 and not is_k9 and STATE.spare_mags > 0:
                start_reload()
        return

    p = STATE.player

    # ── Aim assist (Gameplay → Aim Assist setting) ──
    # Snap the player's aim slightly toward the closest visible enemy that's
    # already near the cursor line. Magnet strength is small (~6° max swing)
    # so it feels like a forgiveness window, not auto-targeting.
    if SETTINGS.aim_assist and STATE.enemies:
        best = None
        best_diff = math.radians(7.0)  # 7° cone
        px, py = p.rect.centerx, p.rect.centery
        cur_angle = p.angle
        solid = _solid_walls()
        for e in STATE.enemies:
            if e.hp <= 0:
                continue
            ex, ey = e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery
            dist = math.hypot(ex - px, ey - py)
            if dist > 500 or dist < 40:
                continue
            target_angle = math.atan2(ey - py, ex - px)
            # Wrap-around safe angle diff
            diff = math.atan2(math.sin(target_angle - cur_angle),
                              math.cos(target_angle - cur_angle))
            adiff = abs(diff)
            if adiff < best_diff and not _wall_blocks_line(px, py, ex, ey, solid):
                best_diff = adiff
                best = (target_angle, diff)
        if best is not None:
            # Pull halfway toward the target (smooth, not snap)
            p.angle = cur_angle + best[1] * 0.5

    if hasattr(p, "barrel_tip"):
        bx, by = p.barrel_tip()
    else:
        bx = p.rect.centerx + math.cos(p.angle) * 39
        by = p.rect.centery + math.sin(p.angle) * 39

    # OS 12: slightly slower bullet, longer range.
    # Damage history:
    #   35 (original)  - trivialized M2, killed anything in 3-4 shots.
    #   22 (nerf #1)   - overcorrected, felt too weak (6 shots per grunt,
    #                    5 per reinforcement, mag emptied after 3 kills).
    #   28 (current)   - middle ground. 115-HP grunt takes 5 shots, 100-HP
    #                    reinforcement takes 4. With 25-round mag = 5 clean
    #                    kills per mag. Player must aim but isn't punished
    #                    for spraying under pressure.
    # Mag size history: 30 → 20 → 25 (same middle-ground logic).
    # Spare mags: capped at exactly 2 from pickup, no mid-mission rewards -
    # ammo scarcity is the design tension that makes the OS-12 feel earned.
    if is_os12:
        bullet_speed = 22
        bullet_life = 24
        bullet_damage = 28
    elif is_k9:
        bullet_speed = 25
        bullet_life = 18
        bullet_damage = 18
    else:
        bullet_speed = 24
        bullet_life = 20
        bullet_damage = 50

    STATE.bullets.append({
        "x": bx, "y": by,
        "prev_x": bx, "prev_y": by,
        "dx": math.cos(p.angle) * bullet_speed,
        "dy": math.sin(p.angle) * bullet_speed,
        "life": bullet_life,
        "owner": "player",
        "damage": bullet_damage,
    })
    solid_for_noise = _solid_walls()
    if is_k9:
        # Suppressed, not silent: only nearby guards with a clear acoustic path
        # react. Keeps the K-9 useful in the black-site without making it magic.
        for e in STATE.enemies:
            if math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - bx, e.rect.centery - by) <= ENEMY_HEAR_RADIUS * 0.45:
                if not _wall_blocks_line(bx, by, e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery, solid_for_noise):
                    e.hear_shot(bx, by, solid_for_noise)
    else:
        enemy_hear_shot(bx, by, STATE.enemies, solid_for_noise)

    if is_os12:
        shake(28)
        hit_stop(0.04)  # rifle weight: brief freeze so the shot lands heavy
        STATE.cam_kick_x = -math.cos(p.angle) * 30.0
        STATE.cam_kick_y = -math.sin(p.angle) * 30.0
        STATE.crosshair_kick = 9
    elif is_k9:
        shake(8)
        # No hit-stop on the suppressed SMG - it should feel fast, not heavy.
        STATE.cam_kick_x = -math.cos(p.angle) * 9.0
        STATE.cam_kick_y = -math.sin(p.angle) * 9.0
        STATE.crosshair_kick = 4
    else:
        shake(18)
        hit_stop(0.03)  # 2-frame punch on the trigger pull
        STATE.cam_kick_x = -math.cos(p.angle) * 20.0
        STATE.cam_kick_y = -math.sin(p.angle) * 20.0
        STATE.crosshair_kick = 6

    STATE.muzzle_flash_timer = 5 if is_os12 else (2 if is_k9 else 4)

    # Recoil
    if is_os12:
        p._recoil_timer = 12
        p._recoil_offset = -10.0
        p._slide_timer = 0  # no slide on a rifle
    elif is_k9:
        p._recoil_timer = 5
        p._recoil_offset = -3.5
        p._slide_timer = 0
    else:
        p._recoil_timer = 8
        p._recoil_offset = -6.0
        p._slide_timer = 6

    # Casing eject - OS 12 ejects further
    eject_offset = 13 if is_os12 else 10
    STATE.casings.append(Casing(
        p.rect.centerx + math.cos(p.angle) * 8
        + math.cos(p.angle - math.pi / 2) * eject_offset,
        p.rect.centery + math.sin(p.angle) * 8
        + math.sin(p.angle - math.pi / 2) * eject_offset,
        p.angle - math.pi / 2,
    ))

    # Consume ammo
    if is_os12:
        STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag -= 1
        STATE.os12_shot_cooldown = 8   # full-auto: ~7.5 shots/sec (~450 RPM, AK cadence)
    elif is_k9:
        STATE.k9_ammo_in_mag -= 1
        STATE.k9_shot_cooldown = 5     # compact SMG cadence (~720 RPM equivalent)
    else:
        STATE.ammo_in_mag -= 1
        STATE.shot_cooldown = 12       # semi-auto: ~5 shots/sec

    STATE.shots_fired += 1

    if is_os12:
        audio.play("gunshot", volume=0.8)  # louder, heavier
    elif is_k9:
        audio.play("gunshot", volume=0.34)  # suppressed SMG thump
    else:
        audio.play("gunshot", volume=0.7)

    # Auto-reload on empty (Gameplay → Auto-Reload)
    if SETTINGS.auto_reload:
        if is_os12 and STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag <= 0 and STATE.os12_spare_mags > 0:
            start_reload()
        elif is_k9 and STATE.k9_ammo_in_mag <= 0 and STATE.k9_spare_mags > 0:
            start_reload()
        elif not is_os12 and not is_k9 and STATE.ammo_in_mag <= 0 and STATE.spare_mags > 0:
            start_reload()
def handle_melee():
    if _mission2_actions_blocked():
        return
    if _player_disarmed():
        return
    if STATE.player_dead or not STATE.player or STATE.melee_active:
        return
    STATE.is_reloading = False
    STATE.reload_timer = 0
    STATE.melee_active = True
    # Melee timer + damage scale with the equipped weapon. The chair leg is
    # slow and blunt; the shiv is fast and piercing. Default (M1/M2) is the
    # original pistol-butt value.
    weapon = getattr(STATE, "mission3_weapon", "none")
    if weapon == "chair_leg":
        STATE.melee_timer = 24
        STATE.melee_damage = 50
    elif weapon == "shiv":
        STATE.melee_timer = 14
        STATE.melee_damage = 85
    elif weapon == "k9_smg":
        # Quick buttstroke / muzzle shove with the compact SMG.
        STATE.melee_timer = 20
        STATE.melee_damage = 62
    else:
        STATE.melee_timer = 18
        STATE.melee_damage = 78
    STATE.melee_duration = STATE.melee_timer   # lets draw code compute 0..1 swing progress
    STATE.melee_hit_done = False
    audio.play("melee_hit", volume=0.6)
def handle_throw_bottle():
    if _mission2_actions_blocked():
        return
    if _player_disarmed():
        return
    if not _player_has_firearm():
        return   # melee-only weapon - no molotovs
    if STATE.player_dead or not STATE.player:
        return
    if STATE.player_bottles <= 0:
        STATE.floating_texts.append([
            STATE.player.rect.centerx,
            STATE.player.rect.centery - 40,
            "NO MOLOTOVS", (220, 60, 60), 60,
        ])
        return
    mx, my = get_scaled_mouse()
    world_mx = mx + STATE.camera_x
    world_my = my + STATE.camera_y
    dx = world_mx - STATE.player.rect.centerx
    dy = world_my - STATE.player.rect.centery
    dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if dist > 400:
        world_mx = STATE.player.rect.centerx + (dx / dist) * 400
        world_my = STATE.player.rect.centery + (dy / dist) * 400
    STATE.player_bottles -= 1
    STATE.thrown_bottles.append({
        "x": STATE.player.rect.centerx,
        "y": STATE.player.rect.centery,
        "start_x": STATE.player.rect.centerx,
        "start_y": STATE.player.rect.centery,
        "tx": world_mx, "ty": world_my,
        "t": 0.0, "speed": 0.035,
        "spin": _rng_legacy.uniform(0, 360),
    })
    audio.play("molotov_throw", volume=0.6)
def spawn_molotov_fire(tx, ty, solid_walls):
    STATE.molotov_fires.append({
        "x": tx, "y": ty,
        "life": MOLOTOV_DURATION,
        "max_life": MOLOTOV_DURATION,
    })
    STATE.fire_zones.append(FireZone(tx, ty))
    shake(12)
    listener = ((STATE.player.rect.centerx, STATE.player.rect.centery)
                if STATE.player else (tx, ty))
    audio.play_3d("molotov_explode", (tx, ty), listener, base_volume=0.9)
    # ── Impact burst ──
    for _ in range(40): spawn_particles(tx, ty, (255, 200, 80), 1)
    for _ in range(30): spawn_particles(tx, ty, (255, 120, 35), 1)
    for _ in range(24): spawn_particles(tx, ty, (80, 75, 70), 1)
    for _ in range(15): spawn_particles(tx, ty, (190, 220, 190), 1)
    # Fire bloom ring expands outward
    for ring_r in range(10, 80, 8):
        for ang in range(0, 360, 30):
            ang_r = math.radians(ang)
            px = tx + math.cos(ang_r) * ring_r
            py = ty + math.sin(ang_r) * ring_r
            STATE.particles.append(Particle(px, py, (255, _rng_legacy.randint(80, 180), 0)))
            STATE.particles[-1].life = _rng_legacy.randint(12, 24)
            STATE.particles[-1].dy -= _rng_legacy.uniform(0.5, 1.5)
    for e in STATE.enemies:
        d = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - tx, e.rect.centery - ty)
        if d < MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 2.4 and not _wall_blocks_line(
                tx, ty, e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery, solid_walls):
            e.alerted = True
            e.last_seen_pos = (tx, ty)
            if d < MOLOTOV_RADIUS:
                e.state = "CHASE"
            elif e.state in ("IDLE", "PATROL"):
                e.state = "SEARCH"
                e.search_timer = 240
                e.distraction_target = (tx, ty)
                e.path = []


def update_molotovs(solid_walls, player_damage_allowed=True):
    """Advance the molotov system one frame: bottle flight + ground fire.

    Lifted verbatim from Mission 1's ``game_update`` so every mission runs
    the *same* molotov: the in-flight bottle tracks toward its target and
    detonates on walls, then each fire burns for its lifetime dealing
    heat-scaled damage, spawning embers, and alerting/distracting guards
    (a fire only pulls an uncommitted guard into SEARCH - it never yanks
    a guard already in CHASE/ATTACK away from the player).

    ``player_damage_allowed`` lets a mission suspend the player's own burn
    damage during authored locked beats (Mission 2's sniper / blackout /
    mission cards) without altering any other behavior. Missions that do
    not pass it keep Mission 1's exact handling.

    Returns ``True`` when the player took fire damage this frame.
    """
    player_hit = False

    # ── Bottles in flight: travel toward the target, stop at walls ──
    for b in STATE.thrown_bottles[:]:
        prev_x, prev_y = b["x"], b["y"]
        b["t"] = min(1.0, b["t"] + b["speed"])
        new_x = b["start_x"] + (b["tx"] - b["start_x"]) * b["t"]
        new_y = b["start_y"] + (b["ty"] - b["start_y"]) * b["t"]
        hit_wall = False
        impact_x, impact_y = new_x, new_y
        # Molotov cannot pass through STATE.walls / closed STATE.doors
        for wall in solid_walls:
            clipped = wall.clipline((prev_x, prev_y), (new_x, new_y))
            if clipped:
                impact_x, impact_y = clipped[0]
                hit_wall = True
                break
        if b["t"] >= 1.0 or hit_wall:
            spawn_molotov_fire(impact_x, impact_y, solid_walls)
            STATE.thrown_bottles.remove(b)
        else:
            b["x"] = new_x
            b["y"] = new_y

    # ── Molotov fire damage ──
    for fire in STATE.molotov_fires[:]:
        fire["life"] -= 1
        fx, fy = fire["x"], fire["y"]
        if _rng_legacy.random() < 0.75:
            px = fx + _rng_legacy.uniform(-MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.55, MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.55)
            py = fy + _rng_legacy.uniform(-MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.55, MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.55)
            if math.hypot(px - fx, py - fy) < MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.65:
                col = _rng_legacy.choice([(255, 95, 25), (255, 150, 40), (255, 210, 80), (80, 70, 65)])
                p = Particle(px, py, col)
                p.dy -= _rng_legacy.uniform(1.0, 2.4)
                p.dx *= 0.35
                p.life = _rng_legacy.randint(18, 34)
                STATE.particles.append(p)
        for e in STATE.enemies:
            dist = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - fx, e.rect.centery - fy)
            if dist < MOLOTOV_RADIUS and not _wall_blocks_line(
                fx, fy, e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery, solid_walls
            ):
                heat = 1.0 - dist / MOLOTOV_RADIUS
                fire_mult = getattr(e, "fire_weakness", 1.0)
                e.hp -= MOLOTOV_ENEMY_DAMAGE * (0.45 + heat) * fire_mult
                if getattr(e, "is_breach_enemy", False) and _rng_legacy.random() < 0.018:
                    STATE.particles.append(Particle(e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery, (255, 190, 70)))
                e.alerted = True
                e.combat_alert_timer = max(getattr(e, "combat_alert_timer", 0), 300)
                # Fire should alert enemies, but it should NOT constantly overwrite
                # their target if they can already see the player.
                if STATE.player:
                    ptx = STATE.player.rect.centerx
                    pty = STATE.player.rect.centery
                    can_see_player = not _wall_blocks_line(
                        e.rect.centerx,
                        e.rect.centery,
                        ptx,
                        pty,
                        solid_walls,
                    )
                else:
                    can_see_player = False
                if can_see_player:
                    e.last_seen_pos = (ptx, pty)
                    # Don't constantly knock enemies out of ATTACK flow.
                    if e.state not in ("ATTACK", "CHASE"):
                        e.state = "CHASE"
                else:
                    # Fire is only a distraction if they are not already committed.
                    if e.state in ("IDLE", "PATROL"):
                        e.state = "SEARCH"
                        e.distraction_target = (fx, fy)
                        e.search_timer = max(getattr(e, "search_timer", 0), 120)
                if _rng_legacy.random() < 0.12:
                    STATE.particles.append(
                        Particle(e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery, (255, 110, 30))
                    )
        if player_damage_allowed and STATE.player and not STATE.player_dead:
            pdist = math.hypot(STATE.player.rect.centerx - fx, STATE.player.rect.centery - fy)
            player_burn_radius = MOLOTOV_RADIUS * 0.72
            if pdist < player_burn_radius and not _wall_blocks_line(
                fx, fy, STATE.player.rect.centerx, STATE.player.rect.centery, solid_walls
            ):
                heat = 1.0 - pdist / player_burn_radius
                # Route through take_damage() so i-frames apply. Molotov burns
                # tick every frame; without i-frames the player could lose
                # 100+ HP in a single step into a fire zone.
                if STATE.player.take_damage(MOLOTOV_PLAYER_DAMAGE * (0.35 + heat)):
                    player_hit = True
        if fire["life"] <= 0:
            STATE.molotov_fires.remove(fire)

    # Process active fire zones (persistent ground fire spawned on impact)
    if STATE.player and not STATE.player_dead:
        STATE.fire_zones[:] = [fz for fz in STATE.fire_zones if fz.update(
            STATE.enemies, STATE.player.rect, audio
        )]
    return player_hit


def draw_thrown_bottles(surface, cam_x, cam_y):
    """Draw molotovs currently in flight.

    Shared by every mission so the throw reads the same everywhere - a
    spinning bottle on a parabolic arc, a contact shadow that fades as it
    rises, a burning wick, and a short flame/smoke trail. Lifted verbatim
    from Mission 1's draw pass.
    """
    for b in STATE.thrown_bottles:
        t = b["t"]
        arc_height = 40
        arc_y_off = -math.sin(t * math.pi) * arc_height
        bx = b["x"] - cam_x
        by = b["y"] - cam_y + arc_y_off
        shadow_alpha = int(60 * (1 - abs(arc_y_off / arc_height)))
        shadow_surf = get_shadow(14, 5, 'ellipse', alpha=255)
        shadow_surf.set_alpha(shadow_alpha)
        surface.blit(shadow_surf, (int(bx - 7), int(b["y"] - cam_y - 2)))
        rot = b.get("spin", 0) + t * 900
        cos_r = math.cos(math.radians(rot))
        sin_r = math.sin(math.radians(rot))

        def _rot(lx, ly):
            return (
                bx + lx * cos_r - ly * sin_r,
                by + lx * sin_r + ly * cos_r,
            )

        # Molotov bottle silhouette
        bottle_pts = [
            _rot(-2.5, -12), _rot(2.5, -12),
            _rot(2.5, -8),
            _rot(1.5, -5),
            _rot(4.5, 0),
            _rot(4.5, 12),
            _rot(-4.5, 12),
            _rot(-4.5, 0),
            _rot(-1.5, -5),
            _rot(-2.5, -8),
        ]
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (95, 70, 35), bottle_pts)
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (210, 150, 60), bottle_pts, 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255, 120, 35), _rot(0, 1), _rot(0, 10), 3)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (255, 210, 110), _rot(-2.5, 0), _rot(-2.5, 8), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (70, 55, 35), _rot(0, -13), _rot(0, -19), 3)
        flame_tip = _rot(0, -27)
        flame_l = _rot(-5, -17)
        flame_r = _rot(5, -17)
        flame_mid_l = _rot(-2.5, -18)
        flame_mid_r = _rot(2.5, -18)
        flame_mid_t = _rot(0, -24)
        flame_glow = get_glow(15, (255, 100, 20), 80)
        surface.blit(flame_glow, (int(flame_tip[0] - 17), int(flame_tip[1] - 17)))
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (255, 80, 15), [flame_tip, flame_l, flame_r])
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (255, 220, 80), [flame_mid_t, flame_mid_l, flame_mid_r])
        for trail_i in range(5):
            trail_t = max(0, t - 0.025 * (trail_i + 1))
            trail_arc = -math.sin(trail_t * math.pi) * arc_height
            trail_x = b["start_x"] + (b["tx"] - b["start_x"]) * trail_t - cam_x
            trail_y = b["start_y"] + (b["ty"] - b["start_y"]) * trail_t - cam_y + trail_arc
            ta = 110 - trail_i * 18
            ts = pygame.Surface((10, 10), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            if trail_i < 2:
                pygame.draw.circle(ts, (255, 120, 30, ta), (5, 5), 4)
            else:
                pygame.draw.circle(ts, (70, 65, 60, ta), (5, 5), 4)
            surface.blit(ts, (int(trail_x - 5), int(trail_y - 5)))


def switch_weapon():
    """Toggle between pistol and OS 12 (Q key)."""
    if _player_disarmed():
        return
    if not _player_has_firearm():
        return   # melee-only weapon - nothing to switch to
    # Mission 3: pistol <-> K-9 swap once both are carried.
    if (getattr(STATE, "k9_unlocked", False)
            and getattr(STATE, "mission3_sidearm_acquired", False)):
        if getattr(STATE, "weapon_swap_timer", 0) > 0:
            return
        target = "k9_smg" if STATE.current_weapon == "pistol" else "pistol"
        STATE.weapon_swap_timer = STATE.weapon_swap_duration
        STATE.weapon_swap_pending = target
        STATE.weapon_swap_sound_played = False
        STATE.is_reloading = False
        STATE.reload_timer = 0
        return
    if not getattr(STATE, "os12_unlocked", False):
        return
    if STATE.is_reloading:
        return
    if STATE.player_dead or not STATE.player:
        return
    # Block if a swap is already in progress
    if getattr(STATE, "weapon_swap_timer", 0) > 0:
        return

    # Determine target weapon (flipped at midpoint, not immediately)
    target = "os12" if STATE.current_weapon == "pistol" else "pistol"

    # Kick off the swap animation
    STATE.weapon_swap_timer = STATE.weapon_swap_duration
    STATE.weapon_swap_pending = target
    STATE.weapon_swap_sound_played = False

    # Cancel any in-progress reload since we initiated a swap
    STATE.is_reloading = False
    STATE.reload_timer = 0

def __getattr__(name):
    """PEP 562 live view for rebound shared state (see _LIVE_STATE)."""
    if name in _LIVE_STATE:
        import sys as _sys2
        for _mod in _LIVE_MODULES:
            _m = _sys2.modules.get(_mod)
            if _m is not None and name in vars(_m):
                return vars(_m)[name]
    raise AttributeError(
        "module " + repr(__name__) + " has no attribute " + repr(name))

    if not ch or ch.isspace():
        return
    if idx % 2 != 0 and ch not in ".!?":
        return
    try:
        audio.play("type_tick", volume=volume)
    except Exception:
        pass

def _clamp_walk_camera():
    """Clamp the walk camera to the map bounds (M1/M2/M3 approach).

    Keeps the view inside the container-wall ring so the camera never
    shows the endless floor outside the dock walls.
    """
    global walk_camera_x, walk_camera_y
    max_x = max(0, len(walk_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE - WIDTH)
    max_y = max(0, len(walk_map) * TILE_SIZE - HEIGHT)
    walk_camera_x = max(0.0, min(max_x, walk_camera_x))
    walk_camera_y = max(0.0, min(max_y, walk_camera_y))
def _walk_update_render():
    """Compute the shake-displaced render camera from the follow camera.

    Mirrors core/camera.py: shake is sampled fresh each frame, decays, and
    is applied ONLY to the render position (never fed back into the follow
    lerp). The render position is clamped to the map bounds too, so shake
    near the walls can't expose the void outside them.
    """
    global walk_render_x, walk_render_y
    sx = sy = 0
    if not getattr(STATE, "reduced_motion", False) and STATE.screen_shake > 0:
        sx = _rng_legacy.randint(-STATE.screen_shake, STATE.screen_shake)
        sy = _rng_legacy.randint(-STATE.screen_shake, STATE.screen_shake)
        STATE.screen_shake = max(0, STATE.screen_shake - 1)
    max_x = max(0, len(walk_map[0]) * TILE_SIZE - WIDTH)
    max_y = max(0, len(walk_map) * TILE_SIZE - HEIGHT)
    walk_render_x = max(0, min(max_x, walk_camera_x + sx))
    walk_render_y = max(0, min(max_y, walk_camera_y + sy))
