def _draw_browser_generic_page(surface, rect, font_big, font, font_small):
    """Render a browser page from the BROWSER_PAGES dict (news/weather/forum/freedom)."""
    page_data = BROWSER_PAGES.get(_browser_page, BROWSER_PAGES["news"])
    title = page_data["title"]
    if title:
        # Chromatic aberration on the page title (bright text).
        title_w = font_big.size(title)[0]
        _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_big, title,
                             (rect.centerx - title_w // 2, rect.y + 16),
                             CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)
    # Content lines.
    y = rect.y + 50
    for prefix, text, color in page_data["lines"]:
        if not text and not prefix:
            y += 10
            continue
        if color is None:
            color = CRT_GREEN
        if prefix:
            # Prefix tag (e.g. "BREAKING", "ALERT") in a colored box.
            prefix_surf = font_small.render(prefix, True, CRT_BG)
            pw = prefix_surf.get_width() + 8
            tag_rect = pygame.Rect(rect.x + 20, y, pw, 16)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, color, tag_rect, border_radius=2)
            surface.blit(prefix_surf, (tag_rect.x + 4, tag_rect.y + 1))
            # Text after the tag.
            txt = font.render(text, True, color)
            surface.blit(txt, (rect.x + 20 + pw + 6, y))
        else:
            txt = font.render(text, True, color)
            surface.blit(txt, (rect.x + 20, y))
        y += 22


def _draw_file_picker(surface):
    """Phase 5: File picker in a Win XP-style window."""
    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 16, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 14)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 12)
    _draw_ipa_wallpaper(surface)
    win_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 340, 60, 680, 440)
    body_rect = _draw_xp_window(surface, win_rect, "Select Evidence Files", font, font_small)
    instr = font_small.render(f"Select all 3 files ({len(_file_picker_selected)}/3 selected)", True, CRT_GREEN)
    surface.blit(instr, (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 10))
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    for i, file in enumerate(EVIDENCE_FILES):
        row_y = body_rect.y + 40 + i * 40
        row_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.x + 12, row_y, body_rect.w - 24, 32)
        hovered = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        selected = i in _file_picker_selected
        if selected:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (12, 55, 28), row_rect, radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        elif hovered:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (8, 35, 18), row_rect, radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        else:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DARK, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        checkbox_rect = pygame.Rect(row_rect.x + 10, row_rect.centery - 8, 16, 16)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 15, 8), checkbox_rect, radius=2)
        border_col = CRT_BRIGHT if selected else (CRT_GREEN if hovered else CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, border_col, checkbox_rect, radius=2, width=1)
        if selected:
            pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (checkbox_rect.x + 3, checkbox_rect.centery), (checkbox_rect.x + 7, checkbox_rect.bottom - 3), 2)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (checkbox_rect.x + 7, checkbox_rect.bottom - 3), (checkbox_rect.right - 3, checkbox_rect.y + 3), 2)
        doc_x = row_rect.x + 36; doc_y = row_rect.centery - 12
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (8, 35, 18), [(doc_x, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 24), (doc_x, doc_y + 24)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CRT_GREEN, [(doc_x, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 24), (doc_x, doc_y + 24)], 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_GREEN, (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y + 4), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_GREEN, (doc_x + 14, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), 1)
        name = font.render(file["name"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if selected else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(name, (doc_x + 26, row_rect.centery - name.get_height() // 2))
        size = font_small.render(file["size"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        surface.blit(size, (row_rect.right - 180, row_rect.centery - size.get_height() // 2))
        desc = font_small.render(file["desc"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        surface.blit(desc, (row_rect.right - 140, row_rect.centery - desc.get_height() // 2))
    back_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.bottom - 38, 80, 28)
    _draw_xp_button(surface, back_rect, "[BACK]", font_small, hovered=back_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos))
    upload_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.centerx - 60, body_rect.bottom - 38, 120, 28)
    all_selected = len(_file_picker_selected) == 3
    _draw_xp_button(surface, upload_rect, "[UPLOAD]", font_small,
                     hovered=upload_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos) and all_selected,
                     enabled=all_selected, color=CRT_BRIGHT if all_selected else CRT_DARK)
    _draw_taskbar(surface, font_small)


def _draw_upload(surface):
    """Phase 6: Upload progress with rotating status messages + intrusion popups."""
    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 24, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)

    # Title (chromatic aberration - brightest text).
    title_w = font_big.size("TRANSMITTING EVIDENCE")[0]
    _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_big, "TRANSMITTING EVIDENCE",
                         (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2, 120), CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)

    # ── State broadcast countdown (top-right corner) ──
    secs = _state_broadcast_timer // 60
    mins = secs // 60
    rem_secs = secs % 60
    bc_text = font_small.render(f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}", True, CRT_AMBER)
    # Pulsing when under 60 seconds.
    if secs < 60 and (_state_broadcast_timer % 30) < 15:
        bc_text = font_small.render(f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}", True, CRT_RED)
    surface.blit(bc_text, (WIDTH - bc_text.get_width() - 20, 20))

    # Status message.
    status = UPLOAD_STATUS_MESSAGES[_upload_status_idx]
    status_surf = font.render(status, True, CRT_GREEN)
    surface.blit(status_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - status_surf.get_width() // 2, 180))

    # Progress bar.
    bar_w = 500
    bar_h = 24
    bar_x = WIDTH // 2 - bar_w // 2
    bar_y = 240
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BG, (bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h), 1)
    fill_w = int(bar_w * _upload_progress)
    if fill_w > 0:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bar_x, bar_y, fill_w, bar_h))
    pct = int(_upload_progress * 100)
    pct_text = font.render(f"{pct}%", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
    surface.blit(pct_text, (WIDTH // 2 - pct_text.get_width() // 2, bar_y + 30))

    # Status log.
    log_y = 320
    log_font = font_small
    shown_messages = UPLOAD_STATUS_MESSAGES[:_upload_status_idx + 1]
    for i, msg in enumerate(shown_messages):
        done = i < _upload_status_idx
        color = CRT_DIM_GREEN if done else CRT_BRIGHT
        prefix = "[OK] " if done else ">> "
        log_line = log_font.render(prefix + msg, True, color)
        surface.blit(log_line, (bar_x, log_y + i * 20))

    # ── IPA counter-intrusion popup ──
    # When active, pauses upload progress and shows a red modal demanding
    # the player click to reroute. Adds tension - "they're coming for you".
    if _upload_intrusion_active:
        # Dim the background.
        dim = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        dim.fill((40, 0, 0, 120))
        surface.blit(dim, (0, 0))
        # Modal window.
        mw, mh = 500, 180
        mx = WIDTH // 2 - mw // 2
        my = HEIGHT // 2 - mh // 2
        modal_rect = pygame.Rect(mx, my, mw, mh)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (20, 5, 5), modal_rect, radius=6)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_RED, modal_rect, radius=6, width=2)
        # Pulsing border.
        pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(_upload_intrusion_timer * 0.2)
        if pulse > 0.5:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (255, 100, 100), modal_rect, radius=6, width=1)
        # Title.
        intr_title = font_big.render("⚠ IPA FIREWALL TRACE", True, CRT_RED)
        surface.blit(intr_title, (mx + mw // 2 - intr_title.get_width() // 2, my + 16))
        # Body.
        intr_body = font.render("Counter-intrusion detected. Rerouting transmission.", True, CRT_AMBER)
        surface.blit(intr_body, (mx + mw // 2 - intr_body.get_width() // 2, my + 56))
        # Click hint.
        if (_upload_intrusion_timer % 30) < 15:
            hint = font_small.render("[CLICK] / [ANY KEY] TO REROUTE", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
            surface.blit(hint, (mx + mw // 2 - hint.get_width() // 2, my + 100))
    elif _upload_progress > 0.5:
        warn = font_small.render("IPA COUNTER-INTRUSION DETECTED - TRANSMISSION PROCEEDING", True, CRT_AMBER)
        surface.blit(warn, (WIDTH // 2 - warn.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT - 60))


def _draw_done(surface):
    """Phase 7: Upload complete - the payoff."""
    font_huge = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 36, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)

    # Big "UPLOAD COMPLETE" text (fades in, with chromatic aberration).
    fade = min(1.0, _done_timer / 30.0)
    title_w = font_huge.size("UPLOAD COMPLETE")[0]
    _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_huge, "UPLOAD COMPLETE",
                         (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2, 180), CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)
    # Apply fade by drawing a black overlay with inverse alpha.
    if fade < 1.0:
        fade_overlay = pygame.Surface((title_w + 10, font_huge.get_height() + 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        fade_overlay.fill((0, 0, 0, int(255 * (1 - fade))))
        surface.blit(fade_overlay, (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2 - 5, 178))

    # State broadcast countdown (still ticking - adds urgency even after upload).
    secs = _state_broadcast_timer // 60
    mins = secs // 60
    rem_secs = secs % 60
    bc_text = font_small.render(f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}", True, CRT_AMBER)
    surface.blit(bc_text, (WIDTH - bc_text.get_width() - 20, 20))

    # Sub-text.
    if _done_timer > 40:
        sub_lines = [
            "Evidence package transmitted to 7 mirror sites.",
            "Journalist contacts notified.",
            "The Route 12 conspiracy is now public record.",
        ]
        for i, line in enumerate(sub_lines):
            sub = font.render(line, True, CRT_GREEN)
            sub.set_alpha(min(255, (_done_timer - 40) * 8))
            surface.blit(sub, (WIDTH // 2 - sub.get_width() // 2, 260 + i * 30))

    # "Continue" hint.
    if _done_timer > 60:
        hint = font_small.render("[CLICK] / [ANY KEY] to continue", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        if (_done_timer % 30) < 15:
            surface.blit(hint, (WIDTH // 2 - hint.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT - 80))


def _draw_info(surface):
    """Info window for EVIDENCE / SYSTEM / LOGS icons.

    Now renders rich content:
      - evidence → file manager (tree + file list) OR document viewer (if _info_sub set)
      - system   → control panel grid OR sub-window (if _info_sub set)
      - logs     → waveform visualizer + scrolling radio log
    """
    # Defensive guard: if _info_content is None, fall back to desktop.
    if _info_content is None:
        global _os_phase
        _os_phase = PHASE_DESKTOP
        return

    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 16, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 12)

    # Draw the desktop wallpaper behind the window.
    _draw_ipa_wallpaper(surface)

    # Info window - centered, 560x460 (bigger for richer content).
    win_x = WIDTH // 2 - 280
    win_y = 100
    win_w, win_h = 560, 460
    win_rect = pygame.Rect(win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h)
    body_rect = _draw_xp_window(surface, win_rect, _get_info_title(), font, font_small)

    # Render the appropriate content.
    if _info_content == "evidence":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            _draw_evidence_document(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
        else:
            _draw_evidence_file_manager(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_content == "system":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            _draw_control_panel_sub(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
        else:
            _draw_control_panel_grid(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_content == "logs":
        _draw_logs_waveform(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)

    # Back button (when in a sub-view).
    if _info_sub is not None:
        back_rect = pygame.Rect(win_x + 12, win_y + win_h - 38, 80, 28)
        mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
        _draw_xp_button(surface, back_rect, "< BACK", font_small,
                        hovered=back_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos))

    # Hint.
    hint = font_small.render("[ESC] to close" + ("  ·  [ESC] back" if _info_sub else ""),
                             True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(hint, (body_rect.x + 100, win_y + win_h - 32))

    # Taskbar.
    _draw_taskbar(surface, font_small)


def _get_info_title():
    """Return the window title for the current info content/sub."""
    if _info_content == "evidence":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            doc = EVIDENCE_DOCS.get(_info_sub, {})
            return f"Evidence - {doc.get('title', _info_sub)}"
        return "Evidence - File Manager"
    elif _info_content == "system":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            for item in CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS:
                if item["id"] == _info_sub:
                    return f"Control Panel - {item['label']}"
            return "Control Panel"
        return "Control Panel"
    elif _info_content == "logs":
        return "Radio Transmission Logs"
    return "Info"


def _draw_evidence_file_manager(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Win-95 style file manager: tree pane (left) + file list (right)."""
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    # ── Left pane: folder tree ──
    tree_x = body_rect.x + 8
    tree_y = body_rect.y + 8
    tree_w = 140
    tree_h = body_rect.h - 16
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 15, 8), (tree_x, tree_y, tree_w, tree_h), radius=3)
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (tree_x, tree_y, tree_w, tree_h), radius=3, width=1)
    # Tree header.
    header = font_small.render("FOLDERS", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(header, (tree_x + 8, tree_y + 6))
    # Folders.
    folders = [
        ("C:\\EVIDENCE", True),  # expanded
        ("  decrees", False),
        ("  logs", False),
        ("  drafts", False),
        ("C:\\SYSTEM", False),
        ("  drivers", False),
        ("  config", False),
    ]
    fy = tree_y + 24
    for name, expanded in folders:
        is_active = name.strip() == "decrees"
        col = CRT_BRIGHT if is_active else CRT_GREEN
        # Folder icon (small square).
        ix = tree_x + 8
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (ix, fy + 2, 8, 6), border_radius=1)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (ix, fy, 4, 3), border_radius=1)
        txt = font_small.render(name, True, col)
        surface.blit(txt, (ix + 12, fy))
        fy += 18

    # ── Right pane: file list ──
    list_x = tree_x + tree_w + 4
    list_y = tree_y
    list_w = body_rect.w - tree_w - 20
    list_h = tree_h
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 12, 6), (list_x, list_y, list_w, list_h), radius=3)
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (list_x, list_y, list_w, list_h), radius=3, width=1)
    # Column headers.
    col_y = list_y + 6
    surface.blit(font_small.render("NAME", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 28, col_y))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("SIZE", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 200, col_y))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("MODIFIED", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 260, col_y))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DARK, (list_x + 4, col_y + 16), (list_x + list_w - 4, col_y + 16), 1)
    # Files.
    files = [
        ("decree_47.txt", "2.1K", "03/14 03:12", "decree"),
        ("auth_chain.log", "4.8K", "03/14 03:08", "auth_chain"),
        ("mag_packet.draft", "1.4K", "03/14 02:55", "mag_packet"),
    ]
    for i, (fname, fsize, fmod, fid) in enumerate(files):
        ry = list_y + 28 + i * 40
        row_rect = pygame.Rect(list_x + 4, ry, list_w - 8, 32)
        hovered = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        selected = (_last_clicked_file == i)
        if selected:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (12, 55, 28), row_rect, radius=2)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, row_rect, 1, border_radius=2)
        elif hovered:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (8, 35, 18), row_rect, radius=2)
        # File icon (document shape).
        ix = list_x + 8
        iy = ry + 8
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (8, 35, 18),
                            [(ix, iy), (ix + 10, iy), (ix + 14, iy + 4),
                             (ix + 14, iy + 16), (ix, iy + 16)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CRT_GREEN,
                            [(ix, iy), (ix + 10, iy), (ix + 14, iy + 4),
                             (ix + 14, iy + 16), (ix, iy + 16)], 1)
        # Name.
        name_col = CRT_BRIGHT if (selected or hovered) else CRT_GREEN
        surface.blit(font.render(fname, True, name_col), (list_x + 28, ry + 8))
        surface.blit(font_small.render(fsize, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 200, ry + 10))
        surface.blit(font_small.render(fmod, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 260, ry + 10))
    # Double-click hint.
    hint = font_small.render("Double-click a file to view its contents", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(hint, (list_x + 4, list_y + list_h - 18))


def _draw_evidence_document(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Document viewer - renders the evidence file based on its kind."""
    doc = EVIDENCE_DOCS.get(_info_sub, EVIDENCE_DOCS["decree"])
    kind = doc.get("kind", "decree")
    doc_x = body_rect.x + 12
    doc_y = body_rect.y + 12
    doc_w = body_rect.w - 24
    doc_h = body_rect.h - 50

    if kind == "decree":
        _draw_doc_decree(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)
    elif kind == "terminal":
        _draw_doc_terminal(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)
    elif kind == "draft":
        _draw_doc_draft(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)


def _draw_doc_decree(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Official decree on letterhead with a seal."""
    # Paper background (off-white, slightly yellowed).
    paper = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    paper.fill((230, 222, 195, 240))
    surface.blit(paper, (x, y))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (140, 130, 100), (x, y, w, h), 1)
    # Letterhead.
    head_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 18, bold=True)
    sub_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 12, italic=True)
    body_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 13)
    foot_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 10)
    # Header text.
    h1 = head_font.render(doc["header"], True, (30, 25, 15))
    surface.blit(h1, (x + w // 2 - h1.get_width() // 2, y + 16))
    h2 = sub_font.render(doc["subheader"], True, (80, 65, 40))
    surface.blit(h2, (x + w // 2 - h2.get_width() // 2, y + 40))
    # Divider.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 100, 60), (x + 40, y + 60), (x + w - 40, y + 60), 1)
    # Seal (circle with text).
    seal_cx = x + w - 50
    seal_cy = y + 90
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (140, 30, 30), (seal_cx, seal_cy), 28, 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (140, 30, 30), (seal_cx, seal_cy), 22, 1)
    seal_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 14, bold=True)
    seal_txt = seal_font.render(doc["seal_text"], True, (140, 30, 30))
    surface.blit(seal_txt, (seal_cx - seal_txt.get_width() // 2, seal_cy - seal_txt.get_height() // 2))
    # Body text.
    ty = y + 80
    for line in doc["body_lines"]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # Signature lines get bold.
        is_sig = "Retardovici" in line or "President" in line
        f = head_font if is_sig else body_font
        col = (20, 15, 10) if is_sig else (35, 30, 20)
        txt = f.render(line, True, col)
        surface.blit(txt, (x + 40, ty))
        ty += 20
    # Footer.
    foot = foot_font.render(doc["footer"], True, (100, 80, 50))
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 40, y + h - 24))


def _draw_doc_terminal(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Green-on-black terminal log."""
    # Terminal background.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (4, 12, 8), (x, y, w, h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (x, y, w, h), 1, border_radius=3)
    term_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 13)
    # Header.
    surface.blit(term_font.render(doc["header"], True, CRT_BRIGHT), (x + 12, y + 12))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (x + 8, y + 32), (x + w - 8, y + 32), 1)
    # Body lines.
    ty = y + 40
    for line in doc["body_lines"]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # [REDACTED] text gets a black bar.
        if "[REDACTED]" in line:
            # Render the parts around [REDACTED].
            parts = line.split("[REDACTED]")
            cx = x + 12
            for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                if part:
                    txt = term_font.render(part, True, CRT_GREEN)
                    surface.blit(txt, (cx, ty))
                    cx += txt.get_width()
                if i < len(parts) - 1:
                    # Draw the redaction bar.
                    bar_w = term_font.size("[REDACTED]")[0]
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (0, 0, 0), (cx, ty, bar_w, 16))
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (cx, ty, bar_w, 16), 1)
                    cx += bar_w
        else:
            col = CRT_AMBER if "WARNING" in line or "COMPROMISED" in line else CRT_GREEN
            txt = term_font.render(line, True, col)
            surface.blit(txt, (x + 12, ty))
        ty += 18
    # Footer.
    foot = term_font.render(doc["footer"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 12, y + h - 24))
    # Blinking cursor at the end.
    if (_os_timer % 24) < 12:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (x + 12 + foot.get_width() + 4, y + h - 24, 8, 14))


def _draw_doc_draft(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Typewritten draft with redactions."""
    # Paper background (slightly creased).
    paper = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    paper.fill((240, 235, 215, 240))
    surface.blit(paper, (x, y))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (120, 110, 85), (x, y, w, h), 1)
    draft_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 12)
    head_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 12, bold=True)
    # Header (DRAFT stamp).
    stamp_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 28, bold=True)
    stamp = stamp_font.render("DRAFT", True, (180, 30, 30))
    stamp.set_alpha(120)
    surface.blit(stamp, (x + w - 100, y + 20))
    # Header lines.
    ty = y + 16
    for line in doc["body_lines"][:4]:  # TO/FROM/RE
        txt = head_font.render(line, True, (40, 30, 20))
        surface.blit(txt, (x + 20, ty))
        ty += 16
    ty += 8
    # Body.
    for line in doc["body_lines"][4:]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # [REDACTED] handling.
        if "[REDACTED]" in line:
            parts = line.split("[REDACTED]")
            cx = x + 20
            for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                if part:
                    txt = draft_font.render(part, True, (35, 30, 20))
                    surface.blit(txt, (cx, ty))
                    cx += txt.get_width()
                if i < len(parts) - 1:
                    bar_w = draft_font.size("[REDACTED]")[0]
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (15, 15, 15), (cx, ty, bar_w, 14))
                    cx += bar_w
        else:
            # Numbered lines get emphasis.
            col = (120, 30, 20) if (line.strip().startswith(tuple("1234")) and "." in line[:3]) else (35, 30, 20)
            txt = draft_font.render(line, True, col)
            surface.blit(txt, (x + 20, ty))
        ty += 16
    # Footer.
    foot = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 10).render(doc["footer"], True, (100, 80, 50))
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 20, y + h - 24))


def _draw_control_panel_grid(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Grid of clickable control panel icons."""
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    # Grid of 5 icons (3 columns x 2 rows, last row has 2).
    grid_x = body_rect.x + 40
    grid_y = body_rect.y + 30
    icon_w, icon_h = 80, 80
    gap_x, gap_y = 120, 110
    for i, item in enumerate(CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS):
        col = i % 3
        row = i // 3
        ix = grid_x + col * (icon_w + gap_x)
        iy = grid_y + row * (icon_h + gap_y)
        icon_rect = pygame.Rect(ix, iy, icon_w, icon_h)
        hovered = icon_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        # Icon background.
        bg = (15, 60, 30) if hovered else (8, 35, 18)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, bg, icon_rect, radius=6)
        border = CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, border, icon_rect, radius=6, width=1)
        # Icon symbol (big letter).
        sym_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 32, bold=True)
        sym = sym_font.render(item["icon"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(sym, (icon_rect.centerx - sym.get_width() // 2,
                           icon_rect.centery - sym.get_height() // 2 - 8))
        # Label.
        lbl = font_small.render(item["label"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(lbl, (icon_rect.centerx - lbl.get_width() // 2, icon_rect.bottom - 18))
    # Description hint for hovered icon.
    for i, item in enumerate(CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS):
        col = i % 3
        row = i // 3
        ix = grid_x + col * (icon_w + gap_x)
        iy = grid_y + row * (icon_h + gap_y)
        if pygame.Rect(ix, iy, icon_w, icon_h).collidepoint(mouse_pos):
            desc = font_small.render(item["desc"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
            surface.blit(desc, (body_rect.centerx - desc.get_width() // 2, body_rect.bottom - 30))
            break


def _draw_control_panel_sub(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Sub-window for a control panel item (Display, Sound, Network, etc.)."""
    if _info_sub == "display":
        _draw_cp_display(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "sound":
        _draw_cp_sound(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "network":
        _draw_cp_network(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "security":
        _draw_cp_security(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "about":
        _draw_cp_about(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)

                 (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 90))

                     (body_rect.right - 12, body_rect.y + 108), 1)

        "                Authorization trace in progress.",
    ]
    ty = body_rect.y + 116
    term_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 12)
    for line in file_lines:

                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (cx, ty, bar_w, 14), 1)
                    cx += bar_w

            txt = term_font.render(line, True, CRT_GREEN)
            surface.blit(txt, (body_rect.x + 16, ty))
        ty += 18

def _draw_logs_waveform(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Waveform visualizer at top + scrolling radio log below."""
    # ── Waveform visualizer (top third) ──
    wf_x = body_rect.x + 12
    wf_y = body_rect.y + 12
    wf_w = body_rect.w - 24
    wf_h = 80
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (2, 12, 6), (wf_x, wf_y, wf_w, wf_h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (wf_x, wf_y, wf_w, wf_h), 1, border_radius=3)
    # Center line.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (10, 30, 18), (wf_x + 4, wf_y + wf_h // 2), (wf_x + wf_w - 4, wf_y + wf_h // 2), 1)
    # Bars.
    n_bars = len(_waveform_bars)
    bar_w = max(2, (wf_w - 8) // n_bars - 1)
    for i, val in enumerate(_waveform_bars):
        bh = max(2, int(val * (wf_h // 2 - 4)))
        bx = wf_x + 4 + i * (bar_w + 1)
        # Top half.
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bx, wf_y + wf_h // 2 - bh, bar_w, bh))
        # Bottom half (mirror).
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bx, wf_y + wf_h // 2, bar_w, bh))
    # Label.
    surface.blit(font_small.render("◆ LIVE SIGNAL", True, CRT_BRIGHT), (wf_x + 8, wf_y + 4))
    # Frequency readout (fake).
    freq = 2400 + int(_waveform_bars[20] * 200)
    surface.blit(font_small.render(f"{freq} Hz", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (wf_x + wf_w - 60, wf_y + 4))

    # ── Radio log (bottom two-thirds) ──
    log_x = body_rect.x + 12
    log_y = wf_y + wf_h + 8
    log_w = body_rect.w - 24
    log_h = body_rect.h - wf_h - 60
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (4, 12, 8), (log_x, log_y, log_w, log_h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (log_x, log_y, log_w, log_h), 1, border_radius=3)
    # Header.
    surface.blit(font_small.render("TIME    SOURCE    MESSAGE", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN),
                 (log_x + 12, log_y + 6))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (log_x + 8, log_y + 22), (log_x + log_w - 8, log_y + 22), 1)
    # Log entries - pull from STATE via _get_radio_log_lines().
    radio_lines = _get_radio_log_lines()
    if radio_lines is None:
        # Fallback static content.
        radio_lines = [
            ("SYSTEM", "Radio transmission logs (decoded):", CRT_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "Balaceanu logistics. Not MAG.", CRT_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "Hidden detonator! Run to shelter!", CRT_AMBER),
            ("SYSTEM", "Tanker detonation detected.", CRT_RED),
            ("VASILE", "[signal degraded]", CRT_DIM_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "You made it. Control building.", CRT_GREEN),
            ("SYSTEM", "Evidence files recovered (3/3)", CRT_BRIGHT),
        ]
    term_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 12)
    ty = log_y + 28
    # Fake timestamps.
    base_time = 342  # 03:42
    for i, (prefix, text, color) in enumerate(radio_lines):
        ts = base_time + i * 2
        ts_str = f"{ts // 60:02d}:{ts % 60:02d}"
        surface.blit(term_font.render(ts_str, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (log_x + 12, ty))
        surface.blit(term_font.render(prefix[:8], True, color), (log_x + 70, ty))
        # Truncate text if too long.
        max_text_w = log_w - 160
        display_text = text
        while term_font.size(display_text)[0] > max_text_w and len(display_text) > 3:
            display_text = display_text[:-1]
        if display_text != text:
            display_text += "..."
        surface.blit(term_font.render(display_text, True, color), (log_x + 140, ty))
        ty += 16
        if ty > log_y + log_h - 16:
            break
    # Signal quality footer.
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Signal quality: DEGRADED  ·  Comms: INTERMITTENT", True, CRT_AMBER),
                 (log_x + 12, log_y + log_h + 6))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# .kilo\worktrees\stump-icon\user_settings.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Live user settings - shared across all gameplay modules.

acaristan.py owns the authoritative variables (loaded from settings_store) and
pushes them into this module via push_from_raw() whenever a setting changes.
Gameplay code reads SETTINGS.* so we don't have to thread 18 parameters
through every function.

Keep this module dependency-free (no pygame, no state) so it imports cleanly
from anywhere.
"""


COLORBLIND_LABELS = ("off", "protanopia", "deuteranopia", "tritanopia")


class _Settings:
    def __init__(self):
        # ── Display ──
        self.fullscreen = False
        self.brightness = 1.0          # 0.5 .. 1.5 multiplier (50 => 1.0 neutral)
        self.scanlines = True
        self.film_grain = True
        self.reduced_motion = False
        self.colorblind_mode = "off"

        # ── Audio ──
        self.master_volume = 1.0       # 0..1
        self.music_volume = 0.7
        self.sfx_volume = 0.85
        self.subtitles = True
        self.mute_on_focus_loss = True

        # ── Gameplay ──
        self.mouse_sensitivity = 1.0   # 0.25 .. 2.0
        self.invert_mouse_y = False
        self.aim_assist = False
        self.auto_reload = True
        self.particle_density = 1.0    # 0.0 .. 1.5

        # ── HUD ──
        self.show_crosshair = True
        self.crosshair_size = 6        # 3=small 6=medium 10=large (pixel half-extent)

    def push_from_raw(self, raw: dict):
        """Update from the raw settings_store dict (0-100 ints, ints for modes).

        This is the single conversion point. acaristan.py calls this every time
        any setting changes; gameplay reads the already-converted float values.
        """
        if "display_mode" in raw:
            self.fullscreen = bool(raw["display_mode"])
        if "brightness" in raw:
            # 0..100 with 50 = neutral; map to 0.5 .. 1.5
            self.brightness = 0.5 + (raw["brightness"] / 100.0)
        if "scanlines" in raw:
            self.scanlines = bool(raw["scanlines"])
        if "grain" in raw:
            self.film_grain = bool(raw["grain"])
        if "reduced_motion" in raw:
            self.reduced_motion = bool(raw["reduced_motion"])
        if "colorblind_mode" in raw:
            idx = int(raw["colorblind_mode"])
            if 0 <= idx < len(COLORBLIND_LABELS):
                self.colorblind_mode = COLORBLIND_LABELS[idx]

        if "master_volume" in raw:
            self.master_volume = raw["master_volume"] / 100.0
        if "music_volume" in raw:
            self.music_volume = raw["music_volume"] / 100.0
        if "sfx_volume" in raw:
            self.sfx_volume = raw["sfx_volume"] / 100.0
        if "subtitles" in raw:
            self.subtitles = bool(raw["subtitles"])
        if "mute_on_focus_loss" in raw:
            self.mute_on_focus_loss = bool(raw["mute_on_focus_loss"])

        if "mouse_sensitivity" in raw:
            # 0..100 with 50 = 1.0; map to 0.25 .. 2.0 roughly linear
            self.mouse_sensitivity = max(0.25, raw["mouse_sensitivity"] / 50.0)
        if "invert_mouse" in raw:
            self.invert_mouse_y = bool(raw["invert_mouse"])
        if "aim_assist" in raw:
            self.aim_assist = bool(raw["aim_assist"])
        if "auto_reload" in raw:
            self.auto_reload = bool(raw["auto_reload"])
        if "particle_density" in raw:
            # 0..100 -> 0.0 .. 1.5 (100 = 1.5x denser than baseline)
            self.particle_density = (raw["particle_density"] / 100.0) * 1.5

        if "crosshair" in raw:
            self.show_crosshair = bool(raw["crosshair"])
        if "crosshair_size" in raw:
            self.crosshair_size = int(raw["crosshair_size"])


SETTINGS = _Settings()

"""Render stills for the M5 outfit change into _shots/outfit/ (dev aid)."""
import os, sys, time
os.environ.setdefault("ACARISTAN_RENDERER", "software")
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
import pygame
pygame.init()
from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
OUT = os.path.join(ROOT, "_shots", "outfit")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
from cutscenes import m5mid3d, m5martial3d

which = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "all"
SHOTS = [("m5x_decree", 2000), ("m5x_change", 600), ("m5x_change", 1400), ("m5x_change", 2300),
         ("m5x_change", 4400), ("m5x_barracks", 3600), ("m5x_faces_release", 1500),
         ("m5x_pw_arrival_door", 2000), ("m5x_vasile_close", 1500), ("m5x_vasile_biribel", 1500),
         ("m5x_maru_biribel", 1500), ("m5x_breach", 2000)]
END = [("m5_radio", 3000), ("m5_river_gate", 2500)]
if len(sys.argv) > 2:
    SHOTS = [s for s in SHOTS if s[0] in sys.argv[2].split(",")]
    END = [s for s in END if s[0] in sys.argv[2].split(",")]


def save(name):
    pygame.image.save(screen, os.path.join(OUT, name + ".png"))


if which in ("all", "3d"):
    for sc, t in SHOTS:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        m5mid3d.draw_m5x(sc, screen, t)
        print(sc, t, "%.0f ms" % ((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000))
        save("%s_%d" % (sc, t))
    for sc, t in END:
        m5martial3d.draw_m5_scene_3d(sc, screen, t)
        save("%s_%d" % (sc, t))
    print("3d failed?", m5martial3d._cache.get("failed"), m5martial3d._cache.get("err"))
if which in ("all", "2d"):
    for sc, t in (("m5x_change", 600), ("m5x_change", 3000), ("m5x_faces_wide", 0), ("m5x_vasile_wide", 0)):
        m5mid3d.draw_m5x_2d(sc, screen, t)
        save("2d_%s_%d" % (sc, t))
    from cutscenes import m5martial
    m5martial._draw_m5_radio(screen, 3000)
    save("2d_m5_radio")
if which in ("all", "game"):
    from core.state import STATE
    from core import outfits
    from entities.player import Player
    from missions.m5 import draw as m5draw
    STATE.active_mission = "MISSION5"
    STATE.m5_outfit = "guard"
    surf = pygame.Surface((360, 120))
    surf.fill((44, 46, 50))
    p = Player(40, 40)
    p.angle = 0.0
    p.story_outfit = outfits.gameplay_outfit(STATE)
    p.draw(surf, 0, 0)
    p2 = Player(40, 40)
    p2.angle = 0.0
    p2.draw(surf, -60, 0)        # saved look, no outfit (reference)

    class _E:
        pass
    for i, kind in enumerate(("raider", "rifle", "marksman")):
        e = _E()
        e.rect = pygame.Rect(180 + i * 60, 40, 32, 32)
        e.angle = 0.0
        e.m5_type = kind
        m5draw._draw_m5_guard(surf, e, 0, 0)
    big = pygame.transform.scale(surf, (1080, 360))
    pygame.image.save(big, os.path.join(OUT, "game_sprites.png"))
    g = big.copy()
    for y in range(g.get_height()):
        for x in range(g.get_width()):
            r, gg, b, _ = g.get_at((x, y))
            l = int(0.299 * r + 0.587 * gg + 0.114 * b)
            g.set_at((x, y), (l, l, l))
    pygame.image.save(g, os.path.join(OUT, "game_sprites_gray.png"))
    port = m5draw._dialogue_portrait("BIRIBEL", (225, 228, 232), 96)
    pygame.image.save(port, os.path.join(OUT, "portrait_biribel.png"))
    print("saved look untouched:", p.look, p._rk["uniform"])
print("done")

# apply_k9_patch.py

"""Safely install this source patch into the supplied First try project.
Usage: python apply_k9_patch.py "C:\\path\\to\\First try"
No external dependencies. Never touches game saves, settings, or assets.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('project',type=Path,help='Existing game project root containing acaristan.py and src/')
    args=parser.parse_args()
    root=args.project.resolve();bundle=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if not (root/'acaristan.py').is_file() or not (root/'src').is_dir():
        parser.error('Choose the game project root containing acaristan.py and src/.')
    if root==bundle:parser.error('Choose your game project, not the patch folder.')
    manifest=json.loads((bundle/'manifest.json').read_text())
    pending=[]
    for name,info in manifest.items():
        source=bundle/name;target=root/name
        if digest(source)!=info['patched_sha256']:
            parser.error(f'Patch file failed its integrity check: {name}')
        actual=digest(target)
        if actual==info['patched_sha256']:continue
        if actual!=info['original_sha256']:
            parser.error(f'{name} differs from the supplied project. Nothing changed; merge it manually to preserve your edits.')
        pending.append(name)
    if not pending:
        print('K9 patch is already installed. Nothing changed.');return
    backup=root/('.k9_backup_'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f'))
    backup.mkdir()
    for name in pending:
        target=root/name
        if target.exists():
            saved=backup/name;saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(target,saved)
    (backup/'rollback.json').write_text(json.dumps({n:(backup/n).is_file() for n in pending},indent=2))
    installed=[]
    try:
        for name in pending:
            target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(bundle/name,target);installed.append(name)
    except Exception:
        for name in reversed(installed):
            target=root/name;saved=backup/name
            if saved.is_file():shutil.copy2(saved,target)
            elif target.exists():target.unlink()
        raise
    print('Installed K9 cutscene upgrade. Original files backed up in:',backup.name)
    print('Run from your game folder: python tools/k9_pickup_check.py')
    print('Then launch normally: python acaristan.py')


if __name__=='__main__':main()

# apply_m5_harbour.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Install the M5 harbour graphics into the supplied project, with hash guards.
Usage: python apply_m5_harbour.py "PATH/TO/First try"
Accepts original, M5-reset or M5-rebuild source; never edits assets or saves.
"""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if p.is_file() else None

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);ap.add_argument('project',type=Path)
    args=ap.parse_args();root=args.project.resolve();bundle=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    if not (root/'acaristan.py').is_file() or not (root/'src').is_dir():ap.error('Choose the game root containing acaristan.py and src/.')
    if root==bundle:ap.error('Choose the game folder, not this patch folder.')
    manifest=json.loads((bundle/'manifest.json').read_text());pending=[]
    # All checks complete before the first source file changes.
    for name,info in manifest.items():
        rel=Path(name)
        if rel.is_absolute() or '..' in rel.parts:ap.error('Unsafe manifest path.')
        source=bundle/rel;target=root/rel
        if digest(source)!=info['patched_sha256']:ap.error('Patch integrity check failed: '+name)
        if target.exists() and not target.is_file():ap.error('Target is not a file: '+name)
        actual=digest(target)
        if actual==info['patched_sha256']:continue
        if actual not in info['accepted_sha256']:ap.error(name+' differs from the supplied original/reset/rebuild. Nothing changed; merge manually to preserve your edits.')
        pending.append(name)
    if not pending:print('M5 harbour graphics already installed. Nothing changed.');return
    backup=root/('.m5_harbour_backup_'+datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f'));backup.mkdir()
    for name in pending:
        target=root/name
        if target.is_file():
            saved=backup/name;saved.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copy2(target,saved)
    (backup/'rollback.json').write_text(json.dumps({n:(backup/n).is_file() for n in pending},indent=2))
    (backup/'README.txt').write_text('Close the game before restoring. For each rollback.json key whose value is true, copy the corresponding backup file to the same relative path in the game root. For each false value, delete that newly installed file. Do not delete other files. Preserve any newer edits before restoring. No save, settings, profile or asset was modified by this installer.\n')
    installed=[]
    try:
        for name in pending:
            target=root/name;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            # Include the current attempt in rollback if a copy fails midway.
            installed.append(name);shutil.copy2(bundle/name,target)
    except Exception:
        for name in reversed(installed):
            target=root/name;saved=backup/name
            if saved.is_file():shutil.copy2(saved,target)
            elif target.exists():target.unlink()
        raise
    print('Installed M5 harbour graphics. Backup:',backup.name)
    print('Art check: python tools/m5_harbour_art_check.py')
    print('Playback check: python tools/m5_shadow_check.py')
    print('Launch: python acaristan.py')
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# outputs\finale_backup\m5harbour_art.py

"""Authored blocky harbour art for M5; canonical people and motion stay intact.
All details are editable engine3d meshes, not pasted screenshots. Practical
spill/contact shadows are baked world-space colour; no claim of ray tracing.
"""
from functools import lru_cache
import math
import random
import pygame
from engine3d import Mesh,box,prism,quad_xz,v_add,v_mul,v_cross,v_norm
from core.config import resource_path

PALETTE={'brick':(87,58,46),'mortar':(39,43,43),'stone':(87,96,92),
         'steel':(43,62,66),'iron':(24,36,40),'roof':(46,58,64),
         'warm':(226,164,83),'glass':(23,48,58)}

def colour(c,amount):return tuple(max(0,min(255,int(v+amount))) for v in c)

def spill(pos,base):
    """Practical lamps tint nearby actual surfaces before directional baking."""
    x,y,z=pos
    lights=((-5.45,2.75,-2.7,2.4,1.0),(-8.8,2.65,-2.7,1.8,.70),
            (4.7,2.3,-6.85,2.5,.45),(-5.4,6.3,25.9,2.7,.55))
    strength=0
    for lx,ly,lz,r,gain in lights:
        d=((x-lx)**2+(z-lz)**2+((y-ly)*.62)**2)/r**2
        strength+=math.exp(-d*1.2)*gain
    return tuple(min(255,int(base[i]+(104,57,17)[i]*strength)) for i in range(3))


def plane(m,o,u,v,w,h,c,em=False):
    p1=v_add(o,v_mul(u,w));p2=v_add(p1,v_mul(v,h));p3=v_add(o,v_mul(v,h))
    # Double-sided for tiny signs/decals; always on the actual surface plane.
    m.face((o,p3,p2,p1),c,2,True,em)


def masonry(axis,at,a0,a1,y0,y1,seed=0,base=None,cell=.55,reverse=False):
    """Cell-centred mortar and brick faces replace (not overlap) large wall faces.
    This avoids the reference painter's coplanar-average-depth checkerboard.
    """
    rng=random.Random(seed);base=base or PALETTE['brick'];m=Mesh()
    rows=max(1,round((y1-y0)/.22));rh=(y1-y0)/rows
    for row in range(rows):
        y=y0+row*rh;offset=cell*.5*(row%2);a=a0-offset
        while a<a1:
            lo=max(a0,a);hi=min(a1,a+cell);w=hi-lo
            if w>.018:
                c=colour(base,rng.randrange(-7,8));hh=rh-.018
                if axis=='x':o=(at,y,lo);u=(0,0,1);n=(1,0,0)
                elif reverse:o=(hi,y,at);u=(-1,0,0);n=(0,0,1)
                else:o=(lo,y,at);u=(1,0,0);n=(0,0,-1)
                center=v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,w/2),(0,rh/2,0)))
                plane(m,o,u,(0,1,0),w,rh,spill(center,colour(c,-17)))
                face_o=v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,.009),v_add((0,.009,0),v_mul(n,.012))))
                plane(m,face_o,u,(0,1,0),w-.018,hh,spill(center,c))
            a+=cell
    return m


@lru_cache(maxsize=32)
def lettering(text,width):
    """Merge horizontal glyph runs into shallow world-space geometry."""
    try:font=pygame.font.Font(resource_path('assets/fonts/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf'),28)
    except (OSError,pygame.error):font=pygame.font.SysFont('monospace',28)
    surf=font.render(text,False,(255,255,255),(0,0,0));scale=width/max(1,surf.get_width());runs=[]
    for y in range(surf.get_height()):
        x=0
        while x<surf.get_width():
            if surf.get_at((x,y))[0]<128:x+=1;continue
            start=x
            while x<surf.get_width() and surf.get_at((x,y))[0]>=128:x+=1
            runs.append((start*scale,(surf.get_height()-y-1)*scale,(x-start)*scale,scale))
    return runs,surf.get_height()*scale


def text_mesh(text,o,u,width,c=(192,192,162)):
    m=Mesh();runs,h=lettering(text,width)
    for x,y,w,dy in runs:plane(m,v_add(o,v_add(v_mul(u,x),(0,y,0))),u,(0,1,0),w,dy,c)
    return m


def window_z(x,y,z,w,h,warm=False,seed=0):
    m=Mesh();frame=PALETTE['steel'];iron=PALETTE['iron']
    m.add(box(w+.14,h+.13,.08,iron,center=(x,y,z),skip=('front','back',)))
    # Several panes, with one dim unlit pane to avoid a uniform checkerboard.
    for ix in (-1,1):
        for iy in (-1,1):
            c=(183,133,68) if warm and (ix+iy+seed)%4 else (23,45,51)
            if not warm:c=(31+seed%6,55+seed%8,65+seed%5)
            m.add(box(w*.45,h*.46,.015,c,center=(x+ix*w*.25,y+iy*h*.25,z-.050),emissive=warm and c[0]>100,skip=('back','top','bottom','left','right')))
    for xx in (-w/2,0,w/2):m.add(box(.035,h+.055,.07,frame,center=(x+xx,y,z-.062)))
    for yy in (-h/2,0,h/2):m.add(box(w+.06,.032,.07,frame,center=(x,y+yy,z-.062)))
    m.add(box(w+.23,.07,.21,(96,106,103),center=(x,y-h/2-.07,z-.07)))
    return m


def puddle(x,z,w,d,y,seed=0,base=(68,88,94)):
    rng=random.Random(seed);m=Mesh()
    pts=((x-w*.46,y,z-d*.30),(x-w*.23,y,z-d*.54),(x+w*.32,y,z-d*.47),
         (x+w*.52,y,z-d*.06),(x+w*.31,y,z+d*.44),(x-w*.35,y,z+d*.40))
    m.face(pts,base,0,True)
    # Broken reflections follow the wet patch, not screen coordinates.
    for i in range(4):
        zz=z-d*.20+i*d*.14;xx=x-w*.27+rng.random()*w*.12
        m.add(quad_xz(xx,zz,xx+w*(.3+rng.random()*.25),zz+.012,y+.003,colour(base,13+i%2*5)))
    return m


def floor(x0,z0,x1,z1,y,seed=0,roof=False):
    rng=random.Random(seed);m=Mesh();size=1.55 if roof else 1.65
    base=PALETTE['roof'] if roof else (61,72,72)
    z=z0
    while z<z1:
        x=x0
        while x<x1:
            xx=min(x1,x+size);zz=min(z1,z+size*.72)
            c=spill(((x+xx)/2,y,(z+zz)/2),colour(base,rng.randrange(-4,5)))
            # Paired quads share a centre, so averaging cannot alternate the layers.
            m.add(quad_xz(x,z,xx,zz,y,colour(c,-9)))
            m.add(quad_xz(x+.012,z+.012,xx-.012,zz-.012,y+.006,c))
            x+=size
        z+=size*.72
    return m


def roof_column():
    """Bevelled, coursed concrete pillar within the original occlusion volume.
    Surface cells ARE the shell, avoiding floating seams over a giant face.
    """
    m=Mesh();cx,cz=1.4,27.25
    ring=((- .295,-.4),(.295,-.4),(.35,-.345),(.35,.345),(.295,.4),(-.295,.4),(-.35,.345),(-.35,-.345))
    for side in range(8):
        ax,az=ring[side];bx,bz=ring[(side+1)%8]
        widths=3 if side in (0,4) else 1
        for row in range(6):
            ya=5+row*.5;yb=ya+.5
            for j in range(widths):
                aa=j/widths;bb=(j+1)/widths
                x0=cx+ax+(bx-ax)*aa;z0=cz+az+(bz-az)*aa
                x1=cx+ax+(bx-ax)*bb;z1=cz+az+(bz-az)*bb
                tone=(row*7+j*3)%5-2
                base=(72,82,79) if row>0 else (54,64,62)
                m.face(((x0,ya,z0),(x0,yb,z0),(x1,yb,z1),(x1,ya,z1)),colour(base,tone),2,True)
    # Solid end caps and shallow metal edge protection, not broken screen lines.
    m.face(tuple((cx+x,8,cz+z) for x,z in reversed(ring)),(113,120,109),2,True)
    for x in (1.115,1.685):
        m.add(box(.027,2.78,.024,(89,105,100),center=(x,6.42,26.850)))
        for y in (5.45,6.42,7.39):m.add(box(.034,.034,.025,(137,135,103),center=(x,y,26.839)))
    m.add(box(.69,.10,.79,(107,118,109),center=(1.4,7.93,27.25)))
    return m

def water_mesh(t,motion=True):
    """Broken warm window reflections and cool current lines, in river space."""
    if not motion:t=0
    m=Mesh()
    for row in range(27):
        z=4.5+row*.72
        for i in range(8):
            phase=i*1.7+row*.9+t*.00055
            x=-18+i*5+math.sin(phase)*.16;w=.42+((row*11+i*7)%13)*.075
            c=(30+row%3*2,48+row%3*3,56+row%3*3)
            m.add(quad_xz(x,z,x+w,z+.018,-.805,c))
    # Reflections under the warehouse's warm bays. Not a perfect mirror strip.
    for cx in (-7.2,3.0):
        for row in range(22):
            z=12.2+row*.54;fade=(row+1)/22
            xx=cx+math.sin(row*1.5+t*.0007)*.12
            w=.10+.45*fade+.14*math.sin(row*.7+t*.0004)
            c=(int(43+74*fade),int(44+32*fade),int(33+6*fade))
            m.add(quad_xz(xx-w/2,z,xx+w/2,z+.024+fade*.025,-.800,c))
    return m


def _hull(points):
    pts=sorted(set(points))
    if len(pts)<3:return pts
    def cross(o,a,b):return (a[0]-o[0])*(b[1]-o[1])-(a[1]-o[1])*(b[0]-o[0])
    lo=[];hi=[]
    for p in pts:
        while len(lo)>1 and cross(lo[-2],lo[-1],p)<=0:lo.pop()
        lo.append(p)
    for p in reversed(pts):
        while len(hi)>1 and cross(hi[-2],hi[-1],p)<=0:hi.pop()
        hi.append(p)
    return lo[:-1]+hi[:-1]


def actor_shadow(hum,pose,pos,yaw,rifle=True):
    """Projected posed-mesh silhouettes: real ground coordinates, not a sprite.
    A two-tone penumbra is deliberately stylized, not a shadow-map claim.
    """
    from engine3d import m_apply
    places,_,root=hum.pose_world(pose,pos,yaw,rifle)
    m=Mesh();floor_y=pos[1]
    for slot,key,M,org,ground,fb in places:
        if key in ('chest','chest2','chest3','face','face2','uarm_acc'):continue
        verts=hum._rifle.verts if key=='rifle' else hum._parts[key][0]
        projected=[]
        for v in verts:
            x,y,z=v_add(root,v_add(org,m_apply(M,v)));height=max(0,y-floor_y)
            projected.append((x+.44*height,z+.48*height))
        h=_hull(projected)
        if len(h)<3:continue
        cx=sum(x for x,z in h)/len(h);cz=sum(z for x,z in h)/len(h)
        for scale,col,layer,dy in ((1.045,(35,46,47),.21,.012),(1.0,(23,34,37),.22,.016)):
            poly=[(cx+(x-cx)*scale,floor_y+dy,cz+(z-cz)*scale) for x,z in h]
            m.face(poly,col,layer,True,True)
    return m

def _banded(xb,zb,y,base,rng,jit,practical=False):
    """Ground strip split into depth bands and x columns. The renderer fogs each
    face from its mean depth, so one giant quad would band; bands keep consecutive
    centroid depths ~10 m apart inside the fog zone and grow past it."""
    m=Mesh()
    for i in range(len(zb)-1):
        for j in range(len(xb)-1):
            c=colour(base,rng.randrange(-jit,jit+1))
            if practical:
                c=spill(((xb[j]+xb[j+1])/2,y,(zb[i]+zb[i+1])/2),c)
            m.add(quad_xz(xb[j],zb[i],xb[j+1],zb[i+1],y,c))
    return m


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def world_shell():
    """Sealing terrain around the authored set so no finale camera sees an edge.
    Layer-0 banded ground plus a layer-2 embankment and deck kerbs; every tone sits
    close to the renderer fog so the shell's own rim at +/-300 m (past fog_end)
    dissolves into haze. Nothing here is coplanar with the deck (y=0), the river
    (y=-0.82) or the warehouse roof (y=5): the painter sort and the projected actor
    shadows depend on that."""
    M=[];add=M.append
    asphalt=colour((61,72,72),-10)
    # Quad sizes stay modest on purpose: a face that straddles the camera plane
    # survives near-clipping as a frame-wide polygon and cannot be sphere-culled.
    add(_banded((-300,-40,-10,10,40,300),(-300,-125,-95,-65,-45,-30,-20,-13),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(601),3,True))
    add(_banded((-300,-95,-65,-45,-30,-18,-10),(-13,-4.5,4.2),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(602),3,True))
    add(_banded((10,22,45,300),(-13,-4.5,4.2),
                -0.06,asphalt,random.Random(602),3,True))
    river=random.Random(603)
    for zb in ((4.2,14,20),(20,26.2)):
        add(_banded((-300,-105,-70,-48,-32),zb,-0.85,(18,35,43),river,3))
        add(_banded((36,48,70,105,300),zb,-0.85,(18,35,43),river,3))
    add(_banded((-300,-70,-35,-14,14,35,70,300),
                (24.4,28.5,33,38,44,51,59,68,79,92,110,135,300),
                -0.02,(40,50,54),random.Random(605),4,True))
    # Far-bank embankment: the vertical face the water-to-ground step needs, or the
    # ground's south rim would show a sliver of river behind it. The wings seal the
    # same step far off axis, where one segment each is enough.
    add(box(160,1.72,.24,(39,50,53),center=(-40,-.74,24.40),seg=5,
            skip=('back','bottom','left','right'),cols={'top':(51,62,65)}))
    # Deck retaining kerbs over the deck/apron junction; the west gap is exactly the
    # service-passage opening, and the east run stops short of the quay coping.
    kerb=colour(PALETTE['stone'],-34)
    for w,d,cx,cz in ((20.0,.22,0,-13.11),(.22,9.0,-10.11,-8.5),
                      (.22,5.4,-10.11,1.0),(.22,16.7,10.11,-4.65)):
        add(box(w,.24,d,kerb,center=(cx,-.02,cz),seg=2.5,skip=('bottom',),
                cols={'top':(61,70,66)}))
    return tuple(M)

def k(t,start,duration):
    p=max(0.0,min(1.0,(float(t)-start)/duration))
    return p*p*p*(p*(p*6-15)+10)


def mix(a,b,p):return a+(b-a)*p


def yaw_to(a,b):return math.degrees(math.atan2(b[0]-a[0],b[2]-a[2]))


def yaw_mix(a,b,p):return a+((b-a+180)%360-180)*p


def travel(t,start,duration):
    """Integrated smooth start/stop, steady middle: distance drives the gait."""
    p=max(0.0,min(1.0,(t-start)/duration));a=.16
    if p<a:q=p*p/(2*a)
    elif p>1-a:q=1-a-(1-p)*(1-p)/(2*a)
    else:q=p-a/2
    return q/(1-a)


def reduced_motion():
    from core.state import STATE  # lazy: draw reads a setting, never writes it
    return bool(getattr(STATE,'reduced_motion',False))


def _transform(mesh, matrix=M_IDENT, origin=(0,0,0)):
    """Small new dynamic accessory, through the PUBLIC renderer mesh API."""
    verts=[v_add(origin,m_apply(matrix,p)) for p in mesh.verts]
    faces=[(idx,col,layer,ds,None,em) for idx,col,layer,ds,em in mesh.faces]
    return verts,faces


def _dynamic(r,mesh,m=M_IDENT,origin=(0,0,0),bias=0.0):
    v,f=_transform(mesh,m,origin);r.add_dynamic(v,f,bias=bias)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _sniper():
    """Compact detailed marksman rifle. Origin=dominant grip, +z=muzzle."""
    m=Mesh();steel=(75,84,83);dark=(24,32,34);rim=(152,152,128)
    m.add(box(.065,.085,.38,steel,center=(0,.01,.105),cols={'top':rim,'left':(64,78,80),'bottom':(32,44,47)}))
    m.add(box(.045,.065,.31,dark,center=(0,.005,-.22),cols={'top':(79,89,78),'left':(43,55,54)}))
    m.add(box(.064,.14,.042,(39,47,49),center=(0,-.03,-.36)))
    m.add(box(.045,.13,.07,(30,37,41),center=(0,-.075,.115)))
    m.add(box(.054,.06,.22,(49,61,63),center=(0,.007,.36)))
    for z in (.30,.34,.38,.42):m.add(box(.058,.007,.012,rim,center=(0,.039,z)))
    m.add(box(.022,.022,.42,dark,center=(0,.01,.68)))
    m.add(box(.042,.044,.16,(42,53,59),center=(0,.01,.96)))
    m.add(box(.043,.008,.012,rim,center=(0,.024,1.04)))
    # Scope mount and a faceted tube; no giant featureless black brick.
    for z in (.05,.20):m.add(box(.03,.037,.025,dark,center=(0,.074,z)))
    tube=prism([(-.031,.097),(-.024,.073),(.024,.073),(.031,.097),(.022,.121),(-.022,.121)],.23,(28,36,41),z0=.01)
    m.add(tube)

    m.add(box(.020,.042,.024,dark,center=(.038,.106,.13)))

    return m


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def actors():
    b=humanoid3d('biribel',rifle='rifle',**biribel_3d(OUTFIT_GUARD))
    # New compact K-9 mesh shares the rig's dominant-grip attachment.
    compact=Mesh()
    compact.add(box(.065,.09,.25,(64,77,78),center=(0,.01,.10),cols={'top':(132,145,128),'left':(87,100,95),'bottom':(27,42,46)}))
    compact.add(box(.035,.034,.19,(28,41,49),center=(0,.012,.32)))
    compact.add(box(.048,.05,.10,(83,100,102),center=(0,.013,.43)))
    compact.add(box(.037,.20,.065,(29,41,48),center=(0,-.10,.10)))
    compact.add(box(.035,.065,.20,(34,44,49),center=(0,.006,-.15)))
    for z in (.05,.10,.15):compact.add(box(.067,.009,.012,(143,151,134),center=(0,.06,z)))
    b._rifle=compact  # instance-owned weapon art; canonical body is unchanged
    u=humanoid3d('ucilev',rifle='sniper');u._rifle=_sniper()
    m=humanoid3d('maru',rifle=None)
    return b,u,m


def _solve(hum,pose,side,target):
    """Fresh two-link IK, solved in torso coordinates (not interpolated poses).
    Both branches are evaluated; joint limits choose a human elbow solution.
    """
    places,joints,_,_=hum.placements(pose,rifle_on=False)
    S=next(M for slot,key,M,org,gr,fb in places if slot==1)
    shoulder=next(org for slot,key,M,org,gr,fb in places if slot==(4 if side=='l' else 10))
    scale=hum._scale;delta=v_sub(target,shoulder)
    q=tuple(sum(S[j*3+i]*delta[j] for j in range(3))/(scale*scale) for i in range(3))
    x,y,z=q;distance=math.sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z)
    if distance>.609:raise ValueError('Unreachable '+side+' hand target: '+str(distance))
    elbow=math.acos(max(-.995,min(.999,(distance*distance-.30*.30-.31*.31)/(2*.30*.31))))
    a=.30+.31*math.cos(elbow);b=.31*math.sin(elbow)
    options=[]
    for sign in (-1,1):
        lateral=sign*math.hypot(x,y)
        pitch=math.atan2(z,-lateral)-math.atan2(b,a)
        roll=math.atan2(x,-y) if sign<0 else math.atan2(-x,y)
        if side=='l':roll=-roll
        pitch=math.degrees(pitch);roll=math.degrees(roll)
        score=abs(roll)*.5+max(0,abs(roll)-80)*5+max(0,pitch-145)*5+max(0,-pitch-25)*5
        options.append((score,pitch,roll))
    _,pitch,roll=min(options)
    return dict(pose,**{side+'sh_p':pitch,side+'sh_r':roll,side+'el':math.degrees(elbow)})


def armed_pose(hum,t,lower=0.0,breath=.5):
    """Right grip drives the weapon. Left hand solved to its real foregrip.
    Every intermediate lowering pose is solved, rather than endpoint blending.
    """
    motion=0 if reduced_motion() else math.sin(t*.0015)*.22*breath
    pose=dict(spine=2,head_p=2,head_y=0,lhip_r=4,rhip_r=4,lkn=4,rkn=4,
              rifle_p=mix(11,57,lower),rifle_y=-40,body_r=motion)
    sc=hum._scale
    S=hum.placements(pose,False)[0][1][2]
    # Target authored in unscaled torso space; right hand is the attachment.
    grip=m_apply(S,(mix(.26,.22,lower),mix(.43,.37,lower),mix(.28,.25,lower)))
    pose=_solve(hum,pose,'r',grip)
    _,j,R,_=hum.placements(pose)
    support=v_add(j['rhand'],m_apply(R,(0,-.022,.16)))
    return _solve(hum,pose,'l',support)


def walking_pose(distance,t,wounded=False,scale=1.0):
    """Distance-driven planted feet: stance anchors stay fixed in world space."""
    distance /= scale  # world travel -> rig space; prevents stature-dependent sliding
    stride=.68
    pose=dict(spine=8 if wounded else 3,head_p=4 if wounded else 0,
              lsh_p=38 if wounded else 12,lel=105 if wounded else 18,
              rsh_p=24 if wounded else 12,rel=74 if wounded else 18,
              lhip_r=2,rhip_r=2,lift=0)
    for side,offset in (('l',0),('r',.5)):
        cycle=distance/stride+offset;n=math.floor(cycle);phase=cycle-n
        anchor=(n-offset)*stride+.18
        if phase<.60:
            foot_z=anchor-distance;rise=0
        else:
            swing=(phase-.60)/.40
            foot_z=anchor+stride*k(swing,0,1)-distance
            rise=.11*math.sin(math.pi*swing)
        y=-.82+rise;z=foot_z-.05
        r=min(.897,math.hypot(y,z));knee=math.acos(max(-1,min(1,(r*r-2*.45*.45)/(2*.45*.45))))
        hip=math.atan2(z,-y)+knee*.5
        pose[side+'hip_p']=math.degrees(hip);pose[side+'kn']=math.degrees(knee)
    return pose


def state_at(t):
    t=max(0,min(DURATION_MS,float(t)))
    d=5.3*travel(t,250,5400)
    maru_pos=(_MARU_START[0]-d,0,_MARU_START[2])
    # Biribel turns from pursuit to the revealed hunter; no impossible snap.
    biri_yaw=yaw_mix(180,yaw_to(BIRI,UC)+40,k(t,6400,2100))
    lower=k(t,28200,2700)
    retreat=3.8*travel(t,32800,2000)
    direction=v_norm((3.2,0,2.1))
    u_pos=v_add(UC,(direction[0]*retreat,0,direction[2]*retreat))
    u_yaw=yaw_mix(yaw_to(UC,BIRI)+40,math.degrees(math.atan2(direction[0],direction[2]))+40,k(t,31700,950))
    return dict(t=t,maru_pos=maru_pos,maru_distance=d,biri_yaw=biri_yaw,
                uc_pos=u_pos,uc_yaw=u_yaw,uc_distance=retreat,lower=lower,
                uc_visible=t>=9600)


def _camera(t):
    """Shared action axis. There is NO Ucilev insert before Biribel discovers him."""
    if t<6200:
        q=k(t,0,6200)
        return v_lerp((5.5,2.5,-6.5),(4.6,2.15,-5.9),q),(-1.65,1.08,-1.65),55,'escape'
    if t<9600:
        return (1.75,1.75,3.85),(0,1.35,0),38,'threat'
    if t<11800:
        return (.15,1.65,.65),(-2,6.20,26.4),mix(26,16,k(t,9600,2000)),'discovery'
    if 13900<=t<17700 or 23000<=t<26700:
        return (2.3,1.72,4.15),(0,1.28,0),40,'biribel'
    if t<31600:
        q=k(t,26700,4300) if t>=26700 else 0
        return v_lerp((-4.5,6.65,22.05),(-4.2,6.45,21.8),q),(-2,6.33,26.4),46,'ucilev'
    if t<34900:
        return (2.8,6.9,21.7),(-.8,5.9,27.2),52,'withdrawal'
    return (1.85,1.70,3.75),(0,1.34,0),37,'radio'


def _scene_mesh():
    from cutscenes.m5harbour_art import scene_meshes
    return scene_meshes()


def _renderer(software=False):
    key='software' if software else 'auto'
    if key not in _cache:
        cls=SoftwareRenderer if software else Renderer
        r=cls(RW,RH,fog=(26,38,44),fog_start=32,fog_end=100)
        r.light=ENV_LIGHT
        for i,mesh in enumerate(_scene_mesh()):r.bake(mesh,tag='shadow_set_'+str(i))
        from cutscenes.m5harbour_art import water_base, world_shell
        r.bake(water_base(),tag='shadow_water_base')
        for i,wm in enumerate(world_shell()):r.bake(wm,tag='shadow_shell_'+str(i))
        _cache[key]=(r,pygame.Surface((RW,RH)))
    return _cache[key]


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _radio_mesh():
    m=Mesh();m.add(box(.058,.10,.029,(45,57,65)))
    m.add(box(.043,.036,.005,(131,157,153),center=(0,.019,.017)))
    for y in (-.03,-.019,-.008):m.add(box(.042,.003,.006,(12,25,34),center=(0,y,.016)))
    m.add(box(.006,.11,.006,(27,38,45),center=(.023,.091,0)))
    return m


def _radio(r,hum,pose,pos,yaw,t,who):
    places,j,root=hum.pose_world(pose,pos,yaw)
    S=next(M for slot,key,M,org,gr,fb in places if slot==1)
    origin=v_add(root,m_apply(S,(-.125,.51,.167)))
    _dynamic(r,_radio_mesh(),S,origin)
    live=any(on<=t<off and sp==who for on,off,sp,txt in LINES)
    if live:
        led=box(.007,.007,.007,(218,177,90),emissive=True)
        _dynamic(r,led,S,v_add(origin,m_apply(S,(.013,.038,.019))))


def _water(r,t):
    from cutscenes.m5harbour_art import water_mesh
    _dynamic(r,water_mesh(t,motion=not reduced_motion()))


def _sky(buf,r,t):
    # The horizon is exactly the fog tone, so fully fogged distance dissolves into
    # the sky; below it a shallow gradient keeps any seam from reading as a flat hole.
    fog=r.fog
    horizon=max(-200,min(RH+200,int(r.horizon_y())))
    zen=(8,16,27)
    for y in range(RH):
        if y<=horizon:
            p=max(0.0,min(1.0,y/max(1,horizon)))
            c=(int(zen[0]+(fog[0]-zen[0])*p),int(zen[1]+(fog[1]-zen[1])*p),int(zen[2]+(fog[2]-zen[2])*p))
        else:
            q=min(1.0,(y-horizon)/max(1.0,float(RH-horizon)));q*=q
            c=(int(fog[0]-3*q),int(fog[1]-4*q),int(fog[2]-6*q))
        pygame.draw.line(buf,c,(0,y),(RW,y))


def _actors(r,st):
    b,u,m=actors();t=st['t']
    bpose=armed_pose(b,t,.40,.9)
    bpose['head_y']=mix(0,-8,k(t,35000,1000))+mix(0,8,k(t,39500,1300))
    bpose['head_p']=mix(2,12,k(t,35000,750))*(1-k(t,38200,1000))
    # Same disciplined stance, not synchronized animation.
    from cutscenes.m5harbour_art import actor_shadow
    mpose=walking_pose(st['maru_distance'],t,True,m._scale)
    _dynamic(r,actor_shadow(b,bpose,BIRI,st['biri_yaw']))
    _dynamic(r,actor_shadow(m,mpose,st['maru_pos'],-90,False))
    r.light=Light(direction=(-.65,.5,-.8),ambient=.65,diffuse=.55,sky=.08,tint=(1.11,1.03,.94))
    jb=r.add_humanoid(b,bpose,BIRI,st['biri_yaw'])
    _radio(r,b,bpose,BIRI,st['biri_yaw'],t,'BIRIBEL')
    # Once stopped, the stride ends in its final planted pose rather than looping.
    r.add_humanoid(m,mpose,st['maru_pos'],-90,rifle_on=False,tint=((35,49,61),.12))
    # White bandage hugs the existing right hand, not a disconnected blob.
    places,jm,root=m.pose_world(mpose,st['maru_pos'],-90,False)
    F=next(M for slot,key,M,org,gr,fb in places if slot==12)
    _dynamic(r,box(.091,.095,.10,(174,181,173)),F,jm['rhand'])
    if st['uc_visible']:
        upose=armed_pose(u,t,st['lower'],.28)
        if st['uc_distance']>0:
            walk=walking_pose(st['uc_distance'],t,scale=u._scale)
            for name in ('lhip_p','rhip_p','lkn','rkn'):upose[name]=walk[name]
        _dynamic(r,actor_shadow(u,upose,st['uc_pos'],st['uc_yaw']))
        r.light=Light(direction=(-.4,.6,-.8),ambient=.65,diffuse=.58,sky=.06,tint=(.94,1.04,1.13))
        ju=r.add_humanoid(u,upose,st['uc_pos'],st['uc_yaw'])
        _radio(r,u,upose,st['uc_pos'],st['uc_yaw'],t,'UCILEV')
    # Target is a tiny emissive 3D patch on Biribel's real torso surface.
    if 6450<=t<30600:
        places,j,root=b.pose_world(bpose,BIRI,st['biri_yaw'])
        S=next(M for slot,key,M,org,gr,fb in places if slot==1)
        back=math.cos(math.radians(st['biri_yaw']))<0
        point=v_add(root,m_apply(S,(.09,.26,-.158 if back else .196)))
        _dynamic(r,box(.030,.023,.006,(242,62,42),emissive=True),S,point,bias=-.06)
    return jb


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _grade():
    # Extremely restrained edge falloff. It never replaces actual 3D lighting.
    s=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,BOT-TOP),pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for x in range(0,70,2):
        a=round(18*(1-x/70)**2)
        pygame.draw.line(s,(0,5,12,a),(x,0),(x,BOT-TOP))
        pygame.draw.line(s,(0,5,12,a),(WIDTH-x-1,0),(WIDTH-x-1,BOT-TOP))
    return s


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _fonts():
    path=resource_path('assets/fonts/IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf')
    try:return pygame.font.Font(path,22),pygame.font.Font(path,13),pygame.font.Font(path,28)
    except (OSError,pygame.error):return pygame.font.SysFont('monospace',22),pygame.font.SysFont('monospace',13),pygame.font.SysFont('monospace',28)


def _subtitle(s,t):
    font,small,big=_fonts()
    for on,off,who,text in LINES:
        if not on<=t<off:continue
        alpha=round(255*min(k(t,on,160),1-k(t,off-160,160)))
        words=text.split();lines=[];line=''
        for word in words:
            attempt=(line+' '+word).strip()
            if font.size(attempt)[0]>WIDTH-130 and line:lines.append(line);line=word
            else:line=attempt
        if line:lines.append(line)
        y=BOT-47 if len(lines)==1 else BOT-56
        for i,line in enumerate(lines):
            img=font.render(line,True,(230,235,230));img.set_alpha(alpha)
            s.blit(img,((WIDTH-img.get_width())//2,y+i*27))
        # No name label before the discovery. Colour reinforces radio context,
        # but text and shot direction carry speaker identity, never colour alone.
        colour=(145,171,185) if who=='UCILEV' else (182,174,139) if who=='VASILE' else (166,178,181)
        pygame.draw.line(s,colour,(WIDTH//2-30,BOT-68),(WIDTH//2+30,BOT-68),2)
        break


def _rain(s,t,view):
    if reduced_motion():return
    # Sparse deterministic screen-projected drizzle, NOT giant foreground streaks.
    # Rendered only inside the film; critical faces/hands remain clear.
    film=s.subsurface((0,TOP,WIDTH,BOT-TOP));overlay=pygame.Surface(film.get_size(),pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(74):
        x=(i*197+math.sin(i*1.4)*49-t*.021)%WIDTH
        y=(i*73+t*(.13+(i%4)*.012))%(BOT-TOP)
        a=22 if view in ('ucilev','biribel','radio') else 34
        pygame.draw.line(overlay,(113,152,173,a),(x,y),(x-2,y+5+(i%3)),1)
    film.blit(overlay,(0,0))


def prepare():
    """Warm static 3D, cast and typography before the app starts its clock."""
    _renderer();actors();_fonts();_grade()


def draw(s,t,force_software=False):
    """Production frame with clamped clock and stable software fallback."""
    st=state_at(t);t=st['t'];r,buf=_renderer(force_software)
    eye,target,fov,view=_camera(t)
    # Tiny camera breathing only; reduced motion gets the exact authored path.
    if not reduced_motion():eye=v_add(eye,(math.sin(t*.0008)*.006,math.sin(t*.0011)*.004,0))
    r.set_camera(eye,target,fov)
    _sky(buf,r,t);r.begin();r.add_static();r.light=ENV_LIGHT;_water(r,t);_actors(r,st)
    r.flush(buf)
    clip=s.get_clip();s.set_clip(clip.clip(pygame.Rect(0,SCENE_TOP,WIDTH,SCENE_BOT-SCENE_TOP)))
    try:
        s.fill((0,0,0));s.blit(pygame.transform.smoothscale(buf,(WIDTH,BOT-TOP)),(0,TOP))
        _rain(s,t,view);s.blit(_grade(),(0,TOP));_subtitle(s,t)
    finally:s.set_clip(clip)


def draw_controls(s,paused=False,confirm=False):
    font,small,big=_fonts()
    label='ESC PAUSE   |   ENTER SKIP'
    if paused:label='ESC RESUME   |   ENTER SKIP'
    img=small.render(label,True,(115,138,152));s.blit(img,(WIDTH-img.get_width()-26,HEIGHT-30))
    if paused or confirm:
        veil=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT),pygame.SRCALPHA);veil.fill((2,8,16,165));s.blit(veil,(0,0))
        title='SKIP FINALE?' if confirm else 'PAUSED'
        img=big.render(title,True,(235,239,231));s.blit(img,((WIDTH-img.get_width())//2,HEIGHT//2-28))
        text='ENTER TO SKIP  /  ESC TO KEEP WATCHING' if confirm else 'ESC TO RESUME'
        img=small.render(text,True,(177,199,208));s.blit(img,((WIDTH-img.get_width())//2,HEIGHT//2+22))

"""Diagnostic: render the M5 squadmate handshake at key beats, report draw
count / frame time / wrist gap, and save a contact sheet.
Usage: python previews/handshake_probe.py [tag] [--b64]"""
import os, sys, math, time, base64
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))
import pygame
pygame.init()
from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
from cutscenes import m5mid3d as M
from engine3d.core import SoftwareRenderer

tag = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "probe"
calls = []
_orig = SoftwareRenderer.add_humanoid
def spy(self, hum, pose, pos, yaw, **kw):
    j = _orig(self, hum, pose, pos, yaw, **kw)
    calls.append(j)
    return j
SoftwareRenderer.add_humanoid = spy

surf = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
out = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "handshake")
os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
frames = []
for t in (0, 700, 1150, 1450, 1950, 3200):
    calls.clear()
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    M._squadmate(surf, t)
    dt = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
    gap = math.dist(calls[0]["rhand"], calls[1]["rhand"]) if len(calls) >= 2 else -1
    print(f"t={t:5d} draws={len(calls)} frame={dt:6.1f}ms gap={gap:.3f}m failed={M._m3d._cache['failed']} {M._m3d._cache.get('err','')}")
    frames.append(surf.copy())
w, h = 640, int(640 * HEIGHT / WIDTH)
sheet = pygame.Surface((w * 2, h * 3))
for i, f in enumerate(frames):
    sheet.blit(pygame.transform.smoothscale(f, (w, h)), ((i % 2) * w, (i // 2) * h))
p = os.path.join(out, f"{tag}_sheet.jpg")
pygame.image.save(sheet, p)
if "--b64" in sys.argv:
    print("B64" + base64.b64encode(open(p, "rb").read()).decode())

    "cutscenes.engine",
    "cutscenes.m3ops",
    "cutscenes.chair",
    "cutscenes.m3cell",
    "cutscenes.route12",
    "cutscenes.cast",
)


def __getattr__(name):
    """PEP 562 live view for rebound shared state (see _LIVE_STATE)."""
    if name in _LIVE_STATE:
        import sys as _sys2
        for _mod in _LIVE_MODULES:
            _m = _sys2.modules.get(_mod)
            if _m is not None and name in vars(_m):
                return vars(_m)[name]
    raise AttributeError(
        "module " + repr(__name__) + " has no attribute " + repr(name))
