class _PausedState(GameState):
    name = "PAUSED"
    _return_to = "GAME"  # Snapshot of the state we came from

    def enter(self):
        # Snapshot the previous state on entry. This prevents the
        # PAUSED → SETTINGS → PAUSED round-trip from corrupting
        # gsm.previous_name (which would become "SETTINGS" instead
        # of the original gameplay state).
        _PausedState._return_to = gsm.previous_name
        try:
            voice.pause()               # keep VO/screams in sync with the frozen scene
        except Exception:
            pass

    def handle_event(self, event, mouse_x, mouse_y, keys):
        global _settings_return_to
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_ESCAPE:
            voice.resume()
            gsm.transition(_PausedState._return_to)
            pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
        if menu.pause_buttons[0].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            voice.resume()
            gsm.transition(_PausedState._return_to)
            pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
        if menu.pause_buttons[1].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            _settings_return_to = "PAUSED"
            gsm.transition("SETTINGS")
        if menu.pause_buttons[2].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            gc.restart_current_mission()
            gsm.transition("GAME")
            pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
            menu.reset_death_animation()
        if menu.pause_buttons[3].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            audio.hard_stop()            # cut right away, not after the fade
            trigger_transition("MENU")

    def update(self, dt):
        pass

    def set_ambience(self):
        _set_ambience(set())

    def render(self, surface):
        # Draw the correct background based on where we came from.
        # WALK uses its own renderer; GAME/NOTEBOOK_INSPECT use game_draw.
        if _PausedState._return_to == "WALK":
            gc.draw_walking_sim()
        else:
            gc.game_draw(STATE.camera_x, STATE.camera_y)
        _g = _advance_grain()
        if _g is not None:
            surface.blit(_g, (0, 0))
        menu.draw_pause_menu()


class _DeathState(GameState):
    name = "DEATH"

    def handle_event(self, event, mouse_x, mouse_y, keys):
        if (getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION3"
                and getattr(STATE, "m3_black_ledger_death_active", False)
                and hasattr(menu, "black_ledger_death_buttons_ready")
                and not menu.black_ledger_death_buttons_ready()):
            return

        if menu.death_buttons[0].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            try:
                gc.restart_current_mission()
            except Exception as _restart_err:
                import traceback
                traceback.print_exc()
                # Save the checkpoint flag BEFORE the fallback - start_mission2()
                # calls STATE.reset() which clears mission2_checkpoint_reached to
                # False. Without this, a failed checkpoint respawn (e.g.
                # _explode_tanker threw) cascades into a permanent loss of the
                # checkpoint: the fallback does a full start_mission2() (clearing
                # the flag), and every subsequent death also does a full restart
                # instead of a checkpoint respawn. We restore the flag after the
                # fallback so the next death uses the checkpoint.
                _checkpoint_was_reached = getattr(STATE, "mission2_checkpoint_reached", False)
                try:
                    if getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION2":
                        from missions import m2
                        # If the checkpoint was reached, retry the checkpoint
                        # respawn before falling back to a full mission restart.
                        # The first failure (inside restart_current_mission →
                        # start_mission2_checkpoint) may have been transient
                        # (audio state, partial initialization race). The retry
                        # calls start_mission2_checkpoint() which re-runs
                        # start_mission2() (STATE.reset + full init) so STATE
                        # is clean - this isn't retrying on corrupted state.
                        _checkpoint_retry_ok = False
                        if _checkpoint_was_reached:
                            try:
                                m2.start_mission2_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                                _checkpoint_retry_ok = True
                            except Exception:
                                traceback.print_exc()
                        if not _checkpoint_retry_ok:
                            # Full mission restart as last resort. Preserve
                            # the checkpoint flag so the next death respawn
                            # uses the checkpoint instead of restarting the
                            # entire mission from the intro cutscene.
                            m2.start_mission2(preserve_timer=False)
                            if _checkpoint_was_reached:
                                STATE.mission2_checkpoint_reached = True
                    elif getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION3":
                        from missions import m3
                        # Deepest phase reached, mirroring
                        # restart_current_mission(): the Kill Order and the
                        # Broadcast Wing are the two gauntlets, so a respawn
                        # there beats dumping the player back in the atrium.
                        if getattr(STATE, "mission3_broadcast_checkpoint_reached", False):
                            m3.start_mission3_broadcast_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                        elif getattr(STATE, "mission3_kill_order_checkpoint_reached", False):
                            m3.start_mission3_kill_order_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                        elif getattr(STATE, "mission3_archives_checkpoint_reached", False):
                            m3.start_mission3_archives_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                        elif getattr(STATE, "mission3_comms_checkpoint_reached", False):
                            m3.start_mission3_comms_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                        elif getattr(STATE, "mission3_breakout_checkpoint_reached", False):
                            m3.start_mission3_breakout_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False)
                        else:
                            m3.start_mission3(preserve_timer=False)
                    else:
                        from missions import m1
                        m1.start_mission(preserve_timer=False)
                except Exception as _fallback_err:
                    traceback.print_exc()
                    trigger_transition("MENU")
                    menu.reset_death_animation()
                    return
            gsm.transition("GAME")
            pygame.mouse.set_visible(False)
            menu.reset_death_animation()
        elif menu.death_buttons[1].is_clicked(event, (mouse_x, mouse_y)):
            trigger_transition("MENU")
            menu.reset_death_animation()

    def update(self, dt):
        pass

    def set_ambience(self):
        _set_ambience({"heartbeat"})

    def render(self, surface):
        if (getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION3"
                and getattr(STATE, "m3_black_ledger_death_active", False)
                and hasattr(menu, "draw_black_ledger_death_buttons")):
            # Black Ledger death is its own final screen. Do NOT call
            # gc.game_draw() here: that draws the gameplay HUD, minimap,
            # objective, ammo panel, etc. The final animated ledger frame
            # becomes the death screen on a clean black-site background.
            surface.fill((3, 2, 2))
            try:
                from missions import m3
                m3._draw_black_ledger_death_overlay()
            except Exception:
                # If the custom renderer ever fails, fall back to the normal
                # death screen rather than trapping the player.
                gc.game_draw(STATE.camera_x, STATE.camera_y)
            menu.draw_black_ledger_death_buttons()
            return

        gc.game_draw(STATE.camera_x, STATE.camera_y)
        _g = _advance_grain()
        if _g is not None:
            surface.blit(_g, (0, 0))
        menu.draw_death_screen()


class _MissionCompleteState(GameState):
    name = "MISSION_COMPLETE"

    def enter(self):
        global mission_complete_timer, mission_complete_fade
        mission_complete_timer = 0
        mission_complete_fade = 0
        # Save exactly once on entry - before any handler can zero the timer.
        # Handles MISSION1 / MISSION2 / MISSION3 via save_system's mapping.
        report = _mission_report_data(success=True)
        save_system.save_mission_complete_record(
            getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1"),
            report["time_str"],
            stats=report,
        )

    def handle_event(self, event, mouse_x, mouse_y, keys):
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key in (pygame.K_SPACE, pygame.K_RETURN):
            if getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION1":
                gc.mission_start_time = pygame.time.get_ticks()
                gc.mission_end_time = 0
                start_cutscene(gc.mission2_intro_shots, "MISSION2", use_fades=False)
                trigger_transition("CUTSCENE")
            elif getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION2":
                # Campaign flow: Mission 2 completion should lead into the
                # Mission 3 intro cutscene, not drop directly into gameplay.
                # The cutscene's after_state="GAME" path then transitions
                # cleanly into Mission 3 gameplay once the intro finishes.
                gc.mission_start_time = pygame.time.get_ticks()
                gc.mission_end_time = 0
                gc.start_mission3(preserve_timer=True)
                start_cutscene(gc.mission3_intro_shots, "GAME", use_fades=True)
                trigger_transition("CUTSCENE")
                pygame.mouse.set_visible(True)
            elif getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION3":
                # M3 → M4 chain (mirrors the M2 → M3 idiom): start M4 while
                # the intro plays; the cutscene's after_state="MISSION4"
                # path drops into gameplay when it ends.
                gc.mission_start_time = pygame.time.get_ticks()
                gc.mission_end_time = 0
                gc.start_mission4(preserve_timer=True)
                start_cutscene(gc.mission4_intro_shots, "MISSION4", use_fades=True)
                trigger_transition("CUTSCENE")
                pygame.mouse.set_visible(True)
            elif getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION4":
                # M4 → M5 chain (mirrors the M3 → M4 idiom): start M5 while
                # the bulletin plays; the cutscene's after_state="MISSION5"
                # path drops into the Lower Quarter when it ends.
                gc.mission_start_time = pygame.time.get_ticks()
                gc.mission_end_time = 0
                gc.start_mission5(preserve_timer=True)
                start_cutscene(gc.mission5_intro_shots, "MISSION5", use_fades=True)
                trigger_transition("CUTSCENE")
                pygame.mouse.set_visible(True)
            else:
                # MISSION5 (and anything after): back to the menu. M5
                # completing the campaign is the W4 behavior until a later
                # milestone extends the chain into M6.
                trigger_transition("MENU")
                pygame.mouse.set_visible(True)

    def update(self, dt):
        pass

    def set_ambience(self):
        _set_ambience(set())
        if mission_complete_timer == 1:
            audio.play("mission_complete", volume=0.6)

    def render(self, surface):
        global mission_complete_timer, mission_complete_fade
        mission_complete_timer += 1
        mission_complete_fade = min(255, mission_complete_timer * 5)

        # Background gradient
        for i in range(HEIGHT):
            t = i / HEIGHT
            r = int(5 + t * 8)
            g = int(8 + t * 12)
            b = int(14 + t * 20)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (r, g, b), (0, i), (WIDTH, i))
        if mission_complete_timer % 3 == 0:
            rng_n = random.Random(mission_complete_timer // 3)
            for _ in range(60):
                nx = rng_n.randint(0, WIDTH - 1)
                ny = rng_n.randint(0, HEIGHT - 1)
                surface.set_at((nx, ny), (12, 16, 22))

        # Card
        card_w, card_h = 520, 440
        card_x = WIDTH // 2 - card_w // 2
        card_y = HEIGHT // 2 - card_h // 2 - 10
        shadow = pygame.Surface((card_w + 16, card_h + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        shadow.fill((0, 0, 0, 80))
        surface.blit(shadow, (card_x + 8, card_y + 8))
        card = pygame.Surface((card_w, card_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        card.fill((8, 12, 18, 235))
        pygame.draw.rect(card, (35, 60, 85, 160), (0, 0, card_w, card_h), 1)
        pygame.draw.rect(card, (50, 120, 180), (0, 0, 4, card_h))
        surface.blit(card, (card_x, card_y))

        def _mc_text(surf, x, y, alpha):
            surf.set_alpha(min(255, alpha))
            surface.blit(surf, (x, y))

        def _mc_wrap(text, font, max_w):
            """Word-wrap to max_w. Long quotes/outcome lines used to render
            as one line and ran off both screen edges."""
            out = []
            for para in str(text).split("\n"):
                line = ""
                for word in para.split(" "):
                    test = (line + " " + word).strip()
                    if font.size(test)[0] <= max_w or not line:
                        line = test
                    else:
                        out.append(line)
                        line = word
                out.append(line)
            return out

        # Header area
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (6, 10, 16, 240),
                         (card_x + 4, card_y, card_w - 4, 42))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (35, 60, 85),
                         (card_x + 16, card_y + 42),
                         (card_x + card_w - 16, card_y + 42), 1)
        eyebrow = font_terminal_small.render(
            "KRAP INTEL - AFTER ACTION REPORT", True, (60, 120, 170))
        _mc_text(eyebrow,
                 card_x + card_w // 2 - eyebrow.get_width() // 2,
                 card_y + 8, mission_complete_fade)
        classif = font_terminal_small.render("CLASSIFIED", True, (180, 60, 50))
        _mc_text(classif, card_x + card_w - classif.get_width() - 20,
                 card_y + 8, mission_complete_fade)
        title_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 32, bold=True)
        title_surf = title_font.render("MISSION COMPLETE", True, (200, 198, 190))
        _mc_text(title_surf,
                 card_x + card_w // 2 - title_surf.get_width() // 2,
                 card_y + 56, mission_complete_fade)
        op_name = _mission_meta.operation_name(STATE)
        op = font_terminal.render(op_name, True, (160, 155, 145))
        _mc_text(op,
                 card_x + card_w // 2 - op.get_width() // 2,
                 card_y + 96, mission_complete_fade)
        outcome_line = getattr(gc, "active_mission_outcome", "Target escaped  ·  Notebook recovered  ·  Questions remain")
        out_lines = _mc_wrap(outcome_line, font_terminal_small, card_w - 48)
        for _oli, out_line in enumerate(out_lines):
            out = font_terminal_small.render(out_line, True, (150, 120, 90))
            _mc_text(out,
                     card_x + card_w // 2 - out.get_width() // 2,
                     card_y + 120 + _oli * 16, mission_complete_fade)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (30, 50, 70),
                         (card_x + 30, card_y + 145),
                         (card_x + card_w - 30, card_y + 145), 1)

        # Stats grid
        if mission_complete_timer > 25:
            stats_fade = min(255, (mission_complete_timer - 25) * 7)
            report = _mission_report_data(success=True)
            stats = [
                ("KILLS", str(report["kills"])),
                ("SHOTS FIRED", str(report["shots_fired"])),
                ("ACCURACY", f"{report['accuracy']}%"),
                ("TOTAL TIME", report["time_str"]),
                ("CIVILIANS HELPED", str(report["civilians_helped"])),
                ("INTEL FOUND", "YES" if report["intel_found"] else "NO"),
                ("RATIONS USED", str(report["rations_used"])),
                ("RANK", report["rank"]),
            ]
            stat_x = card_x + 36
            stat_y = card_y + 158
            for i, (label, value) in enumerate(stats):
                col = i % 2
                row = i // 2
                sx = stat_x + col * 240
                sy = stat_y + row * 42
                lbl = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, (55, 95, 130))
                lbl.set_alpha(stats_fade)
                surface.blit(lbl, (sx, sy))
                val_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 22, bold=True)
                val_col = (255, 220, 120) if label == "RANK" else (180, 220, 245)
                val = val_font.render(value, True, val_col)
                val.set_alpha(stats_fade)
                surface.blit(val, (sx, sy + 14))
                line_alpha = min(stats_fade, 60)
                ul = pygame.Surface((200, 1), pygame.SRCALPHA)
                ul.fill((35, 60, 85, line_alpha))
                surface.blit(ul, (sx, sy + 34))

        pygame.draw.line(surface, (30, 50, 70),
                         (card_x + 30, card_y + 325),
                         (card_x + card_w - 30, card_y + 325), 1)

        # Vasile quote
        if mission_complete_timer > 70:
            q_fade = min(255, (mission_complete_timer - 70) * 5)
            attr = font_terminal_small.render(
                getattr(gc, "active_mission_quote_attr", "Vasile, after a long pause:"), True, (90, 80, 70))
            attr.set_alpha(q_fade)
            surface.blit(attr, (card_x + 36, card_y + 338))
            quote_lines = _mc_wrap(
                getattr(gc, "active_mission_quote", '"Bring it straight to me. Don\'t read it."'),
                font_dialogue, card_w - 72)
            quote_h = 18
            quote_top = card_y + 360 - (len(quote_lines) - 1) * quote_h // 2
            for _qi, quote_line in enumerate(quote_lines):
                quote = font_dialogue.render(quote_line, True, C_VASILE)
                quote.set_alpha(q_fade)
                surface.blit(quote,
                             (card_x + card_w // 2 - quote.get_width() // 2,
                              quote_top + _qi * quote_h))

        # Bottom bar
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (35, 60, 85),
                         (card_x + 16, card_y + card_h - 34),
                         (card_x + card_w - 16, card_y + card_h - 34), 1)
        footer = font_terminal_small.render(
            "KRAP INTELLIGENCE DIVISION - FIELD COPY", True, (45, 65, 80))
        _mc_text(footer,
                 card_x + card_w // 2 - footer.get_width() // 2,
                 card_y + card_h - 26, mission_complete_fade)

        # Continue prompt
        if mission_complete_timer > 120 and (pygame.time.get_ticks() // 600) % 2 == 0:
            next_prompt = "PRESS SPACE TO START MISSION 2" if getattr(gc, "active_mission", "MISSION1") == "MISSION1" else "PRESS SPACE TO RETURN TO MENU"
            prompt = font_btn.render(next_prompt, True, C_ORANGE)
            prompt.set_alpha(mission_complete_fade)
            surface.blit(prompt,
                         (WIDTH // 2 - prompt.get_width() // 2,
                          card_y + card_h + 18))


# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# FSM REGISTRATION
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

for _state_cls in (
    _BootIntroState,
    _MenuState, _SlotSelectState, _MultiplayerState, _SettingsState,

    _CutsceneState, _BriefingState, _WalkState, _GameState_,
    _EscapeCutsceneState, _NotebookInspectState, _PausedState,
    _DeathState, _MissionCompleteState,
):
    gsm.add(_state_cls())

gsm.transition("BOOT_INTRO")
_apply_dev_args()

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# DEV TOOLS - Level Editor & Console
# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
level_editor = LevelEditor()
console = Console()

        elif mission == "MISSION2":

        elif mission == "MISSION3":

# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
# Apply saved display mode on startup
# â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
try:
    apply_display_mode(display_mode, menu.SETTINGS_RESOLUTIONS[res_idx])
except Exception as _e:

# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•
# MAIN LOOP - CLEAN FSM DISPATCH
# â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•â•

MAX_DT = 0.05
running = True

# RPE5 ADAPTER A-002: the loop body is unchanged; it now runs as one frame
# of a scene hosted by engine.core.App.run_scene (crash reports on uncaught
# errors). Every name the body assigns stays a module global, exactly as
# under the old module-level `while running:` loop.
def _legacy_frame():
    global CURSOR_ARROW_STATES, _hud, _mp_live, _s, _sim_step, current_name, dt, event, keys, mouse_visible, mouse_x, mouse_y, music_state, new_mode, running, upload_os
    dt = min(clock.tick(60) / 1000.0, MAX_DT)
    STATE.dt = dt
    mouse_x, mouse_y = get_scaled_mouse()
    keys = pygame.key.get_pressed()

    if hasattr(audio, "update"):
        audio.update()

    # ── Radio director: release queued transmissions (called in all states;
    # the pump itself decides whether the current state may speak) ──
    # Gated by interactions.radio_allowed(): only GAME / WALK outside
    # cutscene handoffs and dialogue; PAUSED/SETTINGS freeze the radio clock.
    interactions.pump_radio(gsm.current_name, gsm.transitioning)

    # â”€â”€ Mouse visibility â”€â”€
    current_name = gsm.current_name
    # Hide the OS pointer wherever the game draws its own cursor instead:
    #   GAME / WALK          → combat reticle (drawn by the mission modules)
    #   menu-family states   → custom tactical arrow (ui.main.draw_menu_cursor)
    # Single source of truth for the menu half is ui.main.CURSOR_ARROW_STATES;
    # hiding the pointer on a state that draws no cursor would strand the user
    # with no visible pointer at all.
    from ui.main import CURSOR_ARROW_STATES
    mouse_visible = current_name not in (CURSOR_ARROW_STATES | {"GAME", "WALK"})
    if current_name == "GAME":
        if level_editor.active:
            mouse_visible = True
        else:
            try:
                from ui import upload_os
                if upload_os.is_upload_os_active():
                    mouse_visible = False
            except ImportError:
                pass
    pygame.mouse.set_visible(mouse_visible)

    # â”€â”€ Event dispatch â”€â”€
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
            continue

        # Global: mute on focus loss
        if event.type == pygame.ACTIVEEVENT:
            try:
                from core.user_settings import SETTINGS as _s
                if _s.mute_on_focus_loss:
                    if event.gain == 0:
                        audio.mute_all()
                    else:
                        audio.unmute_all()
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Global: F11 fullscreen toggle
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_F11:
            new_mode = 1 if display_mode == 0 else 0
            apply_display_mode(new_mode, menu.SETTINGS_RESOLUTIONS[res_idx])
            if gsm.current_name == "SETTINGS":
                _preview_settings()
            else:
                _persist_settings()
            continue

        # F12 - Level Editor toggle (gameplay only)
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_F12:
            if gsm.current_name == "GAME":
                if level_editor.map_data is None:
                    _update_editor_map()
                level_editor.toggle()
            continue

        # `~` - Developer Console toggle (any state)
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN and event.key == pygame.K_BACKQUOTE:
            console.toggle()
            continue

        # Console consumes all events while active
        if console.active:
            console.handle_event(event)
            continue

        # Level Editor processes events alongside game
        if level_editor.active:
            level_editor.handle_event(event)

        # State-level event handling
        if not gsm.transitioning:
            gsm.current.handle_event(event, mouse_x, mouse_y, keys)

    # â”€â”€ Update dispatch â”€â”€
    # NOTE: `keys` is read as a module-level global. It's set each frame
    # at the top of the loop. This works because Python's while-loop
    # doesn't create a new scope. If the loop is ever moved into a
    # function, `keys` must be passed as a parameter to update().
    #
    # ── Fixed-timestep (multiplayer only) ──
    # Off by default: single-player keeps the exact legacy variable-dt
    # behaviour, one update() call per rendered frame. When a multiplayer
    # session enables it (core.fixedstep.set_enabled(True)), the simulation
    # is instead advanced in whole 1/60 s ticks, so a frame counter like
    # `fire_cooldown -= 1` advances the same amount of *game time* on every
    # machine. Without this the host's hardware silently sets the rules of
    # the match: a host rendering at 30 FPS would hand out half the fire rate
    # of one at 60. Rendering is untouched and still happens once per frame,
    # so this cannot change how anything looks.
    #
    # Deliberate asymmetry: this loop advances the simulation and nothing
    # else. Audio, ambience, event handling and rendering stay per-frame so
    # they keep their real-time feel and the frame rate stays free of
    # simulation concerns.
    if _fixedstep.is_enabled():
        for _sim_step in range(_fixedstep.clock().steps(dt)):
            # Each tick sees exactly one fixed dt, so `60.0 * STATE.dt` is
            # exactly 1.0 and px/frame speeds mean the intended thing.
            STATE.dt = _fixedstep.clock().dt
            if not gsm.transitioning:
                gsm.current.update(_fixedstep.clock().dt)
    else:
        # RPE5 Phase 1 (ADR-004): single-player now also runs on the engine's
        # fixed-step clock (App.clock, 60 Hz, max 5 steps/frame). Render,
        # audio and events stay per-frame, exactly like the MP branch above.
        _eng_clock = _rpe5_config._engine_app.clock
        for _sim_step in range(_eng_clock.advance(dt)):
            STATE.dt = _eng_clock.dt
            if not gsm.transitioning:
                gsm.current.update(_eng_clock.dt)
            _eng_clock.tick()

    # â”€â”€ Ambience dispatch â”€â”€
    gsm.current.set_ambience()

    # ── World ambience layers (zone-driven loops + scheduled foley) ──
    ambience.update_ambience()
    # Stream menu music on menu-family states
    music_state = gsm.next_state if gsm.transitioning and gsm.fade_speed > 0 else current_name
    _set_menu_music(music_state in MENU_MUSIC_STATES)

    # â”€â”€ Render dispatch â”€â”€
    gsm.current.render(screen)

    # ── Screen-space cursors (two call sites, mutually exclusive) ──
    # Both are drawn here, after the state's own pass, so they persist no
    # matter what the state rendered on top. Each owns its own state gate:
    #   hud.draw_crosshair()    → GAME / WALK (aiming)
    #   menu.draw_menu_cursor() → every menu-family screen (pointing)
    # They never both paint: the two state sets are disjoint by construction.
    from ui import hud as _hud
    _hud.draw_crosshair(screen, current_name)
    # MULTIPLAYER is a menu-family state, but a live arena match renders
    # through that state name and aims with the combat reticle. Keep the
    # arrow during play; keep it visible on the host's frozen waiting screen
    # so COPY CODE remains easy to target. The pause menu also needs the arrow
    # back to click RESUME / LEAVE MATCH.
    # MULTIPLAYER is the one menu-family state that also hosts live play, so it
    # decides for itself which pointer owns the frame. Asking the match screen
    # rather than testing its mode here keeps host and joiner on the same rule:
    # the frozen lobby and the start countdown want the arrow, a live round
    # wants the reticle. The previous inline test used waiting_for_player(),
    # which only ever returns True for the host -- so a joiner in the very same
    # lobby lost the arrow they needed to click the team panels with.
    _mp_live = (current_name == "MULTIPLAYER"
                and not _match_screen.wants_menu_cursor())
    menu.draw_menu_cursor(screen, current_name, suppressed=_mp_live)

    # â”€â”€ Dev tool overlays â”€â”€
    level_editor.draw(screen)
    console.draw(screen)

    # â”€â”€ FSM transition overlay â”€â”€
    gsm.update_transition()
    gsm.draw_transition(screen)

    # â”€â”€ Global post-processing â”€â”€
    _apply_postprocess()

    _present_frame()
    pygame.display.flip()


class _LegacyGameScene:
    """RPE5 ADAPTER A-002: the whole legacy game as one engine scene."""

    @property
    def done(self):
        return not running

    def frame(self):
        _legacy_frame()


from core import config as _rpe5_config  # noqa: E402
_rpe5_config._engine_app.run_scene(_LegacyGameScene())

try:
    audio.hard_stop(music=True)          # no VO/loop tail after the window closes
    pygame.mixer.quit()
except Exception:
    pass
pygame.quit()
sys.exit()

"""Hand-authored pixel-art sprites (pygame-only, no game imports)."""

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\__init__.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Mission 5 sprite registry.

Every asset is a module ``art.m5.<name>`` exposing ``render(variant=0, scale=1)
-> pygame.Surface`` (pygame-only) plus ``VARIANTS``. ``tools/bake_m5_sprites.py``
bakes them to ``assets/sprites/m5/<name>_<variant>.png``.

``get(name, variant, scale)`` is the one entry point the game uses: baked PNG
first, live ``render()`` second, and ``None`` if both fail - callers keep the
old procedural drawing as the fallback. Results are cached per key, so the
per-frame cost is one dict lookup.
"""
import importlib
import os
import sys

import pygame

ASSETS = ("posters", "printworks_sign", "guard_banner", "guard_plate", "district_map",
          "portrait_frame", "presidential_crest", "calendar", "armband", "wall_posters",
          "hq_locker", "mag", "mag_icon", "plate", "press", "bale", "m5_guard",
          "maru", "tram_wreck", "inspect_art")
# Wall art that the 3D cutscenes mesh into decals (m5decal); the rest are
# gameplay / HUD sprites blitted in 2D.
DECALS = ("posters", "printworks_sign", "guard_banner", "guard_plate", "district_map",
          "portrait_frame", "presidential_crest", "calendar", "armband")

_CACHE = {}


def _root():
    base = getattr(sys, "_MEIPASS", None)
    if base:
        return base
    return os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))))


def sprite_dir():
    return os.path.join(_root(), "assets", "sprites", "m5")


def baked_path(name, variant=0):
    return os.path.join(sprite_dir(), "%s_%d.png" % (name, variant))


def module(name):
    return importlib.import_module("art.m5." + name)


def variants(name):
    return getattr(module(name), "VARIANTS", 1)


def get(name, variant=0, scale=1, baked=True):
    key = (name, variant, scale, baked)
    if key in _CACHE:
        return _CACHE[key]
    surf = None
    if baked:
        try:
            p = baked_path(name, variant)
            if os.path.exists(p):
                surf = pygame.image.load(p)
                if pygame.display.get_init() and pygame.display.get_surface() is not None:
                    surf = surf.convert_alpha()
                if scale != 1:
                    w, h = surf.get_size()
                    surf = pygame.transform.scale(surf, (int(w * scale), int(h * scale)))
        except Exception:
            surf = None
    if surf is None:
        try:
            surf = module(name).render(variant, scale)
        except Exception:
            surf = None
    _CACHE[key] = surf
    return surf

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\_kit.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Shared pixel-art kit for the Mission 5 sprites.

Conventions (see previews/m5_gauntlet/NITPICKS.md):
  * KEY LIGHT FROM THE UPPER-LEFT: bevels/highlights on top+left edges,
    shade on bottom+right edges, cast shadows fall down-right.
  * Flat colour areas (no per-pixel noise) so the 3D decal mesher can merge
    runs into few faces, and so the art reads as deliberate pixel art.
  * pygame only - no game imports (safe for tools/bake_m5_sprites.py).
"""
import pygame

INK = (28, 24, 22)
CREAM = (214, 200, 164)
PAPER = (222, 214, 190)
RED = (150, 30, 28)
GUARD_RED = (180, 40, 40)
BRASS = (176, 140, 62)
GOLD_HI = (232, 200, 120)
GOLD_LO = (112, 84, 36)
GUARD_BLACK = (24, 22, 24)
KRAP_BLUE = (52, 86, 150)
CLEAR = (0, 0, 0, 0)

# classic 5x7 column font (LSB = top row)
_F = {
    "A": (0x7E, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x7E), "B": (0x7F, 0x49, 0x49, 0x49, 0x36),
    "C": (0x3E, 0x41, 0x41, 0x41, 0x22), "D": (0x7F, 0x41, 0x41, 0x22, 0x1C),
    "E": (0x7F, 0x49, 0x49, 0x49, 0x41), "F": (0x7F, 0x09, 0x09, 0x09, 0x01),
    "G": (0x3E, 0x41, 0x49, 0x49, 0x7A), "H": (0x7F, 0x08, 0x08, 0x08, 0x7F),
    "I": (0x00, 0x41, 0x7F, 0x41, 0x00), "J": (0x20, 0x40, 0x41, 0x3F, 0x01),
    "K": (0x7F, 0x08, 0x14, 0x22, 0x41), "L": (0x7F, 0x40, 0x40, 0x40, 0x40),
    "M": (0x7F, 0x02, 0x0C, 0x02, 0x7F), "N": (0x7F, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x7F),
    "O": (0x3E, 0x41, 0x41, 0x41, 0x3E), "P": (0x7F, 0x09, 0x09, 0x09, 0x06),
    "Q": (0x3E, 0x41, 0x51, 0x21, 0x5E), "R": (0x7F, 0x09, 0x19, 0x29, 0x46),
    "S": (0x46, 0x49, 0x49, 0x49, 0x31), "T": (0x01, 0x01, 0x7F, 0x01, 0x01),
    "U": (0x3F, 0x40, 0x40, 0x40, 0x3F), "V": (0x1F, 0x20, 0x40, 0x20, 0x1F),
    "W": (0x3F, 0x40, 0x38, 0x40, 0x3F), "X": (0x63, 0x14, 0x08, 0x14, 0x63),
    "Y": (0x07, 0x08, 0x70, 0x08, 0x07), "Z": (0x61, 0x51, 0x49, 0x45, 0x43),
    "0": (0x3E, 0x51, 0x49, 0x45, 0x3E), "1": (0x00, 0x42, 0x7F, 0x40, 0x00),
    "2": (0x42, 0x61, 0x51, 0x49, 0x46), "3": (0x21, 0x41, 0x45, 0x4B, 0x31),
    "4": (0x18, 0x14, 0x12, 0x7F, 0x10), "5": (0x27, 0x45, 0x45, 0x45, 0x39),
    "6": (0x3C, 0x4A, 0x49, 0x49, 0x30), "7": (0x01, 0x71, 0x09, 0x05, 0x03),
    "8": (0x36, 0x49, 0x49, 0x49, 0x36), "9": (0x06, 0x49, 0x49, 0x29, 0x1E),
    "-": (0x08, 0x08, 0x08, 0x08, 0x08), ".": (0x00, 0x60, 0x60, 0x00, 0x00),
    "!": (0x00, 0x00, 0x5F, 0x00, 0x00), ":": (0x00, 0x36, 0x36, 0x00, 0x00),
    "/": (0x20, 0x10, 0x08, 0x04, 0x02), " ": (0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
}


def new(w, h, fill=CLEAR):
    s = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    s.fill(fill)
    return s


def mix(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t)) for i in range(3))


def shade(c, f):
    return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(c[i] * f))) for i in range(3))


def text_w(s, sp=1, sx=1):
    return (len(s) * (5 + sp) - sp) * sx


def text(surf, s, x, y, col, sp=1, sx=1, sy=1, skip=()):
    """Blit ``s`` in the 5x7 font; ``skip`` = char indices drawn in col[1]
    when ``col`` is a (lit, dead) pair (sign letters that have blown)."""
    lit, dead = (col if isinstance(col[0], tuple) else (col, col))
    for n, ch in enumerate(s.upper()):
        cols = _F.get(ch, _F[" "])
        c = dead if n in skip else lit
        for i, bits in enumerate(cols):
            for j in range(7):
                if bits >> j & 1:
                    surf.fill(c, (x + i * sx, y + j * sy, sx, sy))
        x += (5 + sp) * sx


def text_c(surf, s, cx, y, col, sp=1, sx=1, sy=1, skip=()):
    text(surf, s, cx - text_w(s, sp, sx) // 2, y, col, sp, sx, sy, skip)


def bevel(surf, rect, hi, lo, t=1):
    """Raised edge, lit from the upper-left."""
    x, y, w, h = rect
    for k in range(t):
        surf.fill(hi, (x + k, y + k, w - 2 * k, 1))
        surf.fill(hi, (x + k, y + k, 1, h - 2 * k))
        surf.fill(lo, (x + k, y + h - 1 - k, w - 2 * k, 1))
        surf.fill(lo, (x + w - 1 - k, y + k, 1, h - 2 * k))


def curl(surf, col, a=70):
    """Paper lifting off the wall: 1 px shade on the bottom+right edges."""
    w, h = surf.get_size()
    sh = new(w, h)
    sh.fill((*col, a), (0, h - 1, w, 1))
    sh.fill((*col, a), (w - 1, 0, 1, h))
    surf.blit(sh, (0, 0))


def lines(surf, x, y, w, rows, col, gap=3, seed=1):
    """Fine print too small to read: ragged grey bars."""
    v = seed * 7919
    for r in range(rows):
        v = (v * 1103515245 + 12345) & 0x7FFFFFFF
        ln = w - (v >> 8) % max(1, w // 3) if r % 4 != 3 else w // 2
        surf.fill(col, (x, y + r * gap, ln, 1))


def fade(surf, toward, t):
    """Sun/rain-bleached: pull every opaque pixel toward ``toward``."""
    w, h = surf.get_size()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            r, g, b, a = surf.get_at((x, y))
            if a:
                surf.set_at((x, y), (*mix((r, g, b), toward, t), a))


def scaled(surf, scale):
    if scale == 1:
        return surf
    w, h = surf.get_size()
    return pygame.transform.scale(surf, (max(1, int(w * scale)), max(1, int(h * scale))))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\bale.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Strapped newspaper bundles seen from above (Print Works stacks/pallets).
One baked variant per footprint the map uses, with and without the black
"MAG" label: variant = size_index * 2 + (1 if labelled). Bundles are offset
by a fixed per-variant seed; top edges catch the upper-left key light.
Replaces decor_interior._bale (the drop shadow stays live)."""
import random

import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

SIZES = ((56, 56), (71, 58), (45, 45), (58, 122))
VARIANTS = len(SIZES) * 2
PAPER = (214, 208, 190)
PAPER_D = (176, 170, 152)
INK = (24, 26, 34)
STRAP = (150, 40, 34)
MAG = (230, 190, 120)


def variant_for(w, h, label):
    """Variant for a (w, h) footprint, or None when it is not baked."""
    try:
        return SIZES.index((w, h)) * 2 + (1 if label and w > 40 else 0)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    si, lab = divmod(int(variant) % VARIANTS, 2)
    w, h = SIZES[si]
    rnd = random.Random(500 + si)
    s = K.new(w, h)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, PAPER_D, (0, 0, w, h))
    rows = max(1, h // 22)
    for i in range(rows):
        y = i * (h // rows)
        hh = h // rows - 2
        off = rnd.randint(-2, 2)
        b = pygame.Rect(2 + off, y + 1, w - 4, hh)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, PAPER, b)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (236, 232, 218), b.topleft, (b.right - 1, b.y))      # lit top edge
        pygame.draw.line(s, (236, 232, 218), b.topleft, (b.x, b.bottom - 1))     # lit left edge
        for k in range(3, b.h - 1, 4):                                         # page edges
            pygame.draw.line(s, PAPER_D, (b.x + 2, b.y + k), (b.right - 3, b.y + k))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, STRAP, (b.x + b.w // 3, b.y, 3, b.h))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, STRAP, (b.x + 2 * b.w // 3, b.y, 3, b.h))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (120, 116, 104), b, 1)
    if lab and w > 40:
        pygame.draw.rect(s, INK, (6, 6, 26, 11))
        K.text(s, "MAG", 9, 8, MAG)
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

"""Vasile's district map (52 x 36 px, 1.3 x 0.9 m): street grid, the river,
the Lower Quarter ringed in red, "SECTOR 4" title strip."""
import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

W, H = 52, 36
VARIANTS = 1


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    s = K.new(W, H, (196, 182, 142))
    K.bevel(s, (0, 0, W, H), (226, 214, 180), (120, 108, 80))
    s.fill((150, 136, 100), (2, 2, W - 4, 9))
    K.text_c(s, "SECTOR 4", W // 2, 3, K.INK)
    block = (172, 156, 116)
    for gy in range(4):                                         # city blocks
        for gx in range(7):
            x, y = 3 + gx * 7, 13 + gy * 5
            if (gx * 3 + gy) % 5 == 0:
                continue                                        # squares / parks
            s.fill(block, (x, y, 6, 4))
    s.fill((150, 170, 112), (3 + 7 * 0, 13 + 5 * 0, 6, 4))      # the park
    pts = [(2, 30), (12, 27), (22, 29), (32, 24), (42, 26), (50, 20)]
    pygame.draw.lines(s, (92, 110, 124), False, pts, 3)         # the river
    pygame.draw.lines(s, (130, 148, 160), False, [(x, y - 1) for x, y in pts], 1)
    q = pygame.Rect(30, 12, 18, 11)                             # the Lower Quarter
    for x in range(q.left, q.right, 2):
        s.set_at((x, q.top), K.RED); s.set_at((x, q.bottom - 1), K.RED)
    for y in range(q.top, q.bottom, 2):
        s.set_at((q.left, y), K.RED); s.set_at((q.right - 1, y), K.RED)
    s.fill(K.INK, (W - 8, H - 7, 1, 4))                         # north arrow
    s.fill(K.INK, (W - 9, H - 6, 3, 1))
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Presidential Guard banner (36 x 57 px, 1.2 x 1.9 m): brass rod, black
cloth with folds lit from the left, gold eagle, red band "GUARD",
swallowtail hem with gold fringe."""
import math

import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

W, H = 36, 57
VARIANTS = 1


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    s = K.new(W, H)
    s.fill(K.BRASS, (0, 0, W, 2))                               # rod
    s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (0, 0, W, 1))
    s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (0, 0, 2, 2))                             # finial catch-light
    for x in range(1, W - 1):                                   # cloth with three soft folds
        f = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.cos((x - 2) / (W - 4) * math.pi * 3)
        col = K.mix((18, 16, 18), (40, 37, 40), round(f * 2) / 2)
        s.fill(col, (x, 2, 1, H - 8))
    for x in range(1, W - 1):                                   # swallowtail hem
        d = abs(x - W / 2) / (W / 2)
        bot = int(H - 6 + 4 * d)
        s.fill(s.get_at((x, 10))[:3], (x, H - 6, 1, bot - (H - 6)))
        s.set_at((x, bot), K.BRASS if x % 2 else K.GOLD_LO)     # fringe
    # gold eagle: spread wings, head turned left (to the light)
    cx, cy = 18, 17
    gold = K.BRASS
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, gold, [(cx, cy + 2), (cx - 12, cy - 5), (cx - 9, cy + 1), (cx - 12, cy + 2), (cx - 4, cy + 6)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, gold, [(cx, cy + 2), (cx + 12, cy - 5), (cx + 9, cy + 1), (cx + 12, cy + 2), (cx + 4, cy + 6)])
    pygame.draw.rect(s, gold, (cx - 2, cy - 3, 4, 11))          # body
    pygame.draw.rect(s, gold, (cx - 3, cy - 6, 4, 3))           # head
    s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (cx - 4, cy - 6, 2, 1))                   # beak
    s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (cx - 11, cy - 5, 5, 1))                  # lit wing edge
    s.fill(K.GOLD_LO, (cx + 1, cy - 2, 1, 9))                   # body shade, right
    s.fill(gold, (cx - 4, cy + 8, 8, 1))                        # talons
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.GOLD_HI, [(cx, cy - 13), (cx - 2, cy - 9), (cx + 2, cy - 9)])  # star
    s.fill(K.GUARD_RED, (1, 32, W - 2, 11))                     # red band
    s.fill((206, 70, 60), (1, 32, W - 2, 1))
    s.fill((110, 22, 22), (1, 42, W - 2, 1))
    K.text_c(s, "GUARD", 18, 34, (20, 16, 16))
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\inspect_art.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Static layers of the Mission 5 "[E] look" first-person shots (canvas
CW x CH = 1.3x screen). One variant per shot, in KEYS order. The painters
are the existing pygame-only set painters in missions.m5.inspect_art /
inspect_art_street (all English text); this module freezes them into baked
PNGs so inspect_fpv blits instead of repainting ~80 draw calls per shot.
Per-frame motion (CRT flicker, smoke, sway) stays live in the *_dyn painters."""
import pygame

KEYS = ("notice", "hq_tv", "portrait", "paint", "shop_tv", "tram")
VARIANTS = len(KEYS)


def _painter(key):
    from missions.m5 import inspect_art as a
    from missions.m5 import inspect_art_street as st
    return {"notice": a.notice_static, "hq_tv": a.tv_static, "portrait": a.portrait_static,
            "paint": st.paint_static, "shop_tv": st.shop_static, "tram": st.tram_static}[key]


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    from art.m5 import _kit as K
    from missions.m5 import inspect_art as a
    key = KEYS[int(variant) % VARIANTS]
    s = pygame.Surface((a.CW, a.CH))
    _painter(key)(s)
    out = pygame.Surface((a.CW, a.CH), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    out.blit(s, (0, 0))
    return K.scaled(out, scale)

# src\art\m5\m5_guard.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Presidential Guard trooper, top-down gameplay sprite (96 x 96, figure
centred at (48, 48), facing +x). Same body grammar as the other enemy
families: flat black tunic, sleeve arms to the weapon, skin hands, skin head
with Guard headgear, red armband. draw._draw_m5_guard rotates it into a
cached angle bucket and adds the walk sway, eyes and hit ring live.

Variant 0: rifleman (beret), 1: marksman (beret, long rifle + scope),
2: raider (steel helmet). Replaces the per-frame polygon drawing."""
import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

VARIANTS = 3
SIZE = 96
C = SIZE // 2
KIT = (58, 58, 68)
SEAM = (76, 76, 88)
BELT = (30, 28, 30)
ARMBAND = (200, 30, 30)
BERET = (18, 18, 22)
HELMET = (40, 42, 46)
SKIN = (190, 160, 130)


def _L(f, sd):
    return (C + f, C + sd)


def _I(p):
    return (int(p[0]), int(p[1]))


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    kind = ("rifleman", "marksman", "raider")[int(variant) % VARIANTS]
    s = K.new(SIZE, SIZE)
    L = _L
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, KIT, [L(-6.5, -10), L(6.5, -10), L(6.5, 10), L(-6.5, 10)])
    pygame.draw.line(s, SEAM, L(-4, 0), L(4, 0), 2)                        # tunic seam
    pygame.draw.line(s, BELT, L(-1, -10), L(-1, 10), 2)                    # cross belt
    arm_len = 15
    hand = L(arm_len, 0)
    pygame.draw.line(s, KIT, L(0, 11), (hand[0], hand[1] - 3), 5)
    pygame.draw.line(s, KIT, L(0, -11), (hand[0], hand[1] + 3), 5)
    pygame.draw.line(s, ARMBAND, _I(L(0, 9)), _I(L(4, 9)), 3)              # armband, left sleeve
    grip = L(arm_len + 4, 0)
    glen = 26 if kind == "marksman" else 20
    pygame.draw.circle(s, SKIN, _I(grip), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (30, 28, 26), L(arm_len + 6, 0), L(arm_len + 4 + glen, 0), 3)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (52, 50, 48), _I(L(arm_len + 4 + glen, 0)), 2)
    if kind == "marksman":
        pygame.draw.line(s, (20, 20, 22), L(arm_len + 7, 0), L(arm_len + 13, 0), 5)   # scope
    hr = 8
    pygame.draw.circle(s, SKIN, _I(L(2, 0)), hr)
    if kind == "raider":
        pygame.draw.circle(s, HELMET, _I(L(-1, 0)), hr + 1)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, SKIN, _I(L(4, 0)), hr - 3)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (20, 20, 22), L(3, -hr + 1), L(3, hr - 1), 1)  # chin strap
    else:
        pygame.draw.circle(s, BERET, _I(L(-2, -1)), hr)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, SKIN, _I(L(3, 1)), hr - 3)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, ARMBAND, _I(L(-5, -5)), 2)                   # cockade
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\mag_icon.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""HUD magazine-icon shells (weapon panel). The shell art is static per kind
and state, so it is baked; only the live round count (witness holes / round
stack) is overlaid at runtime by draw._draw_m5_mag_icon.

Variant = kind * 3 + state, kind 0 = stick (K-9 / OS-12), 1 = tapered box
mag; state 0 = empty, 1 = active, 2 = idle.
Stick sprite: 26 x 55, blit at (mx, my - 3). Box sprite: 25 x 47 at (mx, my).
Key light upper-left: lit left flank strip on both kinds."""
import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

VARIANTS = 6
C_TERMINAL = (50, 255, 150)
STICK_OFFSET = (0, -3)
BOX_OFFSET = (0, 0)


def _stick(state):
    s = K.new(26, 55)
    bx, by, mw, mh = 5, 3, 14, 52
    if state == 0:
        base, rim, hi = (24, 28, 28), (52, 62, 58), (36, 42, 40)
    elif state == 1:
        base, rim, hi = (36, 48, 44), (120, 230, 180), (70, 92, 84)
    else:
        base, rim, hi = (32, 38, 36), (86, 112, 102), (54, 66, 62)
    right, bottom = bx + mw, by + mh
    poly = [(bx + 1, by), (right - 1, by + 1), (right - 3, bottom), (bx + 3, bottom)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, base, poly)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, rim if state == 1 else (64, 70, 66), poly, 1)
    pygame.draw.line(s, hi, (bx + 4, by + 4), (bx + 5, bottom - 5), 1)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (80, 86, 78), (bx + 2, by - 3, mw - 2, 4), border_radius=1)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (18, 20, 20), (bx + 1, bottom - 4, mw - 1, 5), border_radius=1)
    for row_i in range(12):                       # empty witness holes
        wy = bottom - 8 - row_i * 3
        for wx_off in (5, 9):
            pygame.draw.circle(s, (18, 20, 20), (bx + wx_off, wy), 1)
    if state == 1:
        pygame.draw.line(s, (120, 230, 180), (right + 3, by + 4), (right + 3, bottom - 4), 2)
    return s


def _box(state):
    s = K.new(25, 47)
    top_w, bot_w, h = 24, 20, 46
    taper = (top_w - bot_w) // 2
    pts = [(0, 0), (top_w, 0), (taper + bot_w, h), (taper, h)]
    if state == 0:
        base, hl, rim = (45, 42, 38), (55, 52, 48), (55, 50, 45)
    elif state == 1:
        base, hl, rim = (90, 86, 78), (115, 110, 100), (70, 66, 58)
    else:
        base, hl, rim = (72, 68, 62), (92, 88, 80), (60, 56, 50)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, base, pts)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, hl, [(1, 2), (5, 2), (taper + 3, h - 3), (taper + 1, h - 3)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, C_TERMINAL if state == 1 else rim, pts, 1)
    dark = (40, 38, 35) if state == 0 else (55, 52, 48)
    for bi in range(12):                          # empty round stack
        pygame.draw.circle(s, dark, (top_w // 2, 8 + bi * 3), 2)
    return s


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    kind, state = divmod(int(variant) % VARIANTS, 3)
    return K.scaled(_stick(state) if kind == 0 else _box(state), scale)

# src\art\m5\maru.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Maru, top-down gameplay sprite (84 x 84, anchor (42, 48) = feet/centre):
the figure_kit cast look - black hoodie, pistol in the good arm, wounded arm
in a white sling. Baked in 36 headings (10 degree steps) x 2 hit-strobe
skins. Variant = heading_index * 2 + strobe.

The figure itself is composed by the shared figure_kit rig (pygame only), via
missions.m5.draw._draw_maru_figure, so the cutscene and gameplay Maru stay
one character; this module turns it into fixed, bakeable frames."""
import math

from art.m5 import _kit as K

HEADINGS = 36
VARIANTS = HEADINGS * 2
W, H = 84, 84
ANCHOR = (42, 48)


def variant_for(angle, flash):
    b = int(round(angle / (2 * math.pi) * HEADINGS)) % HEADINGS
    return b * 2 + (int(flash) % 2)


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    from missions.m5.draw import _draw_maru_figure
    b, strobe = divmod(int(variant) % VARIANTS, 2)
    s = K.new(W, H)
    _draw_maru_figure(s, ANCHOR[0], ANCHOR[1], b * 2 * math.pi / HEADINGS, strobe)
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

"""HUD status plate (convoy / raid clock), 340 x 46: dark glass, steel rim

import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

W, H = 340, 46

BAR = (12, 28, W - 76, 10)


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    s = K.new(W, H)

    pygame.draw.rect(s, (8, 10, 14, 210), r, border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (150, 170, 190, 220), r, 1, border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (196, 210, 224, 230), (6, 1), (W - 7, 1), 1)   # lit top lip
    pygame.draw.line(s, (90, 104, 118, 220), (6, H - 2), (W - 7, H - 2), 1)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 30, 30, 255), BAR)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (150, 170, 190, 255), BAR, 1)
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

"""Official portrait of President Retardovici in a gilt frame (30 x 30 px, 1.0 x 1.0 m).

def render(variant=0, scale=1):

    s.fill(K.GOLD_LO, (3, 3, W - 6, 1)); s.fill(K.GOLD_LO, (3, 3, 1, H - 6))   # inner lip (shaded)
    s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (3, H - 4, W - 6, 1)); s.fill(K.GOLD_HI, (W - 4, 3, 1, H - 6))
    s.fill((54, 64, 58), (4, 4, W - 8, H - 8))                 # studio backdrop
    s.fill((70, 80, 72), (4, 4, 10, H - 8))                    # lit side
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (30, 30, 36), [(5, 26), (8, 20), (15, 18), (22, 20), (25, 26)])  # suit
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (226, 222, 210), [(13, 18), (15, 23), (17, 18)])   # shirt
    s.fill((150, 30, 32), (14, 19, 2, 5))                     # tie
    s.fill((150, 30, 32), (8, 21, 2, 1)); s.fill((150, 30, 32), (9, 22, 3, 1))   # sash
    s.fill(K.BRASS, (20, 21, 2, 2))                            # medal
    s.fill((196, 150, 120), (11, 9, 8, 9))                     # face
    s.fill((150, 108, 86), (17, 10, 2, 8))                     # face shade, right
    s.fill((214, 172, 142), (11, 10, 2, 3))                    # lit cheek, left
    s.fill((150, 150, 150), (10, 6, 10, 3))                    # grey hair

    s.fill((60, 50, 46), (12, 15, 6, 1))                       # moustache
    s.fill((236, 230, 210), (11, 6, 3, 1))                     # hair highlight
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\posters.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Wall posters of the Lower Quarter (32 x 44 px, 0.64 x 0.88 m in the 3D sets).

variant 0  Guard propaganda: sunburst, helmeted Guard bust, "GUARD"
variant 1  curfew order: "CURFEW", red "22:00", fine print, stamp
variant 2  torn + bleached propaganda (variant 0 after a winter outside)
variant 3  faded KRAP party poster from before the Guard (blue, gear crest)
variant 4  MAG resistance print: woodcut fist, "FREE PRESS"
variant 5  MAG newsletter page: red masthead, columns, photo block
Light from the upper-left; paper curls off the wall bottom-right.
"""
import math

import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

W, H = 32, 44
VARIANTS = 6


def _guard(s):
    s.fill(K.PAPER)
    sky = pygame.Rect(1, 1, W - 2, 31)
    s.fill((168, 36, 32), sky)
    cx, cy = 16, 26
    for k in range(12):                                     # sunburst rays
        if k % 2:
            continue
        a0, a1 = math.pi + k * math.pi / 12, math.pi + (k + 1) * math.pi / 12
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (128, 22, 22), [(cx, cy), (cx + 40 * math.cos(a0), cy + 40 * math.sin(a0)),
                                               (cx + 40 * math.cos(a1), cy + 40 * math.sin(a1))])
    s.fill(K.PAPER, (0, 0, W, 1)); s.fill(K.PAPER, (0, 0, 1, H)); s.fill(K.PAPER, (W - 1, 0, 1, H))
    # Guard bust in profile, facing left (towards the light)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.INK, [(6, 32), (9, 24), (14, 22), (22, 22), (27, 25), (29, 32)])  # shoulders
    pygame.draw.rect(s, K.INK, (12, 13, 9, 10))                              # head
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.INK, [(10, 13), (11, 8), (16, 6), (21, 7), (23, 12), (24, 14), (9, 14)])  # helmet
    pygame.draw.line(s, K.INK, (8, 14), (24, 14))                            # brim
    s.fill((210, 90, 70), (10, 9, 1, 4))                                     # rim light, upper-left
    s.fill((210, 90, 70), (11, 8, 4, 1))
    s.fill(K.GUARD_RED, (22, 26, 4, 2))                                      # armband
    s.fill(K.INK, (1, 32, W - 2, 11))                                        # slogan band
    K.text_c(s, "GUARD", 16, 34, K.PAPER, sp=0)
    K.curl(s, (0, 0, 0))


def _curfew(s):
    s.fill(K.PAPER)
    s.fill(K.INK, (1, 2, W - 2, 11))
    K.text_c(s, "CURFEW", 16, 4, K.PAPER, sp=0)
    K.text_c(s, "22:00", 16, 15, K.RED, sp=0)
    K.lines(s, 4, 25, W - 8, 4, (110, 102, 90), seed=3)
    K.lines(s, 4, 37, 12, 2, (110, 102, 90), seed=8)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (176, 46, 40), (24, 37), 5, 1)                     # official stamp
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (176, 46, 40), (24, 37), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (40, 40, 70), (5, 41), (14, 39))                     # signature
    s.fill((150, 140, 116), (0, 0, W, 1)); s.fill((150, 140, 116), (0, 0, 1, H))
    K.curl(s, (0, 0, 0))


def _torn(s):
    _guard(s)
    K.fade(s, (196, 182, 150), 0.38)
    for y in range(H):                                     # ripped away bottom-right
        edge = 34 - (y - 18) * 1.1 + ((y * 37) % 7) - 3 + (4 if 26 < y < 30 else 0)
        for x in range(W):
            if y > 18 and x > edge:
                s.set_at((x, y), K.CLEAR)
    for x in range(0, 9):                                  # torn top-left corner
        for y in range(0, 9 - x - (x % 3 == 0)):
            s.set_at((x, y), K.CLEAR)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (170, 156, 120), (3, 30, 5, 3))    # paste stain


def _krap(s):
    s.fill((206, 196, 160))
    s.fill(K.KRAP_BLUE, (2, 2, W - 4, 27))
    cx, cy = 16, 14
    for k in range(10):                                    # gear teeth
        a = k * math.pi / 5
        s.fill(K.CREAM, (int(cx + 9 * math.cos(a)) - 1, int(cy + 9 * math.sin(a)) - 1, 3, 3))
    pygame.draw.circle(s, K.CREAM, (cx, cy), 8)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, K.KRAP_BLUE, (cx, cy), 5)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.CREAM, [(cx - 2, cy - 4), (cx + 2, cy - 4), (cx + 1, cy + 4), (cx - 1, cy + 4)])
    s.fill((150, 180, 220), (cx - 7, cy - 6, 2, 2))        # highlight, upper-left
    K.text_c(s, "KRAP", 16, 32, K.KRAP_BLUE)
    K.fade(s, (200, 194, 172), 0.42)
    s.fill((178, 170, 146), (19, 0, 1, H))                 # old fold crease
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (184, 170, 132), (3, 34, 9, 6), 1)   # water stain ring
    K.curl(s, (0, 0, 0))


def _mag(s):
    s.fill((232, 226, 206))
    # woodcut fist breaking a chain, printed in red ink
    red = (186, 40, 34)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, red, (11, 6, 10, 9))               # fist
    for i in range(4):
        s.fill((232, 226, 206), (12 + i * 2 + (i > 1), 6, 1, 3))   # knuckle gaps
    pygame.draw.rect(s, red, (13, 15, 6, 9))               # wrist/forearm
    for x0 in (4, 22):                                     # broken chain links
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, red, (x0, 10, 6, 4), 1)
    s.fill((240, 236, 222), (12, 7, 2, 1))                 # highlight, upper-left
    K.text_c(s, "FREE", 16, 27, red)
    K.text_c(s, "PRESS", 16, 35, K.INK)
    K.curl(s, (0, 0, 0))


def _news(s):
    s.fill((226, 220, 200))
    s.fill((186, 40, 34), (2, 2, W - 4, 9))
    K.text_c(s, "MAG", 16, 3, (240, 232, 214))
    s.fill(K.INK, (2, 12, W - 4, 1))
    s.fill((96, 92, 86), (3, 14, 13, 10))                  # photo block
    s.fill((140, 134, 124), (4, 15, 5, 3))
    K.lines(s, 18, 14, 11, 4, (100, 94, 86), seed=5)
    K.lines(s, 3, 27, 12, 5, (100, 94, 86), seed=11)
    K.lines(s, 18, 27, 11, 5, (100, 94, 86), seed=13)
    s.fill((140, 132, 116), (0, 0, W, 1)); s.fill((140, 132, 116), (0, 0, 1, H))
    K.curl(s, (0, 0, 0))


_DRAW = (_guard, _curfew, _torn, _krap, _mag, _news)


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    s = K.new(W, H)
    _DRAW[variant % VARIANTS](s)
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# src\art\m5\presidential_crest.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""State crests (40 x 40 px).

variant 0  presidential seal over the podium (1.6 m): laurel-ringed gold
           medallion, red shield, black eagle, gold star
variant 1  old KRAP party crest in the depot (1.0 m): blue disc, cream gear,
           the party torch - half-painted-over
Gold is lit from the upper-left (bright rim top-left, dark rim bottom-right).
"""
import math

import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

W, H = 40, 40
VARIANTS = 2


def _rim(s, cx, cy, r, base, hi, lo):
    pygame.draw.circle(s, base, (cx, cy), r)
    for k in range(72):
        a = k * math.pi / 36
        lit = math.cos(a - math.radians(225))            # 225 deg = upper-left in screen y-down
        col = hi if lit > 0.45 else (lo if lit < -0.45 else base)
        x, y = cx + (r - 1) * math.cos(a), cy + (r - 1) * math.sin(a)
        s.fill(col, (int(round(x)) - 1, int(round(y)) - 1, 2, 2))


def _seal(s):
    cx = cy = 20
    _rim(s, cx, cy, 19, K.BRASS, K.GOLD_HI, K.GOLD_LO)
    for k in range(16):                                  # laurel leaves
        a = k * math.pi / 8 + 0.2
        x, y = cx + 15 * math.cos(a), cy + 15 * math.sin(a)
        s.fill((96, 120, 54) if k % 2 else (124, 146, 70), (int(x) - 1, int(y) - 1, 3, 2))
    shield = [(cx - 9, cy - 10), (cx + 9, cy - 10), (cx + 9, cy + 2), (cx, cy + 11), (cx - 9, cy + 2)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (160, 30, 30), shield)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.GOLD_HI, shield, 1)
    s.fill((196, 60, 54), (cx - 8, cy - 9, 3, 9))         # lit left of shield
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.INK, [(cx, cy), (cx - 7, cy - 5), (cx - 5, cy + 1), (cx - 1, cy + 5)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.INK, [(cx, cy), (cx + 7, cy - 5), (cx + 5, cy + 1), (cx + 1, cy + 5)])
    s.fill(K.INK, (cx - 1, cy - 5, 3, 10))
    s.fill(K.INK, (cx - 2, cy - 7, 3, 2))
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.GOLD_HI, [(cx, cy - 16), (cx - 2, cy - 12), (cx + 2, cy - 12)])


def _krap(s):
    cx = cy = 20
    _rim(s, cx, cy, 19, K.KRAP_BLUE, (110, 146, 206), (28, 48, 92))
    for k in range(12):                                  # gear teeth
        a = k * math.pi / 6
        x, y = cx + 12 * math.cos(a), cy + 12 * math.sin(a)
        s.fill(K.CREAM, (int(x) - 2, int(y) - 2, 4, 4))
    pygame.draw.circle(s, K.CREAM, (cx, cy), 11)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, K.KRAP_BLUE, (cx, cy), 7)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, K.CREAM, [(cx - 2, cy - 1), (cx + 2, cy - 1), (cx + 1, cy + 6), (cx - 1, cy + 6)])  # torch
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (226, 150, 70), [(cx, cy - 7), (cx - 3, cy - 2), (cx + 3, cy - 2)])   # flame
    s.fill((240, 232, 210), (cx - 10, cy - 7, 3, 2))      # gear highlight, upper-left


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    s = K.new(W, H)
    (_seal, _krap)[variant % VARIANTS](s)
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# src\art\m5\press.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Print Works offset press, top-down (154 x 64). The press bed is the
116 x 52 two-tile footprint at (18, 6); paper feed hangs off the left,
delivery pile off the right, yellow floor safety line around the plinth.
Key light upper-left: lit top edge on each steel box, shaded bottom.
Variant 0: running (green lamp), 1: raid alarm (red lamp).
Replaces decor_interior._press (shadow stays live, it is alpha-blended)."""
import pygame

from art.m5 import _kit as K

VARIANTS = 2
W, H = 154, 64
BED = pygame.Rect(18, 6, 116, 52)
PAPER = (214, 208, 190)
PAPER_D = (176, 170, 152)
INK = (24, 26, 34)
STEEL = (70, 76, 84)
STEEL_D = (40, 44, 50)
HAZ = (196, 160, 40)


def _box(s, r, col):
    pygame.draw.rect(s, col, r)
    pygame.draw.line(s, tuple(min(255, c + 26) for c in col), r.topleft, (r.right - 1, r.y))
    pygame.draw.line(s, tuple(max(0, c - 22) for c in col), (r.x, r.bottom - 1), (r.right - 1, r.bottom - 1))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, tuple(max(0, c - 34) for c in col), r, 1)


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    alarm = int(variant) % VARIANTS == 1
    s = K.new(W, H)
    r = BED
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (20, 22, 26), r.inflate(10, 6))                  # base plinth
    pygame.draw.rect(s, HAZ, r.inflate(16, 12), 2)                       # floor safety line
    _box(s, r, STEEL_D)
    body = r.inflate(-10, -14)
    _box(s, body, STEEL)
    for i in range(5):                                                   # roller train
        x = body.x + 10 + i * (body.w - 20) // 4
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 32, 36), (x - 4, body.y + 2, 8, body.h - 4))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (130, 134, 140), (x - 2, body.y + 3, 3, body.h - 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, INK, (body.x + 6, body.y + body.h // 2 - 3, body.w - 12, 6))
    feed = pygame.Rect(r.x - 18, r.y + 10, 16, r.h - 20)                 # paper feed
    pygame.draw.rect(s, PAPER, feed)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, PAPER_D, feed, 1)
    out = pygame.Rect(r.right + 2, r.y + 12, 18, r.h - 24)               # delivery pile
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (236, 232, 218), out)
    for k in range(2, out.h, 3):
        pygame.draw.line(s, PAPER_D, (out.x + 1, out.y + k), (out.right - 2, out.y + k))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (200, 40, 34) if alarm else (60, 200, 90), (r.right - 12, r.y + 4, 6, 6))
    return K.scaled(s, scale)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\art\m5\wall_posters.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Top-down wall posters for the gameplay maps (the wall is seen as its front band).

variant 0  "MAG 1991"   cream bill, 60 x 16 (Maru's office)
variant 1  "FREE PRESS" red bill,   60 x 16 (Maru's office)
variant 2  "FREE"       red bill,   54 x 16 (press hall)
variant 3  "MAG"        cream bill, 54 x 16 (press hall)
variant 4  "TRUTH"      navy bill,  54 x 16 (press hall)
variant 5  curfew order strip, 26 x 8 (Lower Quarter facades)
variant 6  Guard propaganda strip, 26 x 8 (Lower Quarter facades)
Lit from the upper-left: bright top/left edge, shade bottom/right.
"""
from art.m5 import _kit as K

VARIANTS = 7
#              text          size      paper            ink
_BILLS = (("MAG 1991", (60, 16), (236, 232, 218), (20, 20, 24)),
          ("FREE PRESS", (60, 16), (210, 60, 50), (236, 232, 218)),
          ("FREE", (54, 16), (210, 60, 50), (236, 232, 218)),
          ("MAG", (54, 16), (236, 232, 218), (186, 40, 34)),
          ("TRUTH", (54, 16), (40, 50, 80), (236, 232, 218)))
TEXTS = {b[0]: i for i, b in enumerate(_BILLS)}


def _edges(s, base):
    w, h = s.get_size()
    K.bevel(s, (0, 0, w, h), K.shade(base, 1.18), K.shade(base, 0.62))


def _bill(i):
    txt, (w, h), paper, ink = _BILLS[i]
    s = K.new(w, h, paper)
    _edges(s, paper)
    K.text_c(s, txt, w // 2, (h - 7) // 2, ink, sp=0 if K.text_w(txt) > w - 4 else 1)
    for x in (2, w - 3):                                  # drawing pins
        s.fill((150, 150, 150), (x, 1, 1, 1))
    return s


def _curfew():
    paper = (200, 190, 160)
    s = K.new(26, 8, paper)
    _edges(s, paper)
    s.fill(K.INK, (2, 2, 14, 2))                          # "CURFEW" header bar
    s.fill((120, 112, 96), (2, 5, 12, 1))                 # fine print
    s.fill((176, 46, 40), (19, 2, 4, 4))                  # stamp
    s.fill(paper, (20, 3, 2, 2))
    return s


def _guard():
    red = (150, 26, 30)
    s = K.new(26, 8, red)
    _edges(s, red)
    s.fill(K.INK, (3, 1, 3, 3))                           # helmeted head
    s.fill(K.INK, (2, 4, 6, 3))                           # shoulders
    s.fill(K.INK, (10, 2, 13, 3))                         # "GUARD" slogan block
    s.fill((206, 70, 60), (10, 2, 13, 1))
    return s


def render(variant=0, scale=1):
    v = variant % VARIANTS
    s = _bill(v) if v < len(_BILLS) else (_curfew() if v == 5 else _guard())
    return K.scaled(s, scale)
