# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\cutscenes\figure_kit.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""figure_kit.py - one cast renderer in the "Balaceanu Arrest" house style.

Why this exists
---------------
``m4aftermath`` (the Balaceanu arrest) reads as drawn because its people are
built from *faces and tailoring*, not primitives: angular skull/jaw polygons
with a key-light plane and a rim line, brows/eyelids/nose/nasolabial creases,
lapels + collar + tie, articulated 2-bone limbs with a lit edge and shaded
plane, hands with cuffs, and a ground shadow. ``cast.draw_*`` and
``m3cell._m3_draw_balaceanu`` were circle-head + rectangle-limb sprites; this
kit replaces them so every cutscene that uses the cast inherits the arrest look
without touching the shot code.

Public API
----------
    draw_character(surface, who, cx, foot_y, scale=1.0, facing_right=True,
                   silhouette=False, t=0, fear=0, smile=0, blink=0,
                   look=None, moving=0, prop=None, prop_label=None,
                   label_font=None, *, seated=False, reach=None, bow=0,
                   wardrobe=None)

``who``: biribel | vasile | volkov | commander | fisherman | balaceanu |
         president | maru | bodi | alex | ucilev | ipa | krap | civilian.  The last three are the extras
         (IPA agents/guards/marksmen, KRAP squad members, street civilians)
         so crowds and enemies in cutscenes share the house style instead of
         circle-head primitives.  Figure heights match the legacy sprites (see HEIGHT),
so shot layouts do not move.  Coordinates are authored in "arrest units"
(foot at y=0, head centre at y=-258) and multiplied by ``k``; everything is
hard-edged 1x line art like the arrest (no smoothscale blur).

Staging options (keyword-only):
    seated    - hips drop onto a seat (front view, knees forward); the upper
                body, arms and head move down with them.
    reach     - ((dx, dy), (dx, dy)) wrist targets in *screen pixels*
                relative to (cx, foot_y), screen-left arm first.  Used for
                restrained wrists, grips and grabs; elbows are solved.
    bow       - 0..1, head drops and lids get heavy (restrained/defeated).
    arms      - False skips the default arms + hands (callers draw their own,
                e.g. the M4 armed poses).
    wardrobe  - dict of SPECS overrides (e.g. a prison jumpsuit) so the face
                and build stay the cast member's while the clothes change.
"""
import math

import pygame

try:  # pragma: no cover - config is present in the game
    from core import config as _cfg
    _KRAP_UNI = getattr(_cfg, "C_KRAP_UNIFORM", (55, 65, 80))
    _KRAP_BLUE = getattr(_cfg, "C_KRAP_BLUE", (35, 65, 110))
except Exception:  # standalone preview
    _KRAP_UNI, _KRAP_BLUE = (55, 65, 80), (35, 65, 110)

_REF_H = 296.0  # arrest figure: foot (0) -> top of hair (-296)


# ── colour helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _mix(a, b, t):
    return tuple(max(0, min(255, round(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t))) for i in range(3))


def _dark(c, t=.3):
    return _mix(c, (4, 6, 10), t)


def _lite(c, t=.25):
    return _mix(c, (255, 244, 225), t)

HEIGHT = {k: v["height"] for k, v in SPECS.items()}


class _Pen:
    """Maps arrest-unit coordinates to the surface (scale + mirror + origin).
    Light stays on the figure's left whichever way it faces (``light=True``
    skips the mirror), so mirrored actors keep one consistent key light."""

    def __init__(self, surf, cx, foot, k, facing_right):
        self.s, self.cx, self.fy, self.k = surf, cx, foot, k
        self.f = 1 if facing_right else -1
        self.ox = self.oy = 0.0

    def p(self, x, y, light=False):
        f = 1 if light else self.f
        return (round(self.cx + (x + self.ox) * self.k * f),
                round(self.fy + (y + self.oy) * self.k))

    def w(self, v):
        return max(1, round(v * self.k))

    def poly(self, col, pts, light=False):
        pygame.draw.polygon(self.s, col, [self.p(x, y, light) for x, y in pts])

    def line(self, col, pts, width=1, light=False):
        pygame.draw.lines(self.s, col, False, [self.p(x, y, light) for x, y in pts], self.w(width))

    def ell(self, col, x0, y0, x1, y1, width=0):
        a, b = self.p(x0, y0), self.p(x1, y1)
        r = pygame.Rect(min(a[0], b[0]), min(a[1], b[1]), max(1, abs(b[0] - a[0])), max(1, abs(b[1] - a[1])))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(self.s, col, r, width)

    def circ(self, col, x, y, r, width=0):
        pygame.draw.circle(self.s, col, self.p(x, y), self.w(r), width)


# ── face ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_STUBBLE = [(-15, 20), (-9, 25), (-3, 28), (4, 29), (10, 26), (15, 21), (-19, 14), (19, 15),
            (-12, 17), (-6, 20), (0, 24), (6, 23), (12, 18), (-17, 24), (16, 25), (-1, 31)]


def _face(pen, spec, hx, hy, *, fear=0, smile=0, look=0, blink=0, cig=True):
    """Angular face with key/rim light (port of m4aftermath._face)."""
    pen.ox, pen.oy = hx, hy
    skin = spec["skin"]
    shade, light = _mix(skin, (60, 30, 30), .38), _lite(skin, .22)
    jaw = spec.get("jaw", 1.0)
    lo = lambda x: x * jaw
    P = pen.poly
    L = pen.line
    P(_mix(skin, (40, 20, 20), .5), [(-12, 26), (12, 26), (14, 43), (-14, 43)])          # neck
    outline = [(-26, -18), (-20, -31), (-5, -36), (17, -31), (26, -20), (25, 12),
               (lo(18), 27 + fear * 2), (lo(4), 34 + fear * 2), (lo(-15), 28), (lo(-25), 9)]
    P(skin, outline)
    P(shade, [(8, -31), (26, -20), (25, 12), (lo(18), 27), (lo(4), 34), (8, 15), (14, 2)], light=True)
    P(light, [(-24, -17), (-15, -27), (-12, -5), (-20, 10), (-24, 8)], light=True)
    # hair
    hair, hs = spec["hair"], spec["hair_style"]
    if hs == "swept":
        P(hair, [(-26, -5), (-29, -23), (-19, -34), (-5, -38), (17, -33), (26, -23), (26, -8),
                 (20, -21), (10, -26), (-2, -29), (-18, -22), (-20, -5)])
        L(_lite(hair, .45), [(-23, -27), (-13, -33), (3, -33)], 2)
    elif hs in ("crop", "curly"):
        P(hair, [(-26, -2), (-28, -23), (-19, -34), (-5, -38), (17, -33), (27, -23), (26, -2),
                 (22, -14), (12, -22), (-2, -23), (-16, -20), (-22, -8)])
        if hs == "curly":
            for k_, ox in enumerate((-20, -13, -6, 1, 8, 15, 22)):
                pen.circ(hair, ox, -31 + (k_ % 2) * 3 + abs(ox) * .18, 5.5)
            for ox in (-17, -4, 9):
                pen.line(_lite(hair, .35), [(ox - 3, -34), (ox + 1, -36)], 1)
        else:
            L(_lite(hair, .35), [(-18, -33), (-3, -37), (12, -34)], 2)
    elif hs == "mop":
        # thick, uneven curly mop: crop base, a ring of curls, fringe over the brow
        P(hair, [(-27, -4), (-30, -24), (-20, -37), (-5, -41), (18, -36), (29, -24), (27, -4),
                 (22, -16), (12, -22), (-2, -23), (-16, -20), (-22, -8)])
        for k_, (ox, oy, rr) in enumerate(((-24, -30, 6.5), (-16, -38, 7), (-6, -42, 7.5), (5, -41, 7),
                                           (15, -38, 7), (24, -31, 6.5), (28, -20, 5.5), (-28, -18, 5.5))):
            pen.circ(hair, ox, oy, rr)
        for fx, fl, tilt in ((-18, 12, -3), (-9, 16, 2), (1, 14, -2), (11, 15, 3), (19, 10, 1)):
            P(hair, [(fx - 5, -24), (fx + 5, -24), (fx + 2 + tilt, -24 + fl), (fx - 2 + tilt, -24 + fl - 2)])
        for ox in (-15, -2, 11):
            pen.line(_lite(hair, .3), [(ox - 3, -38), (ox + 2, -40)], 1)
    elif hs == "shag":
        # Maru: thick, messy brown hair with a heavy fringe swept to one side
        P(hair, [(-27, 0), (-30, -22), (-23, -38), (-7, -45), (11, -44), (25, -35), (30, -20),
                 (28, -2), (24, -12), (16, -22), (0, -24), (-16, -20), (-22, -8)])
        for x0, x1, tip in ((-24, -12, (-20, -11)), (-15, -2, (-8, -13)), (-5, 8, (4, -15)),
                            (5, 18, (16, -16)), (14, 27, (25, -12))):
            P(hair, [(x0, -26), (x1, -27), tip])
        for ox, oy in ((-24, -36), (-10, -45), (6, -46), (21, -40)):
            P(hair, [(ox - 6, oy + 4), (ox, oy - 4), (ox + 7, oy + 3)])
        hl = _lite(hair, .35)
        L(hl, [(-20, -35), (-6, -41), (10, -40)], 2)
        L(hl, [(-11, -24), (-4, -16)], 1)
        L(hl, [(8, -25), (15, -18)], 1)
        L(_dark(hair, .35), [(-2, -25), (3, -16)], 1)
    elif hs == "fringe":
        # Bodi: straight, dense dark hair, full fringe cut just above the brows
        P(hair, [(-27, -1), (-29, -24), (-20, -37), (-4, -41), (15, -38), (27, -27), (28, -1),
                 (24, -6), (23, -16), (14, -15), (4, -14), (-6, -15), (-16, -14), (-23, -12), (-24, -4)])
        for fx in (-17, -7, 3, 13):
            P(hair, [(fx - 4, -16), (fx + 5, -16), (fx + 1, -11)])
        L(_lite(hair, .3), [(-19, -32), (-4, -37), (13, -34)], 2)
        L(_dark(hair, .3), [(-12, -26), (-10, -16)], 1)
        L(_dark(hair, .3), [(6, -27), (8, -16)], 1)
    elif hs == "spiky":
        # Alex: short textured cut, tips pushed up and forward
        P(hair, [(-26, -4), (-28, -23), (-19, -34), (-5, -38), (17, -34), (27, -23), (26, -4),
                 (22, -16), (12, -22), (-2, -24), (-16, -21), (-22, -9)])
        for k_, ox in enumerate((-22, -14, -6, 2, 10, 18, 24)):
            h_ = 9 + (k_ % 3) * 3
            P(hair, [(ox - 5, -31 + abs(ox) * .12), (ox + 1 + k_ % 2 * 2, -31 - h_ + abs(ox) * .2),
                     (ox + 5, -31 + abs(ox) * .12)])
        for fx in (-12, -2, 8):
            P(hair, [(fx - 5, -24), (fx + 6, -26), (fx + 3, -18)])
        L(_lite(hair, .4), [(-16, -36), (-4, -41), (10, -38)], 1)
    elif hs == "slick":
        P(hair, [(-26, -2), (-29, -24), (-19, -35), (-4, -39), (18, -34), (27, -23), (26, -4),
                 (21, -20), (8, -27), (-4, -27), (-18, -20), (-22, -2)])
        L(_lite(hair, .3), [(-20, -30), (-6, -35), (10, -33)], 1)
    elif hs == "bald_white":
        for sgn in (-1, 1):
            P(hair, [(sgn * 26, -6), (sgn * 28, -16), (sgn * 22, -22), (sgn * 20, -8), (sgn * 23, 6)])
        L(_lite(skin, .3), [(-12, -30), (0, -34), (12, -30)], 2)
    # ears, under-eye fatigue, nasolabial crease
    pen.ell(_mix(skin, (150, 70, 60), .35), -31, -3, -23, 13)
    L(_dark(skin, .5), [(-26, 1), (-25, 9)], 1)
    L(_mix(skin, (90, 40, 50), .3), [(-17, 6), (-7, 7)], 1)
    L(_mix(skin, (60, 30, 40), .45), [(9, 6), (18, 5)], 1)
    # brows (weight = brow), eyes
    bw = spec.get("brow", 2)
    bc = _dark(hair, .1) if hs != "bald_white" else (190, 190, 185)
    L(bc, [(-19, -10), (-8, -10 - fear * 5)], bw)
    L(bc, [(7, -10 - fear * 4), (18, -9 + smile * 2)], bw)
    eye_h = max(0.4, (3 + fear * 2) * (1 - blink))
    for x in (-13, 13):
        P((219, 203, 173), [(x - 5, -3), (x, -3 - eye_h), (x + 5, -3), (x, -2 + eye_h)])
        pen.circ(spec["iris"], x + look * 2, -3, 1.8)
        L(_mix(skin, (30, 15, 15), .65), [(x - 5, -4), (x + 5, -4)], 1)
    if spec.get("scar"):
        L(_lite(skin, .15), [(-15, -27), (-9, -12), (-4, 6)], 1)
        L(_dark(skin, .35), [(-14, -27), (-8, -12), (-3, 6)], 1)
    # nose, brow ridge highlight, cheek line
    L(_mix(skin, (60, 30, 30), .5), [(1, -6), (-2, 9), (5, 11)], 1.4)
    L(_lite(skin, .3), [(-2, -5), (-4, 6)], 1)
    L(_mix(skin, (70, 30, 40), .45), [(-7, 14), (-11, 22)], 1)
    if spec.get("stubble"):
        sc = _mix(skin, (12, 10, 10), .55)
        for sx, sy in _STUBBLE:
            pygame.draw.rect(pen.s, sc, (*pen.p(sx, sy), pen.w(1.6), pen.w(1.6)))
    if spec.get("beard"):
        P(spec["beard"], [(-24, 6), (-26, 18), (-14, 34), (0, 41), (14, 34), (25, 18), (24, 6),
                          (16, 17), (0, 21), (-16, 17)])
        L(_dark(spec["beard"], .4), [(-10, 25), (0, 26 + fear * 3), (11, 25)], 1)
    else:
        L(_mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .6), [(-10, 22), (0, 21 + fear * 3), (11, 22 - smile * 4)], 1.6)
        if fear > .5:
            L(_mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .55), [(-3, 24), (5, 24)], 1)
        L(_mix(skin, (90, 50, 40), .3), [(-5, 28), (5, 28)], 1)
    if cig and spec.get("cig"):
        # tucked into the mouth corner, drooping (was flat and pointing up)
        L(_mix(skin, (60, 20, 20), .5), [(8, 21), (11, 23)], 2.2)          # lip pinch
        L((196, 140, 80), [(10, 22.5), (13.5, 23.6)], 2)                    # filter
        L((232, 230, 222), [(13.5, 23.6), (23, 26.6)], 2)                   # paper
        L((120, 114, 108), [(23, 26.6), (24.6, 27.1)], 2)                   # ash
        pen.circ((255, 96, 30) if int(pygame.time.get_ticks() / 350) % 2 == 0 else (150, 50, 25), 25.4, 27.3, 1.5)
    rim = spec.get("rim", (137, 168, 191) if not spec.get("president") else (248, 202, 128))
    L(rim, [(23, -15), (24, 9), (17, 24)], 1, light=True)
    if fear > .65:
        L((184, 193, 189), [(-22, -13), (-23, -6)], 1)
    if spec.get("glasses"):
        gc = spec["glasses"]
        for x in (-13, 13):
            pen.circ(gc, x, -3, 7, 1)
            L((205, 214, 208), [(x - 3, -6), (x - 1, -7)], 1)
        L(gc, [(-6, -4), (6, -4)], 1)
    # headgear last so it sits over the hairline
    if spec.get("bandana"):
        bc = spec["bandana"]
        P(bc, [(-28, -10), (-29, -26), (-19, -37), (-4, -40), (17, -36), (28, -26), (28, -10),
               (16, -16), (0, -18), (-16, -16)])
        L(_lite(bc, .3), [(-24, -27), (-8, -35), (10, -33)], 2)
        L(_dark(bc, .35), [(-28, -11), (-16, -17), (0, -19), (16, -17), (28, -11)], 1)
        P(_dark(bc, .15), [(26, -20), (36, -14), (34, -4), (29, -12)])          # knot tails
        P(_dark(bc, .25), [(27, -16), (40, -6), (37, 2), (30, -8)])
    if spec.get("cap"):
        P((19, 29, 46), [(-29, -22), (-23, -44), (23, -44), (29, -22)])
        L((129, 133, 126), [(-28, -22), (29, -22)], 2)
        P((12, 14, 20), [(-27, -22), (31, -22), (30, -16), (-27, -16)])
        pen.circ((190, 160, 90), 0, -33, 3)
    if spec.get("hat"):
        P(spec["hat"], [(-30, -24), (-26, -40), (26, -40), (30, -24)])
        P(_dark(spec["hat"], .35), [(-33, -23), (33, -23), (31, -18), (-33, -18)])
    pen.ox = pen.oy = 0.0


# ── body ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _hand(pen, skin, glove, x, y, dirx):
    col = glove or skin
    pen.ell(col, x - 6, y - 3, x + 6, y + 13)
    pen.line(_dark(col, .25), [(x + dirx * 5, y), (x + dirx * 7, y + 8)], 2)  # thumb side
    pen.line(_lite(col, .2), [(x - dirx * 3, y + 1), (x - dirx * 4, y + 10)], 1)


_SEAT_DROP = 55  # seated: hips fall from y=-104 to y=-49 (arrest units)


def _reach_units(pen, reach):
    """Screen-pixel wrist offsets -> arrest units keyed by arrest-space side."""
    if not reach:
        return {}
    out = {}
    for dx, dy in reach:
        x = dx * pen.f / pen.k
        y = dy / pen.k - pen.oy
        out[1 if x >= 0 else -1] = (x, y)
    return out


def _torso_x(X, hy, y, hem, flare, side):
    """Torso edge at height y (the coat trapezoid, shoulder -> hem)."""
    y0, y1 = hy + 46, hem
    f = 0.0 if y1 == y0 else max(0.0, min(1.0, (y - y0) / (y1 - y0)))
    return side * X(47 + (37 + flare - 47) * f)


def _print(pen, spec, X, hy, half):
    """Chest graphic. ``half`` = usable half-width (arrest units)."""
    pr = spec.get("print")
    if not pr:
        return
    kind, col = pr[0], pr[1]
    if kind == "drip":   # dripping horror-font band (Bodi's tee)
        y0 = hy + 74
        w = half
        pen.poly(col, [(-w, y0), (w, y0 - 3), (w, y0 + 9), (-w, y0 + 11)])
        for i, (dx, ln) in enumerate(((-.85, 9), (-.55, 17), (-.3, 7), (-.05, 22), (.2, 10),
                                      (.45, 19), (.72, 8), (.9, 13))):
            x = dx * w
            pen.poly(col, [(x - 2.4, y0 + 8), (x + 2.4, y0 + 8), (x + 1.5, y0 + 8 + ln), (x - 1.5, y0 + 8 + ln)])
            pen.circ(col, x, y0 + 9 + ln, 2.2)
        dk = _dark(col, .55)
        for gx in (-.7, -.35, 0, .35, .7):
            pen.line(dk, [(gx * w - 2, y0 + 2), (gx * w + 2, y0 + 7)], 1)
    elif kind == "stripe":  # sports-hoodie chest wordmark: small 3-bar mark + red band
        white = pr[2] if len(pr) > 2 else (236, 236, 232)
        y0 = hy + 100
        for i in range(3):
            x = -5 + i * 3.6
            pen.poly(white, [(x, y0 - 4 - i * 2), (x + 2.4, y0 - 4 - i * 2), (x + 2.4, y0 - 1), (x, y0 - 1)])
        pen.poly(col, [(-half, y0 + 3), (half, y0 + 3), (half, y0 + 13), (-half, y0 + 13)])
        pen.line(_lite(col, .35), [(-half, y0 + 4), (half, y0 + 4)], 1)
        for i in range(6):
            x = -half + 4 + i * (2 * half - 8) / 5.0
            pen.line(_dark(col, .45), [(x, y0 + 5), (x, y0 + 11)], 1)
        pen.line(white, [(-half * .7, y0 + 18), (half * .7, y0 + 18)], 2)


def _casual_front(pen, spec, X, hy, top, hem, flare):
    """Hoodie / tee / open shirt chest, drawn over the coat trapezoid."""
    coat = spec["coat"]
    neck = spec["neck"]
    if spec.get("plaid"):              # flannel check: clip the lines to the trapezoid
        pc = spec["plaid"]
        y = hy + 56
        while y < hem - 4:
            pen.line(pc, [(_torso_x(X, hy, y, hem, flare, -1) + 2, y), (_torso_x(X, hy, y, hem, flare, 1) - 2, y)], 2)
            y += 19
        for vx in (-34, -20, 20, 34):
            yb = hem - 2
            pen.line(pc, [(X(vx * .9), top + 6), (X(vx * .82), yb)], 2)
        pen.line(_lite(pc, .5), [(_torso_x(X, hy, hy + 66, hem, flare, -1) + 2, hy + 66),
                                 (_torso_x(X, hy, hy + 66, hem, flare, 1) - 2, hy + 66)], 1)
    if neck == "hood":
        # hood bunched behind the neck + drawstrings + kangaroo pocket + ribbed hem
        hc = _dark(coat, .15)
        pen.poly(hc, [(X(-31), hy + 47), (X(-27), hy + 31), (X(-13), hy + 23), (X(13), hy + 23),
                      (X(27), hy + 31), (X(31), hy + 47), (X(16), hy + 40), (0, hy + 44), (X(-16), hy + 40)])
        pen.line(_lite(coat, .25), [(X(-27), hy + 32), (X(-13), hy + 24), (X(13), hy + 24)], 2, light=True)
        pen.line(_dark(coat, .45), [(X(-16), hy + 41), (0, hy + 45), (X(16), hy + 41)], 2)
        sc = spec.get("strings", _lite(coat, .5))
        for sx in (-6, 6):
            pen.line(sc, [(sx, hy + 44), (sx * 1.2, hy + 84)], 2)
            pen.circ(sc, sx * 1.2, hy + 86, 2)
        _print(pen, spec, X, hy, X(20))
        py0, py1 = hem - 46, hem - 6
        pen.line(_dark(coat, .38), [(X(-30), py1), (X(-23), py0), (X(23), py0), (X(30), py1)], 2)
        pen.line(_lite(coat, .14), [(X(-22), py0 + 2), (X(22), py0 + 2)], 1)
        pen.poly(_dark(coat, .2), [(_torso_x(X, hy, hem - 9, hem, flare, -1), hem - 9),
                                   (_torso_x(X, hy, hem - 9, hem, flare, 1), hem - 9),
                                   (_torso_x(X, hy, hem, hem, flare, 1), hem), (_torso_x(X, hy, hem, hem, flare, -1), hem)])
    elif neck == "crew":
        pen.poly(_dark(coat, .35), [(X(-15), hy + 35), (X(15), hy + 35), (X(10), hy + 45), (X(-10), hy + 45)])
        _print(pen, spec, X, hy, X(26))
    elif neck == "open":
        inner = spec.get("inner", spec["shirt"])
        pen.poly(inner, [(X(-15), hy + 35), (X(15), hy + 35), (X(18), hem), (X(-18), hem)])
        pen.poly(_dark(inner, .35), [(X(-11), hy + 35), (X(11), hy + 35), (X(7), hy + 43), (X(-7), hy + 43)])
        _print(pen, spec, X, hy, X(13))
        for side in (-1, 1):          # shirt fronts + collar points
            pen.line(_dark(coat, .3), [(X(side * 15), hy + 40), (X(side * 18), hem)], 2)
            pen.line(_lite(coat, .25), [(X(side * 17), hy + 44), (X(side * 20), hem)], 1)
            pen.poly(coat, [(X(side * 12), hy + 33), (X(side * 27), hy + 36), (X(side * 17), hy + 58)])
            pen.line(_dark(coat, .35), [(X(side * 12), hy + 33), (X(side * 17), hy + 58)], 1)


def _body(pen, spec, t, moving, prop, prop_label, label_font, seated=False, reach=None, arms=True):
    bulk = spec["bulk"]
    X = lambda x: x * bulk
    step = math.sin(t * .009) * moving
    breath = math.sin(t * .0023) * 1.4 * (1 - moving)
    hy = -258 + breath + spec.get("stoop", 0)
    skin, coat = spec["skin"], spec["coat"]
    long_coat = spec["long_coat"]
    hem = spec.get("hem", -60 if long_coat else -95)
    neck = spec.get("neck")          # None (tailored) | "hood" | "crew" | "open"
    # legs (hip → knee → shoe), shaded outer edge + shoe ellipse
    for side in (-1, 1):
        if seated:  # front view: short foreshortened thigh, shin straight down
            hip, knee, shoe = (X(side * 15), -104 + _SEAT_DROP), (X(side * 23), -42), (X(side * 21), 0)
        else:
            hip, knee, shoe = (X(side * 15), -104), (X(side * 17) + step * side * 7, -49), (X(side * 18) - step * side * 13, 0)
        pen.line(spec["trousers"], [hip, knee, shoe], 19 * bulk)
        pen.line(_lite(spec["trousers"], .22), [(hip[0] - 7, hip[1]), (knee[0] - 7, knee[1])], 2, light=True)
        if spec.get("rips"):          # worn-through knees
            for dy_ in (-6, 0, 5):
                pen.line(spec["rips"], [(knee[0] - 6, knee[1] + dy_), (knee[0] + 5, knee[1] + dy_ + 1)], 1)
            pen.line(spec["rips"], [(knee[0] - 3, knee[1] + 22), (knee[0] + 4, knee[1] + 23)], 1)
        if spec.get("boots_h"):       # rubber boot shafts up the shin
            top = (shoe[0] + (knee[0] - shoe[0]) * spec["boots_h"], shoe[1] + (knee[1] - shoe[1]) * spec["boots_h"])
            pen.line(spec["shoes"], [top, (shoe[0], shoe[1] - 2)], 22 * bulk)
            pen.line(_lite(spec["shoes"], .3), [(top[0] - 10 * bulk, top[1]), (top[0] + 10 * bulk, top[1])], 2)
            pen.line(_lite(spec["shoes"], .18), [(top[0] - 8, top[1] + 3), (shoe[0] - 8, shoe[1] - 6)], 1, light=True)
        pen.ell(spec["shoes"], shoe[0] - 15, shoe[1] - 4, shoe[0] + 19, shoe[1] + 5)
        pen.line(_lite(spec["shoes"], .3), [(shoe[0] - 9, shoe[1] - 2), (shoe[0] + 8, shoe[1] - 2)], 1)
        if spec.get("sole"):
            pen.line(spec["sole"], [(shoe[0] - 14, shoe[1] + 3), (shoe[0] + 18, shoe[1] + 3)], 2)
    # torso (seated: everything above the hips rides down with them)
    if seated:
        pen.oy = _SEAT_DROP
    top = hy + 33
    torso = [(X(-47), hy + 43), (X(-25), top), (X(24), top), (X(47), hy + 46)]
    flare = 9 if long_coat else 0
    torso += [(X(37 + flare), hem), (X(-37 - flare), hem)]
    pen.poly(coat, torso)
    pen.poly(_dark(coat, .28), [(X(14), hy + 36), (X(47), hy + 46), (X(37 + flare), hem), (X(18), hem)], light=True)
    pen.line(spec.get("rim") or _lite(coat, .3), [(X(-46), hy + 49), (X(-37 - flare), hem)], 2, light=True)
    if spec.get("rim"):
        pen.line(spec["rim"], [(X(46), hy + 50), (X(37 + flare), hem)], 2, light=True)
    if neck:
        _casual_front(pen, spec, X, hy, top, hem, flare)
    # lapels / shirt / tie
    if not neck:
        pen.poly(spec["lapel"], [(X(-21), hy + 37), (0, hy + 73), (X(21), hy + 37)])
    if spec.get("vest"):
        pen.poly(spec["vest"], [(X(-26), hy + 50), (X(26), hy + 50), (X(24), hy + 118), (X(-24), hy + 118)])
        for i in range(3):
            px = X(-21 + i * 14.5)
            pen.poly(_dark(spec["vest"], .4), [(px, hy + 86), (px + 11, hy + 86), (px + 11, hy + 106), (px, hy + 106)])
            pen.line(_lite(spec["vest"], .2), [(px, hy + 86), (px + 11, hy + 86)], 1)
            pen.circ((90, 98, 90), px + 5.5, hy + 91, 1.2)
    if not neck:
        pen.poly(spec["shirt"], [(X(-14), hy + 35), (0, hy + 51), (X(14), hy + 35)])
    if spec.get("tie"):
        pen.poly(spec["tie"], [(-5, hy + 48), (5, hy + 48), (7, hy + 100), (0, hy + 112), (-6, hy + 101)])
        pen.line(_lite(spec["tie"], .3), [(-2, hy + 56), (-2, hy + 98)], 1)
    for side in (-1, 1) if not neck else ():
        pen.line(_lite(spec["lapel"], .25), [(X(side * 23), hy + 37), (X(side * 31), hy + 70), (X(side * 9), hy + 92)], 2)
    if spec.get("buttons"):
        for i in range(3):
            pen.circ(spec["buttons"], 0 if spec.get("tie") else 4, hy + 112 + i * 14, 2.4)
    if spec.get("epaulets"):
        for side in (-1, 1):
            pen.poly(spec["epaulets"], [(X(side * 36), hy + 44), (X(side * 52), hy + 47), (X(side * 50), hy + 52), (X(side * 34), hy + 49)])
    if spec.get("medal"):
        pen.circ(spec["medal"], X(-24), hy + 70, 3.4)
        pen.line(_lite(spec["medal"], .2), [(X(-24), hy + 66), (X(-24), hy + 62)], 1)
    if spec.get("patch"):
        pen.poly(spec["patch"], [(X(10), hy + 62), (X(26), hy + 62), (X(26), hy + 72), (X(10), hy + 72)])
        pen.line((205, 205, 200), [(X(10), hy + 62), (X(26), hy + 62), (X(26), hy + 72), (X(10), hy + 72), (X(10), hy + 62)], 1)
    if spec.get("belt"):
        by = -112
        pen.poly(spec["belt"], [(X(-37), by), (X(37), by), (X(36), by + 9), (X(-36), by + 9)])
        pen.poly((174, 155, 106), [(-5, by + 2), (5, by + 2), (5, by + 8), (-5, by + 8)])
    if long_coat:  # centre seam + hem highlight
        pen.line(_dark(coat, .5), [(0, hy + 112), (0, hem)], 1)
        pen.line(_lite(coat, .2), [(X(-46), hem), (X(46), hem)], 1)
    # arms: 2-bone limbs, lit outer edge, cuff, hand
    glove = spec.get("glove")
    targets = _reach_units(pen, reach)
    for side in (-1, 1) if arms else ():
        sh, el = (X(side * 40), hy + 51), (X(side * 50), -171)
        wr = (X(side * 44), -145)
        hold = prop and side == 1
        if hold:
            el, wr = (X(52), -150), (X(70), -150)
        if side in targets:  # solve the elbow: bend outward and down
            wr = targets[side]
            mx, my = (sh[0] + wr[0]) / 2, (sh[1] + wr[1]) / 2
            el = (mx + side * 14, my + 12)
        if spec.get("sleeves") == "short":     # tee: bare arms, sleeve to mid upper arm
            sl = (sh[0] + (el[0] - sh[0]) * .55, sh[1] + (el[1] - sh[1]) * .55)
            pen.line(skin, [sh, el, wr], 13 * bulk)
            pen.line(_lite(skin, .2), [(el[0] - side * 5, el[1]), (wr[0] - side * 4, wr[1])], 1, light=True)
            pen.line(coat, [sh, sl], 18 * bulk)
            pen.line(_dark(coat, .3), [(sl[0] - 8 * bulk, sl[1]), (sl[0] + 8 * bulk, sl[1])], 2)
        else:
            pen.line(coat, [sh, el, wr], 16 * bulk)
            pen.line(_lite(coat, .22), [(sh[0] - side * 5, sh[1]), (el[0] - side * 6, el[1]), (wr[0] - side * 5, wr[1])], 1, light=True)
            cuff = spec.get("cuff_col", spec["shirt"])
            pen.line(cuff, [(el[0] + (wr[0] - el[0]) * .8, el[1] + (wr[1] - el[1]) * .8), wr], 17 * bulk * .8)
            if spec.get("plaid"):
                for f_ in (.3, .62):
                    a_ = (sh[0] + (el[0] - sh[0]) * f_, sh[1] + (el[1] - sh[1]) * f_)
                    pen.line(spec["plaid"], [(a_[0] - 8 * bulk, a_[1]), (a_[0] + 8 * bulk, a_[1] + 1)], 2)
        _hand(pen, skin, glove, wr[0], wr[1], side)
    if arms and spec.get("armband"):  # screen-left upper arm, like the M4 seam idiom
        sh, el = (X(-40), hy + 51), (X(-50), -171)
        a0 = (sh[0] + (el[0] - sh[0]) * .38, sh[1] + (el[1] - sh[1]) * .38)
        a1 = (sh[0] + (el[0] - sh[0]) * .62, sh[1] + (el[1] - sh[1]) * .62)
        pen.line(spec["armband"], [a0, a1], 17 * bulk)
        pen.line(_lite(spec["armband"], .25), [(a0[0] - 6, a0[1]), (a1[0] - 6, a1[1])], 1, light=True)
    if spec.get("satchel"):
        sc = spec["satchel"]
        pen.line(_dark(sc, .2), [(X(-26), hy + 40), (X(30), -110)], 3)
        pen.poly(sc, [(X(22), -122), (X(50), -122), (X(52), -86), (X(24), -86)])
        pen.poly(_dark(sc, .35), [(X(22), -122), (X(50), -122), (X(50), -110), (X(22), -110)])
        pen.circ((170, 150, 100), X(36), -112, 2)
    if spec.get("straps"):            # backpack straps over both shoulders
        stc = spec["straps"]
        for side in (-1, 1):
            pen.line(stc, [(X(side * 24), hy + 38), (X(side * 27), hy + 80), (X(side * 30), hy + 128)], 6)
            pen.line(_lite(stc, .25), [(X(side * 24) - 2, hy + 40), (X(side * 27) - 2, hy + 80)], 1, light=True)
            pen.poly((120, 120, 124), [(X(side * 27) - 4, hy + 92), (X(side * 27) + 4, hy + 92),
                                        (X(side * 27) + 4, hy + 98), (X(side * 27) - 4, hy + 98)])
    if prop == "folder":
        fx, fy = X(80), -158
        pen.poly((68, 52, 36), [(fx - 18, fy - 36), (fx + 18, fy - 36), (fx + 18, fy + 38), (fx - 18, fy + 38)])
        pen.line((130, 42, 36), [(fx - 18, fy - 36), (fx + 18, fy - 36), (fx + 18, fy + 38), (fx - 18, fy + 38), (fx - 18, fy - 36)], 2)
        if prop_label and label_font:
            lab = label_font.render(prop_label, True, (205, 170, 120))
            lab = pygame.transform.smoothscale(lab, (max(1, round(lab.get_width() * .65 * pen.k)), max(1, round(lab.get_height() * .65 * pen.k))))
            pen.s.blit(lab, (pen.p(fx, fy - 24)[0] - lab.get_width() // 2, pen.p(fx, fy - 24)[1]))
        _hand(pen, skin, glove, X(70), -150, 1)
    pen.oy = 0.0
    return hy + (_SEAT_DROP if seated else 0)


def draw_character(surface, who, cx, foot_y, scale=1.0, facing_right=True, silhouette=False,
                   t=0, fear=0, smile=0, blink=0, look=None, moving=0,
                   prop=None, prop_label=None, label_font=None, *, seated=False, reach=None,
                   bow=0, wardrobe=None, arms=True):
    spec = SPECS[who]
    if wardrobe:
        spec = {**spec, **wardrobe}
    k = scale * spec["height"] / _REF_H
    if silhouette:  # same pose, flattened to the usual near-black cutout
        half = 130 * k
        if reach:
            half = max(half, max(abs(dx) for dx, _ in reach) + 30 * k)
        w, h = int(half * 2) + 24, int(330 * k) + 24
        tmp = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        draw_character(tmp, who, w // 2, h - 12, scale, facing_right, False, t, fear, smile, blink,
                       look, moving, prop, prop_label, label_font, seated=seated, reach=reach,
                       bow=bow, wardrobe=wardrobe, arms=arms)
        tmp.fill((16, 18, 24, 255), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MULT)
        surface.blit(tmp, (int(cx - w // 2), int(foot_y - h + 12)))
        return
    pen = _Pen(surface, int(cx), int(foot_y), k, facing_right)
    # ground shadow (alpha, like the legacy sprites)
    sw, sh = max(2, int(104 * k)), max(2, int(16 * k))
    sh_s = pygame.Surface((sw, sh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(sh_s, (0, 0, 0, 80), (0, 0, sw, sh))
    surface.blit(sh_s, (int(cx - sw / 2), int(foot_y - sh * .6)))
    hy = _body(pen, spec, t, moving, prop, prop_label, label_font, seated=seated, reach=reach, arms=arms)
    if look is None:
        look = 1 if facing_right else -1
    lean = 0
    if bow:
        hy += 12 * bow
        blink = max(blink, .55 * bow)
    _face(pen, spec, lean, hy, fear=fear, smile=smile, look=look * (1 if facing_right else -1) * .8,
          blink=blink)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\cutscenes\k9.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""K-9 armory pickup: one continuous, deterministic, software-safe take.

The three legacy scene names address adjacent sections of the same clock.
No gameplay state, input, audio, or global RNG is touched by drawing. Art is
procedural, matching the campaign's editable sprite/illustration pipeline.
"""
from functools import lru_cache
import math
import random

import pygame
from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT, font_terminal, font_terminal_small

WALL_MS = 850
GRAB_MS = 2150
READY_MS = 1800
TOTAL_MS = WALL_MS + GRAB_MS + READY_MS


def _clamp(v):
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, float(v)))


def _ease(v):
    v = _clamp(v)
    return v * v * v * (v * (v * 6 - 15) + 10)


def _lerp(a, b, p):
    return a + (b - a) * p


def _mix(a, b, p):
    return (_lerp(a[0], b[0], p), _lerp(a[1], b[1], p))


def _local(point, pose):
    """Same pivot/rotation for weapon, fingers, controls, and contact points."""
    x, y, scale, angle = pose
    rad = math.radians(angle)
    ca, sa = math.cos(rad), math.sin(rad)
    px, py = point
    return (x + scale * (px * ca + py * sa),
            y + scale * (-px * sa + py * ca))


def _pose(ms):
    g = ms - WALL_MS
    # Nothing leaves the rack until BOTH hands have made contact at 560 ms.
    lift = _ease((g - 610) / 410)
    approach = _ease((g - 980) / 900)
    ready = max(0.0, g - GRAB_MS)
    lower = _ease((ready - 1380) / 420)
    recoil = 0.0
    if 990 < ready < 1160:
        q = (ready - 990) / 170
        recoil = math.sin(q * math.pi * 3) * math.exp(-q * 4) * 2
    return (500 + 16 * approach + 16 * lower,
            321 - 33 * lift + 127 * approach + 42 * lower + recoil,
            1.25 + 0.55 * approach,
            6.0 * lift - 13.0 * approach - 3.0 * lower)

@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _background_soft():
    """Subtle focus pull: the rack recedes as the held weapon approaches."""
    base = _background().copy()
    _hooks(base, TOTAL_MS)
    small = pygame.transform.smoothscale(base, (250, 175))
    soft = pygame.transform.smoothscale(small, (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    grade = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    grade.fill((3, 10, 16, 42))
    soft.blit(grade, (0, 0))
    return soft


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _weapon():
    """Editable 2.5D compact SMG, drawn at 2x for clean small components.

    Local pivot is (0,0). Long axis is x; stock left, muzzle right. A real
    top bevel, handguard, trigger guard, action slot and recessed magazine
    replace the single rounded rectangle in the original illustration.
    """
    u = 2
    s = pygame.Surface((800, 340), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    ox, oy = 400, 92
    def P(x, y): return (round(ox + x * u), round(oy + y * u))
    def poly(c, pts, width=0): pygame.draw.polygon(s, c, [P(*v) for v in pts], width * u)
    def line(c, a, b, w=1): pygame.draw.line(s, c, P(*a), P(*b), max(1, w * u))
    def rect(c, x, y, w, h, edge=0, radius=0):
        pygame.draw.rect(s, c, (*P(x, y), round(w*u), round(h*u)), edge*u, border_radius=radius*u)
    def circ(c, x, y, r): pygame.draw.circle(s, c, P(x,y), round(r*u))
    outline=(7,12,15); metal=(45,56,60)
    # Wire stock with a proper folded buttplate and hinge.
    for a,b in [((-99,-2),(-162,6)),((-99,15),(-162,29))]:
        line(outline,a,b,6); line((77,88,88),a,b,3);line((139,148,132),a,(b[0],b[1]-1))
    poly(outline,[(-165,1),(-156,3),(-151,29),(-159,35),(-167,30)])
    poly((44,55,58),[(-164,4),(-159,5),(-154,28),(-160,31),(-164,27)])
    for y in (9,15,21):line((101,112,110),(-164,y),(-158,y-2))
    # Magazine under receiver. Witness holes are dark recesses, not gold LEDs.
    poly(outline,[(-28,20),(0,20),(5,111),(-21,113),(-28,104)])
    poly((33,43,48),[(-25,23),(-3,23),(2,107),(-19,109),(-24,102)])
    poly((63,76,77),[(-25,23),(-19,24),(-13,109),(-19,109),(-24,102)])

    # Grip and trigger guard, offset from the magazine.
    poly(outline,[(-91,17),(-57,19),(-66,77),(-94,78),(-102,68)])

    poly((56,67,67),[(-57,22),(-35,22),(-32,46),(-57,47),(-65,39)])
    poly((6,14,19),[(-54,26),(-40,26),(-38,41),(-55,42),(-59,37)])
    line((154,155,131),(-51,25),(-49,35),2)
    # Receiver: dark face, warm upper bevel and cool extruded underside.
    poly(outline,[(-107,-24),(36,-24),(49,-14),(49,18),(36,28),(-103,28),(-111,16),(-111,-16)])

    rng=random.Random(909)
    for _ in range(36):

@lru_cache(maxsize=96)
def _weapon_transform(scale, angle):
    base = _weapon()
    sized = pygame.transform.smoothscale(base,(round(base.get_width()*scale/2), round(base.get_height()*scale/2)))
    return pygame.transform.rotate(sized,angle)


def _draw_weapon(s, pose):
    x,y,scale,angle=pose
    # Source pivot is (400,92), NOT the centre of the image. Padding must not
    # shift the gun by half its magazine height when it rotates.
    img=_weapon_transform(round(scale,3),round(angle,2))
    mid=_local((0,39),pose)
    s.blit(img,img.get_rect(center=(round(mid[0]),round(mid[1]))))


def _sleeve(s, start, end, width, cool=False):
    dx,dy=end[0]-start[0],end[1]-start[1]
    length=max(1,math.hypot(dx,dy));nx,ny=-dy/length,dx/length
    def pt(p,off):return(p[0]+nx*off,p[1]+ny*off)
    pts=[pt(start,width*.5),pt(start,-width*.5),pt(end,-width*.27),pt(end,width*.27)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(s,(6,13,18),[pt(start,width*.55),pt(start,-width*.55),pt(end,-width*.32),pt(end,width*.32)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s,(40,53,56) if cool else (56,63,55),pts)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s,(68,80,77) if cool else (90,95,73),[pts[0],pts[3],pt(end,width*.12),pt(start,width*.22)])
    # Broad cloth folds and wrist cuff. Far thicker than the old cable sleeves.
    for p in (.48,.66,.82):
        c=_mix(start,end,p);w=width*(.5-.23*p)
        pygame.draw.line(s,(22,36,40),pt(c,-w),pt(c,w*.6),3)
        pygame.draw.line(s,(72,83,76),pt((c[0]+3,c[1]-3),-w*.75),pt((c[0]+3,c[1]-3),w*.5))
    cuff=_mix(start,end,.95)
    pygame.draw.line(s,(15,26,31),pt(cuff,-width*.29),pt(cuff,width*.29),9)
    pygame.draw.line(s,(112,119,95),pt(cuff,-width*.25),pt(cuff,width*.25),2)


def _glove(s, pos, size, angle, support=False, open_amount=0):
    """Connected palm, curled fingers and thumb; full-size cuff attachment."""
    cx,cy=pos
    rad=math.radians(angle);ca,sa=math.cos(rad),math.sin(rad)
    def p(x,y):return(cx+size*(x*ca+y*sa),cy+size*(-x*sa+y*ca))
    def poly(c,pts,w=0):pygame.draw.polygon(s,c,[p(*v) for v in pts],w)
    def line(c,a,b,w=1):pygame.draw.line(s,c,p(*a),p(*b),w)
    shape=[(-17,14),(-18,-8),(-12,-21),(10,-21),(18,-8),(17,18),(9,26),(-10,26)]
    poly((5,13,18),shape)
    poly((46,58,58),[(x*.9,y*.9) for x,y in shape])
    poly((78,87,75),[(-15,-7),(-10,-18),(8,-18),(15,-6),(10,4),(-10,3)])
    poly((30,45,49),[(-14,8),(13,9),(12,18),(7,23),(-9,22)])
    for i in range(4):
        x=-11+i*6
        poly((118,125,98),[(x,-15),(x+4,-15),(x+4,-8),(x,-9)])
        line((21,37,43),(x-1,-16),(x-1,-3),2)
    side=-1 if support else 1
    # Fingers visibly wrap onto the contact surface, index stays off trigger.
    for i in range(3):
        y=-2+i*6
        end=side*(22+open_amount*12)
        line((9,22,29),(side*12,y),(end,y-3),7)
        line((99,111,96),(side*13,y-2),(end,y-4),2)
    poly((20,35,40),[(-side*10,0),(-side*25,5),(-side*23,14),(-side*11,18)])
    line((124,131,102),(-side*13,2),(-side*22,7),2)
    line((124,131,102),(-10,19),(8,20),2)


def _hands(ms,pose):
    g=ms-WALL_MS
    reach_d=_ease((g-40)/490)
    reach_s=_ease((g-145)/415)
    ready=max(0,g-GRAB_MS)
    dominant=_local((-78,53),pose)
    support=_local((68,28),pose)
    # Support releases the fore-end, checks the action, and returns. Exactly
    # two hands: the dominant grip never disappears during the ready check.
    to_handle=_ease((ready-200)/360)
    return_grip=_ease((ready-1070)/360)
    pull=_ease((ready-590)/300)*(1-_ease((ready-980)/90))
    check=_local((-18-32*pull,-11),pose)
    support=_mix(support,check,to_handle*(1-return_grip))
    d_start=(280,HEIGHT+70);s_start=(885,HEIGHT+80)
    d_pos=_mix(d_start,dominant,reach_d)
    s_pos=_mix(s_start,support,reach_s)
    return (d_start,d_pos,reach_d),(s_start,s_pos,reach_s),pull


def _hooks(s,ms,front=False):
    g=ms-WALL_MS
    lift=_ease((g-610)/410)
    for x in (390,593):
        # Fixed wall clips stay on the rack after the weapon is taken.
        if not front:
            pygame.draw.rect(s,(21,33,38),(x-9,274,18,42),border_radius=3)
            pygame.draw.circle(s,(129,136,115),(x,281),3)
            pygame.draw.line(s,(63,78,77),(x,288),(x,321),6)
            pygame.draw.line(s,(167,173,139),(x-2,289),(x-2,321),2)
        elif lift<.5:
            pygame.draw.arc(s,(163,171,142),(x-10,312,20,15),math.pi,math.pi*2,4)


def _draw(s,ms):
    ms=max(0,min(TOTAL_MS,float(ms)))
    previous_clip=s.get_clip()
    s.set_clip(previous_clip.clip(pygame.Rect(0,SCENE_TOP,WIDTH,SCENE_BOT-SCENE_TOP)))
    try:
        s.blit(_background(),(0,0))
        _hooks(s,ms)
        focus=_ease((ms-WALL_MS-1030)/720)
        if focus:
            soft=_background_soft()
            soft.set_alpha(round(205*focus))
            s.blit(soft,(0,0))
        # Deterministic, low-contrast motes in the task light. No global RNG.
        for i in range(13):
            x=330+(i*83)%350+math.sin(ms*.0007+i)*6
            y=162+(i*47+ms*.007)%292
            pygame.draw.circle(s,(76,81,66),(round(x),round(y)),1)
        pose=_pose(ms)
        d,support,pull=_hands(ms,pose)
        # Sleeves behind the gun, curled fingers in front: no intersecting arms.
        for hand,cool in ((d,False),(support,True)):
            start,end,reach=hand
            if reach>.005:_sleeve(s,start,end,88 if not cool else 94,cool)
        _draw_weapon(s,pose)
        # Charging handle uses the same rigid transform as the gun.
        a=_local((-18-32*pull,-9),pose);b=_local((-18-32*pull,-17),pose)
        pygame.draw.line(s,(12,24,30),a,b,7)
        pygame.draw.line(s,(167,176,151),a,b,3)
        _hooks(s,ms,True)
        for hand,is_support in ((d,False),(support,True)):
            start,end,reach=hand
            if reach>.005:
                _glove(s,end,1.0+(.33*(pose[2]-1.25)/.55),pose[3]-8 if not is_support else pose[3]+18,is_support,1-reach)
        # Reward read arrives only after the action is back in battery.
        ready=ms-WALL_MS-GRAB_MS
        a=round(255*_ease((ready-1260)/200))
        if a:
            title=font_terminal.render('K-9 ACQUIRED',True,(219,224,195));title.set_alpha(a)
            sub=font_terminal_small.render('SUPPRESSED SMG  /  24 ROUNDS + 2 SPARE MAGS',True,(172,187,179));sub.set_alpha(a)
            s.blit(title,(58,SCENE_TOP+40));s.blit(sub,(58,SCENE_TOP+70))
    finally:
        s.set_clip(previous_clip)


def draw_wall(s,t):
    _draw(s,min(WALL_MS,max(0,t)))


def draw_grab(s,t):
    _draw(s,WALL_MS+min(GRAB_MS,max(0,t)))


def draw_ready(s,t):
    _draw(s,WALL_MS+GRAB_MS+min(READY_MS,max(0,t)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\cutscenes\m3broadcast.py

"""Mission 3 - Kill Order -> Broadcast transition cinematic (Slice 5 -> 6).

Illustrated cutscene language, same family as the KO transition
(cutscenes.m3ko) and the chair-break shots: dark vector compositions with
motivated lighting, gradients and light cones from cutscenes.route12,
dust/bloom from cutscenes.chair, the side-view cast from cutscenes.cast.

Same house rules as m3ko v2:
  * Shots are INPUT-PACED (they hold until the player advances), so every
    shot stays ALIVE indefinitely: swinging lamp, streaming road, sweeping
    searchlights, breathing idle - no still tableaus.
  * The camera is a camera: slow push-in per shot (crop+smoothscale) plus
    handheld micro-shake.
  * Highlights bloom (soft normal-blend glow), one cool film tint for
    continuity. App-level vignette/scanlines/letterbox/caption stay the
    single post pass.

Shots (one continuous beat, dock -> road -> broadcast wing -> studio door):
  shutter - roller shutter slams on the loading dock, work-lamp swinging
  road    - night drive, wet ring road, the mast blinking on the horizon
  mast    - state broadcast wing exterior, beacon + sweeping searchlights
  onair   - studio corridor, ON AIR sign, Biribel advances on the doors

Branch-neutral by design: no van, no Volkov on screen. The branch-specific
exfil bark (VOLKOV's van vs MARU's roof line) already played in gameplay,
so these frames read correctly whether Volkov drove or bailed.

Also owns the 22:00 fail sequence (m3_bcast_fail_studio/_pa/_retry), the
three-shot cut the broadcast wing plays when the address finishes first:
studio lost -> the address on the monitor wall -> feed released / re-arm.
Same family, palette flipped cold; the retry shot is the plate the auto
retry hands the wing back on.

Pure functions of t: no STATE reads or writes.
"""
import math
import random

import pygame

from core.config import *
from cutscenes.chair import _cb_camera_shake, _draw_dust_motes
from cutscenes.m3cell import _m3_draw_balaceanu
from cutscenes.m3ko import (_ko_actor, _ko_clamp01, _ko_concrete, _ko_glow,
                             _ko_push, _ko_smoke_loop, _ko_strobe, _ko_tag,
                             _ko_tint)
from cutscenes.route12 import (_draw_light_cone, _draw_vertical_gradient,
                                _ease_cutscene, _lerp_cutscene)


# ── shared bits ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
_BC_BUF = None


def _bc_buf():
    global _BC_BUF
    if _BC_BUF is None:
        _BC_BUF = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    return _BC_BUF


# ── shot 0: shutter slam ───────────────────────────────────────────────
def _draw_m3_bcast_shutter_raw(surface, t):
    """The dock shutter comes DOWN: exfil is behind us now.

    Drops over ~900ms with a dust punch on impact, then holds shut while a
    caged work-lamp swings overhead and the lockdown strobe dies out.
    """
    slam = _ease_cutscene(_ko_clamp01(t / 900.0))
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 2.2, math.exp(-t / 500.0))

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _ko_concrete(surface, (9, 8, 8), (16, 13, 11))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Shutter housing + side rails.
    dx0, dw = 250, 500
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (30, 28, 26), (*W(dx0 - 26, 60), dw + 52, 44))
    for rx in (dx0 - 26, dx0 + dw + 8):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (38, 36, 32), (*W(rx, 60), 18, 470))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (70, 66, 58), W(rx + 9, 64), W(rx + 9, 526), 2)
    # Slats: descend with the slam, then sit shut.
    top = 104
    bot = _lerp_cutscene(300.0, 512.0, slam)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (10, 10, 12), (*W(dx0, top), dw, int(bot - top)))
    y = top
    while y < bot - 4:
        shade = 44 + int(8 * math.sin(y * 0.4))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (shade, shade - 2, shade - 6),
                         (*W(dx0, int(y)), dw, 12))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (20, 18, 16), W(dx0, int(y) + 12),
                         W(dx0 + dw, int(y) + 12), 2)
        y += 14
    # Bottom bar with hazard chevrons.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (52, 48, 40), (*W(dx0 - 6, int(bot)), dw + 12, 22))
    for hx in range(dx0 - 6, dx0 + dw + 6, 26):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (150, 128, 44), W(hx, int(bot) + 20),
                         W(hx + 13, int(bot) + 2), 4)
    # Stencil tag above the housing.
    tag = font_terminal_small.render("DOCK 03 // SEALED", True, (150, 140, 120))
    surface.blit(tag, W(dx0 + dw // 2 - tag.get_width() // 2, 40))

    # Impact dust punch on the slam, then endlessly settling motes.
    if t < 1600:
        k = _ko_clamp01(t / 900.0)
        puff = int(90 * (1 - k))
        if puff > 0:
            dust = pygame.Surface((dw + 120, 120), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for i in range(26):
                rng = random.Random(31 + i)
                px = rng.randint(0, dw + 120)
                py = rng.randint(0, 120)
                r = rng.randint(4, 12)
                pygame.draw.circle(dust, (150, 140, 126, puff), (px, py), r)
            surface.blit(dust, W(dx0 - 60, int(bot) - 40))
    _ko_smoke_loop(layer, dx0 + dw // 2 + ox, bot + oy + 10, t, seed=4.0, n=4)

    # Caged work-lamp swings overhead: the pool of light never sits still.
    swing = math.sin(t * 0.0011) * 46
    lamp_x, lamp_y = WIDTH // 2 + swing, 96
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (16, 16, 18),
                     W(WIDTH // 2, 60), W(int(lamp_x), int(lamp_y)), 3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 58, 52),
                     (*W(int(lamp_x) - 16, int(lamp_y)), 32, 18))
    _draw_light_cone(surface, int(lamp_x + ox), int(lamp_y + 14 + oy), 110,
                     (255, 205, 140), alpha=14)
    pool = pygame.Surface((300, 60), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(pool, (255, 205, 140, 20), (0, 0, 300, 60))
    surface.blit(pool, W(int(lamp_x) - 150, 520))
    _ko_glow(surface, (255, 205, 140), (lamp_x + ox, lamp_y + oy), 40, 30)

    # Lockdown strobe dies with the phase; a faint fault-blink stays alive.
    strobe = _ko_strobe(t) * math.exp(-t / 2500.0)
    fault = 0.25 if (t % 4200.0) < 140.0 else 0.0
    if strobe + fault > 0.01:
        layer.fill((200, 15, 10, int(38 * min(1.0, strobe + fault))))

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "LOADING DOCK // EXFIL")
    return (dx0 + dw // 2 + ox, 300 + oy, 1.12 + 0.18 * slam)


def _draw_m3_bcast_shutter(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_shutter_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


# ── shot 1: night road ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _draw_m3_bcast_road_raw(surface, t):
    """Through the windshield: wet ring road, the mast on the horizon.

    Lane dashes stream, streetlights sweep past, rain needles the glass,
    the dossier rides the dash. First-person and vehicle-neutral.
    """
    horizon = SCENE_TOP + 190
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.9, 1.0)
    vib = math.sin(t * 0.09) * 1.5  # engine tremor on the whole frame

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + vib + oy))

    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, 0, WIDTH, horizon + 60,
                            (5, 7, 15), (24, 16, 20))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Distant city glow + window dots + the mast, blinking.
    glow = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, 130), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(60):
        a = max(0, 40 - i)
        pygame.draw.line(glow, (255, 150, 80, a),
                         (0, 60 + i), (WIDTH, 60 + i), 1)
    surface.blit(glow, (0, horizon - 100))
    rng = random.Random(77)
    for _ in range(70):
        wx = rng.randint(40, WIDTH - 40)
        wy = rng.randint(int(horizon - 78), int(horizon - 18))
        warm = rng.random() > 0.35
        col = (255, 190, 120) if warm else (150, 190, 220)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (*W(wx, wy), 3, 2))
    mx, my = WIDTH - 190, horizon - 30
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (12, 12, 16), W(mx - 26, my), W(mx, my - 92), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (12, 12, 16), W(mx + 26, my), W(mx, my - 92), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (12, 12, 16), W(mx, my - 92), W(mx, my - 104), 3)
    if (t % 1200.0) < 600.0:
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 60, 50), W(mx, my - 108), 5)
        _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60), (mx + ox, my - 108 + vib + oy), 26, 60)

    # Wet asphalt trapezoid + streaming lane dashes.
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (13, 13, 16),
                        [W(0, HEIGHT), W(WIDTH, HEIGHT),
                         W(WIDTH // 2 + 90, horizon), W(WIDTH // 2 - 90, horizon)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (22, 22, 26),
                        [W(0, HEIGHT), W(WIDTH, HEIGHT),
                         W(WIDTH // 2 + 90, horizon), W(WIDTH // 2 - 90, horizon)], 1)
    for k in range(9):
        p = (t * 0.00035 + k / 9.0) % 1.0
        y = horizon + (HEIGHT - horizon) * p * p
        w = 2 + 15 * p * p
        x = WIDTH // 2
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (190, 170, 120), (*W(int(x - w // 2), int(y)),
                                                    int(w), int(3 + 9 * p)))
    # Streetlight pools rushing past, alternating sides.
    for k in range(4):
        p = (t * 0.00035 + k / 4.0 + 0.5) % 1.0
        y = horizon + (HEIGHT - horizon) * p * p
        side = -1 if k % 2 == 0 else 1
        spread = 120 + 420 * p
        ex = WIDTH // 2 + side * spread
        pool = pygame.Surface((180, 46), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(pool, (255, 205, 140, int(10 + 26 * p)), (0, 0, 180, 46))
        surface.blit(pool, W(int(ex) - 90, int(y) - 20))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (10, 10, 12),
                         W(int(ex + side * 60), int(y) - int(220 * p)),
                         W(int(ex + side * 60), int(y)), max(1, int(2 + 3 * p)))
    # Rain needles on the glass.
    rng = random.Random(9)
    for _ in range(46):
        bx = rng.randint(0, WIDTH)
        by = rng.randint(0, HEIGHT)
        ln = rng.randint(9, 22)
        fall = (t * 0.55 + rng.randint(0, 700)) % (HEIGHT + 60)
        yy = (by + fall) % (HEIGHT + 60) - 30
        pygame.draw.line(layer, (170, 190, 210, 70),
                         (bx, int(yy)), (bx - 5, int(yy) + ln), 1)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))

    # Dashboard + the dossier riding shotgun.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 8, 10), (0, HEIGHT - 120, WIDTH, 120))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (40, 42, 46), (0, HEIGHT - 120), (WIDTH, HEIGHT - 120), 2)
    for vx in range(120, WIDTH, 200):
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (120, 200, 170), (vx, HEIGHT - 96), 3)
    dossier_x, dossier_y = WIDTH // 2 + 150, HEIGHT - 96
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (208, 196, 170),
                     (*W(dossier_x, dossier_y), 74, 52))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 50, 40), (*W(dossier_x, dossier_y), 74, 52), 2)
    for ly in range(dossier_y + 10, dossier_y + 40, 8):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 110, 92), W(dossier_x + 8, ly),
                         W(dossier_x + 66, ly), 1)
    stamp = font_terminal_small.render("VOSTRAL", True, (170, 40, 34))
    surface.blit(stamp, W(dossier_x + 8, dossier_y + 34))
    # Windshield frame + mirror.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (5, 5, 7), (0, 0, WIDTH, SCENE_TOP - 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (16, 18, 20),
                     (WIDTH // 2 - 90, SCENE_TOP - 34, 180, 30), border_radius=6)

    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "RING ROAD // 21:47")
    # Push-in bounds: _ko_push only clamps the crop origin, so the focus must
    # keep the whole crop window on-surface (fy +/- (HEIGHT/z)/2 in range).
    breathe = 1.08 + 0.03 * math.sin(t * 2.0 * math.pi / 9000.0)
    return (WIDTH // 2 + ox, horizon + 40 + vib + oy, breathe)


def _draw_m3_bcast_road(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_road_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


# ── shot 2: broadcast wing ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _draw_m3_bcast_mast_raw(surface, t):
    """The state broadcast wing at night: lit facade, mast, searchlights."""
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.8, 1.0)

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT, (4, 6, 12), (10, 9, 12))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    rng = random.Random(5)
    for _ in range(60):
        sx = rng.randint(0, WIDTH)
        sy = rng.randint(0, 220)
        pygame.draw.circle(layer, (200, 210, 230, 60), (sx, sy), 1)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))

    # Facade block with lit windows (two flicker).
    fx0, fy0, fw, fh = 90, 210, 560, 330
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (24, 24, 30), (*W(fx0, fy0), fw, fh))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (52, 52, 60), (*W(fx0, fy0), fw, fh), 2)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (34, 34, 42), (*W(fx0 - 14, fy0 - 18), fw + 28, 18))
    for r in range(4):
        for c in range(7):
            wx = fx0 + 34 + c * 70
            wy = fy0 + 40 + r * 72
            lit = ((r * 7 + c) % 4) != 3
            flick = (r == 1 and c == 4 and (t % 900.0) < 180.0)
            col = (255, 196, 130) if (lit and not flick) else (26, 26, 32)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (*W(wx, wy), 44, 50))
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 60, 68), (*W(wx, wy), 44, 50), 1)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (60, 60, 68), W(wx + 22, wy), W(wx + 22, wy + 50), 1)
    # Entrance canopy + warm doors.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (16, 16, 20), (*W(fx0 + 180, fy0 + fh - 96), 200, 96))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, fx0 + 180 + int(ox), fy0 + fh - 92 + int(oy),
                            200, 88, (255, 206, 140), (120, 84, 48))
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (20, 20, 24),
                        [W(fx0 + 150, fy0 + fh - 96), W(fx0 + 410, fy0 + fh - 96),
                         W(fx0 + 440, fy0 + fh - 60), W(fx0 + 120, fy0 + fh - 60)])
    # No facade sign band: the window grid leaves no clean gap for one, and
    # the location tag below already names the wing. The red beacon + beams
    # carry the "live broadcast" read instead.

    # Mast: lattice, guy wires, pulsing beacon.
    bx, byb = 770, 540
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (14, 14, 18), W(bx - 60, byb), W(bx, byb - 330), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (14, 14, 18), W(bx + 60, byb), W(bx, byb - 330), 4)
    for k in range(9):
        yy = byb - k * 36
        half = 60 * (1 - k / 10.0)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (26, 26, 32),
                         W(int(bx - half), int(yy)), W(int(bx + half), int(yy)), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (26, 26, 32),
                         W(int(bx - half), int(yy)), W(int(bx + half), int(yy) - 36), 1)
    pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.006)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 60, 50), W(bx, byb - 336), 8)
    _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60), (bx + ox, byb - 336 + oy), 60, 30 + 50 * pulse)
    # Uplink dish on the facade roof, tracking slowly.
    dish_x, dish_y = fx0 + fw - 90, fy0 - 18
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (40, 42, 48), W(dish_x, dish_y), W(dish_x, dish_y + 18), 4)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (70, 74, 82), (*W(dish_x - 34, dish_y - 26), 68, 26))
    arm_a = t * 0.00025
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 150, 170),
                     W(dish_x, dish_y - 13),
                     W(int(dish_x + math.cos(arm_a) * 34), int(dish_y - 13 + math.sin(arm_a) * 10)), 2)

    # Searchlight cones sweeping the sky.
    for k, phase in ((0, 0.0), (1, 2.4)):
        ang = math.sin(t * 0.00045 + phase) * 0.55
        sx = 200 + k * 620
        length = 420
        ex = sx + math.sin(ang) * length
        ey = 40 - math.cos(ang) * 60
        beam = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.polygon(beam, (180, 200, 230, 16),
                            [(sx, 540), (ex - 60, ey), (ex + 60, ey)])
        surface.blit(beam, (0, 0))

    # Foreground fence silhouette.
    for px in range(-20, WIDTH + 20, 64):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (8, 8, 10), (px, HEIGHT - 70), (px, HEIGHT - 150), 4)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (8, 8, 10), (0, HEIGHT - 140), (WIDTH, HEIGHT - 140), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (8, 8, 10), (0, HEIGHT - 110), (WIDTH, HEIGHT - 110), 1)

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "STATE BROADCAST WING")
    return (bx + ox, byb - 200 + oy, 1.05 + 0.12 * _ko_clamp01(t / 6000.0))


def _draw_m3_bcast_mast(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_mast_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


# ── shot 3: studio corridor ────────────────────────────────────────────
def _draw_m3_bcast_onair_raw(surface, t):
    """The last walk: Biribel advances on the ON AIR doors, solo and framed.

    Solo by design - no Volkov on screen, so the frame reads correctly
    whether he drove the van or bailed at the dock.
    """
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.9, 1.0)

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT, (14, 8, 9), (26, 16, 14))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    horizon = SCENE_TOP + 200

    # Converging corridor.
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (30, 18, 20),
                        [(0, SCENE_TOP), (cx - 130, horizon),
                         (cx - 210, HEIGHT), (0, HEIGHT)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (26, 15, 17),
                        [(WIDTH, SCENE_TOP), (cx + 130, horizon),
                         (cx + 210, HEIGHT), (WIDTH, HEIGHT)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (38, 24, 24),
                        [(cx - 210, HEIGHT), (cx - 130, horizon),
                         (cx + 130, horizon), (cx + 210, HEIGHT)])
    for i in range(7):
        y = horizon + i * 62
        half = 130 + (y - horizon) * 0.32
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (58, 38, 38),
                         W(int(cx - half), int(y)), W(int(cx + half), int(y)), 2)
    for depth in range(3):
        yy = SCENE_TOP + 30 + depth * 48
        half = 220 - depth * 40
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (150, 60, 55), W(int(cx - half), int(yy)),
                         W(int(cx + half), int(yy)), 4)

    # The double doors + ON AIR sign.
    door_w, door_h = 220, 260
    door_x, door_y = cx - door_w // 2, horizon - 40
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (12, 10, 12),
                     (*W(door_x - 12, door_y - 12), door_w + 24, door_h + 24))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (64, 40, 36), (*W(door_x, door_y), door_w, door_h))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (120, 80, 60), (*W(door_x, door_y), door_w, door_h), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (20, 14, 12), W(cx, door_y), W(cx, door_y + door_h), 3)
    for hx, hy in ((door_x + 26, door_y + door_h // 2),
                   (door_x + door_w - 26, door_y + door_h // 2)):
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (200, 160, 110), W(hx, hy), 5)
    # Warm bleed through the seams + under the doors.
    bleed = pygame.Surface((door_w + 60, 60), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    bleed.fill((255, 190, 120, 40))
    surface.blit(bleed, W(door_x - 30, door_y + door_h - 12))
    seam = pygame.Surface((6, door_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    seam.fill((255, 210, 150, 90))
    surface.blit(seam, W(cx - 3, door_y))
    _draw_light_cone(surface, cx + int(ox), door_y + door_h + int(oy), 170,
                     (255, 195, 130), alpha=24)
    # ON AIR sign, breathing red.
    sign_on = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 0.005)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 8, 8),
                     (*W(door_x + 20, door_y - 64), door_w - 40, 44), border_radius=4)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (255, 60, 50),
                     (*W(door_x + 20, door_y - 64), door_w - 40, 44), 2, border_radius=4)
    onair = font_terminal.render("ON AIR", True, (255, 90, 80))
    surface.blit(onair, W(cx - onair.get_width() // 2, door_y - 58))
    _ko_glow(surface, (255, 60, 50), (cx + ox, door_y - 42 + oy),
             70, 20 + 30 * sign_on)

    # Wall dressing: EXIT sign + framed poster.
    exit_s = font_terminal_small.render("EXIT", True, (110, 230, 150))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 20, 12),
                     (*W(96, horizon + 40), exit_s.get_width() + 16, 26))
    surface.blit(exit_s, W(104, horizon + 45))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (52, 40, 34), (*W(WIDTH - 170, horizon + 30), 110, 150))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (150, 120, 90),
                     (*W(WIDTH - 170, horizon + 30), 110, 150), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (150, 60, 55),
                       W(WIDTH - 115, horizon + 80), 20, 2)
    seal = font_terminal_small.render("IPA", True, (170, 130, 100))
    surface.blit(seal, W(WIDTH - 115 - seal.get_width() // 2, horizon + 118))

    # Biribel advances, then holds at the doors - stride is distance-driven
    # so a held shot freezes instead of treadmill-looping.
    q = _ease_cutscene(_ko_clamp01(t / 2200.0))
    step = q * 3.0
    bx = _lerp_cutscene(300.0, 430.0, q)
    by = HEIGHT - 60
    _ko_actor(surface, "biribel", *W(int(bx), int(by)), scale=0.78,
              facing_right=True, t=t, moving=q < 0.995,
              walk_phase=step * math.pi, silhouette=True)

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "STUDIO CORRIDOR // ON AIR")
    return (cx + ox, door_y + 100 + oy, 1.06 + 0.12 * q)


def _draw_m3_bcast_onair(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_onair_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


# ── 22:00 fail sequence (Slice 6) ────────────────────────────────────────
# The address lands before the file does. Same house rules as the four
# transition shots above (input-paced, push-in, bloom, always alive), but the
# palette flips cold: the studio we were about to take is already theirs.
#   fail_studio - the booth we lost: dead console, red emergency wash
#   fail_pa     - the address itself, playing out on the monitor wall
#   fail_retry  - the feed released; the wing re-arms (auto-retry card)
# Pure functions of t: no STATE reads or writes.


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_studio_raw(surface, t):
    """The studio after we lost it: ON AIR burnt out, emergency red, desk dead.

    Biribel is a silhouette at the console - the frame is about the room
    winning, not about her. The dossier sits on the desk, still in hand.
    """
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.6, 0.7)
    # Emergency lamp: slow breathing pulse + a lazy fault blink so a held
    # frame never settles into a static red wash.
    pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(t * 0.0022)
    fault = 0.22 if (t % 5200.0) < 160.0 else 0.0
    red = min(1.0, pulse * 0.7 + fault)

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _ko_concrete(surface, (11, 7, 8), (26, 14, 13))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    floor_y = SCENE_TOP + 330

    # Floor + the console bank across the back of the booth.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (20, 12, 12), (0, floor_y, WIDTH, HEIGHT - floor_y))
    for i in range(6):
        y = floor_y + 18 + i * 44
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (34, 20, 19), (0, y), (WIDTH, y), 2)
    desk_x, desk_y, desk_w, desk_h = cx - 250, floor_y - 96, 500, 96
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (30, 20, 20),
                     (*W(desk_x, desk_y), desk_w, desk_h), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (86, 54, 48),
                     (*W(desk_x, desk_y), desk_w, desk_h), 2, border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (14, 10, 10),
                     (*W(desk_x + 16, desk_y - 26), desk_w - 32, 28), border_radius=4)

    # Dead monitors: a housing bar behind the bank, residual glow, no image.
    # One keeps a rolling scan flicker so the wall is never fully static.
    hous_y = desk_y - 150
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (22, 15, 15),
                     (*W(desk_x + 18, hous_y - 8), desk_w - 36, 92), border_radius=4)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (64, 40, 36),
                     (*W(desk_x + 18, hous_y - 8), desk_w - 36, 92), 2,
                     border_radius=4)
    for i in range(4):
        mw = 96
        mx = desk_x + 30 + i * ((desk_w - 60) // 4)
        my = desk_y - 132
        rect = pygame.Rect(*W(mx, my), mw, 78)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (10, 8, 8), rect, border_radius=3)
        alive = 0.10 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 0.004 + i * 1.7)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface,
                         (int(70 * alive), int(12 * alive), int(12 * alive)), rect, 2,
                         border_radius=3)
        if i == 2:
            sweep = int((t * 0.32) % 78)
            line = pygame.Surface((mw, 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            line.fill((150, 40, 30, 120))
            surface.blit(line, W(mx, my + sweep))
        _ko_glow(surface, (255, 60, 50), (rect.centerx + ox, rect.centery + oy),
                 58, int(10 + 12 * alive))

    # ON AIR sign, dark and dead - the one that should have been hers.
    sign_y = desk_y - 214
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (24, 10, 10), (*W(cx - 84, sign_y), 168, 40),
                     border_radius=4)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (74, 30, 26), (*W(cx - 84, sign_y), 168, 40), 2,
                     border_radius=4)
    off = font_terminal.render("ON AIR", True, (74, 32, 28))
    surface.blit(off, W(cx - off.get_width() // 2, sign_y + 7))

    # Emergency dome: a tight bloom over the sign, NOT a frame-wide red wash -
    # the room has to stay a room. Soft ellipse only; a hard-filled dome plate
    # read as a red card taped to the shot.
    dome_x, dome_y = cx + 190, sign_y - 30
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (54, 30, 28), (*W(dome_x - 24, dome_y), 48, 10),
                     border_radius=3)
    dome_g = pygame.Surface((160, 96), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i, shrink in enumerate((0, 14, 28)):
        a = int((150 + 50 * red) * (0.35 + 0.22 * i))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(dome_g, (255, 92, 72, a),
                            (shrink, shrink // 2,
                             160 - shrink * 2, 96 - shrink))
    surface.blit(dome_g, W(dome_x - 80, dome_y - 4))
    _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60), (dome_x + ox, dome_y + 24 + oy), 140,
             int(28 + 26 * red))
    _draw_light_cone(surface, dome_x + int(ox), dome_y + 30 + int(oy), 190,
                     (255, 70, 60), alpha=int(14 + 14 * red))
    wash = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    wash.fill((200, 26, 22, int(10 + 14 * red)))
    surface.blit(wash, (0, 0))

    # Cold desk lamp, still on, the only honest light in the room.
    lamp_x = cx - 330
    lamp_top = W(lamp_x, floor_y - 250)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (58, 50, 46), lamp_top, W(lamp_x, floor_y - 96), 6)
    # Shade + bulb, then the pool it throws on the desk.
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (86, 94, 104), [
        W(lamp_x - 30, floor_y - 118), W(lamp_x + 30, floor_y - 118),
        W(lamp_x + 18, floor_y - 96), W(lamp_x - 18, floor_y - 96)])
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (126, 138, 150), W(lamp_x - 30, floor_y - 118),
                     W(lamp_x + 30, floor_y - 118), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (196, 220, 240), W(lamp_x, floor_y - 100), 5)
    pool = pygame.Surface((300, 64), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(pool, (170, 200, 230, 34), (0, 0, 300, 64))
    surface.blit(pool, W(lamp_x - 150, floor_y - 96))
    _draw_light_cone(surface, lamp_x + int(ox), floor_y - 96 + int(oy), 170,
                     (170, 200, 230), alpha=18)
    _ko_glow(surface, (190, 215, 240), (lamp_x + ox, floor_y - 100 + oy), 60, 30)

    # The dossier, face-down on the desk. It is still the win condition.
    file_rect = pygame.Rect(*W(cx + 60, desk_y + 16), 74, 54)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (74, 58, 40), file_rect, border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (140, 48, 40), file_rect, 2, border_radius=3)
    seal = font_terminal_small.render("VOSTRAL", True, (196, 164, 118))
    seal = pygame.transform.smoothscale(
        seal, (max(1, int(seal.get_width() * 0.6)), max(1, int(seal.get_height() * 0.6))))
    surface.blit(seal, (file_rect.centerx - seal.get_width() // 2,
                        file_rect.y + int(9)))

    # Biribel: standing at the console, not advancing, facing the dead sign.
    # Drawn lit (not a silhouette) so the red key reads ON her - the room is
    # the antagonist of this shot, she is not a cardboard cutout in it.
    _ko_actor(surface, "biribel", *W(cx - 150, floor_y + 44), scale=0.74,
              facing_right=True, t=t, moving=False)

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "STATE STUDIO // FEED LOST")
    return (cx - 120 + ox, floor_y - 90 + oy, 1.04 + 0.10 * _ko_clamp01(t / 4000.0))


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_studio(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_fail_studio_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_pa_raw(surface, t):
    """The address finishing: Balaceanu on the monitor wall, tally on.

    The same figure used in the interrogation monitor, played large across a
    wall of CRTs and graded into the studio's red key so the frame reads as
    live state television rather than an illustration of him.
    """
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.5, 0.5)
    sweep = (t * 0.18) % 2000.0

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _ko_concrete(surface, (8, 6, 7), (20, 13, 12))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    cx = WIDTH // 2

    # Monitor wall: 3 x 2 grid of CRTs behind the control glass. Sized so the
    # wall, the tally and the shared location-tag band (HEIGHT-250) never
    # stack on top of each other.
    cols, rows = 3, 2
    wall_w, wall_h = 700, 250
    wall_x, wall_y = cx - wall_w // 2, SCENE_TOP + 16
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (16, 12, 12),
                     (*W(wall_x - 22, wall_y - 22), wall_w + 44, wall_h + 44),
                     border_radius=8)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 46, 42),
                     (*W(wall_x - 22, wall_y - 22), wall_w + 44, wall_h + 44), 2,
                     border_radius=8)
    gap_x = wall_w // cols
    gap_y = wall_h // rows
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            mx = wall_x + c * gap_x + 8
            my = wall_y + r * gap_y + 8
            mw, mh = gap_x - 16, gap_y - 16
            crt = pygame.Surface((mw, mh))
            crt.fill((22, 5, 5))
            pygame.draw.rect(crt, (46, 9, 10), (8, 8, mw - 16, mh - 22),
                             border_radius=3)
            # Balaceanu on the feed, at podium scale per tile.
            pygame.draw.rect(crt, (44, 8, 9), (10, 10, mw - 20, mh - 26),
                             border_radius=2)
            _m3_draw_balaceanu(crt, mw // 2, mh - 22, scale=0.30,
                               facing_left=bool(c % 2))
            red_wash = pygame.Surface((mw, mh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            red_wash.fill((26, 2, 2, 60))
            crt.blit(red_wash, (0, 0), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)
            ghost = crt.copy()
            ghost.set_alpha(54)
            crt.blit(ghost, (3, 0))
            # Scanlines + a slow vertical roll bar so the wall is alive.
            for ly in range(0, mh, 3):
                pygame.draw.line(crt, (0, 0, 0), (0, ly), (mw, ly), 1)
            roll = int((t * 0.10 + c * 130 + r * 90) % mh)
            bar = pygame.Surface((mw, 3), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            bar.fill((255, 120, 100, 40))
            crt.blit(bar, (0, roll))
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 6, 6), (*W(mx, my), mw, mh), border_radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (120, 40, 34), (*W(mx, my), mw, mh), 2,
                             border_radius=3)
            surface.blit(crt, W(mx, my))
            _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60), (mx + mw // 2 + ox, my + mh // 2 + oy),
                     90, 14)

    # Control-glass reflection + a slow pass of the room's key light.
    glass = pygame.Surface((wall_w, wall_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    glass.fill((180, 200, 230, 12))
    surface.blit(glass, W(wall_x, wall_y))
    band_x = wall_x + int((sweep / 2000.0) * wall_w) - 70
    band = pygame.Surface((140, wall_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    band.fill((210, 225, 245, 16))
    surface.blit(band, W(band_x, wall_y))

    # Tally: ON, and it is not ours.
    tally_y = wall_y + wall_h + 30
    tally = font_terminal.render("ADDRESS COMPLETE", True, (255, 96, 86))
    surface.blit(tally, W(cx - tally.get_width() // 2, tally_y))
    _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60), (cx + ox, tally_y + 14 + oy), 190, 24)
    dot_on = (t % 1400.0) < 900.0
    if dot_on:
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 70, 60),
                           W(cx - tally.get_width() // 2 - 26, tally_y + 8), 7)
        _ko_glow(surface, (255, 70, 60),
                 (cx - tally.get_width() // 2 - 26 + ox, tally_y + 8 + oy), 34, 40)

    wash = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    wash.fill((210, 30, 24, 20))
    surface.blit(wash, (0, 0))

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "STATE ADDRESS // 22:00 ON AIR")
    return (cx + ox, wall_y + wall_h // 2 + oy,
            1.05 + 0.14 * _ko_clamp01(t / 5200.0))


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_pa(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_fail_pa_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_retry_raw(surface, t):
    """The re-arm plate: feed released, wing reset, clock back to full.

    Deliberately cold and quiet after two red shots - a dead-green terminal
    plate with static breathing behind it, so the retry reads as a system
    handing the wing back rather than another thing going wrong.
    """
    ox, oy = _cb_camera_shake(t, 0.35, 0.35)
    cx = WIDTH // 2

    def W(x, y):
        return (int(x + ox), int(y + oy))

    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT, (4, 7, 7), (9, 15, 14))
    layer = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # Rolling static behind the plate - recycled bands, so a held shot lives.
    band_h = 14
    for y in range(0, HEIGHT, band_h):
        k = (y + int(t * 0.11)) // band_h
        a = 6 + int(9 * (0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(k * 1.7 + t * 0.004)))
        b = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, band_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        b.fill((120, 190, 150, a))
        layer.blit(b, (0, y))

    # The plate.
    pw, ph = 520, 210
    px, py = cx - pw // 2, SCENE_TOP + 120
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (7, 13, 11), (*W(px - 10, py - 10), pw + 20, ph + 20),
                     border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 130, 100), (*W(px - 10, py - 10), pw + 20, ph + 20),
                     2, border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (10, 20, 16), (*W(px, py), pw, ph))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (52, 104, 80), (*W(px, py), pw, ph), 1)

    head = font_terminal.render("STUDIO FEED RELEASED", True, (150, 235, 180))
    surface.blit(head, W(cx - head.get_width() // 2, py + 34))
    # Blinking cursor keeps the plate alive while the caption types.
    if (t % 900.0) < 520.0:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (150, 235, 180),
                         (*W(px + 34, py + 82), pw - 68, 3))
    line1 = font_terminal_small.render("BROADCAST WING RE-ARMING", True, (96, 170, 132))
    surface.blit(line1, W(cx - line1.get_width() // 2, py + 104))
    line2 = font_terminal_small.render("ADDRESS SLOT 22:00 - RECLAIMED", True,
                                       (78, 138, 108))
    surface.blit(line2, W(cx - line2.get_width() // 2, py + 126))

    # A single green telltale on the plate bezel: the wing is ours again.
    tell = 0.6 + 0.4 * math.sin(t * 0.006)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (120, 220, 160),
                       W(px + pw - 26, py + 20), 5)
    _ko_glow(surface, (120, 220, 160), (px + pw - 26 + ox, py + 20 + oy), 40,
             int(30 + 34 * tell))

    _ko_glow(surface, (120, 220, 160), (cx + ox, py + ph // 2 + oy), 300, 12)
    surface.blit(layer, (0, 0))
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _ko_tag(surface, "STUDIO TERMINAL // RE-ENTRY")
    return (cx + ox, py + ph // 2 + oy, 1.03 + 0.09 * _ko_clamp01(t / 3000.0))


def _draw_m3_bcast_fail_retry(surface, t):
    buf = _bc_buf()
    fx, fy, z = _draw_m3_bcast_fail_retry_raw(buf, t)
    _ko_push(surface, buf, z, fx, fy)
