        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (12, 18, 20), (rack_x, rack_y, 140, 330), border_radius=6)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 85, 82), (rack_x, rack_y, 140, 330), 2, border_radius=6)
        for yy in range(rack_y + 24, rack_y + 300, 24):
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (32, 48, 48), (rack_x + 10, yy), (rack_x + 130, yy), 1)
            if (yy // 24) % 3 == 0:
                pygame.draw.circle(surface, (80, 220, 130), (rack_x + 118, yy + 8), 2)
    # Main relay console.
    panel = pygame.Rect(WIDTH//2 - 210, SCENE_TOP + 155, 420, 190)
    render_util.soft_shadow(surface, (panel.x - 20, panel.bottom - 5, panel.w + 40, 34), 100)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (24, 36, 36), panel, border_radius=7)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (82, 120, 112), panel, 2, border_radius=7)
    header = font_terminal.render("COMMS RELAY", True, (135, 220, 190))
    surface.blit(header, (panel.centerx - header.get_width()//2, panel.y + 18))
    # Antenna dish icon and wave display.
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (12, 18, 18), (panel.centerx, panel.y + 105), 38)
    pygame.draw.arc(surface, (120, 210, 175), (panel.centerx - 52, panel.y + 53, 104, 104), math.pi*0.15, math.pi*0.85, 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 210, 175), (panel.centerx, panel.y + 105), (panel.centerx + 48, panel.y + 84), 3)
    for i in range(4):
        r = 55 + i*22
        pygame.draw.arc(surface, (70, 130, 115), (panel.centerx - r, panel.y + 105 - r, r*2, r*2), -0.6, 0.6, 1)
    # Fluorescent strip above.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (44, 54, 52), (WIDTH//2 - 160, SCENE_TOP + 55, 320, 12), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (170, 210, 190), (WIDTH//2 - 150, SCENE_TOP + 58, 300, 6), border_radius=3)
    caption = font_terminal_small.render("RELAY ACCESS REQUIRED", True, (110, 150, 135))
    surface.blit(caption, (WIDTH//2 - caption.get_width()//2, panel.bottom + 22))


def _draw_m3_volkov_gives_mags(surface, t):
    """First-person close-up: Biribel's own cupped hands wait at the bottom
    of frame while Volkov's arm reaches in from the top-right and tosses two
    spare magazines down into them - one per hand, well separated.

    Pacing fix: the spoken line now plays FIRST (shot 1) over Biribel's empty
    waiting hands. Only for shot 2 does Volkov's arm sweep in from off-screen,
    arc the two mags home AFTER the line is done, and retract once they're
    caught - so the handoff no longer races the dialogue. The catch is a clean
    finger-curl + soft amber rim instead of a stray tick.
    """
    surface.fill((4, 5, 6))
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    floor_y = SCENE_BOT - 30

    # Dim close-up backdrop with a soft vignette.
    for y in range(SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT):
        p = (y - SCENE_TOP) / max(1, SCENE_BOT - SCENE_TOP)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (int(8 + p * 12), int(11 + p * 16), int(12 + p * 14)), (0, y), (WIDTH, y))
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (13, 16, 17), [(0, floor_y), (WIDTH, floor_y), (WIDTH, SCENE_BOT), (0, SCENE_BOT)])
    vig = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(60):
        a = max(0, 70 - i)
        pygame.draw.rect(vig, (0, 0, 0, a), (i, i, WIDTH - 2 * i, HEIGHT - 2 * i), 1)
    surface.blit(vig, (0, 0))

    skin = (176, 132, 100)
    sleeve = (58, 68, 52)

    # Helper for a tapered forearm.
    def forearm(shoulder, wrist, col, hi=None, w0=28, w1=12):
        sx, sy = shoulder
        wx, wy = wrist
        dx, dy = wx - sx, wy - sy
        dist = max(1.0, math.hypot(dx, dy))
        px, py = -dy / dist, dx / dist
        poly = [
            (sx + px * w0, sy + py * w0),
            (sx - px * w0, sy - py * w0),
            (wx - px * w1, wy - py * w1),
            (wx + px * w1, wy + py * w1),
        ]
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, col, poly)
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (8, 9, 9), poly, 1)
        if hi:
            pygame.draw.line(surface, hi, (sx + px * w0 * 0.35, sy + py * w0 * 0.35),
                             (wx + px * w1 * 0.25, wy + py * w1 * 0.25), 1)

    # â”€â”€ Timing (ms, cumulative since cutscene start) â”€â”€
    SHOT1_END = 2400          # the spoken line plays over shot 1
    ARM_IN = 320              # arm sweep-in duration
    ARM_OUT = 300             # arm retract duration
    ARM_RETRACT_AT = 4000     # once both mags are caught, pull back
    arm_in = max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - SHOT1_END) / ARM_IN))
    arm_out = max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - ARM_RETRACT_AT) / ARM_OUT))
    arm_vis = arm_in * (1.0 - arm_out)   # 0 -> 1 (swept in) -> 0 (retracted)

    # Biribel's two cupped hands, clearly separated at the bottom. They rise
    # into frame during the first beat and simply wait empty through shot 1.
    hand_lx, hand_ly = cx - 110, floor_y - 34
    hand_rx, hand_ry = cx + 110, floor_y - 34
    q = max(0.0, min(1.0, t / 420.0))
    q = q * q * (3 - 2 * q)
    for hx, hy in ((hand_lx, hand_ly), (hand_rx, hand_ry)):
        forearm((hx, HEIGHT + 40), (hx, hy + 14), sleeve, (94, 108, 80), 30, 13)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (60, 70, 54), (hx - 30, hy - 4, 60, 40))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, skin, (hx - 23, hy - 9, 46, 30))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (150, 110, 82), (hx - 23, hy - 9, 46, 30), 2)

    # Volkov's arm exists ONLY during shot 2: it sweeps in from off-screen
    # top-right to the release point, opens to drop the mags, then retracts.
    toss_x, toss_y = WIDTH - 150, SCENE_TOP + 78
    if arm_vis > 0.001:
        ax = _lerp_cutscene(WIDTH + 90, toss_x, arm_vis)
        ay = _lerp_cutscene(SCENE_TOP - 70, toss_y, arm_vis)
        forearm((WIDTH + 120, SCENE_TOP - 90), (ax, ay), sleeve, (94, 108, 80), 28, 12)
        released = arm_in >= 1.0 and arm_out <= 0.0
        from core.hands import open_hand_dorsal
        open_hand_dorsal(surface, (ax, ay - 6), angle=180.0, mirror=1, sc=0.85,
                         spread=1.3 if released else 0.7,
                         pal={"skin": skin, "hi": (226, 186, 148),
                              "mid": (170, 126, 94), "sh": (150, 110, 82)})

    # Larger magazine sprite.
    MAG_W, MAG_H = 26, 54

    def draw_mag(x, y, angle):
        s = pygame.Surface((MAG_W, MAG_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (26, 28, 33), (0, 0, MAG_W, MAG_H), border_radius=4)
        # curved grip base (amber)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (208, 162, 92), (3, MAG_H - 14, MAG_W - 6, 11), border_radius=3)
        # ribbed body lines
        for ry in range(8, MAG_H - 16, 9):
            pygame.draw.line(s, (120, 122, 132), (4, ry), (MAG_W - 4, ry), 1)
        # top lip
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (150, 150, 160), (3, 3, MAG_W - 6, 5), border_radius=2)
        s = pygame.transform.rotate(s, angle)
        surface.blit(s, (int(x) - s.get_width() // 2, int(y) - s.get_height() // 2))

    # Each mag arcs from Volkov's hand into its OWN hand, delayed so they
    # never overlap in flight or on landing. Both launches happen AFTER the
    # line is finished (t >= SHOT1_END), so the handoff reads clean.
    def mag_traj(tx, ty, delay, dur=880):
        p = min(1.0, max(0.0, (t - delay) / dur))
        if p <= 0.0:
            return None
        flight = min(1.0, p / 0.72)
        ease = 1.0 - (1.0 - flight) * (1.0 - flight)
        arc = math.sin(flight * math.pi) * 70
        x = toss_x + (tx - toss_x) * ease
        y = toss_y + (ty - toss_y) * ease - arc
        caught = p >= 0.9
        return x, y, caught

    mags = [
        (hand_lx, hand_ly - 6, 2760, -16),   # left hand, slight tilt
        (hand_rx, hand_ry - 6, 3080, 16),    # right hand, delayed, opposite tilt
    ]
    for tx, ty, delay, tilt in mags:
        res = mag_traj(tx, ty, delay)
        if res is None:
            continue
        x, y, caught = res
        # Faint motion ghost trailing behind the mag in flight.
        if not caught:
            gp = min(1.0, max(0.0, (t - delay - 90) / 880.0))
            if gp > 0:
                gf = min(1.0, gp / 0.72)
                ge = 1.0 - (1.0 - gf) * (1.0 - gf)
                gx = toss_x + (tx - toss_x) * ge
                gy = toss_y + (ty - toss_y) * ge - math.sin(gf * math.pi) * 70
                ghost = pygame.Surface((MAG_W, MAG_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)
                pygame.draw.rect(ghost, (60, 60, 70, 80), (0, 0, MAG_W, MAG_H), border_radius=4)
                ghost = pygame.transform.rotate(ghost, tilt)
                surface.blit(ghost, (int(gx) - ghost.get_width() // 2, int(gy) - ghost.get_height() // 2))
        draw_mag(x, y, tilt)
        if caught:
            # Clean catch: Biribel's fingers curl over the mag top + soft amber rim.
            top_y = y - MAG_H / 2
            from core.hands import grip_hand
            grip_hand(surface, (x, top_y + 8), axis=0, mirror=-1, sc=0.8,
                      curl=1.0, yank=0.4, grip_d=20,
                      pal={"skin": skin, "hi": (226, 186, 148),
                           "mid": (170, 126, 94), "sh": (150, 110, 82)})
            rim = pygame.Surface((MAG_W + 8, MAG_H + 8), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.rect(rim, (208, 162, 92, 90), (3, 3, MAG_W + 2, MAG_H + 2), border_radius=6)
            rim = pygame.transform.rotate(rim, tilt)
            surface.blit(rim, (int(x) - rim.get_width() // 2, int(y) - rim.get_height() // 2))


def _m3_archives_corridor_base(surface, t, advance=0.0):
    """Shared moving access corridor for the Comms → Archives sequence."""
    surface.fill((4, 6, 7))
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    top, bot = SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT
    horizon = top + 175
    pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.008)

    # Deep doorway and converging architecture establish one continuous axis.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (8, 11, 13), (0, top, WIDTH, bot - top))
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (18, 23, 25),
                        [(0, top), (cx - 155, horizon), (cx - 230, bot), (0, bot)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (15, 20, 22),
                        [(WIDTH, top), (cx + 155, horizon), (cx + 230, bot), (WIDTH, bot)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (23, 27, 29),
                        [(cx - 230, bot), (cx - 155, horizon),
                         (cx + 155, horizon), (cx + 230, bot)])

    # Moving floor ribs sell forward motion without a disconnected camera cut.
    offset = int((advance * 220 + t * 0.06) % 74)
    for i in range(-1, 8):
        y = horizon + i * 74 + offset
        if horizon <= y <= bot:
            half = int(155 + (y - horizon) * 0.22)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (45, 55, 57), (cx - half, y), (cx + half, y), 2)
    for x0 in (-310, -210, 210, 310):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (38, 47, 49),
                         (cx + int(x0 * 0.50), horizon), (cx + x0, bot), 2)

    # Ceiling strips and an intermittent alarm wash.
    for depth in range(4):
        yy = top + 34 + depth * 55
        half = 240 - depth * 38
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (80, 105, 103),
                         (cx - half, yy), (cx + half, yy), 4)
        glow = pygame.Surface((half * 2 + 30, 22), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(glow, (115, 190, 170, 16 + int(12 * pulse)), glow.get_rect())
        surface.blit(glow, (cx - half - 15, yy - 8), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_ADD)

    return cx, horizon, bot


def _m3_draw_k9_low_ready(surface, x, y, sway=0.0):
    """Compact first-person K-9 silhouette; kept low so staging remains readable."""
    x, y = int(x), int(y + sway)
    sleeve = (48, 58, 53)
    skin = (165, 122, 91)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, sleeve, (x - 145, HEIGHT + 20), (x - 68, y + 42), 24)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, sleeve, (x + 150, HEIGHT + 20), (x + 66, y + 32), 22)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, skin, (x - 65, y + 31), 13)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, skin, (x + 61, y + 24), 12)
    # Receiver, magazine, and short suppressor.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (18, 23, 24), (x - 82, y - 13, 142, 34), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (82, 103, 98), (x - 82, y - 13, 142, 34), 2, border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (31, 39, 39), (x + 54, y - 5, 68, 18), border_radius=8)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (3, 5, 5), (x + 122, y + 4), 6)
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (15, 19, 20),
                        [(x - 18, y + 18), (x + 7, y + 18),
                         (x + 2, y + 86), (x - 19, y + 86)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (77, 91, 86),
                        [(x - 18, y + 18), (x + 7, y + 18),
                         (x + 2, y + 86), (x - 19, y + 86)], 2)


def _draw_m3_archives_relay_confirm(surface, t):
    """The tuned KRAP relay authenticates the Archives access gate."""
    surface.fill((3, 7, 7))
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    # Relay console carried over visually from the preceding objective.
    console = pygame.Rect(cx - 300, SCENE_TOP + 65, 600, 330)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (7, 15, 15), console, border_radius=8)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (56, 108, 98), console, 2, border_radius=8)
    screen_r = pygame.Rect(console.x + 42, console.y + 42, console.w - 84, 190)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (2, 12, 10), screen_r, border_radius=4)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (50, 135, 112), screen_r, 1, border_radius=4)

    lines = [
        "KRAP RELAY // HANDSHAKE ACCEPTED",
        "ROUTE: COMMS-03 > ARCHIVES GATE",
        "CREDENTIAL: IPA-MAINT / GHOST AUTH",
        "MAGLOCK CONTROL ........ RELEASED",
    ]
    reveal = max(0, int(t // 210))
    for i, text in enumerate(lines[:reveal]):
        col = (105, 225, 175) if i == len(lines) - 1 else (80, 155, 132)
        s = font_terminal.render(text, True, col)
        surface.blit(s, (screen_r.x + 24, screen_r.y + 22 + i * 38))

    # A physical status strip changes from regime red to relay green.
    unlocked = t >= 760
    strip = pygame.Rect(console.x + 110, console.bottom - 68, console.w - 220, 20)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (42, 18, 18) if not unlocked else (14, 64, 42), strip, border_radius=4)
    fill = min(strip.w, int(strip.w * max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - 300) / 650.0))))
    if fill:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (80, 210, 145), (strip.x, strip.y, fill, strip.h), border_radius=4)
    status = font_terminal_small.render(
        "ARCHIVES MAGLOCK RELEASED" if unlocked else "INJECTING GATE CREDENTIAL...",
        True, (135, 235, 180) if unlocked else (180, 150, 105))
    surface.blit(status, (cx - status.get_width() // 2, SCENE_BOT - 72))


def _draw_m3_archives_corridor_push(surface, t):
    """First-person push through the newly opened access corridor."""
    p = max(0.0, min(1.0, t / 1500.0))
    cx, horizon, bot = _m3_archives_corridor_base(surface, t, p)

    # Opening blast door at the far end; panels separate as Biribel advances.
    open_p = p * p * (3.0 - 2.0 * p)
    gap = int(12 + open_p * 150)
    door_y = horizon - 58
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (32, 41, 43), (cx - 158, door_y, 158 - gap, 250))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (32, 41, 43), (cx + gap, door_y, 158 - gap, 250))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (95, 145, 132), (cx - gap, door_y), (cx - gap, door_y + 250), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (95, 145, 132), (cx + gap, door_y), (cx + gap, door_y + 250), 3)

    # Figures moving beyond the door foreshadow combat rather than an empty room.
    if p > 0.55:
        alpha = int(210 * (p - 0.55) / 0.45)
        silhouettes = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for sx, face_r in ((cx - 86, True), (cx + 112, False)):
            # Cast-sheet IPA guards (figure_kit), flattened to silhouettes.
            _fk_draw(silhouettes, "ipa", sx, horizon + 92, 0.27, facing_right=face_r,
                     silhouette=True, moving=1, t=t + sx * 7)
        silhouettes.fill((255, 255, 255, alpha), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MULT)
        surface.blit(silhouettes, (0, 0))

    bob = math.sin(t * 0.018) * 4 * (0.3 + p)
    _m3_draw_k9_low_ready(surface, cx, bot - 92, bob)
    tag = font_terminal_small.render("ARCHIVES ACCESS CORRIDOR", True, (92, 130, 124))
    surface.blit(tag, (cx - tag.get_width() // 2, SCENE_TOP + 18))


def _draw_m3_archives_volkov_join(surface, t):
    """Volkov catches Biribel at the threshold without breaking screen direction."""
    cx, horizon, bot = _m3_archives_corridor_base(surface, t, 1.0)
    floor_y = bot - 30

    # Open threshold and cold Archives light beyond.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (55, 76, 79), (cx - 150, horizon - 55, 300, 230))
    spill = pygame.Surface((500, 290), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.polygon(spill, (125, 190, 185, 38), [(190, 0), (310, 0), (500, 290), (0, 290)])
    surface.blit(spill, (cx - 250, horizon - 30), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_ADD)

    # Volkov enters from the player's left and turns in the same travel direction.
    enter = max(0.0, min(1.0, t / 850.0))
    ease = enter * enter * (3.0 - 2.0 * enter)
    vx = int(-100 + (cx - 190 + 100) * ease)
    draw_volkov(surface, vx, floor_y, scale=0.67, facing_right=True,
                act_t=t / 1000.0)

    # Biribel remains present in first person, preserving continuity.
    _m3_draw_k9_low_ready(surface, cx + 110, bot - 95, math.sin(t * 0.012) * 2)
    if t > 900:
        arrow = font_terminal_small.render("VOLKOV // LINKED UP", True, (205, 165, 92))
        surface.blit(arrow, (vx - arrow.get_width() // 2, floor_y - 220))


def _draw_m3_archives_hostile_reveal(surface, t):
    """A threatening Archives reveal that resolves directly into gameplay."""
    surface.fill((6, 8, 10))
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    floor_y = SCENE_BOT - 35
    push = max(0.0, min(1.0, t / 1700.0))

    # Atrium perspective: central clerk route, stacks on both sides, vault deep right.
    for y in range(SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT):
        p = (y - SCENE_TOP) / max(1, SCENE_BOT - SCENE_TOP)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (int(9 + p * 22), int(12 + p * 24), int(15 + p * 26)),
                         (0, y), (WIDTH, y))
    horizon = SCENE_TOP + 155
    for side in (-1, 1):
        near_x = cx + side * 310
        far_x = cx + side * 135
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (16, 21, 26),
                            [(far_x - side * 65, horizon - 45), (near_x - side * 150, SCENE_TOP + 20),
                             (near_x - side * 150, floor_y), (far_x - side * 65, horizon + 170)])
        for k in range(5):
            yy = horizon - 15 + k * 48
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (57, 72, 83),
                             (far_x - side * 65, yy), (near_x - side * 150, yy + k * 4), 2)

    # Maru's destination and Vostral vault are visible but spatially distinct.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (22, 29, 34), (cx - 78, horizon - 18, 156, 132), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (93, 122, 137), (cx - 78, horizon - 18, 156, 132), 2, border_radius=3)
    vault = font_terminal_small.render("COLD VAULT", True, (130, 165, 180))
    surface.blit(vault, (cx - vault.get_width() // 2, horizon + 34))
    maru = font_terminal_small.render("NW CLERK OFFICE / DEAD-DROP", True, (176, 135, 215))
    surface.blit(maru, (54, SCENE_TOP + 46))

    # Three guards snap into alert poses; red sight lines sweep toward camera.
    guards = [(cx - 245, floor_y - 95), (cx + 215, floor_y - 110), (cx + 30, horizon + 76)]
    for i, (gx, gy) in enumerate(guards):
        wake = max(0.0, min(1.0, (t - 300 - i * 170) / 420.0))
        # Cast-sheet IPA guard (figure_kit); hands come up as they wake.
        g_scale = 0.29
        g_foot = gy + 10
        _fk_draw(surface, "ipa", gx, g_foot, g_scale, facing_right=gx < cx, t=t + i * 300,
                 fear=0.2 * wake,
                 reach=None if wake <= 0 else ((-10, -34 - 8 * wake), (12, -36 - 8 * wake)))
        if wake > 0:
            aim_x = gx + (cx - gx) * wake
            aim_y = gy - 28 + (floor_y - 120 - (gy - 28)) * wake
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (150, 35, 34), (gx, gy - 30), (int(aim_x), int(aim_y)), 1)
            pygame.draw.circle(surface, (220, 55, 48), (int(aim_x), int(aim_y)), 2)

    # Volkov covers left while Biribel raises the K-9. End composition matches gameplay.
    draw_volkov(surface, cx - 285, floor_y, scale=0.62, facing_right=True,
                act_t=t / 1000.0)
    raise_y = floor_y - 66 - int(34 * push)
    _m3_draw_k9_low_ready(surface, cx + 105, raise_y, 0)

    plate = font_terminal.render("ARCHIVES WING // CONTACT", True, (205, 95, 82))
    surface.blit(plate, (cx - plate.get_width() // 2, SCENE_TOP + 18))


def _draw_m3_archives_door_unlock(surface, t):
    """Close-up: the archive access door's magnetic lock disengages."""
    surface.fill((5, 7, 8))
    cx = WIDTH // 2
    # Door slab.
    door_w, door_h = 260, 320
    door_x = cx - door_w // 2

    # Label.
    label = font_terminal.render("ARCHIVE ACCESS // UNLOCKED", True, (100, 220, 170))

    pygame.draw.line(surface, (160, 190, 220), (vault_x + 20, vault_y + 120), (vault_x + 100, vault_y + 120), 2)
    label = font_terminal.render("ARCHIVES WING // ATRIUM", True, (140, 180, 200))
    surface.blit(label, (cx - label.get_width() // 2, SCENE_BOT - 80))


def _draw_vent_shaft(surface, t):
    """Ventilation shaft - dark corrugated metal tunnel, dust motes, forward crawl."""
    surface.fill((6, 6, 8))
    cx, cy = WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2

    # Corrugated tunnel walls - perspective lines converging to center.
    for i in range(20):
        y_off = i * 28
        shrink = 0.3 + 0.7 * (i / 20)
        lw = int(WIDTH * shrink)
        left = cx - lw // 2
        right = cx + lw // 2
        top = cy - 120 + y_off
        col = (18 + i, 18 + i, 20 + i)
        # Top corrugation.
        pygame.draw.line(surface, col, (left, top), (right, top), 2)
        # Side ribs.
        if i % 3 == 0:
            rib_col = (28, 28, 30)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, rib_col, (left, top), (left, top + 26), 1)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, rib_col, (right, top), (right, top + 26), 1)

    # Dust motes drifting forward.
    rng = random.Random(int(t * 0.01))
    for _ in range(12):
        mx = rng.randint(100, WIDTH - 100)
        my = rng.randint(80, HEIGHT - 80)
        ms = 1 + rng.random() * 1.5
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (60, 58, 52), (int(mx), int(my)), int(ms))

    # Faint light ahead - the exit glow at the tunnel end.
    glow_r = 60 + int(8 * math.sin(t * 0.03))
    glow = pygame.Surface((glow_r * 2, glow_r * 2), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for r in range(glow_r, 0, -4):
        a = max(0, int(18 * (1 - r / glow_r)))
        pygame.draw.circle(glow, (80, 90, 70, a), (glow_r, glow_r), r)
    surface.blit(glow, (cx - glow_r, cy - glow_r - 60), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_ADD)

    # Forward motion blur streaks.
    for _ in range(6):
        sx = rng.randint(120, WIDTH - 120)
        sy = rng.randint(100, HEIGHT - 100)
        slen = rng.randint(20, 50)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (30, 30, 34), (sx, sy), (sx, sy + slen), 1)


def _draw_vent_exit(surface, t):
    """Looking out from the vent grate into the Stabilization Center kitchen."""
    import math
    import random

    # 1. Background / Back Wall (institutional pale green/gray tiles)
    wall_col = (45, 52, 48)
    wall_dark = (30, 35, 32)
    surface.fill(wall_col)

    # Tile grid on the back wall
    tile_size = 40
    for tx in range(0, WIDTH, tile_size):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, wall_dark, (tx, 0), (tx, HEIGHT), 1)
    for ty in range(0, HEIGHT, tile_size):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, wall_dark, (0, ty), (WIDTH, ty), 1)

    # 2. Stainless steel shelving on the back wall
    shelf_y = int(HEIGHT * 0.35)
    shelf_col = (85, 90, 95)
    shelf_hi = (130, 135, 140)
    shelf_dark = (50, 55, 60)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, shelf_col, (80, shelf_y, WIDTH - 160, 12))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, shelf_hi, (80, shelf_y), (WIDTH - 80, shelf_y), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, shelf_dark, (80, shelf_y + 12), (WIDTH - 80, shelf_y + 12), 2)

    # Pots and institutional trays on the shelf
    rng = random.Random(99)
    for px in range(100, WIDTH - 100, 70):
        if rng.random() > 0.3:
            pw = rng.randint(30, 50)
            ph = rng.randint(20, 35)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (65, 70, 75), (px, shelf_y - ph, pw, ph), border_radius=2)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, shelf_hi, (px, shelf_y - ph, pw, ph), 1, border_radius=2)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 45, 50), (px + pw//2 - 10, shelf_y - ph - 4, 20, 4), border_radius=1)

    # 3. Hanging rack with pots (center)
    rack_y = int(HEIGHT * 0.15)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (40, 45, 50), (250, rack_y), (WIDTH - 250, rack_y), 4)
    for hx in range(280, WIDTH - 280, 90):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (60, 65, 70), (hx, rack_y), (hx, rack_y + 40), 2)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (55, 60, 65), (hx - 25, rack_y + 40, 50, 35))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, shelf_hi, (hx - 25, rack_y + 40, 50, 35), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (40, 45, 50), (hx + 25, rack_y + 50), (hx + 45, rack_y + 45), 3)

    # 4. Industrial stove / prep table (lower half)
    table_y = int(HEIGHT * 0.65)
    table_w = 500
    table_x = WIDTH // 2 - table_w // 2
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, shelf_col, (table_x, table_y, table_w, 20), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, shelf_hi, (table_x, table_y), (table_x + table_w, table_y), 2)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (70, 75, 80), (table_x, table_y + 20, table_w, 150))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, shelf_dark, (table_x, table_y + 170), (table_x + table_w, table_y + 170), 2)
    
    # Oven doors
    for ox in range(table_x + 20, table_x + table_w - 20, 120):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (55, 60, 65), (ox, table_y + 40, 100, 110), border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, shelf_dark, (ox, table_y + 40, 100, 110), 2, border_radius=4)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, shelf_hi, (ox + 10, table_y + 50, 80, 6), border_radius=2)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (15, 18, 20), (ox + 20, table_y + 70, 60, 40), border_radius=2)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (30, 35, 40), (ox + 20, table_y + 70, 60, 40), 1, border_radius=2)

    # 5. Overhead fluorescent light (flickering)
    light_cx = WIDTH // 2
    light_cy = int(HEIGHT * 0.05)
    flicker = 0.85 + 0.15 * math.sin(t * 0.2)
    light_col = (int(230 * flicker), int(240 * flicker), int(220 * flicker))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (60, 65, 70), (light_cx - 100, light_cy, 200, 16), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, light_col, (light_cx - 95, light_cy + 4, 190, 8), border_radius=2)
    
    # Light cone (additive blend)
    cone = pygame.Surface((400, 500), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.polygon(cone, (*light_col, 25), [
        (200 - 95, 0), (200 + 95, 0),
        (350, 500), (50, 500)
    ])
    surface.blit(cone, (light_cx - 200, light_cy + 16), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)

    # 6. The vent grate frame (foreground, framing the whole view)
    frame_col = (12, 14, 16)
    frame_hi = (35, 38, 42)
    frame_w = 50

    # Thick borders
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, frame_col, (0, 0, WIDTH, frame_w))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, frame_col, (0, HEIGHT - frame_w, WIDTH, frame_w))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, frame_col, (0, 0, frame_w, HEIGHT))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, frame_col, (WIDTH - frame_w, 0, frame_w, HEIGHT))

    # Inner bevels
    pygame.draw.line(surface, frame_hi, (frame_w, frame_w), (WIDTH - frame_w, frame_w), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, frame_hi, (frame_w, HEIGHT - frame_w), (WIDTH - frame_w, HEIGHT - frame_w), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, frame_hi, (frame_w, frame_w), (frame_w, HEIGHT - frame_w), 2)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, frame_hi, (WIDTH - frame_w, frame_w), (WIDTH - frame_w, HEIGHT - frame_w), 2)

    # Grate slats (horizontal and vertical bars crossing the view)
    slat_col = (18, 20, 22)
    slat_hi = (40, 45, 50)

    # Horizontal slats
    for sy in range(frame_w, HEIGHT - frame_w, 70):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, slat_col, (frame_w, sy, WIDTH - frame_w * 2, 10))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, slat_hi, (frame_w, sy), (WIDTH - frame_w, sy), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (5, 6, 8), (frame_w, sy + 10), (WIDTH - frame_w, sy + 10), 1)

    # Vertical slats
    for sx in range(frame_w, WIDTH - frame_w, 90):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, slat_col, (sx, frame_w, 10, HEIGHT - frame_w * 2))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, slat_hi, (sx, frame_w), (sx, HEIGHT - frame_w), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (5, 6, 8), (sx + 10, frame_w), (sx + 10, HEIGHT - frame_w), 1)

    # Screws in the corners of the frame
    screw_col = (50, 55, 60)
    for cx, cy in [(25, 25), (WIDTH - 25, 25), (25, HEIGHT - 25), (WIDTH - 25, HEIGHT - 25)]:
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, screw_col, (cx, cy), 8)
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (20, 22, 25), (cx, cy), 8, 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 16, 18), (cx - 4, cy), (cx + 4, cy), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (15, 16, 18), (cx, cy - 4), (cx, cy + 4), 2)

    # Dust motes / kitchen steam floating in the light cone
    rng2 = random.Random(int(t * 0.5))
    for _ in range(15):
        mx = rng2.randint(light_cx - 150, light_cx + 150)
        my = rng2.randint(light_cy + 50, HEIGHT - 100)
        mr = rng2.randint(1, 3)
        alpha = rng2.randint(40, 100)
        dust = pygame.Surface((mr*4, mr*4), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.circle(dust, (220, 230, 210, alpha), (mr*2, mr*2), mr)
        surface.blit(dust, (mx, my), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_ADD)

"""m4aftermath.py - Mission 4 finale + intro cutscene art (The Aftermath).

Bespoke shots replace the Slice-0 title-card stubs:

  1. m4_city_curfew      - the capital hours after the broadcast: skyline on
                           fire, searchlights, a curfew the regime can no
                           longer hold. Doubles as the M3 -> M4 intro callback
                           frame (the Vostral still glowing on the street).
  2. m4_arrest_screen    - the state airwaves turning on their own general:
                           Balaceanu escorted out on a wall monitor while the
                           square cheers Retardovici's crest. Biribel is not in
                           this frame - the arrest happens without him.
  3. m4_maru_silhouette  - the liaison in the transmitter hall, the only new
                           face the team actually meets on the ground.
  4. m4_roof_dawn        - studio roof at first light, curfew lifting; Biribel
                           and Vasile watch a city that cheered the wrong man.

Purely procedural, in the same visual language as m3ending (SAFE_TOP..SAFE_BOT
composition so the dialogue box never covers the performers; every wide shot
lives inside that band). Helpers are ported by import from the shared cutscene
layers, not re-implemented.
"""
import math
import random

import pygame

from core.config import *
from core.state import STATE
from functools import lru_cache

from cutscenes.cast import draw_biribel, draw_vasile
from cutscenes.m3ko import _ko_clamp01, _ko_glow, _ko_tint
from cutscenes.m3cell import _m3_clamp01, _m3_noise, _m3_smooth
from cutscenes.chair import _draw_dust_motes
from cutscenes.route12 import _draw_vertical_gradient

_CREST = (230, 200, 120)      # Retardovici's presidential gold
_ARREST = (220, 90, 70)       # Balaceanu red (the general being led out)
_LIAISON = (110, 200, 140)    # Maru green (matches m4.meta C_MARU)
_DAWN = (228, 150, 96)        # first-light warm

SAFE_TOP = SCENE_TOP + 6
SAFE_BOT = HEIGHT - 158   # dialogue box ceiling


def _tag(surface, text, color=(120, 200, 220)):
    """Location tag pinned inside the safe band (m3ending._tag idiom)."""
    surf = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, color)
    surface.blit(surf, (WIDTH // 2 - surf.get_width() // 2, SAFE_TOP + 2))


def _skyline(surface, base_y, rng, *, lit_runs=True, fire=False, t=0, height_scale=1.0):
    """Row of rooftops along ``base_y``. ``fire`` turns some into burnings
    (ember glow + a rising plume), used by the curfew and roof shots."""
    buildings = []
    x = -20
    while x < WIDTH + 20:
        bw = rng.randint(56, 104)
        bh = round(rng.randint(110, 320) * height_scale)
        buildings.append((x, bw, bh))
        x += bw + rng.randint(4, 16)
    for bx, bw, bh in buildings:
        by = base_y - bh
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (14, 16, 24), (bx, by, bw, bh + 60))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (22, 25, 36), (bx, by, bw, 3))
        if lit_runs:
            for wy in range(by + 12, base_y - 8, 19):
                lit = 0
                for wx in range(bx + 8, bx + bw - 10, 15):
                    on = rng.random() < 0.4
                    if on and lit < 3:
                        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (54, 58, 82), (wx, wy, 7, 10))
                        lit += 1
                    elif on:
                        lit = 0
        if fire and rng.random() < 0.28:
            fx = bx + bw // 2
            pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * 0.006 + fx)
            _ko_glow(surface, (220, 120, 60), (fx, by + 6), 90, int(20 + 30 * pulse))
            for k in range(5):
                ph = ((t / 900.0) + k * 0.5) % 2.5
                a = max(0, int(70 * (1 - ph / 2.5)))
                if a:
                    r = int(8 + ph * 16)
                    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (70, 62, 58, a),
                                       (int(fx + math.sin(ph * 2 + k) * 10),
                                        int(by - ph * 46)), r)
    return buildings


def _figure(surface, who, cx, foot_y, scale, facing_right, t, color=None):
    """Silhouette of a cast member (m3ending._figure idiom). ``color`` tints
    the flat for the liaison/crest shots; black by default."""
    w = int(150 * scale) + 8
    h = int(320 * scale) + 8
    ts = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    if who == "vasile":
        draw_vasile(ts, w // 2, h - 6, scale=scale, facing_right=facing_right)
    else:
        draw_biribel(ts, w // 2, h - 6, scale=scale, facing_right=facing_right,
                     in_silhouette=True)
    flat = ts.copy()
    fill = color if color is not None else (6, 7, 11)
    flat.fill((*fill, 255), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MIN)
    bob = (math.sin(t * 0.006) + 1) * 0.8
    surface.blit(flat, (int(cx - ts.get_width() / 2),
                        int(foot_y - ts.get_height() + 6 - bob)))


def _draw_m4_city_curfew(surface, t):
    """The capital at its third curfew night: a skyline on fire it can't police."""
    surface.fill((9, 11, 18))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(surface, 0, SCENE_TOP, WIDTH, SAFE_BOT - SCENE_TOP,
                            (26, 22, 34), (7, 8, 13))
    rng = random.Random(2048)

    base_y = SAFE_BOT - 120
    _skyline(surface, base_y, rng, lit_runs=True, fire=True, t=t)

    # Searchlights sweeping the smoke - the regime's last visible authority.
    for i, sx in enumerate((WIDTH // 4, WIDTH // 2, 3 * WIDTH // 4)):
        ang = math.sin(t * 0.0016 + i * 1.9) * 0.5
        cone = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        top_w, bottom_w = 10, 150
        reach = base_y - SAFE_TOP
        cxp, cyp = sx, SAFE_TOP + 10
        pts = [(cxp - top_w // 2, cyp), (cxp + top_w // 2, cyp),
               (int(cxp + math.sin(ang) * reach + bottom_w // 2), cyp + reach),
               (int(cxp + math.sin(ang) * reach - bottom_w // 2), cyp + reach)]
        pygame.draw.polygon(cone, (200, 210, 235, 20), pts)
        surface.blit(cone, (0, 0))

    # Street: wet asphalt catching the burning, a lone checkpoint barrier.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (12, 12, 16), (0, base_y, WIDTH, HEIGHT - base_y))
    for y in range(base_y, HEIGHT, 22):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (18, 18, 24), (0, y), (WIDTH, y), 1)
    _ko_glow(surface, (200, 90, 60), (WIDTH // 2, base_y + 10), 360, 40)
    for bx in (WIDTH // 2 - 160, WIDTH // 2 + 120):
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (40, 36, 30), (bx, base_y - 26, 90, 34))
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (66, 58, 46), (bx, base_y - 26, 90, 6))

    _draw_dust_motes(surface, t)
    _m3_noise(surface, 5151, count=70, alpha=20)
    _ko_tint(surface)
    _tag(surface, "THE CAPITAL // 48H CURFEW")


# One millisecond timeline owns blocking and editorial cuts. No render-time
# events: seeking, replaying, or holding SPACE can never repeat the arrest.
ARREST_CUFF_MS = 7900
ARREST_ESCORT_MS = 9400
ARREST_END_MS = 14800
_FILM_H = SAFE_BOT - SAFE_TOP


def _beat(t, start, length):
    return _m3_smooth(_m3_clamp01((t - start) / float(length)))


def arrest_camera(t, reduced_motion=False):
    """Broadcast camera sheet; cropping never changes physical blocking.

    Crops keep the same screen direction (president left, general right).
    The cuff insert compresses 400ms of action into a 2.2s editorial hold.
    Reduced motion keeps the cuts but removes dolly movement/contact shake.
    """
    t = max(0, min(float(t), ARREST_END_MS))
    if t < 2400:
        name, a, b, p = "establish", (500, 228, 1000), (510, 225, 910), _beat(t, 0, 2400)
    elif t < 4800:
        name, a, b, p = "president", (311, 147, 350), (310, 145, 320), _beat(t, 2400, 2400)
    elif t < 7200:
        name, a, b, p = "realization", (679, 152, 370), (677, 147, 336), _beat(t, 4800, 2400)
    elif t < 9400:
        name, a, b, p = "cuffs", (500, 228, 1000), (500, 228, 1000), 0
    elif t < 12400:
        name, a, b, p = "escort", (610, 235, 820), (670, 228, 910), _beat(t, 9400, 3000)
    else:
        name, a, b, p = "aftermath", (340, 180, 560), (320, 178, 510), _beat(t, 12400, 1000)
    if reduced_motion:
        p = 0
    cx, cy, w = (a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * p for i in range(3))
    h = w * _FILM_H / WIDTH
    return name, pygame.Rect(round(cx - w / 2), round(cy - h / 2), round(w), round(h))


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _arrest_room():
    """Static palace set: cached so close-ups do not redraw architecture."""
    s = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, _FILM_H))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(s, 0, 0, WIDTH, _FILM_H, (37, 42, 53), (16, 19, 26))
    for x in (66, 184, 814, 932):
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (46, 47, 54), (x - 26, 0, 52, 342))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (74, 66, 59), (x - 25, 0, 5, 342))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (28, 33, 44), (x + 17, 0, 9, 342))
        for y in (34, 307):
            pygame.draw.rect(s, (101, 83, 60), (x - 33, y, 66, 8))
    # Regime-blue and red banners recall the earlier Route 12 address.
    for x in (242, 752):
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (25, 35, 59), [(x - 29, 24), (x + 29, 24),
                            (x + 29, 258), (x, 277), (x - 29, 258)])
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (94, 32, 35), (x - 6, 24, 12, 226))
        pygame.draw.line(s, (150, 114, 67), (x - 32, 24), (x + 32, 24), 4)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (14, 20, 30), (852, 109, 126, 265))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (104, 83, 64), (851, 108, 128, 266), 3)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (6, 10, 17), (863, 117, 102, 255))
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (161, 138, 95), (945, 245), 3)
    # Seal stays behind the president, never above the prisoner.
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (100, 79, 48), (322, 69), 39, 3)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (50, 48, 46), (322, 69), 33)
    for dx in (-18, 0, 18):
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (173, 141, 86), [(322 + dx, 45), (329 + dx, 75),
                            (322 + dx, 91), (315 + dx, 75)])
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (28, 28, 34), (0, 342, WIDTH, _FILM_H - 342))
    for y in (348, 362, 385, 420):
        pygame.draw.line(s, (58, 52, 48), (0, y), (WIDTH, y), 1)
    for x in range(-400, 1600, 155):
        pygame.draw.line(s, (45, 42, 44), (500 + (x - 500) * .35, 342), (x, _FILM_H), 1)
    # Broad feathered practical light, composited rather than opaque discs.
    _ko_glow(s, (245, 187, 119), (318, 155), 235, 32)
    _ko_glow(s, (104, 146, 191), (680, 182), 245, 27)
    return s


def _face(s, cx, cy, scale, *, fear=0, smile=0, look=0, blink=0, president=False):
    """Angular, receding-haired campaign faces with motivated key/rim light.

    Expressions deform brows, eyelids, jaw and mouth, not floating emoji.
    Balaceanu keeps his tan skin/dark hair; the president the navy suit.
    """
    def p(x, y):
        return round(cx + x * scale), round(cy + y * scale)
    def line(col, points, width=1):
        pygame.draw.lines(s, col, False, [p(x, y) for x, y in points], max(1, round(width * scale)))
    def poly(col, points):
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, col, [p(x, y) for x, y in points])
    skin = (198, 154, 115) if not president else (207, 168, 127)
    poly((111, 76, 60), [(-12, 26), (12, 26), (14, 43), (-14, 43)])
    poly(skin, [(-26, -18), (-20, -31), (-5, -36), (17, -31), (26, -20),
               (25, 12), (18, 27 + fear * 2), (4, 34 + fear * 2), (-15, 28), (-25, 9)])
    poly((133, 91, 76), [(8, -31), (26, -20), (25, 12), (18, 27),
                       (4, 34), (8, 15), (14, 2)])
    poly((235, 190, 139), [(-24, -17), (-15, -27), (-12, -5), (-20, 10), (-24, 8)])
    # Receding temples, swept hair, ears, under-eye fatigue and nasolabial crease.
    poly((40, 29, 29), [(-26, -5), (-29, -23), (-19, -34), (-5, -38),
                       (17, -33), (26, -23), (26, -8), (20, -21),
                       (10, -26), (-2, -29), (-18, -22), (-20, -5)])
    line((88, 69, 61), [(-23, -27), (-13, -33), (3, -33)], 2)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (178, 123, 98), (*p(-31, -3), max(1, round(8 * scale)), max(1, round(16 * scale))))
    line((99, 61, 53), [(-26, 1), (-25, 9)], 1)
    line((156, 110, 91), [(-17, 6), (-7, 7)], 1)
    line((101, 67, 62), [(9, 6), (18, 5)], 1)
    # Fear brings the inner brows up; disdain weighs the president's outer lid.
    line((56, 37, 35), [(-19, -10), (-8, -10 - fear * 5)], 2)
    line((48, 32, 32), [(7, -10 - fear * 4), (18, -9 + smile * 2)], 2)
    eye_h = max(0.4, (3 + fear * 2) * (1 - blink))
    for x in (-13, 13):
        poly((219, 203, 173), [(x - 5, -3), (x, -3 - eye_h), (x + 5, -3), (x, -2 + eye_h)])
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (22, 25, 28), p(x + look * 2, -3), max(1, round(1.8 * scale)))
        line((77, 50, 47), [(x - 5, -4), (x + 5, -4)], 1)
    line((117, 73, 59), [(1, -6), (-2, 9), (5, 11)], 1.4)
    line((223, 172, 122), [(-2, -5), (-4, 6)], 1)
    line((119, 74, 66), [(-7, 14), (-11, 22)], 1)
    line((66, 39, 40), [(-10, 22), (0, 21 + fear * 3), (11, 22 - smile * 4)], 1.6)
    if fear > .5:
        line((69, 43, 41), [(-3, 24), (5, 24)], 1)
    line((157, 103, 80), [(-5, 28), (5, 28)], 1)
    line((137, 168, 191) if not president else (248, 202, 128), [(23, -15), (24, 9), (17, 24)], 1)
    if fear > .65:
        line((184, 193, 189), [(-22, -13), (-23, -6)], 1)  # a single sweat catchlight


def _official(s, who, cx, foot, t, arrest=0, moving=0):
    president = who == "president"
    step = math.sin(max(0, t - ARREST_ESCORT_MS) * .009) * moving
    breath = math.sin(t * .0023) * (1.1 if president else 1.8) * (1 - moving)
    slouch = arrest * 9
    head_y = foot - 258 + breath + slouch
    lean = -arrest * 5
    # Weight transfer is tied to physical movement, not the camera's zoom.
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (10, 13, 20), (cx - 51, foot - 5, 102, 13))
    for side in (-1, 1):
        hip = (cx + side * 15, foot - 104)
        knee = (cx + side * 17 + step * side * 7, foot - 49)
        shoe = (cx + side * 18 - step * side * 13, foot)
        pygame.draw.lines(s, (19, 23, 33), False, [hip, knee, shoe], 19)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (62, 63, 71), (hip[0] - 7, hip[1]), (knee[0] - 7, knee[1]), 2)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (8, 10, 17), (shoe[0] - 15, shoe[1] - 4, 34, 9))
    body = (31, 40, 61) if president else (49, 38, 37)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, body, [(cx - 47, head_y + 43), (cx - 25, head_y + 33),
                        (cx + 24, head_y + 33), (cx + 47, head_y + 46),
                        (cx + 37 + lean, foot - 95), (cx - 37 + lean, foot - 95)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (112, 109, 107), [(cx - 21, head_y + 37), (cx, head_y + 73), (cx + 21, head_y + 37)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (217, 203, 178), [(cx - 14, head_y + 35), (cx, head_y + 51), (cx + 14, head_y + 35)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (174, 40, 42) if president else (135, 31, 28),
                        [(cx - 5, head_y + 48), (cx + 5, head_y + 48), (cx + 7, head_y + 100), (cx, head_y + 112), (cx - 6, head_y + 101)])
    for side in (-1, 1):
        pygame.draw.lines(s, (80, 81, 90) if president else (98, 73, 65), False,
                         [(cx + side * 23, head_y + 37), (cx + side * 31, head_y + 70), (cx + side * 9, head_y + 92)], 2)
        shoulder = (cx + side * 40, head_y + 51)
        wrist = (cx + side * (44 - arrest * 26), foot - 145 + arrest * 5)
        pygame.draw.lines(s, body, False, [shoulder, (cx + side * 50, foot - 171), wrist], 16)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (172, 126, 94), wrist, 7)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (122, 107, 86), (cx - 46, head_y + 49), (cx - 36, foot - 103), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, _CREST if president else (156, 113, 74), (cx - 24, head_y + 70), 3)
    blink = .92 if (president and 3450 < t < 3570) or (not president and 5100 < t < 5240) else 0
    _face(s, cx + lean, head_y, 1, fear=arrest, smile=_beat(t, 12400, 1200) if president else 0,
          look=0 if president else -_beat(t, 4700, 1100), blink=blink, president=president)


def _guard(s, cx, foot, t, side, reach=0, moving=0):
    step = math.sin(t * .009 + side) * moving
    for k in (-1, 1):
        pygame.draw.lines(s, (16, 25, 39), False,
                         [(cx + k * 12, foot - 106), (cx + k * 14 + k * step * 8, foot - 51),
                          (cx + k * 15 - k * step * 11, foot)], 18)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (7, 11, 18), (cx + k * 15 - k * step * 11 - 14, foot - 4, 32, 10))
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (27, 40, 58), [(cx - 40, foot - 228), (cx + 40, foot - 228),
                        (cx + 33, foot - 99), (cx - 33, foot - 99)])
    pygame.draw.line(s, (91, 102, 110), (cx - 33, foot - 221), (cx - 28, foot - 115), 2)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (12, 18, 28), (cx - 36, foot - 118, 72, 9))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (174, 155, 106), (cx - 5, foot - 116, 10, 6))
    _face(s, cx, foot - 261, .82, look=-side)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (19, 29, 46), [(cx - 29, foot - 280), (cx - 22, foot - 302),
                        (cx + 23, foot - 302), (cx + 29, foot - 280)])
    pygame.draw.line(s, (129, 133, 126), (cx - 27, foot - 281), (cx + 28, foot - 281), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (174, 144, 89), (cx, foot - 292), 3)
    for k in (-1, 1):
        shoulder = (cx + k * 34, foot - 217)
        wrist = (cx + k * 39, foot - 150)
        if k == -side:
            wrist = (cx + k * (39 + reach * 25), foot - 158 + reach * 9)
        pygame.draw.lines(s, (31, 46, 65), False, [shoulder, (cx + k * 44, foot - 179), wrist], 14)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (25, 30, 34), wrist, 7)


def _arrest_world(t):
    s = _arrest_room().copy()
    approach = _beat(t, 4300, 2900)
    cuffs = _beat(t, 7480, 420)
    walk = _beat(t, ARREST_ESCORT_MS, 3200)
    move = 1 if ARREST_ESCORT_MS < t < 12600 else 0
    bx = 681 + walk * 410
    _guard(s, bx - 73 - (1 - approach) * 142, 404, t, -1, cuffs, move or (0 < approach < 1))
    _official(s, "general", bx, 400, t, _beat(t, 4750, 2000), move)
    _guard(s, bx + 73 + (1 - approach) * 123, 411, t, 1, cuffs, move or (0 < approach < 1))
    _official(s, "president", 318, 400, t)
    # The lectern divides power from custody and hides only the president's legs.
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (61, 45, 40), [(232, 286), (401, 286), (391, 415), (244, 415)])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (120, 90, 59), [(225, 282), (407, 282), (398, 293), (235, 293)])
    pygame.draw.line(s, (178, 140, 89), (233, 287), (401, 287), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (160, 129, 78), (318, 344), 29, 2)
    seal = font_terminal_small.render("IPA / STATE", True, _CREST)
    s.blit(seal, (318 - seal.get_width() // 2, 337))
    for x in (296, 336):
        pygame.draw.lines(s, (10, 14, 21), False, [(x, 284), (x - 5, 255), (x - 2, 246)], 3)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (17, 20, 24), (x - 8, 238, 12, 17))
    if cuffs:
        pygame.draw.line(s, (172, 176, 177), (bx - 17, 262), (bx + 17, 262), 2)
        for x in (bx - 17, bx + 17):
            pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (196, 203, 203), (x - 7, 253, 14, 17), 2)
    return s


def _cuff_insert(t):
    """Slow, legible contact: gloved hands close real hinged steel cuffs."""
    s = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, _FILM_H))
    _draw_vertical_gradient(s, 0, 0, WIDTH, _FILM_H, (38, 42, 52), (10, 15, 24))
    _ko_glow(s, (133, 164, 184), (515, 198), 370, 35)
    settle = _beat(t, 7200, 700)
    # Suited forearms tense at the wrists; gloves enter from opposite sides.
    for side in (-1, 1):
        x = 500 + side * 109
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (52, 39, 39), [(x - 63, 425), (x + 62, 425),
                            (x + 46, 212), (x - 43, 212)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (102, 78, 68), [(x - 56, 420), (x - 48, 243), (x - 38, 218), (x - 34, 420)])
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (210, 199, 174), (x - 38, 207, 76, 19))
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (183, 134, 99), [(x - 33, 211), (x - 31, 159),
                            (x - 22, 139), (x + 28, 145), (x + 35, 205)])
        pygame.draw.line(s, (223, 172, 127), (x - 25, 200), (x - 23, 157), 4)
        gx = x + side * (168 - settle * 96)
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, (23, 32, 45), [(gx + side * 230, 147), (gx, 154),
                            (gx - side * 52, 175), (gx - side * 51, 207), (gx + side * 225, 238)])
        for k in range(3):
            pygame.draw.line(s, (63, 71, 77), (gx - side * 35, 169 + k * 11),
                             (gx + side * 10, 164 + k * 13), 5)
        cuff = pygame.Rect(x - 48, 185, 96, 57)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (41, 52, 64), cuff, 12)
        pygame.draw.arc(s, (185, 198, 204), cuff, .08, math.pi + .22, 7)
        pygame.draw.arc(s, (108, 126, 142), cuff, math.pi + .22, math.tau, 6)
        close = _beat(t, ARREST_CUFF_MS - 20 + (side + 1) * 100, 200)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (203, 211, 214), (x - 43, 206), (x + 42, 156 + close * 55), 6)
        for k in range(4):
            pygame.draw.line(s, (68, 81, 94), (x + 25 + k * 4, 206), (x + 25 + k * 4, 216), 1)
    # Short chain hangs under gravity; no spark shower or gunshot language.
    for i in range(7):
        x = 443 + i * 16
        y = 225 + math.sin(i / 6 * math.pi) * (18 + (1 - settle) * 12)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (143, 160, 172), (x - 11, y - 5, 22, 10), 3)
        pygame.draw.arc(s, (225, 225, 209), (x - 11, y - 5, 22, 10), 0, math.pi, 1)
    return s


def _camera_frame(world, rect):
    frame = pygame.Surface((rect.w, rect.h))
    frame.fill((8, 12, 19))
    frame.blit(world, (-rect.x, -rect.y))
    # Nearest-neighbour maintains the game's intentional hard-edged line art.
    return pygame.transform.scale(frame, (WIDTH, _FILM_H))


@lru_cache(maxsize=4)
def _film_shade(size, strength=64):
    w, h = size
    shade = pygame.Surface(size, pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(20):
        a = int(strength * ((20 - i) / 20) ** 2 / 5)
        pygame.draw.rect(shade, (3, 9, 19, a), (i * w // 70, i * h // 65,
                         w - i * w // 35, h - i * h // 32), max(1, w // 70))
    return shade


def _film_finish(frame, t, warm=False):
    # Split-tone grade: steel shadows, restrained amber practical highlights.
    frame.fill((250, 244, 230) if warm else (234, 241, 253), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_MULT)
    frame.blit(_film_shade(frame.get_size(), 46 if warm else 68), (0, 0))
    dust = pygame.Surface(frame.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    for i in range(18):
        x = (71 + i * 137 + math.sin(t * .0004 + i) * 7) % WIDTH
        y = (31 + i * 79 - t * .006) % _FILM_H
        pygame.draw.circle(dust, (211, 191, 150, 28), (int(x), int(y)), 1)
    frame.blit(dust, (0, 0))


def _draw_m4_arrest_screen(surface, t):
    """A six-angle arrest on the public CRT; power survives its scapegoat.

    President/general/guards only. Biribel remains absent from the broadcast.
    All action settles by 14.8s, leaving a stable frame for input-paced reading.
    """
    t = max(0, min(t, ARREST_END_MS))
    reduced = bool(getattr(STATE, "reduced_motion", False))
    angle, rect = arrest_camera(t, reduced)
    frame = (_camera_frame(_cuff_insert(t), pygame.Rect(220, 75, 560, round(560 * _FILM_H / WIDTH)))
             if angle == "cuffs" else _camera_frame(_arrest_world(t), rect))
    _film_finish(frame, t)
    # Minimal contact jolt, not an explosion. Never present in reduced motion.
    if not reduced and ARREST_CUFF_MS <= t < ARREST_CUFF_MS + 130:
        shift = round(math.sin((t - ARREST_CUFF_MS) * .08) * 2 * (1 - (t - ARREST_CUFF_MS) / 130))
        frame.scroll(shift, 0)
    # Reveal/withdraw the actual public monitor, retaining the original square.
    surround = 1 - _beat(t, 0, 2200) if t < 2400 else _beat(t, 13400, 1400)
    if reduced:
        surround = 1 if t < 2400 or t >= 13400 else 0
    mw = round(WIDTH - 300 * surround)
    mh = round(_FILM_H - 142 * surround)
    mx, my = (WIDTH - mw) // 2, SAFE_TOP + round(18 * surround)
    surface.fill((7, 10, 17))
    _ko_glow(surface, (83, 118, 151), (WIDTH // 2, SAFE_TOP + 220), 450, 22)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (21, 29, 39), (mx - 12, my - 10, mw + 24, mh + 20), border_radius=6)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (98, 106, 112), (mx - 12, my - 10, mw + 24, mh + 20), 2, border_radius=6)
    feed = pygame.transform.scale(frame, (mw, mh))
    # Feed UI is clipped to the tube, not an unbounded crawl across actors.
    ui = pygame.Surface((mw, mh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.circle(ui, (220, 67, 57), (22, 20), 3)
    cap = font_terminal_small.render("STATE / LIVE", True, (218, 217, 200))
    ui.blit(cap, (34, 12))
    if t >= 4300:
        pygame.draw.rect(ui, (18, 23, 33, 231), (0, mh - 33, mw, 33))
        label = "GENERAL BALACEANU / RELIEVED OF COMMAND" if t < 9400 else "ARRESTED ON THE PRESIDENT'S ORDER"
        text = font_terminal_small.render(label, True, _ARREST if t < 12400 else _CREST)
        ui.blit(text, (max(12, (mw - text.get_width()) // 2), mh - 25))
    for y in range(0, mh, 4):
        pygame.draw.line(ui, (0, 0, 0, 17), (0, y), (mw, y))
    feed.blit(ui, (0, 0))
    surface.blit(feed, (mx, my))
    if surround > .1:
        crowd = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, _FILM_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for i in range(23):
            px = 8 + i * 45
            py = _FILM_H - 34 - (i * 13 % 20)
            pygame.draw.circle(crowd, (5, 8, 14), (px, py), 12)
            pygame.draw.polygon(crowd, (5, 8, 14), [(px - 17, py + 15), (px + 17, py + 15),
                                (px + 24, _FILM_H), (px - 24, _FILM_H)])
            if i % 4 == 0 and t > 12400:
                pygame.draw.lines(crowd, (5, 8, 14), False, [(px - 12, py + 17), (px - 26, py - 5), (px - 19, py - 22)], 7)
        crowd.set_alpha(round(255 * surround))
        surface.blit(crowd, (0, SAFE_TOP))
        crest = font_terminal_small.render("LONG LIVE THE PRESIDENT", True, _CREST)
        crest.set_alpha(round(255 * surround))
        surface.blit(crest, ((WIDTH - crest.get_width()) // 2, SAFE_BOT - 96))

def _push_safe(surface, zoom, focus, warm=False, t=0):
    """Crop only picture, never letterbox/subtitles; accessibility locks dolly."""
    frame = surface.subsurface((0, SAFE_TOP, WIDTH, _FILM_H)).copy()
    if not getattr(STATE, "reduced_motion", False):
        w, h = round(WIDTH / zoom), round(_FILM_H / zoom)
        rect = pygame.Rect(0, 0, w, h)
        rect.center = (round(focus[0]), round(focus[1] - SAFE_TOP))
        rect.clamp_ip(frame.get_rect())
        frame = pygame.transform.scale(frame.subsurface(rect), (WIDTH, _FILM_H))
    _film_finish(frame, t, warm=warm)
    surface.blit(frame, (0, SAFE_TOP))

    # Distant haze silhouettes add depth without regenerating gameplay art.
