def start_m5(preserve_timer=False):
    """Begin Mission 5 gameplay at the Guard HQ walk (STAGE_HQ, phase 2)."""
    STATE.reset()
    STATE.active_mission = MISSION5_KEY
    STATE.active_mission_id = MISSION5_ID
    STATE.active_mission_title = MISSION5_TITLE
    STATE.active_mission_operation = "THE CAPITAL - EMERGENCY RULE"
    STATE.active_mission_outcome = "Parliament dissolved  ·  KRAP folded into the Guard  ·  Maru is on the list"
    STATE.active_mission_quote_attr = "Retardovici, on every channel:"
    STATE.active_mission_quote = '"The Presidential Guard will finish the work the Vostral began."'

    STATE.request_mission5_ending = False
    STATE.request_death_screen = False
    STATE.player_dead = False
    STATE.mission5_stage = STAGE_HQ
    STATE.mission_phase = "m5_hq"
    STATE.m5_office_done = False
    STATE.m5_guard_kills = 0
    STATE.m5_maru_found = False
    STATE.m5_dialogue_active = False
    STATE.m5_dialogue_done = False
    STATE.m5_raid_active = False
    STATE.request_m5_cutscene = None
    STATE.m5_convoy_late = False
    STATE.m5_civ_saved = False
    _m5_seen_cuts.clear()
    _m5_decor.reset_run()
    STATE.m5_raid_timer = 0
    STATE.m5_maru_hp = M5_MARU_MAX_HP
    STATE.m5_maru_dead = False
    STATE.m5_fail_timer = 0
    STATE.mission5_quarter_checkpoint_reached = False
    STATE.mission5_printworks_checkpoint_reached = False
    STATE.mission5_tunnel_checkpoint_reached = False
    STATE.m5_marks = set()
    # Biribel is in the President's black for the whole mission: the intro's
    # m5x_change beat always plays before this, and every checkpoint start
    # (hq/quarter/printworks/tunnel) routes through here, so a skipped intro
    # or a checkpoint load can't bring the KRAP kit back. STATE.reset() puts
    # it back to "krap" for every other mission (core.outfits reads it only
    # while MISSION5 is active anyway).
    STATE.m5_outfit = OUTFIT_GUARD

    STATE.rain_drops = [
        (_rng_legacy.randint(0, WIDTH), _rng_legacy.randint(SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT),
         _rng_legacy.randint(10, 20))
        for _ in range(200)
    ]
    STATE.mission_start_time = (
        STATE.mission_start_time if (preserve_timer and STATE.mission_start_time)
        else pygame.time.get_ticks())
    STATE.mission_end_time = 0
    STATE.hostiles_killed = 0
    STATE.shots_fired = 0
    STATE.shots_hit = 0
    STATE.k9_unlocked = True
    STATE.current_weapon = "k9_smg"
    STATE.player_disarmed = False

    try:
        from core.save_system import set_slot_progress
        set_slot_progress("m5")
    except Exception:
        pass

    _m5_maps._radio_marks = set()
    _m5_maps._last_keys = None
    _dlg_reset()

    _enter_hq()
    return STATE.player


def start_mission5_hq_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False):
    """Guard HQ walk (the true opening). Same as a fresh start_m5."""
    return start_m5(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)


def start_mission5_quarter_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False):
    """Lower Quarter with the HQ/office already played."""
    start_m5(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    STATE.m5_office_done = True
    _enter_quarter()
    return STATE.player


def start_mission5_printworks_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False):
    start_mission5_quarter_checkpoint(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    _enter_printworks()
    return STATE.player


def start_mission5_tunnel_checkpoint(preserve_timer=False):
    start_mission5_printworks_checkpoint(preserve_timer=preserve_timer)
    STATE.m5_maru_found = True
    STATE.m5_dialogue_done = True
    _enter_tunnel()
    return STATE.player


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Failure (Maru dies)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _update_maru_fail():
    """Returns True while the Maru-death fail owns the frame."""
    if not getattr(STATE, "m5_maru_dead", False):
        return False
    if getattr(STATE, "m5_fail_timer", 0) == 0:
        _set_objective("MISSION FAILED - Maru is dead.")
        _radio("VASILE: ...Biribel? Tell me that wasn't Maru.",
               color=C_VASILE, duration=400, mark="maru_dead")
        _sfx("bullet_impact_enemy", 0.5)
        STATE.mission_phase = "m5_failed"
    STATE.m5_fail_timer = getattr(STATE, "m5_fail_timer", 0) + 1
    if STATE.m5_fail_timer >= M5_FAIL_HOLD_FRAMES:
        STATE.request_death_screen = True
    return True


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage ladder
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _update_stage(keys=None):
    if getattr(STATE, "request_m5_cutscene", None):
        return
    if _update_maru_fail():
        return
    if getattr(STATE, "m5_dialogue_active", False):
        _update_dialogue()
        return

    stage = getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", STAGE_QUARTER)

    if stage == STAGE_HQ:
        _update_hq_barks()
        if (not getattr(STATE, "m5_office_done", False)
                and _near(_vasile_desk_pos(), radius=HQ_OFFICE_RADIUS)):
            _start_vasile_dialogue()
        return

    if stage == STAGE_QUARTER:
        _m5_quarter.update()
        if getattr(STATE, "request_m5_cutscene", None):
            return  # do not overwrite the checkpoint cinematic with arrival
        if _near(_printworks_door_pos(), radius=70):
            _m5_quarter.on_exit()
            _enter_printworks()
            _request_cut("arrival")
        return

    if stage == STAGE_PRINTWORKS:
        if not getattr(STATE, "m5_dialogue_done", False):
            if _near(_maru_office_pos(), radius=95):
                _start_maru_dialogue()
        return

    if stage == STAGE_RAID:
        _update_maru()
        if STATE.m5_raid_active:
            STATE.m5_raid_timer += 1
            STATE.m5_squad_timer -= 1
            if STATE.m5_squad_timer <= 0:
                _spawn_raid_squad()
                STATE.m5_squad_timer = _rng_legacy.randint(*M5_RAID_SQUAD_GAP)
            # Timer-driven, never kill-gated (M3 exfil-door lesson).
            if STATE.m5_raid_timer >= int(M5_RAID_SECONDS * 60):
                _open_stair()
            return
        m = STATE.m5_maru
        if _near(_stair_pos(), radius=70) and m and math.hypot(
                m["x"] - _stair_pos()[0], m["y"] - _stair_pos()[1]) <= 200:
            _request_cut("descent")
        elif _near(_stair_pos(), radius=70):
            _radio("BIRIBEL: Not without Maru.", color=BIRIBEL_SPEAKER,
                   duration=240, mark="stair_wait")
        return

    if stage == STAGE_TUNNEL:
        _update_maru()
        STATE.m5_squad_timer -= 1
        if STATE.m5_squad_timer <= 0:
            _spawn_pursuit_squad()
            STATE.m5_squad_timer = M5_PURSUIT_INTERVAL
        m = STATE.m5_maru
        gx, gy = _river_gate_pos()
        if m and math.hypot(m["x"] - gx, m["y"] - gy) <= M5_GATE_RADIUS:
            _complete_m5()
        elif _near((gx, gy), radius=M5_GATE_RADIUS):
            _radio("BIRIBEL: Gate's here. Come on, Maru.",
                   color=BIRIBEL_SPEAKER, duration=240, mark="gate_wait")
        return
    return


def _complete_m5():
    """Latch success once; app.py routes to completion while the finale is cut."""
    if (getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) == STAGE_DONE
            or getattr(STATE, "request_mission5_ending", False)):
        return
    STATE.mission5_stage = STAGE_DONE
    STATE.mission_phase = "m5_done"
    STATE.mission_end_time = pygame.time.get_ticks()
    # Preserve the existing handoff flag and mission report/save contract.
    STATE.request_mission5_ending = True


def inspect_active():
    """True while a first-person [E] look shot is on screen."""
    return _m5_decor._fpv.active()


def handle_inspect_event(event):
    """Any key (ESC included) or click closes the look shot."""
    if event.type in (pygame.KEYDOWN, pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN):
        _m5_decor._fpv.skip()


def handle_interact():
    """E-key: advance dialogue; otherwise nothing (doors are proximity)."""
    if getattr(STATE, "m5_dialogue_active", False):
        _dlg_press(pygame.K_e)
        return
    if _m5_decor.inspect():
        return
    if (getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) == STAGE_HQ
            and not getattr(STATE, "m5_office_done", False)
            and _near(_vasile_desk_pos(), radius=HQ_OFFICE_RADIUS)):
        _start_vasile_dialogue()
        return
    if (getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) == STAGE_PRINTWORKS
            and not getattr(STATE, "m5_dialogue_done", False)
            and _near(_maru_office_pos(), radius=95)):
        _start_maru_dialogue()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\missions\m5\inspect_art.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""inspect_art.py - painters for the Mission 5 first-person inspect shots.

Every shot paints onto an oversized canvas (CW x CH, 1.3x the screen) so the
camera in inspect_fpv.py can push and pan across it. Each shot is split in a
static painter (run once, cached) and an optional dynamic painter (per frame:
tickers, rain, embers). Shared helpers live here; the street/storeroom shots
are in inspect_art_street.py.
"""
import math
import random

import pygame

from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT

CW, CH = int(WIDTH * 1.3), int(HEIGHT * 1.3)
_fonts = {}
_cache = {}
GUARD_RED = (168, 30, 32)
GOLD = (176, 146, 86)


# -- helpers --
def font(size, kind="mono"):
    f = _fonts.get((size, kind))
    if f is None:
        names = {"mono": "consolas,couriernew,dejavusansmono",
                 "head": "impact,arialblack,arial"}[kind]
        f = pygame.font.SysFont(names, size, bold=(kind == "mono"))
        _fonts[(size, kind)] = f
    return f


def mix(a, b, u):
    return tuple(int(x + (y - x) * u) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def ease(u):
    u = max(0.0, min(1.0, u))
    return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)


def grad(s, rect, top, bot):
    x, y, w, h = [int(v) for v in rect]
    for i in range(h):
        pygame.draw.line(s, mix(top, bot, i / max(1, h - 1)), (x, y + i), (x + w - 1, y + i))


def soft(r, col, a=255, p=1.6):
    """Radial alpha falloff sprite (2r x 2r)."""
    k = ("soft", r, col, a, p)
    s = _cache.get(k)
    if s is None:
        s = pygame.Surface((2 * r, 2 * r), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for i in range(r, 0, -1):
            pygame.draw.circle(s, (*col, int(a * (1 - i / r) ** p)), (r, r), i)
        _cache[k] = s
    return s


def addlight(s, cx, cy, r, col, k=1.0):
    """Additive light pool (premultiplied, BLEND_RGB_ADD)."""
    key = ("add", r, col)
    spr = _cache.get(key)
    if spr is None:
        spr = pygame.Surface((2 * r, 2 * r))
        for i in range(r, 0, -2):
            f = (1 - i / r) ** 2
            pygame.draw.circle(spr, tuple(int(c * f) for c in col), (r, r), i)
        _cache[key] = spr
    if k < 0.999:
        spr = spr.copy()
        spr.fill(tuple(int(255 * max(0.0, k)) for _ in range(3)), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_MULT)
    s.blit(spr, (int(cx - r), int(cy - r)), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_ADD)


def blobs(s, rect, n, col, seed, rmin=30, rmax=120, a=60):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    x, y, w, h = rect
    for _ in range(n):
        r = max(10, int(rnd.randint(rmin, rmax) // 10 * 10))
        s.blit(soft(r, col, a), (x + rnd.randrange(max(1, w)) - r, y + rnd.randrange(max(1, h)) - r))


def speckle(s, rect, n, cols, seed, size=(1, 2)):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    x, y, w, h = rect
    for _ in range(n):
        r = rnd.randint(*size)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, rnd.choice(cols), (x + rnd.randrange(w), y + rnd.randrange(h), r, r))


def text(s, txt, size, col, pos, kind="mono", center=False, alpha=255, angle=0):
    img = font(size, kind).render(txt, True, col)
    if angle:
        img = pygame.transform.rotate(img, angle)
    if alpha < 255:
        img.set_alpha(alpha)
    x, y = pos
    if center:
        x, y = x - img.get_width() // 2, y - img.get_height() // 2
    s.blit(img, (int(x), int(y)))
    return img.get_size()


def crest(s, cx, cy, r, ring=GUARD_RED, fill=(24, 20, 26), gold=GOLD):
    """Guard crest: the state's three gold diamonds inside a red ring."""
    pygame.draw.circle(s, ring, (cx, cy), r)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, fill, (cx, cy), int(r * 0.84))
    d, hh, ww = int(r * 0.32), int(r * 0.5), int(r * 0.14)
    for dx in (-d, 0, d):
        pygame.draw.polygon(s, gold, [(cx + dx, cy - hh), (cx + dx + ww, cy + int(r * .05)),
                                      (cx + dx, cy + hh), (cx + dx - ww, cy + int(r * .05))])


def crt(s, rect, t, seed=0):
    """Scanlines, a slow roll bar and a corner glare over a CRT picture."""
    x, y, w, h = rect
    key = ("scan", w, h)
    sc = _cache.get(key)
    if sc is None:
        sc = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for yy in range(0, h, 3):
            pygame.draw.line(sc, (0, 0, 0, 70), (0, yy), (w, yy))
        pygame.draw.polygon(sc, (255, 255, 255, 16), [(0, 0), (int(w * .42), 0), (int(w * .18), h // 2), (0, int(h * .62))])
        _cache[key] = sc
    s.blit(sc, (x, y))
    ry = int((t * 0.05 + seed * 97) % (h + 60)) - 30
    bar = pygame.Surface((w, 26), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    bar.fill((255, 255, 255, 12))
    s.blit(bar, (x, y + ry))


def rounded_mask(w, h, rad):
    key = ("mask", w, h, rad)
    m = _cache.get(key)
    if m is None:
        m = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        pygame.draw.rect(m, (255, 255, 255, 255), (0, 0, w, h), border_radius=rad)
        _cache[key] = m
    return m


def blit_screen(s, scr, pos, rad):
    w, h = scr.get_size()
    a = _to_alpha(scr)
    a.blit(rounded_mask(w, h, rad), (0, 0), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MULT)
    s.blit(a, pos)


def _to_alpha(scr):
    a = pygame.Surface(scr.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    a.blit(scr, (0, 0))
    return a


def pin(s, x, y, col=(186, 40, 36)):
    s.blit(soft(10, (0, 0, 0), 140), (x - 6, y - 4))
    pygame.draw.circle(s, mix(col, (0, 0, 0), .35), (x, y + 1), 9)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, col, (x, y), 8)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, mix(col, (255, 255, 255), .55), (x - 3, y - 3), 3)


def rot_blit(s, surf, angle, center):
    img = pygame.transform.rotate(surf, angle)
    s.blit(img, img.get_rect(center=center))


def shadow_of(surf, a=90):
    sh = surf.copy()
    sh.fill((0, 0, 0, a), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MULT)
    return sh


def type_bars(s, x, y, rows, rnd, col, step=22, maxw=300):
    """Illegible typed lines (old notices, small print)."""
    for i in range(rows):
        w = rnd.randint(int(maxw * .45), maxw)
        xx = x
        while xx < x + w:
            ww = rnd.randint(14, 46)
            pygame.draw.rect(s, col, (xx, y + i * step, min(ww, x + w - xx), 6))
            xx += ww + rnd.randint(5, 9)


# -- 1. notice board --
def _strike(p, x0, x1, y, rnd, heavy=False):
    col = (178, 28, 30)
    if heavy:      # scribbled out until nothing reads
        pts, x = [], x0 - 6
        while x < x1 + 8:
            pts.append((x, y + rnd.randint(-13, 11)))
            x += rnd.randint(9, 16)
        pygame.draw.lines(p, col, False, pts, 5)
        pygame.draw.lines(p, (150, 22, 26), False, [(a + 5, b + 4) for a, b in pts], 3)
    else:
        a = rnd.uniform(-4, 4)
        pts = [(x0 - 10, y + a), ((x0 + x1) / 2, y + a * .3 + rnd.uniform(-2, 2)), (x1 + 12, y - a)]
        pygame.draw.lines(p, col, False, pts, 5)


def notice_static(s):
    grad(s, (0, 0, CW, CH), (80, 86, 80), (50, 54, 50))
    blobs(s, (0, 0, CW, CH), 30, (24, 26, 22), 11, 40, 140, 50)
    bx, by, bw, bh = 110, 60, 1080, 790
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (66, 44, 26), (bx - 24, by - 24, bw + 48, bh + 48))
    pygame.draw.line(s, (122, 88, 56), (bx - 22, by - 22), (bx + bw + 22, by - 22), 3)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (40, 26, 16), (bx - 22, by + bh + 22), (bx + bw + 22, by + bh + 22), 4)
    grad(s, (bx, by, bw, bh), (160, 120, 78), (134, 98, 60))
    speckle(s, (bx, by, bw, bh), 4200, [(110, 78, 46), (178, 140, 96), (96, 66, 40), (146, 108, 68)], 12)
    rnd = random.Random(13)
    for _ in range(46):          # holes from a hundred old notices
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (72, 50, 30), (bx + rnd.randrange(bw), by + rnd.randrange(bh)), 2)
    # an older notice behind, mostly covered, and a small card bottom right
    back = pygame.Surface((380, 500), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    grad(back, (0, 0, 380, 500), (206, 192, 150), (180, 164, 122))
    pygame.draw.rect(back, (96, 86, 70), (28, 30, 220, 16))
    type_bars(back, 28, 80, 17, random.Random(14), (118, 106, 88), 24, 320)
    rot_blit(s, shadow_of(back, 70), 5, (412, 412))
    rot_blit(s, back, 5, (404, 404))
    card = pygame.Surface((190, 120), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    grad(card, (0, 0, 190, 120), (196, 204, 210), (172, 180, 186))
    type_bars(card, 14, 18, 5, random.Random(16), (90, 96, 104), 18, 160)
    rot_blit(s, shadow_of(card, 70), -7, (1046, 738))
    rot_blit(s, card, -7, (1040, 732))
    pin(s, 1010, 690, (60, 110, 170))
    # the transfer list
    pw, ph = 540, 720
    p = pygame.Surface((pw, ph), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    grad(p, (0, 0, pw, ph), (234, 230, 216), (212, 206, 188))
    pygame.draw.line(p, (198, 192, 174), (0, ph // 2 + 6), (pw, ph // 2 - 4), 2)   # fold
    text(p, "KRAP SQUAD 4", 56, (28, 30, 36), (pw // 2, 72), kind="head", center=True)
    text(p, "- TRANSFERRED -", 26, (44, 44, 50), (pw // 2, 128), center=True)
    pygame.draw.line(p, (60, 60, 66), (40, 158), (pw - 40, 158), 2)
    rows = (("KOVAC", 1), (None, 2), ("SANDU", 1), (None, 2), (None, 2), (None, 2), ("BIRIBEL", 0))
    rnd = random.Random(15)
    for i, (name, cross) in enumerate(rows):
        y = 196 + i * 64
        text(p, "%02d." % (i + 1), 22, (74, 74, 80), (50, y + 4))
        if name:
            w, _h = text(p, name, 32, (26, 28, 34), (118, y - 4))
        else:
            w = rnd.randint(150, 240)
            type_bars(p, 118, y + 8, 1, rnd, (52, 54, 62), 0, w)
        if cross:
            _strike(p, 118, 118 + w, y + 13, rnd, heavy=cross == 2)
    torn = [(pw, ph - 170), (pw - 22, ph - 140), (pw - 38, ph - 118), (pw - 70, ph - 92),
            (pw - 96, ph - 58), (pw - 130, ph - 36), (pw - 176, ph), (pw, ph)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(p, (0, 0, 0, 0), torn)
    pygame.draw.lines(p, (246, 242, 232), False, torn[:-1], 2)
    rot_blit(s, shadow_of(p, 100), -1.6, (662, 484))
    rot_blit(s, p, -1.6, (650, 470))
    pin(s, 404, 134)
    pin(s, 894, 122)
    pin(s, 300, 176, (210, 180, 60))
    addlight(s, 560, 120, 620, (40, 36, 26))

# -- 4. paint tins --
def _tin(s, cx, by, r, h, shade=1.0, rnd=None, label=True):
    def c(col):
        return tuple(int(v * shade) for v in col)
    ey = int(r * 0.32)
    body = pygame.Rect(cx - r, by - h, 2 * r, h)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, c((20, 20, 22)), (cx - r, by - ey, 2 * r, 2 * ey))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, c((46, 46, 50)), body)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, c((76, 76, 82)), (cx - r + int(r * .22), by - h, int(r * .2), h))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, c((28, 28, 31)), (cx + r - int(r * .36), by - h, int(r * .36), h))
    for f in (0.1, 0.9):
        pygame.draw.line(s, c((88, 88, 94)), (cx - r, by - int(h * f)), (cx + r - 1, by - int(h * f)), 2)
    if label:
        ly0, ly1 = by - int(h * 0.8), by - int(h * 0.22)
        off = rnd.randint(-int(r * .1), int(r * .1)) if rnd else 0   # label fits the can (G4)
        s.set_clip(body)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, c((214, 208, 194)), (cx - r, ly0, 2 * r, ly1 - ly0))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, c(GUARD_RED), (cx - r, ly0 + 5, 2 * r, 7))
        fs = max(8, int(r * 0.24))
        lh = ly1 - ly0
        text(s, "GUARD BLACK", fs, c((18, 18, 22)), (cx + off, ly0 + int(lh * .42)), center=True)
        text(s, "40 LITRES", fs, c((18, 18, 22)), (cx + off, ly0 + int(lh * .72)), center=True)
        dk = pygame.Surface((int(r * .36), lh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        dk.fill((0, 0, 0, 100))
        s.blit(dk, (cx + r - int(r * .36), ly0))
        s.set_clip(None)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, c((98, 98, 104)), (cx - r, by - h - ey, 2 * r, 2 * ey))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, c((62, 62, 68)), (cx - r + 6, by - h - ey + 3, 2 * r - 12, 2 * ey - 6))

    ey = int(74 * .32)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (126, 126, 132), (936, 722 - ey, 148, 2 * ey))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (10, 10, 12), (942, 722 - ey + 4, 136, 2 * ey - 8))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (70, 70, 78), (990, 714, 44, 7))
    for dx, ln in ((-52, 46), (-22, 92), (48, 28)):
        x = 1010 + dx
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (10, 10, 12), (x - 4, 726, 9, ln))
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (10, 10, 12), (x, 726 + ln), 6)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (80, 80, 88), (x - 2, 730), (x - 2, 722 + ln), 1)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (96, 96, 102), (1114, 690, 50, 150))     # lid against it
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (130, 130, 136), (1120, 696, 38, 138))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (14, 14, 16), (1128, 740, 18, 60))        # paint on the underside
    pygame.draw.line(s, (150, 104, 60), (1046, 716), (1196, 752), 14)  # brush
    pygame.draw.line(s, (176, 176, 182), (1026, 712), (1050, 717), 18)
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (12, 12, 14), [(980, 696), (1028, 702), (1026, 724), (976, 722)])
    pygame.draw.line(s, (10, 10, 12), (1184, 758), (1186, 790), 4)
    pygame.draw.circle(s, (10, 10, 12), (1186, 792), 4)

# -- 5. shop TV through a half-down shutter --
SHOP_SCREEN = (500, 446, 250, 190)
SHOP_TICKER = ("CURFEW IN THE LOWER QUARTER IS FOR YOUR PROTECTION  \u00b7  "

def shop_static(s):
    grad(s, (0, 0, CW, CH), (100, 76, 50), (60, 44, 30))
    rnd = random.Random(51)
    for sy in (190, 340, 490):
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (70, 50, 34), (110, sy, 1080, 12))
        x = 124
        while x < 1170:
            w, h = rnd.randint(28, 70), rnd.randint(40, 112)
            col = rnd.choice(((150, 120, 70), (120, 60, 46), (84, 96, 110), (170, 150, 110),
                              (96, 110, 70), (140, 90, 60), (200, 190, 160)))
            pygame.draw.rect(s, col, (x, sy - h, w, h))
            pygame.draw.rect(s, mix(col, (0, 0, 0), .35), (x, sy - h, w, h), 2)
            x += w + rnd.randint(2, 16)
    grad(s, (60, 664, 1180, 246), (122, 88, 56), (78, 56, 36))
    pygame.draw.line(s, (156, 118, 78), (60, 664), (1240, 664), 4)
    tv = pygame.Rect(462, 418, 372, 248)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 26, 22), tv.move(8, 10), border_radius=18)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (62, 58, 54), tv, border_radius=18)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (16, 16, 18), (488, 434, 274, 214), border_radius=18)
    for yy in (470, 530):
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (40, 38, 36), (796, yy), 15)
    pygame.draw.line(s, (40, 38, 36), (650, 418), (610, 330), 3)        # rabbit ears
    pygame.draw.line(s, (40, 38, 36), (660, 418), (740, 344), 3)
    addlight(s, 930, 110, 460, (96, 70, 36))
    # the shutter, pulled half down from the street side
    for yy in range(0, _SHUTTER_Y, 26):
        grad(s, (80, yy, 1140, 26), (140, 142, 146), (88, 90, 96))
        pygame.draw.line(s, (56, 58, 62), (80, yy + 25), (1219, yy + 25), 2)
    blobs(s, (80, 0, 1140, _SHUTTER_Y), 22, (110, 64, 34), 52, 20, 70, 90)
    blobs(s, (680, 220, 200, 120), 2, (40, 40, 44), 53, 40, 60, 80)        # a dent
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (62, 64, 70), (80, _SHUTTER_Y - 6, 1140, 22))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (40, 42, 46), (80, _SHUTTER_Y + 14, 1140, 3))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 30, 34), (586, _SHUTTER_Y + 2, 110, 10), border_radius=4)
    for x0, x1 in ((0, 80), (1220, CW)):                                     # window frame
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (24, 22, 24), (x0, 0, x1 - x0, CH))
        pygame.draw.line(s, (70, 74, 86), (x0 + 12, 0), (x0 + 12, CH), 2)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 30, 34), (0, 866, CW, 44))
    for x in (140, 420, 760, 1060):
        pygame.draw.line(s, (120, 100, 70), (x, 872), (x + 90, 872), 2)


def shop_dyn(s, t):
    x, y, w, h = SHOP_SCREEN
    flick = 0.88 + 0.12 * math.sin(t * 0.031) * math.sin(t * 0.0071)
    scr = pygame.Surface((w, h))
    grad(scr, (0, 0, w, h), (20, 26, 46), (6, 8, 16))
    pygame.draw.rect(scr, (150, 26, 28), (0, 12, w, 36))
    text(scr, "MAG = FOREIGN AGITATION", 17, (248, 242, 232), (w // 2, 30), center=True)
    crest(scr, w // 2, 98, 36)
    pygame.draw.rect(scr, (90, 18, 20), (0, h - 34, w, 24))
    img = font(15).render(SHOP_TICKER, True, (240, 232, 220))
    scr.blit(img, (int(24 - t * 0.085), h - 22 - img.get_height() // 2))
    crt(scr, (0, 0, w, h), t, 3)
    if flick < 0.999:
        scr.fill(tuple(int(255 * flick) for _ in range(3)), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGB_MULT)
    blit_screen(s, scr, (x, y), 16)
    addlight(s, x + w // 2, 690, 300, (30, 40, 70), flick)
    lay = pygame.Surface((CW, CH), pygame.SRCALPHA)                       # rain, street side
    rnd = random.Random(77)
    for _ in range(150):
        x0, y0 = rnd.randrange(CW), rnd.randrange(CH)
        v, ln = rnd.uniform(0.9, 1.5), rnd.randint(16, 40)
        yy = (y0 + t * v) % (CH + 60) - 30
        xx = x0 - yy * 0.1
        pygame.draw.line(lay, (180, 190, 210, rnd.randint(40, 90)), (xx, yy), (xx - 4, yy + ln), 1)
    s.blit(lay, (0, 0))


# -- 6. the burned tram --
_WIN_X = (110, 330, 550, 770, 990)
_WIN_Y, _WIN_W, _WIN_H = 282, 180, 200


def tram_static(s):
    grad(s, (0, 0, CW, CH), (14, 16, 26), (30, 24, 24))
    rnd = random.Random(61)
    x = 0
    while x < CW:                                      # far blocks
        w, h = rnd.randint(90, 200), rnd.randint(140, 300)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (22, 22, 30), (x, 220 - h // 3, w, 600))
        for _ in range(rnd.randint(0, 2)):
            pygame.draw.rect(s, (150, 120, 70), (x + rnd.randint(10, w - 30), 240 - h // 3 + rnd.randint(0, 60), 14, 18))
        x += w + rnd.randint(4, 30)
    grad(s, (0, 800, CW, 110), (34, 30, 30), (16, 14, 14))
    for x in (120, 380, 700, 1000):
        pygame.draw.line(s, (90, 60, 34), (x, 840), (x + 140, 842), 2)
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (52, 54, 58), (60, 206, 1180, 50), border_top_left_radius=26, border_top_right_radius=26)
    pygame.draw.lines(s, (36, 36, 40), False, [(600, 206), (640, 150), (700, 170), (760, 120)], 4)  # pantograph
    grad(s, (60, 256, 1180, 264), (100, 36, 30), (86, 30, 26))
    grad(s, (60, 520, 1180, 40), (168, 150, 112), (140, 124, 92))
    grad(s, (60, 560, 1180, 182), (104, 36, 32), (80, 28, 24))
    pygame.draw.rect(s, (22, 20, 20), (60, 742, 1180, 54))
    for wx in (210, 330, 940, 1060):
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (30, 30, 32), (wx, 792), 38)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (64, 64, 70), (wx, 792), 38, 4)
    for i, wx in enumerate(_WIN_X):
        r = pygame.Rect(wx, _WIN_Y, _WIN_W, _WIN_H)
        grad(s, r, (24, 26, 36), (14, 12, 12))
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (40, 44, 60), (wx + 20, _WIN_Y + 22, _WIN_W - 40, 60))   # far-side window
        for sx in (wx + 14, wx + 96):                                              # empty seats
            pygame.draw.rect(s, (30, 22, 18), (sx, _WIN_Y + 110, 70, 90), border_top_left_radius=12,
                             border_top_right_radius=12)
            for k in range(3):
                pygame.draw.line(s, (90, 90, 96), (sx + 10 + k * 20, _WIN_Y + 130), (sx + 18 + k * 20, _WIN_Y + 190), 1)
        if i != 2:                                     # glass gone, shards in the frame
            for _ in range(5):
                ex = wx + rnd.randint(0, _WIN_W)
                top = rnd.random() < .5
                ey = _WIN_Y if top else _WIN_Y + _WIN_H
                d = 26 if top else -26
                pygame.draw.polygon(s, (60, 74, 90), [(ex - 12, ey), (ex + 12, ey), (ex + rnd.randint(-8, 8), ey + d + rnd.randint(-10, 10))])
        else:
            g = pygame.Surface((_WIN_W, _WIN_H), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            g.fill((90, 90, 96, 70))
            s.blit(g, r)
            pygame.draw.lines(s, (150, 156, 168), False, [(wx + 40, _WIN_Y + 30), (wx + 80, _WIN_Y + 90), (wx + 70, _WIN_Y + 150), (wx + 120, _WIN_Y + 196)], 1)
        pygame.draw.rect(s, (14, 12, 12), r, 8)
    for i, wx in enumerate(_WIN_X):                    # the fire climbed out of the windows
        blobs(s, (wx - 30, 200, _WIN_W + 60, 120), 4, (8, 6, 6), 62 + i, 60, 120, 170)
    blobs(s, (600, 260, 640, 480), 14, (10, 8, 8), 70, 50, 150, 150)
    blobs(s, (60, 600, 300, 140), 5, (10, 8, 8), 71, 40, 90, 120)
    blobs(s, (120, 230, 1000, 100), 8, (70, 72, 100), 72, 40, 80, 70)
    speckle(s, (60, 256, 1180, 486), 900, [(150, 92, 70), (60, 20, 18), (120, 110, 90)], 73, (1, 3))
    # fresh Guard paint over the scorch
    word = font(108, "head").render("PROVOCATEURS", True, (8, 8, 10))
    over = pygame.transform.smoothscale(word, (word.get_width() // 4, word.get_height() // 4))
    over = pygame.transform.smoothscale(over, word.get_size())
    over.set_alpha(110)

    shine = font(108, "head").render("PROVOCATEURS", True, (120, 120, 130))
    s.blit(pygame.transform.rotate(shine, 3), (wx0 - 3, wy0 - 3))
    s.blit(pygame.transform.rotate(word, 3), (wx0, wy0))
    for _ in range(16):                                # runs from the fresh paint
        x = wx0 + 30 + rnd.randint(0, word.get_width() - 60)
        y0 = wy0 + 120 - int((x - wx0) * math.tan(math.radians(3)))
        ln = rnd.randint(14, 70)
        pygame.draw.line(s, (8, 8, 10), (x, y0), (x, y0 + ln), rnd.choice((2, 3)))
        pygame.draw.circle(s, (8, 8, 10), (x, y0 + ln), 3)


def tram_dyn(s, t):
    wx = _WIN_X[3]
    k = 0.7 + 0.3 * math.sin(t * 0.004) * math.sin(t * 0.0013 + 1)
    addlight(s, wx + _WIN_W // 2, _WIN_Y + _WIN_H - 20, 150, (140, 60, 16), k)     # still smouldering
    addlight(s, 650, 960, 700, (60, 26, 8), 0.8 + 0.2 * k)
    rnd = random.Random(81)
    for _ in range(9):                                 # smoke, blowing east
        x0, y0, r = rnd.randrange(CW), rnd.randint(80, 520), rnd.choice((90, 120, 150))
        x = (x0 + t * rnd.uniform(0.02, 0.05)) % (CW + 300) - 150
        s.blit(soft(r, (70, 66, 66), 110), (int(x - r), int(y0 - t * 0.012 - r)))
    for _ in range(60):                                # embers
        x0, y0 = rnd.randrange(80, CW - 80), rnd.randint(300, 800)
        v, ph = rnd.uniform(0.03, 0.08), rnd.uniform(0, 6.28)
        rise = (t * v + ph * 40) % 420
        x = x0 + 14 * math.sin(t * 0.002 + ph) + rise * 0.25
        f = 1 - rise / 420
        col = mix((255, 200, 90), (200, 60, 20), 1 - f)
        pygame.draw.circle(s, col, (int(x), int(y0 - rise)), 2 if f > .4 else 1)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\missions\m5\inspect_fpv.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""inspect_fpv.py - Mission 5 "[E] look": a short first-person look at the
thing instead of a radio line.

    can_play(key)      shot exists and a real display is up (headless -> text)
    start(key)         begin; M5 game_update freezes while active()
    update(dt_ms)      advance (called from systems.game_update) -> active
    draw(surface)      full-screen, over HUD (called from draw.game_draw)
    skip()             any key / click / ESC (app.py via m5.handle_inspect_event)
    render_frame(key, t) -> Surface   (also used by tools/_inspect_shots.py)

Camera: the shot is painted on a 1.3x canvas; the view rises from below
(the player lifting his eyes), then eases a push/pan between two keys with a
small hand-held sway. Vignette + grain on top, one caption line.
"""
import math
import os
import random

import pygame

from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
from missions.m5 import inspect_art as _art
from missions.m5 import inspect_art_street as _street

FRAME_MS = 1000.0 / 60.0
RISE_MS = 520
HOLD_MS = 1500          # rest on the last frame, then close by itself
FADE_IN_MS = 300
FADE_OUT_MS = 220
FORCE_HEADLESS = False  # tools flip this to exercise the shots under the dummy driver

# key -> static painter, dynamic painter, camera ((fx, fy, zoom) start, end), ms, caption
SHOTS = {
    "notice": dict(static=_art.notice_static, dyn=None,
                   cam=((0.50, 0.29, 1.22), (0.45, 0.70, 1.55)), dur=4000,
                   caption="Every name crossed out. Mine's still there. For now."),
    "hq_tv": dict(static=_art.tv_static, dyn=_art.tv_dyn,
                  cam=((0.47, 0.62, 1.08), (0.48, 0.46, 1.58)), dur=3800,
                  caption="Somebody turned the volume down."),
    "portrait": dict(static=_art.portrait_static, dyn=None,
                     cam=((0.50, 0.33, 1.75), (0.50, 0.46, 1.0)), dur=3800,
                     caption="New frame, old smile."),
    "paint": dict(static=_street.paint_static, dyn=None,
                  cam=((0.36, 0.52, 1.35), (0.72, 0.78, 1.4)), dur=3800,
                  caption="Enough for the whole building."),
    "shop_tv": dict(static=_street.shop_static, dyn=_street.shop_dyn,
                    cam=((0.50, 0.42, 1.15), (0.48, 0.56, 1.6)), dur=3600,
                    caption="The shopkeeper pulled the shutter halfway."),
    "tram": dict(static=_street.tram_static, dyn=_street.tram_dyn,
                 cam=((0.33, 0.42, 1.45), (0.52, 0.64, 1.25)), dur=4000,
                 caption="Nobody was on it when it burned. Probably."),
}

_st = {"key": None, "t": 0.0, "close": None, "caption": ""}
_static = {}
_fx = {}


def can_play(key):
    if key not in SHOTS:
        return False
    if FORCE_HEADLESS:
        return True
    # Ask SDL which driver is really running. The env var is unreliable: other
    # modules (e.g. missions.m3) setdefault SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy at import
    # time, after the real window already exists.
    try:
        if pygame.display.get_init():
            return pygame.display.get_driver() != "dummy"
    except pygame.error:
        pass
    return os.environ.get("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "") != "dummy"


def active():
    return _st["key"] is not None


def start(key, caption=None):
    _static_for(key)
    _st.update(key=key, t=0.0, close=None,
               caption=SHOTS[key]["caption"] if caption is None else caption)


def skip():
    if _st["key"] is not None and _st["close"] is None:
        _st["close"] = _st["t"]


def reset():
    _st.update(key=None, t=0.0, close=None, caption="")


def update(dt_ms=FRAME_MS):
    key = _st["key"]
    if key is None:
        return False
    _st["t"] += dt_ms
    t = _st["t"]
    if _st["close"] is None and t >= SHOTS[key]["dur"] + HOLD_MS:
        _st["close"] = t
    if _st["close"] is not None and t - _st["close"] >= FADE_OUT_MS:
        reset()
    return active()


def draw(surface):
    key = _st["key"]
    if key is None:
        return
    t = _st["t"]
    a = _art.ease(t / FADE_IN_MS)
    if _st["close"] is not None:
        a *= 1.0 - _art.ease((t - _st["close"]) / FADE_OUT_MS)
    frame = render_frame(key, t, _st["caption"])
    frame.set_alpha(int(255 * a))
    surface.blit(frame, (0, 0))


# -- rendering --
def _static_for(key):
    s = _static.get(key)
    if s is None:
        s = pygame.Surface((_art.CW, _art.CH))
        spr = None
        try:                                  # baked layer (src/art/m5/inspect_art.py)
            from art import m5 as _m5art
            from art.m5.inspect_art import KEYS
            if key in KEYS:
                spr = _m5art.get("inspect_art", KEYS.index(key))
        except Exception:
            spr = None
        if spr is not None and spr.get_size() == s.get_size():
            s.blit(spr, (0, 0))
        else:
            SHOTS[key]["static"](s)
        _static[key] = s
    return s


def canvas(key, t):
    """The whole painted set at time t (static layer + per-frame motion)."""
    shot = SHOTS[key]
    s = _static_for(key)
    if shot["dyn"] is None:
        return s
    s = s.copy()
    shot["dyn"](s, t)
    return s


def _vignette():
    v = _fx.get("vig")
    if v is None:
        sw, sh = 100, 70
        small = pygame.Surface((sw, sh), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for y in range(sh):
            for x in range(sw):
                d = math.hypot((x - sw / 2) / (sw / 2), (y - sh / 2) / (sh / 2))
                small.set_at((x, y), (0, 0, 0, int(215 * max(0.0, min(1.0, (d - 0.5) / 0.75)) ** 1.4)))
        v = _fx["vig"] = pygame.transform.smoothscale(small, (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    return v


def _grain(t):
    g = _fx.get("grain")
    if g is None:
        g = []
        for i in range(4):
            rnd = random.Random(900 + i)
            s = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for _ in range(2600):
                c = rnd.choice((0, 255))
                pygame.draw.rect(s, (c, c, c, rnd.randint(10, 26)),
                                 (rnd.randrange(WIDTH), rnd.randrange(HEIGHT), 2, 2))
            g.append(s)
        _fx["grain"] = g
    return g[int(t / 60) % len(g)]


def render_frame(key, t, caption=None):
    shot = SHOTS[key]
    cv = canvas(key, t)
    (fx0, fy0, z0), (fx1, fy1, z1) = shot["cam"]
    u = _art.ease(t / shot["dur"])
    rise = 1.0 - _art.ease(t / RISE_MS)
    z = max(WIDTH / _art.CW + 0.01, (z0 + (z1 - z0) * u) * (1.0 - 0.05 * rise))
    sx = 7 * math.sin(t * 0.0011) + 3 * math.sin(t * 0.0029 + 0.7)
    sy = 5 * math.sin(t * 0.0014 + 1.3) + 2 * math.sin(t * 0.0037)
    vw, vh = WIDTH / z, HEIGHT / z
    cx = (fx0 + (fx1 - fx0) * u) * _art.CW + sx
    cy = (fy0 + (fy1 - fy0) * u) * _art.CH + sy + rise * HEIGHT * 0.22
    x0 = max(0.0, min(_art.CW - vw, cx - vw / 2))
    y0 = max(0.0, min(_art.CH - vh, cy - vh / 2))
    view = cv.subsurface((int(x0), int(y0), int(vw), int(vh)))
    out = pygame.transform.smoothscale(view, (WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    out.blit(_vignette(), (0, 0))
    out.blit(_grain(t), (0, 0))
    if caption is None:
        caption = shot["caption"]
    ca = _art.ease((t - 900) / 500)
    if caption and ca > 0:
        img = _art.font(21).render(caption, True, (232, 228, 214))
        bar = pygame.Surface((img.get_width() + 44, img.get_height() + 16), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        bar.fill((6, 8, 12, int(175 * ca)))
        bx = WIDTH // 2 - bar.get_width() // 2
        by = HEIGHT - 84
        out.blit(bar, (bx, by))
        img.set_alpha(int(255 * ca))
        out.blit(img, (bx + 22, by + 8))
    ha = _art.ease((t - 700) / 400)
    if ha > 0:
        hint = _art.font(13).render("[E] / ANY KEY  BACK", True, (200, 196, 184))
        hint.set_alpha(int(150 * ha))
        out.blit(hint, (WIDTH - hint.get_width() - 22, HEIGHT - 30))
    return out

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\missions\m5\maps.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Mission 5 - part module. See __init__.py for the package facade.

Owner module for the Mission 5 runtime map state: MISSION5_MAP (the
currently-bound playable grid), _last_keys, _objective, _radio_marks.
Parts access these as ``_m5_maps.NAME`` - never ``from missions.m5.maps
import MISSION5_MAP`` (that snapshots the binding).

Four procedural maps in the M4 tile grammar (see meta.py):
  MISSION5_HQ_MAP       30x16  Guard HQ (old KRAP depot) - walking sim
  MISSION5_QUARTER_MAP  40x30  Lower Quarter night streets
  MISSION5_PRINT_MAP    26x20  MAG print works (presses, Maru's office)
  MISSION5_TUNNEL_MAP   48x12  basement tunnel to the river gate
Each is validated at import: sealed border, uniform rows, key tiles on
walkable floor, and every walkable cell connected to the start.
"""

from collections import deque

from missions.m5.meta import (
    M5_SOLID_CHARS, M5_WALKABLE_TILES,
    QUARTER_W, QUARTER_H, QUARTER_START_TILE, PRINTWORKS_DOOR_TILE,
    QUARTER_TRAM_TILES, QUARTER_CHECKPOINTS, QUARTER_GUARDS,
    PRINT_W, PRINT_H, PRINT_START_TILE, MARU_TILE, BASEMENT_STAIR_TILE,
    RAID_INSERTION_TILES,
    TUNNEL_W, TUNNEL_H, TUNNEL_START_TILE, TUNNEL_MARU_START_TILE,
    RIVER_GATE_TILE, TUNNEL_PURSUIT_TILES,
    HQ_W, HQ_H, HQ_START_TILE, VASILE_TILE, VASILE_DESK_FRONT_TILE, HQ_NPCS,
)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Grid helpers (M4 procedural idiom, ported - not imported)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _blank(w, h, fill="C"):
    return [[fill for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]


def _paint(g, x, y, tw, th, tile):
    h = len(g)
    w = len(g[0])
    for row in range(y, y + th):
        for col in range(x, x + tw):
            if 0 <= col < w and 0 <= row < h:
                g[row][col] = tile


def _seal_border(g):
    h = len(g)
    w = len(g[0])
    for x in range(w):
        g[0][x] = "C"
        g[h - 1][x] = "C"
    for y in range(h):
        g[y][0] = "C"
        g[y][w - 1] = "C"


def _validate(g, name, key_tiles, start):
    """Sealed border, uniform rows, walkable keys, full connectivity."""
    h = len(g)
    w = len(g[0])
    assert all(len(row) == w for row in g), name + ": row width mismatch"
    for x in range(w):
        assert g[0][x] in M5_SOLID_CHARS and g[h - 1][x] in M5_SOLID_CHARS, \
            name + ": border not sealed (rows)"
    for y in range(h):
        assert g[y][0] in M5_SOLID_CHARS and g[y][w - 1] in M5_SOLID_CHARS, \
            name + ": border not sealed (cols)"
    for key, (cx, cy) in key_tiles.items():
        assert 0 < cx < w - 1 and 0 < cy < h - 1, \
            "{}: key {} out of bounds".format(name, key)
        assert g[cy][cx] in M5_WALKABLE_TILES, \
            "{}: key {} on solid {!r}".format(name, key, g[cy][cx])
    reached = {start}
    todo = deque([start])
    while todo:
        x, y = todo.popleft()
        for nx, ny in ((x - 1, y), (x + 1, y), (x, y - 1), (x, y + 1)):
            if (nx, ny) in reached or not (0 <= nx < w and 0 <= ny < h):
                continue
            if g[ny][nx] in M5_SOLID_CHARS:
                continue
            reached.add((nx, ny))
            todo.append((nx, ny))
    loose = [(x, y) for y in range(h) for x in range(w)
             if g[y][x] not in M5_SOLID_CHARS and (x, y) not in reached]
    if loose:
        raise ValueError("{}: disconnected floor {}".format(name, loose[:8]))


def _stamp(g, marks):
    for (x, y), ch in marks:
        g[y][x] = ch


def _bake(g):
    return ["".join(row) for row in g]


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Guard HQ (30x16) - walking sim, no spawns but P
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _generate_hq_map():
    w, h = HQ_W, HQ_H
    g = _blank(w, h, "C")
    _paint(g, 1, 9, 8, 6, "F")       # locker hall (entry, south-west)
    _paint(g, 9, 10, 15, 3, "L")     # main corridor
    _paint(g, 10, 2, 9, 6, "O")      # briefing room (north)
    _paint(g, 20, 2, 8, 6, "O")      # Commander's office (north-east)
    _paint(g, 24, 10, 4, 4, "O")     # armory (east)
    _paint(g, 13, 8, 2, 2, "D")      # corridor -> briefing
    _paint(g, 22, 8, 2, 2, "D")      # corridor -> office
    for x in (11, 13, 15, 17):       # briefing benches
        g[4][x] = "B"
    _paint(g, 23, 3, 3, 1, "B")      # Vasile's desk (the flag stands on it)
    _paint(g, 26, 13, 1, 1, "B")     # armory rack
    _seal_border(g)
    keys = {"start": HQ_START_TILE, "vasile": VASILE_TILE,
            "desk_front": VASILE_DESK_FRONT_TILE}
    for i, (c, r, _n, _a, _l) in enumerate(HQ_NPCS):
        keys["npc%d" % i] = (c, r)
    _validate(g, "m5 hq", keys, HQ_START_TILE)
    _stamp(g, [(HQ_START_TILE, "P")])
    return _bake(g)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Lower Quarter (40x30)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Streets carved out of a solid block field. Main avenue rows 13-17
# (sidewalk 13/17, asphalt 14-16) runs depot (west) -> print works (east).
_Q_V_LANES = ((3, 4), (12, 13), (22, 23), (31, 32))
_Q_H_LANES = ((4, 5), (24, 25))
_Q_AVENUE = (14, 15, 16)


def _generate_quarter_map():
    w, h = QUARTER_W, QUARTER_H
    g = _blank(w, h, "C")
    # Cross streets (asphalt) with sidewalk edges.
    for a, b in _Q_V_LANES:
        _paint(g, a - 1, 2, b - a + 3, h - 4, "d")
        _paint(g, a, 2, b - a + 1, h - 4, ".")
    for a, b in _Q_H_LANES:
        _paint(g, 2, a - 1, 31, b - a + 3, "d")
        _paint(g, 2, a, 31, b - a + 1, ".")
        for va, vb in _Q_V_LANES:          # keep junctions asphalt
            _paint(g, va, a, vb - va + 1, b - a + 1, ".")
    # Main avenue, depot yard to the print-works door.
    _paint(g, 1, 13, 33, 5, "d")
    _paint(g, 1, 14, 33, 3, ".")
    for va, vb in _Q_V_LANES:
        _paint(g, va, 13, vb - va + 1, 5, ".")
    # Depot yard (west, the start) - foyer floor.
    _paint(g, 1, 12, 3, 7, "F")
    # Checkpoints: barricade across the avenue leaving one gap row.
    for cp in QUARTER_CHECKPOINTS:
        for row in _Q_AVENUE:
            if row != cp["gap_row"]:
                g[row][cp["col"]] = "B"
    # Burning tram wreck.
    for x, y in QUARTER_TRAM_TILES:
        g[y][x] = "B"
    # Print-works block (solid) with the door gap in its west face.
    _paint(g, 34, 10, 5, 11, "C")
    dx, dy = PRINTWORKS_DOOR_TILE
    g[dy][dx] = "D"
    _seal_border(g)
    keys = {"start": QUARTER_START_TILE, "door": PRINTWORKS_DOOR_TILE}
    for i, (c, r, _k, _p) in enumerate(QUARTER_GUARDS):
        keys["guard%d" % i] = (c, r)
    _validate(g, "m5 quarter", keys, QUARTER_START_TILE)
    marks = [(QUARTER_START_TILE, "P")]
    marks += [((c, r), "M" if k == "marksman" else "E")
              for c, r, k, _p in QUARTER_GUARDS]
    _stamp(g, marks)
    return _bake(g)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Print works (26x20)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _generate_print_map():
    w, h = PRINT_W, PRINT_H
    g = _blank(w, h, "C")
    _paint(g, 1, 15, 8, 4, "F")      # front shop (entry, south-west)
    _paint(g, 1, 7, 15, 7, "O")      # press hall (west/centre)
    _paint(g, 17, 2, 7, 6, "O")      # Maru's back office (north-east)
    _paint(g, 1, 2, 14, 4, "O")      # paper store (north-west)
    _paint(g, 17, 9, 8, 4, "O")      # loading bay (east)
    _paint(g, 10, 15, 14, 4, "L")    # basement corridor (south)
    # Connections (2-wide door gaps).
    _paint(g, 3, 14, 2, 1, "D")      # shop -> press hall
    _paint(g, 6, 6, 2, 1, "D")       # press hall -> paper store
    _paint(g, 15, 3, 2, 1, "D")      # paper store -> office
    _paint(g, 16, 10, 1, 2, "D")     # press hall -> loading bay
    _paint(g, 19, 8, 2, 1, "D")      # loading bay -> office
    _paint(g, 9, 16, 1, 2, "D")      # shop -> corridor
    _paint(g, 20, 13, 2, 2, "D")     # loading bay -> corridor
    _paint(g, 12, 14, 2, 1, "D")     # press hall -> corridor
    # Presses (solid cover islands) and paper stacks.
    for x, y in ((3, 8), (7, 8), (11, 8), (3, 11), (7, 11), (11, 11)):
        _paint(g, x, y, 2, 1, "H")
    for x, y in ((3, 3), (8, 3), (12, 4)):
        _paint(g, x, y, 1, 2, "B")
    _paint(g, 19, 5, 2, 1, "B")      # office desk
    _paint(g, 15, 17, 2, 1, "B")     # crates in the corridor
    # Raid insertion doors punched into the outer wall.
    for x, y in RAID_INSERTION_TILES:
        if x == 0 or x == w - 1 or y == 0 or y == h - 1:
            continue
        g[y][x] = "I"
    sx, sy = BASEMENT_STAIR_TILE
    g[sy][sx] = "S"
    _seal_border(g)
    keys = {"start": PRINT_START_TILE, "maru": MARU_TILE,
            "stair": BASEMENT_STAIR_TILE}
    for i, t in enumerate(RAID_INSERTION_TILES):
        keys["insert%d" % i] = t
    _validate(g, "m5 printworks", keys, PRINT_START_TILE)
    _stamp(g, [(PRINT_START_TILE, "P"), (MARU_TILE, "N")])
    return _bake(g)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Tunnel (48x12)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _generate_tunnel_map():
    w, h = TUNNEL_W, TUNNEL_H
    g = _blank(w, h, "C")
    _paint(g, 1, 4, 10, 4, "L")      # basement landing
    _paint(g, 10, 2, 4, 8, "L")      # first bend (wide)
    _paint(g, 13, 2, 12, 3, "L")     # upper run
    _paint(g, 13, 7, 12, 3, "L")     # lower run (parallel - flanking)
    _paint(g, 24, 2, 4, 8, "L")      # junction
    _paint(g, 27, 4, 12, 4, "W")     # flooded section (slow, walkable)
    _paint(g, 38, 3, 9, 6, "L")      # river chamber
    # Pillars / debris (cover, never sealing).
    for x, y in ((6, 4), (17, 3), (20, 8), (31, 5), (35, 6), (41, 4), (41, 7)):
        g[y][x] = "B"
    _seal_border(g)
    keys = {"start": TUNNEL_START_TILE, "maru": TUNNEL_MARU_START_TILE,
            "gate": RIVER_GATE_TILE}
    for i, t in enumerate(TUNNEL_PURSUIT_TILES):
        keys["pursuit%d" % i] = t
    _validate(g, "m5 tunnel", keys, TUNNEL_START_TILE)
    _stamp(g, [(TUNNEL_START_TILE, "P"), (TUNNEL_MARU_START_TILE, "N"),
               (RIVER_GATE_TILE, "G")])
    return _bake(g)

    """(w, h) in tiles of the currently-bound MISSION5_MAP."""
    grid = MISSION5_MAP
    h = len(grid)
    return (len(grid[0]) if h else 0), h

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\missions\m5\quarter.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""quarter.py - Lower Quarter systems (round 2): turns 'run and gun' into a run
with choices.

    init()            after _build_quarter_world (flow._enter_quarter)
    update()          every frame in the QUARTER stage (flow._update_stage)
    on_exit()         entering the Print Works: convoy result radio
    draw_world(...)   searchlight cone, detained civilian (after enemies)
    draw_hud(s)       convoy bar

Systems
  * Convoy clock: the Guard convoy reaches the Print Works in
    M5_CONVOY_FRAMES. Every shot fired is noise: +45 frames and +1 heat.
    If the convoy arrives first, a Guard squad dismounts at the door.
  * Heat (0-100, 5 pips of 20): being SPOTTED (+14), shots a guard can see
    (+3, unseen +1), kills (+6) and the searchlight (+12) raise it; it cools
    off (to a floor) while no guard is hunting you. Heat 40 / 80 sends a
    hunter team to your LAST KNOWN position - not to where you are now.
  * Darkness: guards' sight range scales with how lit Biribel is (street
    lamps, the burning tram, the searchlight, his own muzzle flash). In the
    dark between lamps he is hard to see; the HUD chip says HIDDEN/EXPOSED/
    SPOTTED so the rule is readable.
  * Searchlight at the depot gate sweeps the avenue; being lit alerts
    nearby troopers.
  * Old faces: Kovac and Sandu (east checkpoint) are ex-KRAP. They let
    Biribel walk by - unless he's been killing Guardsmen, or shoots near them.
  * Detained civilian at the south marksman: clear the guards around him
    and he runs; walk past and Vasile notices.
"""
import math
import random
from engine.core import LEGACY_RNG as _rng_legacy  # RPE5 R6: named 'legacy' rng stream

import pygame

from core.config import *
from core.state import STATE

from missions.m5.meta import C_SYSTEM, C_VASILE, C_GUARD, STAGE_QUARTER
from missions.m5.world import (_radio, _sfx, _spawn_m5_guard, _arm_hunt, _tile_world,
                               _tile_walkable, _solid_walls)

T = TILE_SIZE
M5_CONVOY_FRAMES = 12600         # 3.5 min at 60 fps (was 2.5 - too punishing)
SHOT_CONVOY_COST = 20
HEAT_WAVES = (40, 80)            # heat (0-100) that sends hunter teams
HEAT_SPOTTED, HEAT_SHOT_SEEN, HEAT_SHOT, HEAT_KILL, HEAT_LIGHT = 14, 3, 1, 6, 12
HEAT_DECAY = 0.04                # per frame while nobody hunts (2.4 / s)
VIS_DARK = 0.4                   # sight scale in full dark (1.0 = lit)
AWARE_SIGHT = 0.55               # alerted guards' x3 range was map-wide
SEARCH_ORIGIN = (int(9.5 * T), int(13.3 * T))
SEARCH_LEN = 6 * T
SEARCH_HALF = 0.12
OLD_FACES = {"q_31_15": "KOVAC", "q_31_13": "SANDU"}
PATROLS = {
    "q_13_5": [(13, 5), (22, 5), (22, 10), (22, 5), (13, 5), (13, 10)],
    "q_21_17": [(21, 17), (22, 20), (22, 23), (27, 23), (22, 23)],
    "q_23_24": [(23, 24), (32, 24), (32, 19), (32, 24), (23, 24), (13, 24)],
}
CIV_POS = (int(16.3 * T), int(24.5 * T))

_S = {}           # per-run quarter state (owned here; reset in init())
_sprites = {}


def init():
    _S.clear()
    _S.update(convoy=0, heat=0, waves=0, last_shots=_shots(), flash_prev=0,
              late=False, radio50=False, radio80=False, light_cd=0, lit=False,
              civ="held", civ_x=float(CIV_POS[0]), civ_alpha=255, civ_bark=False,
              civ_walked=False, checks=set(), siren=False, faces_spoken=set(),
              faces_cut=False,
              t=0, kills0=int(getattr(STATE, "m5_guard_kills", 0) or 0),
              vis=VIS_DARK, flash_t=0, spotted=False, last_known=None,
              cool=0)
    STATE.m5_convoy_late = False
    STATE.m5_civ_saved = False
    for e in STATE.enemies:
        e.sight_mul = VIS_DARK          # from the very first frame (no 1-frame x1.0 peek)
        lab = getattr(e, "m5_label", "")
        if lab in OLD_FACES:
            e.m5_passive = True
            e.m5_face = OLD_FACES[lab]
        if lab in PATROLS:
            _apply_patrol(e, PATROLS[lab])


def _apply_patrol(e, tiles):
    pts = [_tile_world(c, r) for c, r in tiles if _tile_walkable(c, r)]
    if len(pts) < 2 or not isinstance(getattr(e, "patrol_points", None), list):
        return
    e.patrol_points = pts
    e.patrol_idx = 0


def _shots():
    return int(getattr(STATE, "shots_fired", 0) or 0)


def _player_c():
    return STATE.player.rect.center if STATE.player is not None else (0, 0)


def _count_shot():
    """Shots fired this frame (stat counter, else muzzle-flash rising edge)."""
    n = _shots()
    d = max(0, n - _S["last_shots"])
    _S["last_shots"] = n
    if d == 0 and not hasattr(STATE, "shots_fired"):
        f = getattr(STATE, "muzzle_flash_timer", 0)
        d = 1 if f > _S["flash_prev"] else 0
        _S["flash_prev"] = f
    return d


def update():
    if not _S or getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) != STAGE_QUARTER or STATE.player is None:
        return
    if getattr(STATE, "m5_dialogue_active", False) or getattr(STATE, "request_m5_cutscene", None) == "old_faces":
        return
    _S["t"] += 1
    px, py = _player_c()
    walls = _solid_walls()
    _update_visibility(px, py)
    shots = _count_shot()
    if shots:
        _S["convoy"] += SHOT_CONVOY_COST * shots
        _S["flash_t"] = 30                       # muzzle flash lights him up
        seen = any(_hunter_sees(e, px, py, walls) for e in _active_guards())
        _add_heat((HEAT_SHOT_SEEN if seen else HEAT_SHOT) * shots, px, py)
        _provoke_faces_by_noise(px, py)
    _update_spotting(px, py, walls)
    kills = int(getattr(STATE, "m5_guard_kills", 0) or 0)
    if kills > _S["kills0"]:
        _add_heat(HEAT_KILL * (kills - _S["kills0"]), px, py)
        _S["kills0"] = kills
    _cool_heat()
    _update_convoy()
    _update_heat(px, py)
    _update_searchlight(px, py)
    _update_faces(px, py)
    if getattr(STATE, "request_m5_cutscene", None):
        return  # cinematic owns the checkpoint beat; no queued barks over it
    _update_civilian(px, py)
    _update_story(px)


def _update_convoy():
    if _S["late"]:
        return
    _S["convoy"] += 1
    frac = _S["convoy"] / M5_CONVOY_FRAMES
    if frac >= 0.5 and not _S["radio50"]:
        _S["radio50"] = True
        _radio("VASILE: Guard convoy just cleared the bridge. Halfway to you. Every shot you "
               "fire, they hear it - and they speed up.", color=C_VASILE, duration=380)
    if frac >= 0.8 and not _S["radio80"]:
        _S["radio80"] = True
        _radio("VASILE: Two streets out. Move, Biribel.", color=C_VASILE, duration=300, priority=1)
    if frac >= 1.0:
        _S["late"] = True
        STATE.m5_convoy_late = True
        _sfx("alarm", 0.3)
        _radio("GUARD RADIO: Convoy on site. Dismount, secure the print works.",
               color=C_GUARD, duration=360)
        for c, r in ((33, 13), (33, 17), (32, 15)):
            if _tile_walkable(c, r):
                _spawn_m5_guard(*_tile_world(c, r), etype="guard", label="convoy", aware=False)


def _far_spawn(px, py):
    best = None
    for c, r in ((3, 4), (12, 4), (22, 4), (31, 4), (3, 25), (12, 25), (22, 25), (31, 25)):
        if not _tile_walkable(c, r):
            continue
        x, y = _tile_world(c, r)
        d = math.hypot(x - px, y - py)
        if d > 700 and (best is None or d < best[0]):
            best = (d, x, y)
    return best


def _active_guards():
    return [e for e in STATE.enemies if e.hp > 0 and not getattr(e, "m5_passive", False)]


def _hunting(e):
    return getattr(e, "state", "") in ("CHASE", "ATTACK")


def _hunter_sees(e, px, py, walls):
    try:
        return e._can_see(px, py, walls)
    except Exception:
        return False


def _add_heat(n, px, py):
    _S["heat"] = min(100.0, _S["heat"] + n)
    _S["last_known"] = (px, py)
    _S["cool"] = 240                              # 4 s before it starts to cool


def _cool_heat():
    if _S["cool"] > 0:
        _S["cool"] -= 1
        return
    if any(_hunting(e) for e in _active_guards()):
        return
    floor = HEAT_WAVES[_S["waves"] - 1] * 0.75 if _S["waves"] else 0.0
    _S["heat"] = max(floor, _S["heat"] - HEAT_DECAY)


def _light_at(px, py):
    """0..1: how lit the player is (lamps / tram fire / searchlight / flash)."""
    if _S["lit"] or _S["flash_t"] > 0:
        return 1.0
    try:
        from missions.m5 import decor as _decor   # lazy: decor is draw-side
        lights = _decor._STAGE_LIGHTS.get(STAGE_QUARTER, ())
    except Exception:
        return 1.0
    best = 0.0
    for lx, ly, r, _col, _kind in lights:
        d = math.hypot(px - lx, py - ly)
        if d < r:
            best = max(best, 1.0 - d / r)
    return min(1.0, best * 1.6)


def _update_visibility(px, py):
    if _S["flash_t"] > 0:
        _S["flash_t"] -= 1
    target = VIS_DARK + (1.0 - VIS_DARK) * _light_at(px, py)
    _S["vis"] += (target - _S["vis"]) * 0.15           # eyes adjust, no popping
    for e in _active_guards():
        aware = e.alerted or getattr(e, "combat_alert_timer", 0) > 0
        e.sight_mul = _S["vis"] * (AWARE_SIGHT if aware else 1.0)


def _update_spotting(px, py, walls):
    """A guard switching to CHASE/ATTACK while he can actually see Biribel
    = SPOTTED: heat, a '!' over him, and the HUD chip turns red."""
    spotted = False
    for e in _active_guards():
        hunting = _hunting(e)
        if hunting and not getattr(e, "m5_hunt_prev", False) and _hunter_sees(e, px, py, walls):
            _add_heat(HEAT_SPOTTED, px, py)
            STATE.floating_texts.append([e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery - 34, "!",
                                         (236, 70, 56), 50])
        e.m5_hunt_prev = hunting
        if hunting and getattr(e, "lost_sight_timer", 99) < 30:
            spotted = True
    _S["spotted"] = spotted


def _investigate(e, pos, spread=None):
    """Send a guard to LOOK at a position (search), not to the live player."""
    spread = T if spread is None else spread
    e.alerted = True
    e.state = "SEARCH"
    e.search_timer = 480
    e.combat_alert_timer = max(getattr(e, "combat_alert_timer", 0), 300)
    e.distraction_target = (pos[0] + _rng_legacy.randint(-spread, spread),
                            pos[1] + _rng_legacy.randint(-spread, spread))
    e.sweep_points = []
    e.path = []
    e.path_timer = 0


def _update_heat(px, py):
    if _S["waves"] >= len(HEAT_WAVES) or _S["heat"] < HEAT_WAVES[_S["waves"]]:
        return
    sp = _far_spawn(px, py)
    if sp is None:
        return
    _S["waves"] += 1
    target = _S["last_known"] or (px, py)
    for k in range(_S["waves"] + 1):     # wave 1 = two guards, wave 2 = three
        e = _spawn_m5_guard(sp[1] + k * 26, sp[2], etype="guard", label="heat", aware=True)
        _investigate(e, target, 2 * T)
    _radio("GUARD RADIO: Shots in the Quarter! Patrol, converge on the avenue."
           if _S["waves"] == 1 else
           "GUARD RADIO: Armed hostile, KRAP uniform. Shoot on sight.",
           color=C_GUARD, duration=320)


def _search_angle():
    return math.pi * 0.0 + 0.75 * math.sin(_S["t"] * 0.011)


def _update_searchlight(px, py):
    if _S["light_cd"] > 0:
        _S["light_cd"] -= 1
    ox, oy = SEARCH_ORIGIN
    dx, dy = px - ox, py - oy
    dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    a = _search_angle()
    diff = (math.atan2(dy, dx) - a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    _S["lit"] = 30 < dist < SEARCH_LEN and abs(diff) < SEARCH_HALF
    if _S["lit"] and _S["light_cd"] == 0:
        _S["light_cd"] = 720
        n = 0
        for e in _active_guards():
            if not _hunting(e) and math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 380:
                _investigate(e, (px, py))      # they come and LOOK - they don't know
                n += 1
        _add_heat(HEAT_LIGHT, px, py)
        _radio("GATE TOWER: Movement on the avenue - light him up!" if n else
               "GATE TOWER: ...thought I saw something.", color=C_GUARD, duration=240)


def _faces():
    return [e for e in STATE.enemies if getattr(e, "m5_face", None) and e.hp > 0]


def _provoke(e, line=None):
    if not getattr(e, "m5_passive", False):
        return
    e.m5_passive = False
    _arm_hunt(e)
    if line:
        _radio(line, color=C_GUARD, duration=300)


def _provoke_faces_by_noise(px, py):
    for e in _faces():
        if math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 450:
            _provoke(e, "%s: You're shooting at OUR people now? Fine!" % e.m5_face)


def _update_faces(px, py):
    kills = int(getattr(STATE, "m5_guard_kills", 0) or 0)
    for e in _faces():
        if not getattr(e, "m5_passive", False):
            continue
        if getattr(e, "m5_hp0", None) is None:
            e.m5_hp0 = e.hp
        if e.hp < e.m5_hp0:
            _provoke(e, "%s: Biribel, you bastard!" % e.m5_face)
            continue
        if hasattr(e, "angle") and math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 300:
            e.angle = math.atan2(py - e.rect.centery, px - e.rect.centerx)
        if math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 230 and kills >= 4:
            _S["faces_spoken"].add(e.m5_face)
            _provoke(e, "%s: Heard the shooting up the avenue. That was you. "
                     "Sorry, Biribel." % e.m5_face)

    # One shared encounter, not two copies of the same radio greeting.
    # Resolve damage/hostility FIRST; never show a friendly dead/provoked actor.
    if _S["faces_cut"] or getattr(STATE, "player_dead", False):
        return
    faces = _faces()
    passive = [e for e in faces if getattr(e, "m5_passive", False)]
    from entities.weapons import _wall_blocks_line  # lazy: collision helper
    walls = _solid_walls()
    near = [e for e in passive if math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 230
            and not _wall_blocks_line(px, py, *e.rect.center, walls)]
    if not near or kills >= 4 or getattr(STATE, "request_m5_cutscene", None):
        return
    if any(_hunting(e) and math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py) < 450
           for e in _active_guards()):
        return  # don't interrupt a firefight with a friendly conversation
    if any(b.get("owner") == "enemy" and math.hypot(b["x"] - px, b["y"] - py) < 450
           for b in STATE.bullets):
        return
    if len(passive) != 2:
        # A surviving friend gets a truthful, unique line, never the two-person take.
        for e in near:
            if e.m5_face not in _S["faces_spoken"]:
                _S["faces_spoken"].add(e.m5_face)
                _radio("%s: Keep moving, Biribel. I can't cover you for long." % e.m5_face,
                       color=(170, 190, 210), duration=300,
                       mark="old_face_" + e.m5_face)
        return
    _S["faces_cut"] = True
    _S["faces_spoken"].update(OLD_FACES.values())
    _S["checks"].add("east")
    from missions.m5 import flow  # lazy: flow loads after quarter
    flow._request_cut("old_faces")


def _update_civilian(px, py):
    st = _S["civ"]
    if st == "held":
        d = math.hypot(px - CIV_POS[0], py - CIV_POS[1])
        if d < 380 and not _S["civ_bark"]:
            _S["civ_bark"] = True
            _radio("DETAINED MAN: I only carried the paper! I don't even read it!",
                   color=(220, 210, 190), duration=300)
        guards_near = any(e.hp > 0 and math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - CIV_POS[0],
                                                  e.rect.centery - CIV_POS[1]) < 260
                          for e in STATE.enemies)
        if not guards_near and d < 300:
            _S["civ"] = "run"
            STATE.m5_civ_saved = True
            _radio("DETAINED MAN: God keep you, soldier. I'm gone - I was never here.",
                   color=(220, 210, 190), duration=320)
        elif px > 27 * T and not _S["civ_walked"]:
            _S["civ_walked"] = True
            _radio("VASILE: They've got a man on his knees by the south lane. ...Keep walking. "
                   "Or don't. Your call.", color=C_VASILE, duration=380)
    elif st == "run":
        _S["civ_x"] -= 2.6
        _S["civ_alpha"] -= 2
        if _S["civ_alpha"] <= 0:
            _S["civ"] = "gone"


def _update_story(px):
    if not _S["siren"] and _S["t"] > 240:
        _S["siren"] = True
        _sfx("alarm", 0.25)
        _radio("LOUDSPEAKER: Curfew is in effect. Citizens found outdoors will be detained. "
               "Report MAG distributors to the Guard.", color=C_SYSTEM, duration=380)
    if px > 15 * T and "mid" not in _S["checks"]:
        _S["checks"].add("mid")
        _radio("VASILE: Tram junction. The shop TV's still running the President. "
               "Don't stop to watch.", color=C_VASILE, duration=320)
    if px > 27 * T and "east" not in _S["checks"]:
        _S["checks"].add("east")
        _radio("VASILE: East checkpoint - that's Kovac and Sandu. Ours, until Monday. "
               "Don't make them choose.", color=C_VASILE, duration=380)


def on_exit():
    if not _S:
        return
    if _S["late"]:
        _radio("VASILE: The convoy beat you. They're already at the doors - find Maru, fast.",
               color=C_VASILE, duration=320)
    else:
        _radio("VASILE: You beat the convoy. Small mercy. Use it.", color=C_VASILE, duration=300)


# ── drawing ──
def _civ_sprite():
    if "civ" not in _sprites:
        s = pygame.Surface((80, 110), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        try:
            from cutscenes import figure_kit  # lazy: heavy cutscene module
            figure_kit.draw_character(s, "civilian", 40, 104, 1.0, False)
        except Exception:
            pygame.draw.circle(s, (200, 170, 140), (40, 30), 10)
            pygame.draw.rect(s, (90, 80, 70), (30, 40, 20, 40))
        _sprites["civ"] = pygame.transform.smoothscale(s, (40, 55))
    return _sprites["civ"]


def draw_world(surface, cam_x, cam_y):
    if not _S or getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) != STAGE_QUARTER:
        return
    # searchlight cone
    ox, oy = SEARCH_ORIGIN[0] - cam_x, SEARCH_ORIGIN[1] - cam_y
    a = _search_angle()
    pts = [(ox, oy)] + [(ox + math.cos(a + k) * SEARCH_LEN, oy + math.sin(a + k) * SEARCH_LEN)
                        for k in (-SEARCH_HALF, -SEARCH_HALF / 2, 0, SEARCH_HALF / 2, SEARCH_HALF)]
    cone = pygame.Surface(surface.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.polygon(cone, (255, 250, 220, 70 if not _S["lit"] else 110), pts)
    surface.blit(cone, (0, 0))
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (255, 250, 230), (int(ox), int(oy)), 7)
    # detained civilian
    if _S["civ"] != "gone":
        spr = _civ_sprite()
        x, y = int(_S["civ_x"]) - cam_x, CIV_POS[1] - cam_y
        if _S["civ"] == "held":
            spr = pygame.transform.smoothscale(spr, (40, 40))  # kneeling
            pygame.draw.ellipse(surface, (0, 0, 0), (x - 16, y + 12, 32, 10))
            surface.blit(spr, (x - 20, y - 24))
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (200, 200, 210), (x - 6, y - 4), (x + 6, y - 4), 2)  # zip-tie
        else:
            spr = spr.copy()
            spr.set_alpha(max(0, _S["civ_alpha"]))
            surface.blit(spr, (x - 20, y - 40))


def draw_hud(surface, plate=None):
    """Convoy clock + heat pips. Drawn by m5.draw._draw_hud in the HUD pass
    (after vignette/scanlines) through its shared status-plate helper, so it
    sits in the free top strip instead of hiding under the minimap."""
    if not _S or getattr(STATE, "mission5_stage", None) != STAGE_QUARTER or plate is None:
        return
    frac = min(1.0, _S["convoy"] / M5_CONVOY_FRAMES)
    if _S["late"]:
        title, tcol, fcol, right = "GUARD CONVOY ON SITE", (236, 96, 80), (220, 60, 50), "NOW"
    else:
        secs = max(0, int((M5_CONVOY_FRAMES - _S["convoy"]) // 60))
        warn = frac > 0.7
        title = "GUARD CONVOY INBOUND"
        tcol = (236, 180, 90) if warn else (200, 210, 224)
        fcol = (230, 170, 60) if warn else (120, 220, 170)
        right = "{:d}:{:02d}".format(secs // 60, secs % 60)
    plate(surface, title, tcol, frac, fcol, right,
          pips=min(5.0, _S["heat"] / 20.0), pips_max=5)
    # Visibility chip under the HOSTILES box: the stealth rule, made readable.
    if _S["spotted"]:
        txt, col = "SPOTTED", (236, 80, 64)
    elif _S["vis"] > 0.7:
        txt, col = "EXPOSED - IN LIGHT", (232, 184, 96)
    else:
        txt, col = "HIDDEN - IN SHADOW", (140, 178, 160)
    chip = pygame.Surface((180, 22), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    pygame.draw.rect(chip, (0, 0, 0, 120), chip.get_rect())
    surface.blit(chip, (20, 50))
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, col, (32, 61), 5)
    if txt != "SPOTTED":
        pygame.draw.circle(surface, (10, 12, 14), (32, 61), 2)
    surface.blit(font_terminal_small.render(txt, True, col), (44, 52))
