"""Read-only KRAPNET presentation. No sockets, timers or session mutations.

The arena schematic is derived from the existing authoritative tile strings;
this module never changes maps, teams, capacity or protocol data.
"""
import pygame
from missions import arena as AR

BG = (7, 12, 15)
PLATE = (14, 21, 24)
EDGE = (48, 64, 66)
ACCENT = (232, 166, 82)
TEXT = (225, 229, 216)
DIM = (148, 162, 157)
GREEN = (155, 194, 134)


def text(ui, surface, x, y, label, size=12, color=DIM, bold=False):
    ui._blit(surface, x, label, y, size, color, mono=True, bold=bold)


def fitted(ui, surface, rect, label, size=12, color=DIM, bold=False):
    label = ui._clip(label, ui._font(size, bold, True), rect.w)
    text(ui, surface, rect.x, rect.y, label, size, color, bold)


def background(surface):
    surface.fill(BG)
    w, h = surface.get_size()
    for x in range(0, w, 40):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (12, 21, 24), (x, 0), (x, h))
    for y in range(0, h, 40):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (12, 21, 24), (0, y), (w, y))


def frame(ui, surface, panel, title, subtitle, state):
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (2, 5, 7), panel.move(5, 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATE, panel)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, panel, 1)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, ACCENT, (panel.x, panel.y, 5, 88))
    x = panel.x + 24
    text(ui, surface, x, panel.y + 17, 'KRAPNET / OPERATIONS TERMINAL', 11, ACCENT, True)
    text(ui, surface, x, panel.y + 38, title, 30, TEXT, True)
    text(ui, surface, x, panel.y + 78, subtitle, 12)
    r = pygame.Rect(panel.right - 194, panel.y + 22, 170, 30)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (24, 34, 30), r)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, r, 1)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, GREEN, (r.x + 14, r.centery), 3)
    text(ui, surface, r.x + 26, r.y + 8, state, 11, GREEN, True)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, EDGE, (x, panel.y + 104), (panel.right - 24, panel.y + 104))
    # Registration marks, not decoration over content.
    for cx, cy, dx, dy in ((panel.x, panel.y, 1, 1), (panel.right - 1, panel.y, -1, 1),
                           (panel.x, panel.bottom - 1, 1, -1), (panel.right - 1, panel.bottom - 1, -1, -1)):
        pygame.draw.line(surface, ACCENT, (cx, cy), (cx + dx * 10, cy))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, ACCENT, (cx, cy), (cx, cy + dy * 10))


def section(ui, surface, x, y, label, width):
    text(ui, surface, x, y, label, 11, DIM, True)
    tw = ui._font(11, True, True).size(label)[0]
    pygame.draw.line(surface, EDGE, (x + tw + 12, y + 6), (x + width, y + 6))


def card(surface, rect):
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (9, 16, 19), rect)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, rect, 1)


def preview(ui, surface, rect, name):
    """A cached, accurate, north-up arena survey with real spawn/pickup tiles."""
    key = (name, rect.size)
    cache = getattr(ui, '_survey_cache', None)
    if cache is None or cache[0] != key:
        image = pygame.Surface(rect.size)
        image.fill((9, 18, 21))
        for gx in range(0, rect.w, 20):
            pygame.draw.line(image, (18, 32, 35), (gx, 0), (gx, rect.h))
        for gy in range(0, rect.h, 20):
            pygame.draw.line(image, (18, 32, 35), (0, gy), (rect.w, gy))
        rows = AR.ARENAS.get(name, AR.ARENAS['yard'])
        cols = max(map(len, rows))
        cell = max(1, min((rect.w - 140) // cols, (rect.h - 44) // len(rows)))
        ox, oy = (rect.w - cols * cell) // 2, (rect.h - len(rows) * cell) // 2
        for row, line in enumerate(rows):
            for col, tile in enumerate(line):
                r = pygame.Rect(ox + col * cell, oy + row * cell, cell, cell)
                if tile == '#':
                    pygame.draw.rect(image, (67, 88, 84), r.inflate(-1, -1))
                    pygame.draw.line(image, (113, 134, 120), r.topleft, (r.right - 2, r.top))
                elif tile == '+':
                    pygame.draw.rect(image, ACCENT, r.inflate(-2, -2), 1)
                else:
                    pygame.draw.rect(image, (22, 39, 40), r.inflate(-1, -1))
                    if tile in '12345678':
                        pygame.draw.circle(image, GREEN, r.center, max(2, cell // 3), 1)
                    elif tile in 'RBWM':
                        pygame.draw.rect(image, ACCENT, pygame.Rect(r.centerx - 1, r.centery - 1, 3, 3))
        # Survey ticks and a north indicator.
        for xx in range(16, rect.w - 16, 20):
            pygame.draw.line(image, EDGE, (xx, 0), (xx, 4))
            pygame.draw.line(image, EDGE, (xx, rect.h - 5), (xx, rect.h - 1))
        ui._survey_cache = (key, image)
    surface.blit(ui._survey_cache[1], rect)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, rect, 1)
    text(ui, surface, rect.x + 12, rect.y + 12, 'SURVEY / ' + name.upper(), 11, ACCENT, True)
    text(ui, surface, rect.right - 30, rect.y + 12, 'N', 12, TEXT, True)
    pygame.draw.line(surface, DIM, (rect.right - 26, rect.y + 34), (rect.right - 26, rect.y + 50))
    pygame.draw.lines(surface, DIM, False, [(rect.right - 30, rect.y + 40), (rect.right - 26, rect.y + 34), (rect.right - 22, rect.y + 40)])
    text(ui, surface, rect.x + 12, rect.bottom - 20, 'O SPAWN   /   + SUPPLY', 10)
    text(ui, surface, rect.right - 117, rect.bottom - 20, '%02d x %02d TILES' % (len(AR.ARENAS[name][0]), len(AR.ARENAS[name])), 10)


def draw_entry(ui, surface, panel):
    background(surface)
    frame(ui, surface, panel, 'MULTIPLAYER', 'ARENA OPERATIONS  /  HOST OR JOIN A PRIVATE MATCH', 'SESSION SETUP')
    ui._map_rects, ui._pl_rects, ui._mode_rects, ui._btn_rects = {}, {}, {}, {}
    x, y, left = panel.x + 24, panel.y + 122, 540
    rx, rw = x + left + 24, 328
    section(ui, surface, x, y, '01 / SELECT THEATRE', left)
    preview(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(x, y + 24, left, 210), ui.map_name)
    for i, name in enumerate(ui.maps()):
        r = pygame.Rect(x + i * 184, y + 246, 172, 36)
        ui._row(surface, r, '%s / %dP' % (name.upper(), AR.max_players(name)), name == ui.map_name)
        ui._map_rects[i] = r
    section(ui, surface, x, y + 300, '02 / RULES OF ENGAGEMENT', left)
    for i, (mode, label) in enumerate(((AR.MODE_TDM, 'TEAM DEATHMATCH'), (AR.MODE_FFA, 'FREE-FOR-ALL'))):
        r = pygame.Rect(x + i * 276, y + 324, 264, 40)
        ui._row(surface, r, label, ui.mode_name == mode)
        ui._mode_rects[i] = r
    section(ui, surface, x, y + 388, '03 / ROOM CAPACITY', left)
    cap = ui.max_players()
    cw = (left - (cap - 2) * 8) // (cap - 1)
    for i in range(2, cap + 1):
        r = pygame.Rect(x + (i - 2) * (cw + 8), y + 412, cw, 36)
        ui._row(surface, r, str(i), i == ui.players)
        ui._pl_rects[i] = r

    section(ui, surface, rx, y, 'OPERATOR / CALLSIGN', rw)
    ui._draw_name_box(surface, pygame.Rect(rx, y + 24, rw, 42))
    host_card = pygame.Rect(rx, y + 90, rw, 132)
    card(surface, host_card)
    text(ui, surface, rx + 14, y + 104, 'CREATE A ROOM', 18, TEXT, True)
    text(ui, surface, rx + 14, y + 134, 'Host. Share the code. Start when ready.', 12)
    hr = pygame.Rect(rx + 14, y + 164, rw - 28, 44)
    ui._action(surface, hr, 'HOST MATCH', True)
    ui._btn_rects[1] = hr
    join_card = pygame.Rect(rx, y + 246, rw, 194)
    card(surface, join_card)
    text(ui, surface, rx + 14, y + 260, 'JOIN AN OPERATION', 18, TEXT, True)
    text(ui, surface, rx + 14, y + 290, 'Paste the entire code, including @TOKEN.', 12)
    ui._draw_addr_box(surface, pygame.Rect(rx + 14, y + 316, rw - 28, 42))
    jr = pygame.Rect(rx + 14, y + 382, rw - 28, 44)
    ui._action(surface, jr, 'JOIN MATCH', False)
    ui._btn_rects[2] = jr
    text(ui, surface, rx, y + 452, 'HOST SETTINGS APPLY TO NEW ROOMS ONLY', 10)
    fy = panel.bottom - 52
    pygame.draw.line(surface, EDGE, (x, fy), (panel.right - 24, fy))
    br = pygame.Rect(x, fy + 10, 150, 32)
    ui._back(surface, br)
    ui._btn_rects[3] = br
    if ui.status:
        label, color = ui.status, ACCENT
        if any(word in label.lower() for word in ('could not', 'closed', 'invalid', 'failed')):
            color = (247, 130, 110)
    else:
        label, color = 'TAB / SWITCH FIELD    ENTER / JOIN    ESC / BACK', DIM
    fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(br.right + 24, fy + 20, panel.right - br.right - 48, 18), label, 12, color)


def draw_lobby(ui, surface, panel):
    background(surface)
    host = ui.mode == 'hosting'
    roster = ui._lobby_roster() if host else (ui._match_state or {}).get('roster', [])
    roster = list(roster or [])[:8]
    cap = ui.players if host else (ui._match_state or {}).get('room_capacity', 8)
    cap = max(2, min(8, int(cap or 8)))
    count = len(roster)
    frame(ui, surface, panel, 'MATCH LOBBY', '%s  /  %s  /  FIRST TO 15' % (ui.map_name.upper(), 'TEAM DEATHMATCH' if ui._team_play() else 'FREE-FOR-ALL'), 'HOST CONTROL' if host else 'WAITING FOR HOST')
    # These are presentation-only click targets; event dispatch stays in the owner.
    ui._wait_rects, ui._lobby_rects = {}, {}
    x, y, lw = panel.x + 24, panel.y + 122, 540
    rx, rw = x + lw + 24, 328
    section(ui, surface, x, y, 'THEATRE / ' + ui.map_name.upper(), lw)
    preview(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(x, y + 24, lw, 194), ui.map_name)
    box = pygame.Rect(x, y + 236, lw, 104)
    card(surface, box)
    text(ui, surface, x + 16, box.y + 14, 'INVITE / ROOM CODE' if host else 'ROOM / CONNECTION STATUS', 11, ACCENT, True)
    if host:
        ready = ui.room_code_ready()
        label = ui.share_code() if ready else 'ESTABLISHING CONNECTION...'
        fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(x + 16, box.y + 37, lw - 32, 26), label, 21 if ready else 15, TEXT if ready else DIM, True)
        text(ui, surface, x + 16, box.y + 78, 'Share the full code. Friends paste it into JOIN MATCH.', 12)
    else:
        text(ui, surface, x + 16, box.y + 38, 'CONNECTED / AWAITING HOST', 21, GREEN, True)
        text(ui, surface, x + 16, box.y + 78, 'Choose a side. The host controls match deployment.', 12)
    if host:
        ready = ui.room_code_ready()
        copy = pygame.Rect(x, y + 358, 190, 44)
        ui._action(surface, copy, 'COPY CODE' if ready else 'CHECKING...', ready)
        if ready:
            ui._wait_rects['copy'] = copy
        reason = ui._unstartable_reason()
        can_start = count >= 2 and reason is None
        start = pygame.Rect(x + 206, y + 358, 334, 44)
        label = 'NEED 2+ PLAYERS' if count < 2 else (reason or 'START MATCH')
        ui._action(surface, start, label, can_start)
        if can_start:
            ui._lobby_rects['start'] = start
        note, color = ui._forward_status()
        # Two measured lines, not an unbounded status string.
        font = ui._font(12, False, True)
        words, line, lines = note.split(), '', []
        for word in words:
            candidate = (line + ' ' + word).strip()
            if font.size(candidate)[0] > lw and line:
                lines.append(line)
                line = word
            else:
                line = candidate
        lines.append(line)
        for i, line in enumerate(lines[:2]):
            fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(x, y + 418 + i * 18, lw, 18), line, 12, color)
    else:
        card(surface, pygame.Rect(x, y + 358, lw, 44))
        text(ui, surface, x + 16, y + 374, 'STANDBY / THE HOST WILL START WHEN EVERYONE IS IN', 12, DIM, True)
    section(ui, surface, rx, y, 'OPERATORS / %02d OF %02d' % (count, cap), rw)
    board = pygame.Rect(rx, y + 24, rw, 392)
    if ui._team_play():
        ui._draw_team_board(surface, board, roster, ui._teams_table(), ui._local_slot(), host)
    else:
        card(surface, board)
        text(ui, surface, board.x + 12, board.y + 14, 'FREE-FOR-ALL / NO ALLIANCES', 11, ACCENT, True)
        for slot in range(cap):
            r = pygame.Rect(board.x + 12, board.y + 46 + slot * 40, board.w - 24, 34)
            card(surface, r)
            if slot < count:
                try:
                    pid, name = int(roster[slot][0]), str(roster[slot][1])
                except (ValueError, TypeError, IndexError):
                    pid, name = slot, 'OPERATOR'
                mine = pid == ui._local_slot()
                label = ('YOU / ' if mine else '') + name
                color = TEXT if mine else GREEN
            else:
                label, color = 'OPEN SLOT / AWAITING OPERATOR', DIM
            fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(r.x + 10, r.y + 10, r.w - 20, 18), label, 12, color)
    text(ui, surface, rx, y + 440, 'SIMULATION HELD UNTIL HOST STARTS', 11)
    fy = panel.bottom - 52
    pygame.draw.line(surface, EDGE, (x, fy), (panel.right - 24, fy))
    text(ui, surface, x, fy + 21, 'ESC / MATCH OPTIONS', 12, TEXT, True)
    fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(x + 230, fy + 21, panel.w - 278, 18), ui.status or ('HOST / INVITE YOUR SQUAD' if host else 'CONNECTED / WAITING FOR DEPLOYMENT'), 12)


def draw_teams(ui, surface, board, roster, teams, my_slot, host):
    names = {}
    for row in roster:
        try:
            names[int(row[0])] = str(row[1])
        except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
            continue
    # Balance gets its own row, never laid over a team header.
    header_h = 42 if host else 8
    if host:
        b = pygame.Rect(board.x, board.y, board.w, 32)
        ui._row(surface, b, 'AUTO-BALANCE TEAMS', False)
        ui._lobby_rects['balance'] = b
    col_w = (board.w - 8) // 2
    for index, team in enumerate((AR.TEAM_IPA, AR.TEAM_KRAP)):
        col = pygame.Rect(board.x + index * (col_w + 8), board.y + header_h, col_w, board.h - header_h)
        tint = (232, 166, 82) if team == AR.TEAM_IPA else (131, 191, 200)
        here = teams.get(my_slot) == team
        members = sorted(pid for pid in teams if teams[pid] == team)
        card(surface, col)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, tint if here else EDGE, col, 2 if here else 1)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, tint, (col.x, col.y, col.w, 3))
        text(ui, surface, col.x + 10, col.y + 14, '%s / %02d' % (AR.TEAM_NAMES[team], len(members)), 13, tint, True)
        # All eight members fit even for a deliberately unbalanced team.
        capacity = ui.players if host else (ui._match_state or {}).get('room_capacity', 8)
        empty_slots = min(4, (max(2, min(8, int(capacity or 8))) + 1) // 2)
        for i in range(max(len(members), empty_slots)):
            yy = col.y + 44 + i * 32
            if yy + 30 > col.bottom - 32:
                break
            if i < len(members):
                pid = members[i]
                mine = pid == my_slot
                available = col.w - 20 - (44 if host and not mine else 0)
                label = ('> ' if mine else '') + names.get(pid, 'OPERATOR')
                fitted(ui, surface, pygame.Rect(col.x + 10, yy + 4, available, 18), label, 12, TEXT if mine else tint, mine)
                if host and not mine:
                    move = pygame.Rect(col.right - 48, yy, 40, 24)
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (27, 40, 43), move)
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, move, 1)
                    text(ui, surface, move.x + 5, move.y + 7, 'MOVE', 10, TEXT)
                    ui._lobby_rects['swap_%d' % pid] = move
            else:
                text(ui, surface, col.x + 10, yy + 4, '-- OPEN --', 11, DIM)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, (25, 39, 41), (col.x + 8, yy + 29), (col.right - 8, yy + 29))
        text(ui, surface, col.x + 10, col.bottom - 23, 'YOUR SIDE' if here else 'CLICK TO JOIN', 11, tint, True)
        ui._lobby_rects['team_%d' % team] = col

_BROWSER_FONTS = {}


def browser_font(size, bold=False):
    key = (size, bold)
    if key not in _BROWSER_FONTS:
        _BROWSER_FONTS[key] = pygame.font.SysFont('Consolas', size, bold=bold)
    return _BROWSER_FONTS[key]


def browser_shell(surface, panel):
    """Browser chrome only. All existing list, relay and DM logic stays owned by mp."""
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (2, 5, 7), panel.move(5, 6))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, PLATE, panel)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, EDGE, panel, 1)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, ACCENT, (panel.x, panel.y, 5, 88))
    surface.blit(browser_font(11, True).render('KRAPNET / OPERATIONS TERMINAL', True, ACCENT), (panel.x + 28, panel.y + 16))
    surface.blit(browser_font(30, True).render('MULTIPLAYER', True, TEXT), (panel.x + 28, panel.y + 38))

"""Pixel bitmap fonts for the radio UI (polish pass T6b).

Two hand-authored proportional fonts, drawn with integer-scaled square
pixels only (no anti-aliasing, no TTF), so radio text matches the game's
pixel-art sprites at any window scale:

* ``R7`` - 7 px cap height, 5 px x-height, 2 px descenders, mixed case.
  Body text (medium / large radio text sizes).
* ``R5`` - 5 px cap height, 4 px x-height, mixed case. Labels, callsigns,
  history rows and the small radio text size.

``PixelFont(name, scale, bold)`` mimics the bit of the ``pygame.font.Font``
API the UI uses: ``render(text, aa, color)``, ``size(text)``,
``get_linesize()``, ``get_height()``. Unknown characters are folded to
ASCII (accents stripped, smart quotes / dashes mapped) or drawn as ``?``.
Glyph rows: ``#`` = ink, ``.`` = empty; row 0 is the cap/ascender line.
"""
import unicodedata

import pygame

# name -> (glyph table, cap rows, total rows incl. descenders, line gap)
FONTS = {"R7": (_R7, 7, 9, 2), "R5": (_R5, 5, 7, 2)}

_MAP = {"\u2018": "'", "\u2019": "'", "\u201a": ",", "\u201c": '"', "\u201d": '"',
        "\u201e": '"', "\u2013": "-", "\u2212": "-", "\u00a0": " ", "\t": " ",
        "\u00ab": '"', "\u00bb": '"', "\u2022": "*", "\u00b7": "."}

_RUNS = {}


def _runs(name, ch):
    """Glyph as (width, [(row, x0, length), ...]) horizontal ink runs."""
    key = (name, ch)
    hit = _RUNS.get(key)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    table = FONTS[name][0]
    rows = table[ch].split("|")
    w = max(len(r) for r in rows)
    runs = []
    for y, r in enumerate(rows):
        x = 0
        while x < len(r):
            if r[x] == "#":
                x0 = x
                while x < len(r) and r[x] == "#":
                    x += 1
                runs.append((y, x0, x - x0))
            else:
                x += 1
    hit = (w, runs)
    _RUNS[key] = hit
    return hit


def fold(text, name="R7"):
    """Map text onto the glyph set (accents stripped, quotes/dashes folded)."""
    table = FONTS[name][0]
    out = []
    for ch in text or "":
        if ch in table:
            out.append(ch)
            continue
        ch = _MAP.get(ch, ch)
        if ch in table:
            out.append(ch)
            continue
        base = "".join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", ch)
                       if not unicodedata.combining(c))
        if base and all(c in table for c in base):
            out.append(base)
        elif ch in ("\n", "\r"):
            out.append(" ")
        else:
            out.append("?")
    return "".join(out)


class PixelFont:
    """Integer-scaled bitmap font with a ``pygame.font.Font``-like surface."""

    def __init__(self, name="R7", scale=2, bold=False, tracking=1):
        self.name = name
        self.scale = max(1, int(scale))
        self.bold = bool(bold)
        self.tracking = tracking
        _t, self.cap, self.rows, self.gap = FONTS[name]
        self._cache = {}

    # -- metrics (all in output pixels) ---------------------------------
    def _adv(self, ch):
        w, _r = _runs(self.name, ch)
        return w + self.tracking + (1 if self.bold else 0)

    def size(self, text):
        t = fold(text, self.name)
        if not t:
            return (0, self.get_height())
        units = sum(self._adv(c) for c in t) - self.tracking
        return (max(0, units) * self.scale, self.get_height())

    def get_height(self):
        return self.rows * self.scale

    def get_linesize(self):
        return (self.rows + self.gap) * self.scale

    def get_ascent(self):
        return self.cap * self.scale

    # -- drawing ---------------------------------------------------------
    def draw(self, surface, text, pos, color):
        """Draw straight onto ``surface`` (no intermediate surface)."""
        t = fold(text, self.name)
        k = self.scale
        x, y0 = int(pos[0]), int(pos[1])
        col = tuple(color)
        for ch in t:
            w, runs = _runs(self.name, ch)
            for ry, rx, rl in runs:
                surface.fill(col, (x + rx * k, y0 + ry * k, (rl + (1 if self.bold else 0)) * k, k))
            x += self._adv(ch) * k
        return x - int(pos[0])

    def render(self, text, antialias=False, color=(255, 255, 255), background=None):
        key = (text, tuple(color), background)
        hit = self._cache.get(key)
        if hit is not None:
            return hit
        w, h = self.size(text)
        surf = pygame.Surface((max(1, w), h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        if background is not None:
            surf.fill(background)
        self.draw(surf, text, (0, 0), (*tuple(color)[:3], 255) if len(color) == 3 else color)
        if len(self._cache) > 384:
            self._cache.clear()
        self._cache[key] = surf
        return surf


_FONTS = {}


def font(name="R7", scale=2, bold=False):
    """Shared cached PixelFont instance."""
    key = (name, int(scale), bool(bold))
    f = _FONTS.get(key)
    if f is None:
        f = _FONTS[key] = PixelFont(name, scale, bold)
    return f

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\ui\radio.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Radio transmission widget (polish pass T6, field-radio restyle T6b).

One widget for every mission's radio traffic. The radio director in
``core.interactions`` decides WHAT is on air and WHEN (``live_line()``,
``radio_allowed()``, a pause-aware ``radio_clock()``); this module only
draws it:

* fixed bottom anchor in the free band right of the HP / weapon / molotov
  column (x >= 332) and left of the bottom-right edge markers, clear of
  the crosshair, minimap (top-right) and objective panel (top-left);
* drawn as a field radio set in the game's pixel-art style: gunmetal case
  with bevels and screws, a caller-ID screen with the speaker's pixel
  portrait (``assets/art/spr_portraits``, generated by
  ``tools/sprites/portraits.py``; integer nearest-neighbour scale only),
  speaker grille, recessed display glass with the callsign plate in the
  speaker's ``SPEAKER_COLORS`` accent, an LED signal ladder, RX lamp and an
  amber frequency readout (``mission_meta`` channel ``"NET // 141.20"``);
* bitmap pixel fonts (``ui.pixfont``, no TTF): word-wrapped body, at most
  3 rows visible (older rows scroll up and fade), typewriter paced to the VO
  clip (fixed readable rate without VO), block caret;
* slide + fade in (180 ms ease-out) with a short burst of static while the
  set "tunes in", fade out (250 ms), squelch in/out;
* signal LEDs only move while the VO channel is busy, faint scan band on
  the glass, queued-transmission LEDs, critical lines pulse the case edge
  and blink a red lamp;
* hidden instantly when the radio is blocked (cutscene / menu), frozen with
  the pause menu (all motion runs on the radio clock).

Settings (``PREFS``): radio text size (small / medium / large) and a
speaker-name toggle, persisted through ``core.settings_store``.
"""
import math
import os
import random

import pygame

from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, SPEAKER_COLORS
from ui import pixfont

IN_MS = 180
OUT_MS = 250
STATIC_MS = 220            # static burst while the set tunes in
MAX_ROWS = 3
HISTORY_MS = 4200          # how long a finished line lingers above the live one
TYPE_MS_PER_CHAR = 30      # typewriter rate when the line has no recording
PULSE_MS = 650
# HUD anchor (logical 1000x700 px): the left HUD column (weapon panel,
# M1 molotov panel, HP strip) ends near x=300; bottom-right holds edge
# waypoint markers / M2 COMMS OFFLINE from x~830.
HUD_ANCHOR_X = 332
HUD_ANCHOR_BOTTOM = 16
SIZE_LABELS = ("SMALL", "MEDIUM", "LARGE")
# body font per text size: (pixfont name, multiple of the pixel unit)
_BODY_FONTS = (("R5", 2), ("R7", 2), ("R7", 3))
PORTRAIT_PX = 24           # portrait source size (spr_portraits frames)

BODY_RGB = (226, 238, 214)     # phosphor white on the display glass
HIST_RGB = (196, 204, 192)
CASE = (50, 54, 46)            # olive gunmetal
CASE_HI = (82, 88, 72)
CASE_LO = (28, 30, 26)
CASE_INK = (12, 13, 11)
GLASS = (10, 15, 12)
GLASS_HI = (24, 32, 26)
AMBER = (255, 178, 64)
AMBER_BG = (44, 26, 8)
LED_OFF = (36, 42, 36)
LED_GREEN = (110, 236, 120)
LED_RED = (240, 64, 52)

PREFS = {
    "radio_text_size": 1,
    "radio_speaker_names": True,
    "subtitles": True,
}

# speaker (upper, base name) -> spr_portraits frame key
PORTRAIT_KEYS = {
    "BIRIBEL": "biribel", "VASILE": "vasile", "CAPTAIN VASILE": "vasile",
    "VOLKOV": "volkov", "COMMANDER": "commander", "FISHERMAN": "fisherman",
    "OLD FISHERMAN": "fisherman", "BALACEANU": "balaceanu",
    "PRESIDENT RETARDOVICI": "president", "RETARDOVICI": "president",
    "PRESIDENTIAL PA": "president", "PA": "president", "MARU": "maru",
    "COMMAND": "krap_command", "KRAP COMMAND": "krap_command", "KRAP CMD": "krap_command",
    "KRAP": "krap_command", "IPA DISPATCH": "ipa_dispatch", "IPA": "ipa_dispatch",
    "OLD SQUADMATE": "old_squadmate", "GABI": "gabi", "SEBY": "seby", "DARIUS": "darius",
    "OLD WOMAN": "old_woman", "HUNGRY KID": "hungry_kid", "NARRATOR": "narrator",
    "PA SYSTEM": "pa_system", "INTERCEPT": "intercept", "RADIO": "radio",
    "RADIO VOICE": "radio", "SYSTEM": "system", "LOYALIST COMMS": "loyalist_comms",
}


def apply_settings(values):
    """Copy the radio prefs out of a settings dict (settings_store profile)."""
    for k in PREFS:
        if k in values:
            PREFS[k] = values[k]
    if PREFS["radio_text_size"] not in (0, 1, 2):
        PREFS["radio_text_size"] = 1


def unit_for(surface_or_scale):
    """Pixel-art unit in screen px: 2 at the 1000x700 logical size."""
    if isinstance(surface_or_scale, (int, float)):
        scale = surface_or_scale
    else:
        sw, sh = surface_or_scale.get_size()
        scale = max(0.75, min(sw / WIDTH, sh / HEIGHT))
    return max(1, int(round(2 * scale)))


def body_font(size=None, u=2):
    """Pixel font used for the transmission body at text size ``size``."""
    if size not in (0, 1, 2):
        size = PREFS.get("radio_text_size", 1)
        size = size if size in (0, 1, 2) else 1
    name, mult = _BODY_FONTS[size]
    return pixfont.font(name, max(1, int(round(mult * u / 2.0))))


def _label_font(u):
    return pixfont.font("R5", u)


def _base(speaker):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    cut = s.find("(")
    return s[:cut].strip() if cut > 0 else s


def accent_for(speaker, fallback=(150, 170, 190)):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    for key in (s, _base(s), s.split(" ")[0] if s else ""):
        if key and key in SPEAKER_COLORS:
            return SPEAKER_COLORS[key]
    return tuple(fallback[:3]) if fallback else (150, 170, 190)


def portrait_key(speaker):
    s = (speaker or "").upper().strip()
    for key in (s, _base(s), s.split(" ")[0] if s else ""):
        if key in PORTRAIT_KEYS:
            return PORTRAIT_KEYS[key]
    if "INTERCEPT" in s:
        return "intercept"
    return "unknown"


def _channel_label():
    try:
        from core.mission_meta import radio_channel
        from core.state import STATE
        return radio_channel(STATE)
    except Exception:
        return "OPEN CHANNEL"


def _split_channel(label):
    """"KRAP CMD // 141.20" -> ("KRAP CMD", "141.20")."""
    label = (label or "").strip()
    if "//" in label:
        net, freq = label.split("//", 1)
        return net.strip(), freq.strip()
    return label, ""


def _wrap(text, font, width):
    rows = []
    for para in (text or "").replace(" / ", "\n").split("\n"):
        words, cur = para.split(" "), ""
        for w in words:
            t = (cur + " " + w) if cur else w
            if font.size(t)[0] > width and cur:
                rows.append(cur)
                cur = w
            else:
                cur = t
        if cur:
            rows.append(cur)
    return rows or [""]


def _mix(a, b, t):
    return tuple(int(a[i] + (b[i] - a[i]) * t) for i in range(3))


# -- portraits ------------------------------------------------------------
_portraits = {}
_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def _portrait_source(speaker, accent):
    """24x24 source portrait: hand-made PNG override > generated sheet > fallback."""
    name = _base(speaker).lower().replace(" ", "_")
    path = os.path.join(_ROOT, "assets", "sprites", "portraits", name + ".png")
    if name and os.path.exists(path):
        try:
            img = pygame.image.load(path)
            if pygame.display.get_surface() is not None:
                img = img.convert_alpha()
            return img
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        from core import artpack
        img = artpack.frame("spr_portraits", portrait_key(speaker))
        if img is None and portrait_key(speaker) != "unknown":
            img = artpack.frame("spr_portraits", "unknown")
        if img is not None:
            return img
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


def _fallback_portrait(accent):
    """Procedural caller in the same 24 px grid: shadowed head + headset."""
    s = pygame.Surface((PORTRAIT_PX, PORTRAIT_PX), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    body = _mix(accent, (40, 44, 48), 0.6)
    lit = _mix(accent, (90, 96, 100), 0.5)
    for y, (x0, x1) in {18: (6, 17), 19: (4, 19)}.items():
        s.fill(body, (x0, y, x1 - x0 + 1, 1))
    s.fill(body, (2, 20, 20, 4))
    s.fill(body, (10, 15, 4, 4))
    s.fill(lit, (7, 5, 10, 10))
    s.fill(lit, (8, 4, 8, 12))
    s.fill(lit, (9, 15, 6, 1))
    s.fill((40, 42, 46), (9, 10, 2, 1))
    s.fill((40, 42, 46), (13, 10, 2, 1))
    s.fill((58, 62, 66), (7, 2, 10, 1))
    s.fill((58, 62, 66), (4, 8, 3, 4))
    return s


def _portrait(speaker, size, accent):
    """Portrait at an integer multiple of the 24 px source (nearest only)."""
    key = (_base(speaker), size, tuple(accent))
    hit = _portraits.get(key)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    src = _portrait_source(speaker, accent)
    cache = src is not None or os.environ.get("ACA_ART", "") in ("legacy", "off")
    if src is None:      # sheet missing / no display yet: don't pin the fallback
        src = _fallback_portrait(accent)
    w, h = src.get_size()
    k = max(1, size // max(1, w))
    surf = pygame.transform.scale(src, (w * k, h * k)) if k != 1 else src.copy()
    if surf.get_size() != (size, size):
        out = pygame.Surface((size, size), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        out.blit(surf, ((size - surf.get_width()) // 2, size - surf.get_height()))
        surf = out
    if cache:
        _portraits[key] = surf
    return surf


def _ease_out(x):
    x = max(0.0, min(1.0, x))
    return 1.0 - (1.0 - x) ** 3


def _vo_busy():
    try:
        from audio import voice
        return voice.busy()
    except Exception:
        return False


def _sfx(name, volume):
    try:
        from core.config import audio
        audio.play(name, volume=volume)
    except Exception:
        pass


# -- static chassis (cached per size / accent) ------------------------------
_chassis = {}


def _screw(s, x, y, u):
    s.fill((112, 114, 104), (x, y, 2 * u, 2 * u))
    s.fill((150, 152, 140), (x, y, u, u))
    s.fill((40, 42, 38), (x + u, y + u, u, u))
    s.fill((60, 62, 56), (x, y + u, 2 * u, max(1, u // 2)))


def _bevel_box(s, rect, fill, hi, lo, u, inset=False):
    r = pygame.Rect(rect)
    s.fill(fill, r)
    a, b = (lo, hi) if inset else (hi, lo)
    s.fill(a, (r.x, r.y, r.w, u))
    s.fill(a, (r.x, r.y, u, r.h))
    s.fill(b, (r.x, r.bottom - u, r.w, u))
    s.fill(b, (r.right - u, r.y, u, r.h))


def _build_chassis(w, h, u, layout):
    s = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    # case: ink outline, olive gunmetal body, lit top-left / dark bottom-right
    s.fill((*CASE_INK, 255), (u, 0, w - 2 * u, h))
    s.fill((*CASE_INK, 255), (0, u, w, h - 2 * u))
    body = pygame.Rect(u, u, w - 2 * u, h - 2 * u)
    _bevel_box(s, body, CASE, CASE_HI, CASE_LO, u)
    # subtle brushed texture: a darker line every 3 units
    for y in range(body.y + 3 * u, body.bottom - 2 * u, 3 * u):
        s.fill(_mix(CASE, CASE_LO, 0.25), (body.x + u, y, body.w - 2 * u, max(1, u // 2)))
    for x, y in ((2 * u, 2 * u), (w - 4 * u, 2 * u), (2 * u, h - 4 * u), (w - 4 * u, h - 4 * u)):
        _screw(s, x, y, u)
    # caller-ID screen bezel
    scr = layout["screen"]
    _bevel_box(s, scr.inflate(2 * u, 2 * u), (8, 10, 9), CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=False)
    # speaker grille under the screen (when the set is tall enough)
    g = layout.get("grille")
    if g is not None:
        _bevel_box(s, g, _mix(CASE, CASE_LO, 0.4), CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=True)
        for yy in range(g.y + 2 * u, g.bottom - 2 * u + 1, 2 * u):
            for xx in range(g.x + 2 * u + ((yy - g.y) // (2 * u)) % 2 * u, g.right - 2 * u, 2 * u):
                s.fill(CASE_INK, (xx, yy, u, u))
    # recessed display glass
    win = layout["window"]
    _bevel_box(s, win.inflate(2 * u, 2 * u), GLASS, CASE_LO, CASE_HI, u, inset=False)
    s.fill(GLASS, win)
    s.fill(GLASS_HI, (win.x, win.y, win.w, u))
    for y in range(win.y + u, win.bottom, 2 * u):
        s.fill((14, 20, 16), (win.x, y, win.w, max(1, u // 2)))
    return s


def _screen_overlay(chip, u):
    """Scanlines + glass glint over the caller-ID screen (cached)."""
    key = ("scr", chip, u)
    hit = _chassis.get(key)
    if hit is None:
        hit = pygame.Surface((chip, chip), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        for y in range(u, chip, 2 * u):
            hit.fill((0, 0, 0, 46), (0, y, chip, max(1, u // 2)))
        hit.fill((255, 255, 255, 60), (u, u, u, 3 * u))
        hit.fill((255, 255, 255, 34), (2 * u, u, 2 * u, u))
        _chassis[key] = hit
    return hit


def _chassis_for(w, h, u, layout):
    key = (w, h, u, layout["screen"].topleft, layout.get("grille") is not None)
    hit = _chassis.get(key)
    if hit is None:
        if len(_chassis) > 32:
            _chassis.clear()
        hit = _chassis[key] = _build_chassis(w, h, u, layout)
    return hit


class RadioTransmission:
    """Stateful widget; one shared instance (``TRANSMISSION``)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.cur = None          # dict copied from interactions.live_line()
        self.cur_key = None
        self.out_at = None       # radio-clock ms when the fade-out started
        self.history = []        # finished lines: dicts with 'done_at'
        self.log = []            # last 10 (speaker, body, color) for other UIs
        self.last_clock = 0

    # -- state ------------------------------------------------------------
    def reset(self):
        self.cur = None
        self.cur_key = None
        self.out_at = None
        self.history.clear()

    def _sync(self, live, allowed, clock):
        if not allowed:
            if self.cur is not None or self.history:
                self.reset()     # hard cut; the director already squelched
            return
        key = None if live is None else (live["start"], live["text"])
        if key != self.cur_key:
            if self.cur is not None:
                old = dict(self.cur)
                old["done_at"] = clock
                self.history.append(old)
                self.history = self.history[-2:]
            if live is not None:
                self.cur = dict(live)
                self.out_at = None
                self.log.append((live["speaker"], live["body"], live["color"]))
                self.log = self.log[-10:]
                if not live.get("vo_ms"):   # voiced clips carry their own squelch
                    _sfx("squelch_head", 0.22)
            else:
                self.cur = None
            self.cur_key = key
        if self.cur is not None and self.out_at is None and clock >= self.cur["end"]:
            self.out_at = clock
            if not self.cur.get("vo_ms"):
                _sfx("squelch_tail", 0.2)
        if self.cur is not None and self.out_at is not None and clock - self.out_at > OUT_MS:
            old = dict(self.cur)
            old["done_at"] = clock
            self.history.append(old)
            self.history = self.history[-2:]
            self.cur = None
        self.history = [h for h in self.history if clock - h["done_at"] < HISTORY_MS]

    # -- layout -----------------------------------------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def metrics(surface):
        """Geometry shared by draw() and the smoke test."""
        sw, sh = surface.get_size()
        scale = max(0.75, min(sw / WIDTH, sh / HEIGHT))
        u = unit_for(scale)
        f_body = body_font(PREFS.get("radio_text_size", 1), u)
        f_lab = _label_font(u)
        chip = PORTRAIT_PX * u
        pad = 4 * u
        panel_w = int(min(sw * 0.49, 490 * scale))
        win_x = pad + u + chip + u + 4 * u + u
        win_w = panel_w - win_x - pad - u
        text_w = win_w - 6 * u
        plate_h = (f_lab.cap + 2) * u
        head_h = plate_h + 2 * u
        return {"scale": scale, "u": u, "f_body": f_body, "f_lab": f_lab, "chip": chip,
                "pad": pad, "panel_w": panel_w, "win_x": win_x, "win_w": win_w,
                "text_w": text_w, "plate_h": plate_h, "head_h": head_h,
                "row_h": f_body.get_linesize()}

    @staticmethod
    def panel_height(m, n_rows):
        u = m["u"]
        win_h = 2 * u + m["head_h"] + n_rows * m["row_h"]
        return max(m["chip"] + 2 * u + 2 * m["pad"], win_h + 2 * u + 2 * m["pad"])

    # -- drawing ----------------------------------------------------------
    def draw(self, surface, live=None, allowed=True, clock=None, queued=0,
             channel=None, anchor="hud", bar_h=0, force_text=False):
        if clock is None:
            clock = self.last_clock
        self.last_clock = clock
        self._sync(live, allowed, clock)
        if self.cur is None and not self.history:
            return None
        sw, sh = surface.get_size()
        m = self.metrics(surface)
        scale = m["scale"]
        if anchor == "letterbox":
            x0 = (sw - m["panel_w"]) // 2
            one = self.panel_height(m, 1)
            bottom = sh - max(4, (bar_h - one) // 2)
        else:
            x0 = int(HUD_ANCHOR_X * scale)
            bottom = sh - int(HUD_ANCHOR_BOTTOM * scale)
        drawn = None
        # history rows (compact, one line each) stacked above the live panel
        stack_y = bottom
        if self.cur is not None:
            rect = self._draw_live(surface, self.cur, clock, x0, bottom, m, queued,
                                   channel, force_text)
            drawn = rect
            stack_y = rect.top - int(4 * scale)
        # letterbox: one line only, history would stack into the picture
        for h in (() if anchor == "letterbox" else reversed(self.history)):
            age = clock - h["done_at"]
            a = int(150 * max(0.0, 1.0 - age / HISTORY_MS))
            if a <= 6:
                continue
            stack_y = self._draw_history(surface, h, x0, stack_y, m, a)
        return drawn

    def _draw_history(self, surface, h, x0, bottom, m, alpha):
        u, font, panel_w = m["u"], m["f_lab"], m["panel_w"]
        acc = accent_for(h["speaker"], h["color"])
        name = _base(h["speaker"]) if PREFS.get("radio_speaker_names", True) else ""
        body = (h["body"] or "").replace("\n", " ")
        name_w = font.size(name)[0] + 3 * u if name else 0
        room = panel_w - 8 * u - name_w
        while font.size(body)[0] > room and len(body) > 4:
            body = body[:-5] + "\u2026"
        hgt = (font.rows + 2) * u
        s = pygame.Surface((panel_w, hgt), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        s.fill((14, 16, 13, int(alpha * 0.85)))
        s.fill((*CASE_LO, alpha), (0, hgt - u, panel_w, u))
        s.fill((*acc, alpha), (0, 0, u, hgt))
        x = 3 * u
        if name:
            t = font.render(name, False, acc)
            t.set_alpha(alpha)
            s.blit(t, (x, u))
            x += name_w
        t = font.render(body, False, HIST_RGB)
        t.set_alpha(alpha)
        s.blit(t, (x, u))
        surface.blit(s, (x0, bottom - hgt))
        return bottom - hgt - u

    def _draw_live(self, surface, cur, clock, x0, bottom, m, queued, channel, force_text):
        u, chip, pad = m["u"], m["chip"], m["pad"]
        f_body, f_lab = m["f_body"], m["f_lab"]
        panel_w, row_h = m["panel_w"], m["row_h"]
        acc = accent_for(cur["speaker"], cur["color"])
        age = clock - cur["start"]
        a_in = _ease_out(age / IN_MS)
        a_out = 1.0
        slide = (1.0 - a_in) * -26
        if self.out_at is not None:
            k = min(1.0, (clock - self.out_at) / OUT_MS)
            a_out = 1.0 - k
            slide += -10 * k
        alpha = max(0.0, min(1.0, a_in * a_out))
        show_text = force_text or PREFS.get("subtitles", True) or not cur.get("vo_ms")
        body = cur["body"] or ""
        rows = _wrap(body, f_body, m["text_w"]) if show_text else []
        # typewriter, paced to the clip when there is one
        vo = cur.get("vo_ms") or 0
        type_ms = vo * 0.92 if vo else max(1, len(body)) * TYPE_MS_PER_CHAR
        n_vis = len(body) if type_ms <= 0 else int(len(body) * min(1.0, age / type_ms))
        vis_rows, left = [], n_vis
        for r in rows:
            if left <= 0:
                break
            vis_rows.append(r[:left])
            left -= len(r) + 1
        scrolled = max(0, len(vis_rows) - MAX_ROWS)
        vis_rows = vis_rows[scrolled:]
        n_rows = max(1, min(MAX_ROWS, len(rows))) if show_text else 0
        panel_h = self.panel_height(m, n_rows)

        # layout (panel-local px)
        screen = pygame.Rect(pad + u, pad + u, chip, chip)
        grille = None
        g_top = screen.bottom + 3 * u
        if panel_h - pad - g_top >= 7 * u:
            grille = pygame.Rect(screen.x - u, g_top, chip + 2 * u, panel_h - pad - g_top)
        win = pygame.Rect(m["win_x"], pad + u, m["win_w"], panel_h - 2 * pad - 2 * u)
        layout = {"screen": screen, "window": win, "grille": grille}
        s = _chassis_for(panel_w, panel_h, u, layout).copy()

        crit = (cur.get("priority") or 0) >= 1
        busy = _vo_busy() and vo > 0 and self.out_at is None
        tuning = age < STATIC_MS
        # critical: the case edge flashes in the accent, once
        if crit and age < PULSE_MS:
            p = math.sin(math.pi * age / PULSE_MS)
            ring = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            pygame.draw.rect(ring, (*acc, int(90 + 160 * p)), ring.get_rect(), max(u, int(u * (1 + 2 * p))))
            s.blit(ring, (0, 0))

        # caller-ID screen: accent-tinted CRT, portrait, scanlines, glass glint
        s.fill(_mix(acc, (6, 8, 8), 0.82), screen)
        if not tuning or age > STATIC_MS * 0.55:
            s.blit(_portrait(cur["speaker"], chip, acc), screen.topleft)
        s.blit(_screen_overlay(chip, u), screen.topleft)

        # header inside the glass: callsign plate, LED ladder, RX lamp,
        # amber frequency readout with queue LEDs
        hx, hy = win.x + 3 * u, win.y + 2 * u
        plate_h = m["plate_h"]
        if PREFS.get("radio_speaker_names", True) and cur["speaker"]:
            name = _base(cur["speaker"])
            nw = f_lab.size(name)[0]
            plate = pygame.Rect(hx, hy, nw + 4 * u, plate_h)
            s.fill(acc, plate)
            s.fill(_mix(acc, (255, 255, 255), 0.35), (plate.x, plate.y, plate.w, u))
            s.fill(_mix(acc, (0, 0, 0), 0.35), (plate.x, plate.bottom - u, plate.w, u))
            f_lab.draw(s, name, (plate.x + 2 * u, plate.y + u), (14, 14, 16))
            hx = plate.right + 3 * u
        seg_rows = max(3, (plate_h // u - 1) // 2)
        for i in range(6):
            if busy:
                lv = 0.25 + 0.75 * abs(math.sin(clock * (0.011 + i * 0.0037) + i * 1.7)
                                      * math.sin(clock * 0.0047 + i))
            else:
                lv = 0.0
            lit = int(round(lv * seg_rows))
            for j in range(seg_rows):
                on = j < lit
                col = (LED_RED if j == seg_rows - 1 else acc) if on else LED_OFF
                s.fill(col, (hx + i * 2 * u, hy + plate_h - (j + 1) * 2 * u + u, u, u))
        hx += 12 * u + u
        # RX lamp: green while receiving, red blink for critical traffic
        on_air = self.out_at is None
        lamp = LED_OFF
        if on_air:
            lamp = LED_RED if (crit and (clock // 180) % 2 == 0) else LED_GREEN
        rx = f_lab.render("RX", False, (120, 130, 118))
        ly = hy + (plate_h - rx.get_height()) // 2 + u
        s.blit(rx, (hx, ly))
        s.fill(lamp, (hx + rx.get_width() + u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, 2 * u, 2 * u))
        if on_air:
            s.fill(_mix(lamp, (255, 255, 255), 0.5), (hx + rx.get_width() + u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, u, u))
        hx += rx.get_width() + 4 * u
        net, freq = _split_channel(channel or _channel_label())
        qn = min(3, queued)
        right = win.right - 3 * u
        for i in range(qn):
            s.fill(AMBER, (right - 2 * u - i * 3 * u, hy + plate_h // 2 - u, 2 * u, 2 * u))
        if qn:
            right -= qn * 3 * u + 2 * u
        if freq:
            ft = f_lab.render(freq, False, AMBER)
            box = pygame.Rect(right - ft.get_width() - 4 * u, hy, ft.get_width() + 4 * u, plate_h)
            if box.x > hx:
                s.fill(AMBER_BG, box)
                s.fill(_mix(AMBER_BG, (0, 0, 0), 0.5), (box.x, box.y, box.w, u))
                s.blit(ft, (box.x + 2 * u, box.y + u))
                right = box.x - 2 * u
        if net:
            nt = f_lab.render(net, False, (118, 128, 118))
            if right - nt.get_width() > hx:
                s.blit(nt, (right - nt.get_width(), hy + u))

        # body rows: phosphor text with a 1-unit drop shadow; first row fades
        tx, by = win.x + 3 * u, hy + m["head_h"]
        for i, r in enumerate(vis_rows):
            ra = 120 if (scrolled and i == 0) else 255
            t = f_body.render(r, False, BODY_RGB)
            sh_ = f_body.render(r, False, (0, 0, 0))
            if ra != 255:
                t = t.copy()
                t.set_alpha(ra)
                sh_ = sh_.copy()
                sh_.set_alpha(ra)
            s.blit(sh_, (tx + u // 2 or 1, by + i * row_h + (u // 2 or 1)))
            s.blit(t, (tx, by + i * row_h))
        if show_text and n_vis < len(body) and (clock // 220) % 2 == 0 and vis_rows:
            last = vis_rows[-1]
            cxp = tx + f_body.size(last)[0] + f_body.scale
            s.fill(acc, (cxp, by + (len(vis_rows) - 1) * row_h,
                         f_body.scale * 3, f_body.get_ascent()))

        # scan band drifting down the glass
        band_h = 4 * u
        band_y = win.y + int((clock * 0.05) % (win.h + band_h * 2)) - band_h
        bt, bb = max(win.y, band_y), min(win.bottom, band_y + band_h)
        if bb > bt:
            band = pygame.Surface((win.w, bb - bt), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            band.fill((180, 255, 200, 10))
            s.blit(band, (win.x, bt))

        # static burst while the set tunes in (screen + glass)
        if tuning:
            k = 1.0 - age / STATIC_MS
            rng = random.Random(int(clock // 40) * 7919 + len(body))
            noise = pygame.Surface((panel_w, panel_h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            for area, dens in ((screen, 0.55), (win, 0.22)):
                n = int(area.w * area.h / (u * u) * dens * k)
                for _ in range(n):
                    nx = area.x + rng.randrange(0, max(1, area.w // u)) * u
                    ny = area.y + rng.randrange(0, max(1, area.h // u)) * u
                    v = rng.randrange(60, 230)
                    noise.fill((v, v, v, int(200 * k)), (nx, ny, u, u))
            s.blit(noise, (0, 0))

        s.set_alpha(int(255 * alpha))
        surface.blit(s, (x0 + int(slide), bottom - panel_h))
        return pygame.Rect(x0, bottom - panel_h, panel_w, panel_h)


TRANSMISSION = RadioTransmission()


def draw_radio(surface, anchor="hud", bar_h=0, force_text=False):
    """Per-frame entry point for mission HUDs (via ui.hud.draw_pinned_radio)."""
    try:
        from core import interactions as I
    except Exception:
        return None
    return TRANSMISSION.draw(surface, live=I.live_line(), allowed=I.radio_allowed(),
                             clock=I.radio_clock(), queued=I.queue_depth(),
                             anchor=anchor, bar_h=bar_h, force_text=force_text)


def recent_lines(n=10):
    """Last transmissions as (speaker, body, color), oldest first."""
    return list(TRANSMISSION.log[-n:])

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# src\ui\shop.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------


"""The Outfitter - spend Acaribucks on the loadout you play the arena in.

One screen with three tabs, not a shop and a separate customization screen:
buying and wearing act on the same rows, and splitting them would mean two
layouts to keep in step and two trips for one decision.

Follows ui.match_screen's shape rather than ui.system's - a class holding its
own state, drawn onto a surface handed in by app.py - for one specific reason.
The settings screen is a module of functions plus module-level rects whose
state is rebound globals read through the ui facade. That works for settings
because nothing else writes them. This screen mutates a wallet, so instance
state means there is no shared global for another module to snapshot stale, and
the "never `from <owner> import <mutable>`" rule in AGENTS.md cannot be broken
here by accident.

The preview is not a drawing of a drawing. Every icon and the big preview call
the PRODUCTION sprite code - entities.player.Player.draw(), the weapon rigs and
the head-gear registry - so what the shop shows is literally what the arena
renders. A hand-drawn preview would be a second art path, and it would promise
hats the game then fails to wear.
"""
import math

import pygame

from core import appearance, artpack, profile_store
from core.config import (
    WIDTH, C_ORANGE, font_speaker, font_terminal, font_terminal_small,
    font_prompt,
)
from entities import weapon_rig
from entities.player import Player
from ui.widgets import note_hover

# ── Panel geometry ──
# Same plate size and position as the settings screen, so the two full-screen
# panels do not jump between each other.
PANEL_W, PANEL_H = 720, 660
PANEL_X = WIDTH // 2 - PANEL_W // 2
PANEL_Y = 30
TAB_BAR_Y = PANEL_Y + 76
CONTENT_Y = TAB_BAR_Y + 50

# A 4 x 2 grid holds the largest tab (8 palettes) with no scrolling, which is
# why there is no scroll state in this file at all. The weapons tab would be
# 18 rows; it is cut to 6 by picking one gun at a time, which is also the way
# anybody actually browses finishes.
#
# CELL_H is icon + up to two label lines + status + the gaps, measured rather
# than guessed. Names get two lines because the alternative was either renaming
# items the designer chose or shipping a shop where "Ballistic Goggles" reads as
# "Ballisti...". At 96px of one line, four names lost their second word.
COLS, ROWS = 4, 2
CELL_W, CELL_H = 104, 164
# The cell border eats 8px, and the label keeps 8px of its own margin. One
# constant for the label budget so the renderer and the smoke check cannot
# measure against different widths and both think they passed.
LABEL_MAX_W = (CELL_W - 8) - 8
ICON_BOX = 96
ICON_TOP = 4
LABEL_TOP = ICON_TOP + ICON_BOX + 6      # 104
LABEL_LINE_H = 15
STATUS_TOP = LABEL_TOP + 2 * LABEL_LINE_H + 2   # 136
GRID_X = PANEL_X + 28
GRID_Y = CONTENT_Y + 40
GRID_W = COLS * CELL_W

GUN_CHIP_W = GRID_W // 3

RIGHT_X = PANEL_X + GRID_W + 44
RIGHT_W = PANEL_X + PANEL_W - 28 - RIGHT_X
# Sized so the preview column ends level with the bottom of the two-row grid,
# which stops the panel reading as a tall empty band on the right.
PREVIEW_H = 292
ACTION = pygame.Rect(RIGHT_X, GRID_Y + PREVIEW_H + 14, RIGHT_W, 36)
COST_Y = ACTION.bottom + 12

DESC_Y = GRID_Y + ROWS * CELL_H + 16
BACK = pygame.Rect(PANEL_X + 28, PANEL_Y + PANEL_H - 56, 150, 30)

# Catalog gun key -> the rig name Player.rig_weapon expects.
RIG_BY_GUN = {"os12": "os12", "k9": "k9_smg", "pistol": "pistol"}

# Icon poses. The rifle is drawn along the facing and the head sits two pixels
# further along that same line, so a head-on crop of the head has a barrel
# running through it. Yawing the gear poses clears the thing being sold without
# touching what is rendered.
BODY_ANGLE = -math.pi / 2
HEAD_ANGLE = -math.pi / 2 + 0.6

TABS = ("PALETTES", "GEAR", "WEAPONS")

# Colours, in the terminal green the settings panel uses.
C_ON = (80, 220, 120)
C_HEAD = (140, 240, 160)
C_BODY = (110, 160, 120)
C_OFF = (80, 110, 90)
C_DARK = (6, 12, 8)
C_MID = (10, 20, 14)
C_SEL = (14, 40, 22)
C_LINE = (25, 50, 32)
C_UNAFFORD = (90, 100, 96)
C_PLATE = (10, 16, 22)


def _money(n):
    return "{:,}".format(int(n))


def _fit(font, text, max_w):
    """Ellipsize *text* until it fits max_w pixels.

    Measured rather than counted. The cell is 96px wide and this face is
    monospace at roughly 8.4px a character, so a fixed character budget both
    wastes room on "Issue" and lets "Ballistic Goggles" run straight through the
    cell border - which is exactly the bug a 13-character limit produced.
    """
    text = str(text)
    if font.size(text)[0] <= max_w:
        return text
    while text and font.size(text + "...")[0] > max_w:
        text = text[:-1]
    return (text.rstrip() + "...") if text else ""


class ShopScreen(object):
    """The Outfitter panel. Instance state only; see the module docstring."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = "closed"          # "closed" | "open"
        self.tab = 0
        self.gun = "os12"
        self.selected = None          # catalog id the buttons act on
        self.toast = ""
        self.toast_left = 0.0
        self.return_to = "MENU"
        self._rects = []              # (rect, item_id), rebuilt every draw
        self._tab_rects = []
        self._gun_rects = []

    # ── lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def open_panel(self, return_to="MENU"):
        self.mode = "open"
        self.return_to = return_to
        self.toast = ""
        self.toast_left = 0.0
        # Land on the first thing this player does not own, so the panel opens
        # showing a choice rather than a wall of EQUIPPED.
        self.selected = self._first_unowned()

    def close(self):
        self.mode = "closed"

    def update(self, dt):
        if self.toast_left > 0:
            self.toast_left = max(0.0, self.toast_left - max(0.0, float(dt)))
            if not self.toast_left:
                self.toast = ""

    def _rows(self):
        """Catalog rows for the active tab as [(item_id, entry, is_default)]."""
        if self.tab == 0:
            return appearance.catalog_rows("palette")
        if self.tab == 1:
            return appearance.catalog_rows("head")
        return appearance.catalog_rows(self.gun)

    def _first_unowned(self):
        owned = set(profile_store.load()["owned"])
        for item_id, _entry, _default in self._rows():
            if item_id not in owned:
                return item_id
        return None

    # ── input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def handle_event(self, event, mouse):
        """Returns "back" when the player asks to leave, else None."""
        if self.mode != "open":
            return None
        if event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if event.key in (pygame.K_ESCAPE, pygame.K_BACKSPACE):
                return "back"
            if event.key in (pygame.K_LEFT, pygame.K_RIGHT):
                step = -1 if event.key == pygame.K_LEFT else 1
                self.tab = (self.tab + step) % len(TABS)
                self.selected = self._first_unowned()
                return None
            if event.key == pygame.K_RETURN:
                self._act()
                return None
        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button == 1:
            # Cells first: a click on a row selects it, and selecting is by far
            # the most common intent on a shop screen.
            for rect, item_id in self._rects:
                if rect.collidepoint(mouse):
                    self.selected = item_id
                    return None
            for i, rect in enumerate(self._tab_rects):
                if rect.collidepoint(mouse):
                    self.tab = i
                    self.selected = self._first_unowned()
                    return None
            for gun, rect in self._gun_rects:
                if rect.collidepoint(mouse):
                    self.gun = gun
                    self.selected = self._first_unowned()
                    return None
            if ACTION.collidepoint(mouse):
                self._act()
                return None
            if BACK.collidepoint(mouse):
                return "back"
        return None

    def _act(self):
        """Buy the selected item if it is affordable, then wear it."""
        item_id = self.selected
        if not item_id:
            self._say("NOTHING SELECTED")
            return
        profile = profile_store.load()
        if item_id in profile["owned"]:
            profile_store.equip(item_id)
            self._say("WEARING %s" % appearance.item_label(item_id).upper())
            return
        ok, reason = profile_store.buy(item_id)
        if not ok:
            if reason == "poor":
                need = int(appearance.price_of(item_id) or 0) \
                    - profile["acaribucks"]
                self._say("NEED %s MORE ACARIBUCKS" % _money(need))
            elif reason == "unknown":
                # Only reachable if the catalog shrank under a saved profile,
                # which is the one drift this screen has to survive gracefully.
                self._say("NOT IN THE CATALOG")
                self.selected = self._first_unowned()
            else:
                self._say("ALREADY OWNED")
            return
        profile_store.equip(item_id)
        self._say("BOUGHT %s" % appearance.item_label(item_id).upper())

    def _say(self, text):
        self.toast = text
        self.toast_left = 2.6

    # ── art ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _loadout_with(self, item_id):
        """The equipped loadout, with *item_id* tried on in its own slot."""
        app = profile_store.equipped()
        if item_id in appearance.PALETTES:
            app["palette"] = item_id
        elif item_id in appearance.HEADGEARS:
            app["head"] = item_id
        elif item_id in appearance.FINISHES:
            app["finish"] = dict(app["finish"])
            app["finish"][appearance.FINISHES[item_id]["gun"]] = item_id
        return appearance.normalize(app)

    def _avatar(self, app, rig, box, scale=1, focus=0, angle=BODY_ANGLE):
        """Render a whole character through the production sprite code.

        Cached in core.artpack.pose, which is what that cache exists for: a
        parameterised procedural body drawn once and blitted thereafter. The
        LIVE avatar must never go through it, because Player.draw() advances
        breathing, the walk cycle and the blink timer as a side effect of
        rendering -- caching a live sprite would freeze it mid-breath and pin it
        to one spot. Static shop art has none of that problem.

        Facing north by default, because that is the only angle where a peak, a
        brow band and a night-vision mount are all visible at once.

        ``focus`` crops a native-resolution square of that half-width around
        the head and scales it back up, for the gear cells. The head is an
        18-pixel circle on a sprite whose rifle reaches 46 pixels out, so at
        icon size a beret and a helmet differ by a couple of pixels. This is a
        crop of the real render rather than a second drawing of a hat, which is
        what keeps the zoom honest: the pixels shown are the pixels you wear.

        The yaw in HEAD_ANGLE exists because the rifle is drawn along the
        facing and the head sits two pixels further along it, so at a dead
        north the barrel runs straight through the thing being sold. Turning
        the pose a little clears the head without changing what is rendered.
        """
        def paint(surf):
            native = pygame.Surface((box, box), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            p = Player(0, 0)
            p.rig_weapon = rig
            p.angle = angle
            p.blink_timer = 40
            p.set_appearance(app)
            # Player(0, 0) puts the body centre at (16, 16); offset by that
            # minus half the box to land the sprite in the middle.
            p.draw(native, offset_x=16 - box // 2, offset_y=16 - box // 2)
            out = native
            if focus:
                cx = cy = box // 2
                half = min(cx, cy, int(focus))
                out = native.subsurface(pygame.Rect(cx - half, cy - half,
                                                    half * 2, half * 2))
            total = int(box * scale)
            surf.blit(pygame.transform.scale(out, (total, total)), (0, 0))
        return artpack.pose(("outfitter_avatar", appearance.key_of(app), rig,
                             box, scale, int(focus), round(angle, 3)),
                            (box * scale, box * scale), paint)

    def _rig_icon(self, item_id, gun, box, scale=2):
        """One weapon, drawn by the same function the match calls.

        A finish swatch has to be the real rig or it is a decoration: the
        geometry - where the handguard ends, how far the suppressor reaches -
        is most of what identifies a gun, and a re-drawn silhouette would sell
        a colour scheme attached to the wrong shape.

        Rendered at 1/scale and blown back up because a pistol is about twenty
        pixels long at the size the match draws it, which in a 96-pixel cell is
        a smudge. Scaling is the same trick the gear crops use: bigger, but
        still the pixels the game produces.
        """
        roles = appearance.resolve(self._loadout_with(item_id))["rigs"]
        inner = max(24, int(box) // int(scale))

        def paint(surf):
            ctx = {"grip_x": inner * 0.30, "grip_y": inner * 0.5,
                   "arm_dx": 1.0, "arm_dy": 0.0, "raise_factor": 0.0,
                   "reload_active": False, "reload_progress": 0.0}
            small = pygame.Surface((inner, inner), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            weapon_rig.draw(small, RIG_BY_GUN[gun], ctx, roles)
            surf.blit(pygame.transform.scale(small, (box, box)), (0, 0))
        return artpack.pose(("outfitter_rig", item_id, box, scale),
                            (box, box), paint)

    # ── draw ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def draw(self, surface):
        if self.mode != "open":
            return
        mouse = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
        dim = pygame.Surface(surface.get_size(), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        dim.fill((0, 0, 0, 168))
        surface.blit(dim, (0, 0))
        panel = pygame.Rect(PANEL_X, PANEL_Y, PANEL_W, PANEL_H)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_PLATE, panel)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, (30, 90, 50), panel, 2)

        self._rects = []
        self._draw_header(surface)
        self._draw_tabs(surface, mouse)
        self._draw_grid(surface, mouse)
        self._draw_detail(surface, mouse)
        self._draw_footer(surface, mouse)

    def _draw_header(self, surface):
        """Title with the two-layer phosphor glow, and the wallet."""
        title = "// OUTFITTER //"
        glow = font_speaker.render(title, True, (30, 90, 50))
        top = font_speaker.render(title, True, C_HEAD)
        surface.blit(glow, (PANEL_X + 29, PANEL_Y + 24))
        surface.blit(top, (PANEL_X + 28, PANEL_Y + 23))

        amount = font_terminal.render(_money(profile_store.balance()), True,
                                      C_ORANGE)
        label = font_terminal_small.render("ACARIBUCKS", True, C_OFF)
        right = PANEL_X + PANEL_W - 28
        surface.blit(amount, (right - amount.get_width(), PANEL_Y + 22))
        surface.blit(label, (right - label.get_width(), PANEL_Y + 48))
        pygame.draw.line(surface, (50, 140, 80), (PANEL_X + 24, PANEL_Y + 66),
                         (PANEL_X + PANEL_W - 24, PANEL_Y + 66), 1)

    def _draw_tabs(self, surface, mouse):
        self._tab_rects = []
        w = PANEL_W // len(TABS)
        for i, name in enumerate(TABS):
            rect = pygame.Rect(PANEL_X + i * w, TAB_BAR_Y, w, 34)
            self._tab_rects.append(rect)
            active = (i == self.tab)
            hot = rect.collidepoint(mouse)
            if hot:
                note_hover()
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_SEL if active else (
                C_MID if hot else C_DARK), rect)
            if active:
                pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ON,
                                 (rect.x, rect.bottom - 3, rect.width, 3))
            else:
                pygame.draw.line(surface, C_LINE, (rect.x, rect.bottom),
                                 (rect.right, rect.bottom), 1)
            text = font_terminal_small.render(
                name, True,
                C_HEAD if active else (C_BODY if hot else C_OFF))
            surface.blit(text, (rect.centerx - text.get_width() // 2,
                                rect.centery - text.get_height() // 2))

    def _draw_grid(self, surface, mouse):
        self._gun_rects = []
        if self.tab == 2:
            for i, gun in enumerate(appearance.GUN_KEYS):
                rect = pygame.Rect(GRID_X + i * GUN_CHIP_W, CONTENT_Y,
                                   GUN_CHIP_W - 6, 26)
                self._gun_rects.append((gun, rect))
                active = (gun == self.gun)
                hot = rect.collidepoint(mouse)
                if hot:
                    note_hover()
                pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_SEL if active else (
                    C_MID if hot else C_DARK), rect)
                if active:
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ON, rect, 1)
                text = font_terminal_small.render(
                    _gun_label(gun), True, C_HEAD if active else C_OFF)
                surface.blit(text, (rect.centerx - text.get_width() // 2,
                                    rect.centery - text.get_height() // 2))

        profile = profile_store.load()
        owned = set(profile["owned"])
        wearing = profile["equipped"]
        balance = profile["acaribucks"]
        for index, (item_id, entry, _default) in enumerate(self._rows()):
            col, row = index % COLS, index // COLS
            rect = pygame.Rect(GRID_X + col * CELL_W, GRID_Y + row * CELL_H,
                               CELL_W - 8, CELL_H - 8)
            self._rects.append((rect, item_id))
            hot = rect.collidepoint(mouse)
            picked = (item_id == self.selected)
            if hot:
                note_hover()
            if picked:
                pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_SEL, rect)
                pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ON, rect, 1)
            else:
                pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_MID if hot else C_DARK, rect)

            if item_id in appearance.FINISHES:
                art = self._rig_icon(item_id,
                                     appearance.FINISHES[item_id]["gun"],
                                     ICON_BOX)
            else:
                # Gear is a zoom on the head; a palette is the whole body,
                # because that is the difference between what is being sold.
                gear = item_id in appearance.HEADGEARS
                art = self._avatar(self._loadout_with(item_id), "os12",
                                   ICON_BOX,
                                   focus=24 if gear else 0,
                                   angle=HEAD_ANGLE if gear else BODY_ANGLE)
            surface.blit(art, (rect.centerx - art.get_width() // 2,
                               rect.top + ICON_TOP))

            label_color = C_HEAD if picked else (C_BODY if hot else C_OFF)
            for li, line in enumerate(_name_lines(font_terminal_small,
                                                  entry["name"],
                                                  LABEL_MAX_W)):
                text = font_terminal_small.render(line, True, label_color)
                surface.blit(text, (rect.centerx - text.get_width() // 2,
                                    rect.top + LABEL_TOP
                                    + li * LABEL_LINE_H))
            self._status_line(surface, rect, item_id, entry, owned, wearing,
                              balance)

    def _status_line(self, surface, rect, item_id, entry, owned, wearing,
                     balance):
        """Price, OWNED, or EQUIPPED - the one line that decides a click."""
        if _is_worn(item_id, wearing):
            text, color = "EQUIPPED", C_ON
        elif item_id in owned:
            text, color = "OWNED", C_BODY
        elif entry["price"] > balance:
            text, color = "%s ACB" % _money(entry["price"]), C_UNAFFORD
        else:
            text, color = "%s ACB" % _money(entry["price"]), C_ORANGE
        surf = font_terminal_small.render(text, True, color)
        surface.blit(surf, (rect.centerx - surf.get_width() // 2,
                            rect.top + STATUS_TOP))

    def _draw_detail(self, surface, mouse):
        """Live preview, price, description and the one action button."""
        box = pygame.Rect(RIGHT_X, GRID_Y, RIGHT_W, PREVIEW_H)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_DARK, box)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_LINE, box, 1)

        item_id = self.selected
        if not item_id:
            surface.blit(font_prompt.render("SELECT AN ITEM", True, C_OFF),
                         (box.centerx - 66, box.centery - 8))
            return

        app = self._loadout_with(item_id)
        rig = (RIG_BY_GUN[appearance.FINISHES[item_id]["gun"]]
               if item_id in appearance.FINISHES else "os12")
        art = self._avatar(app, rig, 116, scale=2)
        surface.blit(art, (box.centerx - art.get_width() // 2,
                           box.centery - art.get_height() // 2))

        price = int(appearance.price_of(item_id) or 0)
        owned = item_id in profile_store.load()["owned"]
        if price == 0:
            cost, cost_color = "ISSUE - FREE", C_BODY
        elif owned:
            cost, cost_color = "OWNED", C_ON
        elif price > profile_store.balance():
            cost, cost_color = ("%s ACB - SHORT" % _money(price)), C_UNAFFORD
        else:
            cost, cost_color = "%s ACARIBUCKS" % _money(price), C_ORANGE
        text = font_terminal_small.render(cost, True, cost_color)
        surface.blit(text, (RIGHT_X + (RIGHT_W - text.get_width()) // 2,
                            COST_Y))

        surface.blit(font_terminal.render(
            _fit(font_terminal, appearance.item_label(item_id).upper(),
                 GRID_W - 12), True, C_HEAD),
            (GRID_X, DESC_Y))
        _wrap(surface, appearance.item_desc(item_id), GRID_X, DESC_Y + 26,
              GRID_W - 12, font_terminal_small, C_BODY, 2)

        hot = ACTION.collidepoint(mouse)
        if hot:
            note_hover()
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_SEL if hot else C_DARK, ACTION)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ON, ACTION, 1)
        worn = _is_worn(item_id, profile_store.equipped())
        label = "WORN" if worn else ("BUY & WEAR" if not owned else "WEAR")
        text = font_prompt.render(label, True, C_HEAD if hot else C_BODY)
        surface.blit(text, (ACTION.centerx - text.get_width() // 2,
                            ACTION.centery - text.get_height() // 2))

    def _draw_footer(self, surface, mouse):
        hot = BACK.collidepoint(mouse)
        if hot:
            note_hover()
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_MID if hot else C_DARK, BACK)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_LINE, BACK, 1)
        text = font_prompt.render("BACK", True, C_HEAD if hot else C_BODY)
        surface.blit(text, (BACK.centerx - text.get_width() // 2,
                            BACK.centery - text.get_height() // 2))
        hint = font_terminal_small.render(
            "LEFT/RIGHT TAB   ENTER CONFIRM   ESC BACK", True, C_OFF)
        surface.blit(hint, (BACK.right + 24, BACK.centery - 7))
        if self.toast:
            toast = font_terminal.render(self.toast, True, C_ORANGE)
            surface.blit(toast, (PANEL_X + PANEL_W - 28 - toast.get_width(),
                                 BACK.centery - 11))


# ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _is_worn(item_id, wearing):
    """Is this exact catalog id what the profile currently has equipped?"""
    if item_id == wearing["palette"] or item_id == wearing["head"]:
        return True
    return item_id in wearing["finish"].values()


def _gun_label(gun):
    return {"os12": "OS-12", "k9": "K-9", "pistol": "PISTOL"}.get(gun, gun)


def _name_lines(font, name, max_w):
    """Split an item name across at most two lines, breaking between words.

    Returns a single line whenever the name already fits, so "Issue" and
    "Beret" stay on one row and the grid does not read as having a gap in it.
    Only the names that genuinely need the second row get one.
    """
    words = str(name).split()
    if not words:
        return [""]
    joined = " ".join(words)
    if font.size(joined)[0] <= max_w:
        return [joined]
    # Grow line one word by word until adding the next would overflow.
    count = 1
    while (count < len(words)
           and font.size(" ".join(words[:count + 1]))[0] <= max_w):
        count += 1
    line1 = _fit(font, " ".join(words[:count]), max_w)
    rest = " ".join(words[count:])
    return [line1] if not rest else [line1, _fit(font, rest, max_w)]


def _wrap(surface, text, x, y, width, font, color, max_lines=2):
    """Greedy word wrap, capped at max_lines with a visible cut."""
    words = str(text).split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        trial = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if not current or font.size(trial)[0] <= width:
            current = trial
            continue
        lines.append(current)
        current = word
        if len(lines) == max_lines:
            break
    if current and len(lines) < max_lines:
        lines.append(current)
    if len(lines) == max_lines and " ".join(lines).split() != words:
        # Something was dropped, so mark the cut. Measured, because the last
        # line is already exactly as wide as the column allows.
        lines[-1] = _fit(font, lines[-1], width)
    for i, line in enumerate(lines[:max_lines]):
        surface.blit(font.render(line, True, color), (x, y + i * 16))
