def _draw_browser_generic_page(surface, rect, font_big, font, font_small):
    """Render a browser page from the BROWSER_PAGES dict (news/weather/forum/freedom)."""
    page_data = BROWSER_PAGES.get(_browser_page, BROWSER_PAGES["news"])
    title = page_data["title"]
    if title:
        # Chromatic aberration on the page title (bright text).
        title_w = font_big.size(title)[0]
        _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_big, title,
                             (rect.centerx - title_w // 2, rect.y + 16),
                             CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)
    # Content lines.
    y = rect.y + 50
    for prefix, text, color in page_data["lines"]:
        if not text and not prefix:
            y += 10
            continue
        if color is None:
            color = CRT_GREEN
        if prefix:
            # Prefix tag (e.g. "BREAKING", "ALERT") in a colored box.
            prefix_surf = font_small.render(prefix, True, CRT_BG)
            pw = prefix_surf.get_width() + 8
            tag_rect = pygame.Rect(rect.x + 20, y, pw, 16)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, color, tag_rect, border_radius=2)
            surface.blit(prefix_surf, (tag_rect.x + 4, tag_rect.y + 1))
            # Text after the tag.
            txt = font.render(text, True, color)
            surface.blit(txt, (rect.x + 20 + pw + 6, y))
        else:
            txt = font.render(text, True, color)
            surface.blit(txt, (rect.x + 20, y))
        y += 22


def _draw_file_picker(surface):
    """Phase 5: File picker in a Win XP-style window."""
    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 16, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 14)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 12)
    _draw_ipa_wallpaper(surface)
    win_rect = pygame.Rect(WIDTH // 2 - 340, 60, 680, 440)
    body_rect = _draw_xp_window(surface, win_rect,
                                _prof("Select Evidence Files", "Select Vostral Files"),
                                font, font_small)
    instr = font_small.render(f"Select all 3 files ({len(_file_picker_selected)}/3 selected)", True, CRT_GREEN)
    surface.blit(instr, (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 10))
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    for i, file in enumerate(EVIDENCE_FILES):
        row_y = body_rect.y + 40 + i * 40
        row_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.x + 12, row_y, body_rect.w - 24, 32)
        hovered = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        selected = i in _file_picker_selected
        if selected:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (12, 55, 28), row_rect, radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        elif hovered:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (8, 35, 18), row_rect, radius=3)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        else:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DARK, row_rect, 1, border_radius=3)
        checkbox_rect = pygame.Rect(row_rect.x + 10, row_rect.centery - 8, 16, 16)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 15, 8), checkbox_rect, radius=2)
        border_col = CRT_BRIGHT if selected else (CRT_GREEN if hovered else CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, border_col, checkbox_rect, radius=2, width=1)
        if selected:
            pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (checkbox_rect.x + 3, checkbox_rect.centery), (checkbox_rect.x + 7, checkbox_rect.bottom - 3), 2)
            pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (checkbox_rect.x + 7, checkbox_rect.bottom - 3), (checkbox_rect.right - 3, checkbox_rect.y + 3), 2)
        doc_x = row_rect.x + 36; doc_y = row_rect.centery - 12
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (8, 35, 18), [(doc_x, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 24), (doc_x, doc_y + 24)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CRT_GREEN, [(doc_x, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 24), (doc_x, doc_y + 24)], 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_GREEN, (doc_x + 14, doc_y), (doc_x + 14, doc_y + 4), 1)
        pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_GREEN, (doc_x + 14, doc_y + 4), (doc_x + 18, doc_y + 4), 1)
        name = font.render(file["name"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if selected else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(name, (doc_x + 26, row_rect.centery - name.get_height() // 2))
        size = font_small.render(file["size"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        surface.blit(size, (row_rect.right - 180, row_rect.centery - size.get_height() // 2))
        desc = font_small.render(file["desc"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        surface.blit(desc, (row_rect.right - 140, row_rect.centery - desc.get_height() // 2))
    back_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.bottom - 38, 80, 28)
    _draw_xp_button(surface, back_rect, "[BACK]", font_small, hovered=back_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos))
    upload_rect = pygame.Rect(body_rect.centerx - 60, body_rect.bottom - 38, 120, 28)
    all_selected = len(_file_picker_selected) == 3
    _draw_xp_button(surface, upload_rect, "[UPLOAD]", font_small,
                     hovered=upload_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos) and all_selected,
                     enabled=all_selected, color=CRT_BRIGHT if all_selected else CRT_DARK)
    _draw_taskbar(surface, font_small)


def _draw_upload(surface):
    """Phase 6: Upload progress with rotating status messages + intrusion popups."""
    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 24, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)

    # Title (chromatic aberration - brightest text).
    _transmit_title = _prof("TRANSMITTING EVIDENCE", "CUTTING INTO LIVE FEED")
    title_w = font_big.size(_transmit_title)[0]
    _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_big, _transmit_title,
                         (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2, 120), CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)

    # ── Countdown: M3 runs on the slice's real 22:00 clock, M2 on its own ──
    live = _live_address_clock()
    if live is not None:
        bc_text = font_small.render("STATE ADDRESS IN: %s" % live, True, CRT_AMBER)
        if int(live.split(":")[1]) < 60:
            bc_text = font_small.render("STATE ADDRESS IN: %s" % live, True, CRT_RED)
    else:
        secs = _state_broadcast_timer // 60
        mins = secs // 60
        rem_secs = secs % 60
        bc_text = font_small.render(f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}",
                                    True, CRT_AMBER)
        if secs < 60 and (_state_broadcast_timer % 30) < 15:
            bc_text = font_small.render(
                f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}", True, CRT_RED)
    surface.blit(bc_text, (WIDTH - bc_text.get_width() - 20, 20))

    # M3: a live audience tally, so "going live" has a number attached.
    if _os_profile == PROFILE_M3:
        viewers = 120000 + int(_upload_progress * 3880000)
        tally = font_small.render("VIEWERS: %s" % f"{viewers:,}", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
        surface.blit(tally, (20, 20))
        talk = font_small.render("CAM 3 // UPLINK LIVE", True, CRT_AMBER)
        surface.blit(talk, (20, 38))

    # Status message.
    status = UPLOAD_STATUS_MESSAGES[_upload_status_idx]
    status_surf = font.render(status, True, CRT_GREEN)
    surface.blit(status_surf, (WIDTH // 2 - status_surf.get_width() // 2, 180))

    # Progress bar.
    bar_w = 500
    bar_h = 24
    bar_x = WIDTH // 2 - bar_w // 2
    bar_y = 240
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BG, (bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (bar_x, bar_y, bar_w, bar_h), 1)
    fill_w = int(bar_w * _upload_progress)
    if fill_w > 0:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bar_x, bar_y, fill_w, bar_h))
    pct = int(_upload_progress * 100)
    pct_text = font.render(f"{pct}%", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
    surface.blit(pct_text, (WIDTH // 2 - pct_text.get_width() // 2, bar_y + 30))

    # Status log.
    log_y = 320
    log_font = font_small
    shown_messages = UPLOAD_STATUS_MESSAGES[:_upload_status_idx + 1]
    for i, msg in enumerate(shown_messages):
        done = i < _upload_status_idx
        color = CRT_DIM_GREEN if done else CRT_BRIGHT
        prefix = "[OK] " if done else ">> "
        log_line = log_font.render(prefix + msg, True, color)
        surface.blit(log_line, (bar_x, log_y + i * 20))

    # ── IPA counter-intrusion popup ──
    # When active, pauses upload progress and shows a red modal demanding
    # the player click to reroute. Adds tension - "they're coming for you".
    if _upload_intrusion_active:
        # Dim the background.
        dim = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        dim.fill((40, 0, 0, 120))
        surface.blit(dim, (0, 0))
        # Modal window.
        mw, mh = 500, 180
        mx = WIDTH // 2 - mw // 2
        my = HEIGHT // 2 - mh // 2
        modal_rect = pygame.Rect(mx, my, mw, mh)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (20, 5, 5), modal_rect, radius=6)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_RED, modal_rect, radius=6, width=2)
        # Pulsing border.
        pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(_upload_intrusion_timer * 0.2)
        if pulse > 0.5:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (255, 100, 100), modal_rect, radius=6, width=1)
        # Title.
        intr_title = font_big.render(
            _prof("IPA FIREWALL TRACE", "STUDIO CUTS THE FEED"), True, CRT_RED)
        surface.blit(intr_title, (mx + mw // 2 - intr_title.get_width() // 2, my + 16))
        # Body.
        intr_body = font.render(
            _prof("Counter-intrusion detected. Rerouting transmission.",
                  "Master control is pushing back. Hold the feed."),
            True, CRT_AMBER)
        surface.blit(intr_body, (mx + mw // 2 - intr_body.get_width() // 2, my + 56))
        # Click hint.
        if (_upload_intrusion_timer % 30) < 15:
            hint = font_small.render("[CLICK] / [ANY KEY] TO REROUTE", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
            surface.blit(hint, (mx + mw // 2 - hint.get_width() // 2, my + 100))
    elif _upload_progress > 0.5:
        warn = font_small.render(
            _prof("IPA COUNTER-INTRUSION DETECTED - TRANSMISSION PROCEEDING",
                  "MASTER CONTROL PUSHING BACK - FEED HELD"),
            True, CRT_AMBER)
        surface.blit(warn, (WIDTH // 2 - warn.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT - 60))


def _draw_done(surface):
    """Phase 7: Upload complete - the payoff."""
    font_huge = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 36, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 18)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)

    # Big "UPLOAD COMPLETE" text (fades in, with chromatic aberration).
    fade = min(1.0, _done_timer / 30.0)
    title_w = font_huge.size("UPLOAD COMPLETE")[0]
    _draw_chromatic_text(surface, font_huge, "UPLOAD COMPLETE",
                         (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2, 180), CRT_BRIGHT, offset=1)
    # Apply fade by drawing a black overlay with inverse alpha.
    if fade < 1.0:
        fade_overlay = pygame.Surface((title_w + 10, font_huge.get_height() + 4), pygame.SRCALPHA)
        fade_overlay.fill((0, 0, 0, int(255 * (1 - fade))))
        surface.blit(fade_overlay, (WIDTH // 2 - title_w // 2 - 5, 178))

    # State broadcast countdown (still ticking - adds urgency even after upload).
    secs = _state_broadcast_timer // 60
    mins = secs // 60
    rem_secs = secs % 60
    bc_text = font_small.render(f"STATE BROADCAST IN: {mins:02d}:{rem_secs:02d}", True, CRT_AMBER)
    surface.blit(bc_text, (WIDTH - bc_text.get_width() - 20, 20))

    # Sub-text.
    if _done_timer > 40:
        sub_lines = _prof(
            [
                "Evidence package transmitted to 7 mirror sites.",
                "Journalist contacts notified.",
                "The Route 12 conspiracy is now public record.",
            ],
            [
                "Vostral record cut into the live address.",
                "Balaceanu's career is now public record.",
                "The nation saw it live.",
            ],
        )
        for i, line in enumerate(sub_lines):
            sub = font.render(line, True, CRT_GREEN)
            sub.set_alpha(min(255, (_done_timer - 40) * 8))
            surface.blit(sub, (WIDTH // 2 - sub.get_width() // 2, 260 + i * 30))

    # "Continue" hint.
    if _done_timer > 60:
        hint = font_small.render("[CLICK] / [ANY KEY] to continue", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
        if (_done_timer % 30) < 15:
            surface.blit(hint, (WIDTH // 2 - hint.get_width() // 2, HEIGHT - 80))


def _draw_info(surface):
    """Info window for EVIDENCE / SYSTEM / LOGS icons.

    Now renders rich content:
      - evidence → file manager (tree + file list) OR document viewer (if _info_sub set)
      - system   → control panel grid OR sub-window (if _info_sub set)
      - logs     → waveform visualizer + scrolling radio log
    """
    # Defensive guard: if _info_content is None, fall back to desktop.
    if _info_content is None:
        global _os_phase
        _os_phase = PHASE_DESKTOP
        return

    font_big = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 16, bold=True)
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 14)
    font_small = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial", 12)

    # Draw the desktop wallpaper behind the window.
    _draw_ipa_wallpaper(surface)

    # Info window - centered, 560x460 (bigger for richer content).
    win_x = WIDTH // 2 - 280
    win_y = 100
    win_w, win_h = 560, 460
    win_rect = pygame.Rect(win_x, win_y, win_w, win_h)
    body_rect = _draw_xp_window(surface, win_rect, _get_info_title(), font, font_small)

    # Render the appropriate content.
    if _info_content == "evidence":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            _draw_evidence_document(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
        else:
            _draw_evidence_file_manager(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_content == "system":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            _draw_control_panel_sub(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
        else:
            _draw_control_panel_grid(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_content == "logs":
        _draw_logs_waveform(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)

    # Back button (when in a sub-view).
    if _info_sub is not None:
        back_rect = pygame.Rect(win_x + 12, win_y + win_h - 38, 80, 28)
        mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
        _draw_xp_button(surface, back_rect, "< BACK", font_small,
                        hovered=back_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos))

    # Hint.
    hint = font_small.render("[ESC] to close" + ("  ·  [ESC] back" if _info_sub else ""),
                             True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(hint, (body_rect.x + 100, win_y + win_h - 32))

    # Taskbar.
    _draw_taskbar(surface, font_small)


def _get_info_title():
    """Return the window title for the current info content/sub."""
    if _info_content == "evidence":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            doc = EVIDENCE_DOCS.get(_info_sub, {})
            return f"Evidence - {doc.get('title', _info_sub)}"
        return "Evidence - File Manager"
    elif _info_content == "system":
        if _info_sub is not None:
            for item in CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS:
                if item["id"] == _info_sub:
                    return f"Control Panel - {item['label']}"
            return "Control Panel"
        return "Control Panel"
    elif _info_content == "logs":
        return "Radio Transmission Logs"
    return "Info"


def _draw_evidence_file_manager(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Win-95 style file manager: tree pane (left) + file list (right)."""
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    # ── Left pane: folder tree ──
    tree_x = body_rect.x + 8
    tree_y = body_rect.y + 8
    tree_w = 140
    tree_h = body_rect.h - 16
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 15, 8), (tree_x, tree_y, tree_w, tree_h), radius=3)
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (tree_x, tree_y, tree_w, tree_h), radius=3, width=1)
    # Tree header.
    header = font_small.render("FOLDERS", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(header, (tree_x + 8, tree_y + 6))
    # Folders.
    folders = _prof(
        [
            ("C:\\EVIDENCE", True),  # expanded
            ("  decrees", False),
            ("  logs", False),
            ("  drafts", False),
            ("C:\\SYSTEM", False),
            ("  drivers", False),
            ("  config", False),
        ],
        [
            ("C:\\VOSTRAL", True),  # expanded
            ("  records", False),
            ("  keys", False),
            ("  drafts", False),
            ("C:\\SYSTEM", False),
            ("  drivers", False),
            ("  config", False),
        ],
    )
    fy = tree_y + 24
    for name, expanded in folders:
        is_active = name.strip() == _prof("decrees", "records")
        col = CRT_BRIGHT if is_active else CRT_GREEN
        # Folder icon (small square).
        ix = tree_x + 8
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (ix, fy + 2, 8, 6), border_radius=1)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, col, (ix, fy, 4, 3), border_radius=1)
        txt = font_small.render(name, True, col)
        surface.blit(txt, (ix + 12, fy))
        fy += 18

    # ── Right pane: file list ──
    list_x = tree_x + tree_w + 4
    list_y = tree_y
    list_w = body_rect.w - tree_w - 20
    list_h = tree_h
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (2, 12, 6), (list_x, list_y, list_w, list_h), radius=3)
    _draw_rounded_rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (list_x, list_y, list_w, list_h), radius=3, width=1)
    # Column headers.
    col_y = list_y + 6
    surface.blit(font_small.render("NAME", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 28, col_y))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("SIZE", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 200, col_y))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("MODIFIED", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 260, col_y))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DARK, (list_x + 4, col_y + 16), (list_x + list_w - 4, col_y + 16), 1)
    # Files.
    files = _prof(
        [
            ("decree_47.txt", "2.1K", "03/14 03:12", "decree"),
            ("auth_chain.log", "4.8K", "03/14 03:08", "auth_chain"),
            ("mag_packet.draft", "1.4K", "03/14 02:55", "mag_packet"),
        ],
        [
            ("service_record.txt", "3.3K", "21:58 21:12", "decree"),
            ("feed_keys.log", "1.9K", "21:58 21:08", "auth_chain"),
            ("route12_truth.draft", "2.6K", "21:58 20:55", "mag_packet"),
        ],
    )
    for i, (fname, fsize, fmod, fid) in enumerate(files):
        ry = list_y + 28 + i * 40
        row_rect = pygame.Rect(list_x + 4, ry, list_w - 8, 32)
        hovered = row_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        selected = (_last_clicked_file == i)
        if selected:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (12, 55, 28), row_rect, radius=2)
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, row_rect, 1, border_radius=2)
        elif hovered:
            _draw_rounded_rect(surface, (8, 35, 18), row_rect, radius=2)
        # File icon (document shape).
        ix = list_x + 8
        iy = ry + 8
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, (8, 35, 18),
                            [(ix, iy), (ix + 10, iy), (ix + 14, iy + 4),
                             (ix + 14, iy + 16), (ix, iy + 16)])
        pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CRT_GREEN,
                            [(ix, iy), (ix + 10, iy), (ix + 14, iy + 4),
                             (ix + 14, iy + 16), (ix, iy + 16)], 1)
        # Name.
        name_col = CRT_BRIGHT if (selected or hovered) else CRT_GREEN
        surface.blit(font.render(fname, True, name_col), (list_x + 28, ry + 8))
        surface.blit(font_small.render(fsize, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 200, ry + 10))
        surface.blit(font_small.render(fmod, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (list_x + 260, ry + 10))
    # Double-click hint.
    hint = font_small.render("Double-click a file to view its contents", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(hint, (list_x + 4, list_y + list_h - 18))


def _draw_evidence_document(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Document viewer - renders the evidence file based on its kind."""
    doc = EVIDENCE_DOCS.get(_info_sub, EVIDENCE_DOCS["decree"])
    kind = doc.get("kind", "decree")
    doc_x = body_rect.x + 12
    doc_y = body_rect.y + 12
    doc_w = body_rect.w - 24
    doc_h = body_rect.h - 50

    if kind == "decree":
        _draw_doc_decree(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)
    elif kind == "terminal":
        _draw_doc_terminal(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)
    elif kind == "draft":
        _draw_doc_draft(surface, doc, doc_x, doc_y, doc_w, doc_h, font, font_small)


def _draw_doc_decree(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Official decree on letterhead with a seal."""
    # Paper background (off-white, slightly yellowed).
    paper = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    paper.fill((230, 222, 195, 240))
    surface.blit(paper, (x, y))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (140, 130, 100), (x, y, w, h), 1)
    # Letterhead.
    head_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 18, bold=True)
    sub_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 12, italic=True)
    body_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 13)
    foot_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Times New Roman", 10)
    # Header text.
    h1 = head_font.render(doc["header"], True, (30, 25, 15))
    surface.blit(h1, (x + w // 2 - h1.get_width() // 2, y + 16))
    h2 = sub_font.render(doc["subheader"], True, (80, 65, 40))
    surface.blit(h2, (x + w // 2 - h2.get_width() // 2, y + 40))
    # Divider.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (120, 100, 60), (x + 40, y + 60), (x + w - 40, y + 60), 1)
    # Seal (circle with text).
    seal_cx = x + w - 50
    seal_cy = y + 90
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (140, 30, 30), (seal_cx, seal_cy), 28, 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, (140, 30, 30), (seal_cx, seal_cy), 22, 1)
    seal_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 14, bold=True)
    seal_txt = seal_font.render(doc["seal_text"], True, (140, 30, 30))
    surface.blit(seal_txt, (seal_cx - seal_txt.get_width() // 2, seal_cy - seal_txt.get_height() // 2))
    # Body text.
    ty = y + 80
    for line in doc["body_lines"]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # Signature lines get bold.
        is_sig = "Retardovici" in line or "President" in line
        f = head_font if is_sig else body_font
        col = (20, 15, 10) if is_sig else (35, 30, 20)
        txt = f.render(line, True, col)
        surface.blit(txt, (x + 40, ty))
        ty += 20
    # Footer.
    foot = foot_font.render(doc["footer"], True, (100, 80, 50))
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 40, y + h - 24))


def _draw_doc_terminal(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Green-on-black terminal log."""
    # Terminal background.
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (4, 12, 8), (x, y, w, h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (x, y, w, h), 1, border_radius=3)
    term_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 13)
    # Header.
    surface.blit(term_font.render(doc["header"], True, CRT_BRIGHT), (x + 12, y + 12))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (x + 8, y + 32), (x + w - 8, y + 32), 1)
    # Body lines.
    ty = y + 40
    for line in doc["body_lines"]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # [REDACTED] text gets a black bar.
        if "[REDACTED]" in line:
            # Render the parts around [REDACTED].
            parts = line.split("[REDACTED]")
            cx = x + 12
            for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                if part:
                    txt = term_font.render(part, True, CRT_GREEN)
                    surface.blit(txt, (cx, ty))
                    cx += txt.get_width()
                if i < len(parts) - 1:
                    # Draw the redaction bar.
                    bar_w = term_font.size("[REDACTED]")[0]
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (0, 0, 0), (cx, ty, bar_w, 16))
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (cx, ty, bar_w, 16), 1)
                    cx += bar_w
        else:
            col = CRT_AMBER if "WARNING" in line or "COMPROMISED" in line else CRT_GREEN
            txt = term_font.render(line, True, col)
            surface.blit(txt, (x + 12, ty))
        ty += 18
    # Footer.
    foot = term_font.render(doc["footer"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 12, y + h - 24))
    # Blinking cursor at the end.
    if (_os_timer % 24) < 12:
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (x + 12 + foot.get_width() + 4, y + h - 24, 8, 14))


def _draw_doc_draft(surface, doc, x, y, w, h, font, font_small):
    """Typewritten draft with redactions."""
    # Paper background (slightly creased).
    paper = pygame.Surface((w, h), pygame.SRCALPHA)
    paper.fill((240, 235, 215, 240))
    surface.blit(paper, (x, y))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (120, 110, 85), (x, y, w, h), 1)
    draft_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 12)
    head_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 12, bold=True)
    # Header (DRAFT stamp).
    stamp_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 28, bold=True)
    stamp = stamp_font.render("DRAFT", True, (180, 30, 30))
    stamp.set_alpha(120)
    surface.blit(stamp, (x + w - 100, y + 20))
    # Header lines.
    ty = y + 16
    for line in doc["body_lines"][:4]:  # TO/FROM/RE
        txt = head_font.render(line, True, (40, 30, 20))
        surface.blit(txt, (x + 20, ty))
        ty += 16
    ty += 8
    # Body.
    for line in doc["body_lines"][4:]:
        if not line:
            ty += 8
            continue
        # [REDACTED] handling.
        if "[REDACTED]" in line:
            parts = line.split("[REDACTED]")
            cx = x + 20
            for i, part in enumerate(parts):
                if part:
                    txt = draft_font.render(part, True, (35, 30, 20))
                    surface.blit(txt, (cx, ty))
                    cx += txt.get_width()
                if i < len(parts) - 1:
                    bar_w = draft_font.size("[REDACTED]")[0]
                    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (15, 15, 15), (cx, ty, bar_w, 14))
                    cx += bar_w
        else:
            # Numbered lines get emphasis.
            col = (120, 30, 20) if (line.strip().startswith(tuple("1234")) and "." in line[:3]) else (35, 30, 20)
            txt = draft_font.render(line, True, col)
            surface.blit(txt, (x + 20, ty))
        ty += 16
    # Footer.
    foot = pygame.font.SysFont("Courier New", 10).render(doc["footer"], True, (100, 80, 50))
    surface.blit(foot, (x + 20, y + h - 24))


def _draw_control_panel_grid(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Grid of clickable control panel icons."""
    mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()
    # Grid of 5 icons (3 columns x 2 rows, last row has 2).
    grid_x = body_rect.x + 40
    grid_y = body_rect.y + 30
    icon_w, icon_h = 80, 80
    gap_x, gap_y = 120, 110
    for i, item in enumerate(CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS):
        col = i % 3
        row = i // 3
        ix = grid_x + col * (icon_w + gap_x)
        iy = grid_y + row * (icon_h + gap_y)
        icon_rect = pygame.Rect(ix, iy, icon_w, icon_h)
        hovered = icon_rect.collidepoint(mouse_pos)
        # Icon background.
        bg = (15, 60, 30) if hovered else (8, 35, 18)
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, bg, icon_rect, radius=6)
        border = CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN
        _draw_rounded_rect(surface, border, icon_rect, radius=6, width=1)
        # Icon symbol (big letter).
        sym_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Arial Black", 32, bold=True)
        sym = sym_font.render(item["icon"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(sym, (icon_rect.centerx - sym.get_width() // 2,
                           icon_rect.centery - sym.get_height() // 2 - 8))
        # Label.
        lbl = font_small.render(item["label"], True, CRT_BRIGHT if hovered else CRT_GREEN)
        surface.blit(lbl, (icon_rect.centerx - lbl.get_width() // 2, icon_rect.bottom - 18))
    # Description hint for hovered icon.
    for i, item in enumerate(CONTROL_PANEL_ITEMS):
        col = i % 3
        row = i // 3
        ix = grid_x + col * (icon_w + gap_x)
        iy = grid_y + row * (icon_h + gap_y)
        if pygame.Rect(ix, iy, icon_w, icon_h).collidepoint(mouse_pos):
            desc = font_small.render(item["desc"], True, CRT_DIM_GREEN)
            surface.blit(desc, (body_rect.centerx - desc.get_width() // 2, body_rect.bottom - 30))
            break


def _draw_control_panel_sub(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Sub-window for a control panel item (Display, Sound, Network, etc.)."""
    if _info_sub == "display":
        _draw_cp_display(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "sound":
        _draw_cp_sound(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "network":
        _draw_cp_network(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "security":
        _draw_cp_security(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)
    elif _info_sub == "about":
        _draw_cp_about(surface, body_rect, font, font_small)


def _draw_cp_display(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Display settings - fake resolution + brightness sliders."""
    surface.blit(font.render("Display Properties", True, CRT_BRIGHT), (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 8))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Resolution:", True, CRT_GREEN), (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 40))
    surface.blit(font.render("1000 x 700 (recommended)", True, CRT_BRIGHT), (body_rect.x + 120, body_rect.y + 38))
    # Fake slider.
    sx = body_rect.x + 12
    sy = body_rect.y + 70
    sw = body_rect.w - 24
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (sx, sy, sw, 6), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (sx, sy, sw * 7 // 10, 6), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (sx + sw * 7 // 10, sy + 3), 6)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, CRT_DARK, (sx + sw * 7 // 10, sy + 3), 6, 1)
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Brightness:", True, CRT_GREEN), (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 90))
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DARK, (sx, body_rect.y + 120, sw, 6), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (sx, body_rect.y + 120, sw * 5 // 10, 6), border_radius=2)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, (sx + sw * 5 // 10, body_rect.y + 123), 6)
    pygame.draw.circle(surface, CRT_DARK, (sx + sw * 5 // 10, body_rect.y + 123), 6, 1)
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Color depth: 8-bit (CRT phosphor)", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN),
                 (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 140))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Refresh rate: 60 Hz (interlaced)", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN),
                 (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 158))


def _draw_cp_sound(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Sound settings - volume slider + mute toggle."""
    surface.blit(font.render("Sound Properties", True, CRT_BRIGHT), (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 8))
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Master Volume:", True, CRT_GREEN), (body_rect.x + 12, body_rect.y + 40))
    sx = body_rect.x + 12
    sy = body_rect.y + 70
    sw = body_rect.w - 24

def _draw_logs_waveform(surface, body_rect, font, font_small):
    """Waveform visualizer at top + scrolling radio log below."""
    # ── Waveform visualizer (top third) ──
    wf_x = body_rect.x + 12
    wf_y = body_rect.y + 12
    wf_w = body_rect.w - 24
    wf_h = 80
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (2, 12, 6), (wf_x, wf_y, wf_w, wf_h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (wf_x, wf_y, wf_w, wf_h), 1, border_radius=3)
    # Center line.
    pygame.draw.line(surface, (10, 30, 18), (wf_x + 4, wf_y + wf_h // 2), (wf_x + wf_w - 4, wf_y + wf_h // 2), 1)
    # Bars.
    n_bars = len(_waveform_bars)
    bar_w = max(2, (wf_w - 8) // n_bars - 1)
    for i, val in enumerate(_waveform_bars):
        bh = max(2, int(val * (wf_h // 2 - 4)))
        bx = wf_x + 4 + i * (bar_w + 1)
        # Top half.
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bx, wf_y + wf_h // 2 - bh, bar_w, bh))
        # Bottom half (mirror).
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_GREEN, (bx, wf_y + wf_h // 2, bar_w, bh))
    # Label (+ drawn diamond: "◆" as text is tofu on machines without the glyph).
    label_surf = font_small.render("LIVE SIGNAL", True, CRT_BRIGHT)
    lx, ly = wf_x + 18, wf_y + 4
    surface.blit(label_surf, (lx, ly))
    _dw, _dh = 7, 7
    _dcx, _dcy = wf_x + 11, ly + label_surf.get_height() // 2
    pygame.draw.polygon(surface, CRT_BRIGHT, [
        (_dcx, _dcy - _dh // 2), (_dcx + _dw // 2, _dcy),
        (_dcx, _dcy + _dh // 2), (_dcx - _dw // 2, _dcy),
    ])
    # Frequency readout (fake).
    freq = 2400 + int(_waveform_bars[20] * 200)
    surface.blit(font_small.render(f"{freq} Hz", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (wf_x + wf_w - 60, wf_y + 4))

    # ── Radio log (bottom two-thirds) ──
    log_x = body_rect.x + 12
    log_y = wf_y + wf_h + 8
    log_w = body_rect.w - 24
    log_h = body_rect.h - wf_h - 60
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, (4, 12, 8), (log_x, log_y, log_w, log_h), border_radius=3)
    pygame.draw.rect(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (log_x, log_y, log_w, log_h), 1, border_radius=3)
    # Header.
    surface.blit(font_small.render("TIME    SOURCE    MESSAGE", True, CRT_DIM_GREEN),
                 (log_x + 12, log_y + 6))
    pygame.draw.line(surface, CRT_DIM_GREEN, (log_x + 8, log_y + 22), (log_x + log_w - 8, log_y + 22), 1)
    # Log entries - pull from STATE via _get_radio_log_lines().
    radio_lines = _get_radio_log_lines()
    if radio_lines is None:
        # Fallback static content.
        radio_lines = [
            ("SYSTEM", "Radio transmission logs (decoded):", CRT_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "Balaceanu logistics. Not MAG.", CRT_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "Hidden detonator! Run to shelter!", CRT_AMBER),
            ("SYSTEM", "Tanker detonation detected.", CRT_RED),
            ("VASILE", "[signal degraded]", CRT_DIM_GREEN),
            ("VASILE", "You made it. Control building.", CRT_GREEN),
            ("SYSTEM", "Evidence files recovered (3/3)", CRT_BRIGHT),
        ]
    term_font = pygame.font.SysFont("Consolas", 12)
    ty = log_y + 28
    # Fake timestamps.
    base_time = 342  # 03:42
    for i, (prefix, text, color) in enumerate(radio_lines):
        ts = base_time + i * 2
        ts_str = f"{ts // 60:02d}:{ts % 60:02d}"
        surface.blit(term_font.render(ts_str, True, CRT_DIM_GREEN), (log_x + 12, ty))
        surface.blit(term_font.render(prefix[:8], True, color), (log_x + 70, ty))
        # Truncate text if too long.
        max_text_w = log_w - 160
        display_text = text
        while term_font.size(display_text)[0] > max_text_w and len(display_text) > 3:
            display_text = display_text[:-1]
        if display_text != text:
            display_text += "..."
        surface.blit(term_font.render(display_text, True, color), (log_x + 140, ty))
        ty += 16
        if ty > log_y + log_h - 16:
            break
    # Signal quality footer.
    surface.blit(font_small.render("Signal quality: DEGRADED  ·  Comms: INTERMITTENT", True, CRT_AMBER),
                 (log_x + 12, log_y + log_h + 6))

"""Split from menu.py - see menu.py (shim) for the map."""
from core.config import *

from core.state import STATE


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Shared hover bookkeeping (for the custom arrow cursor)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ui.main.draw_menu_cursor() wants to know "is the pointer over something
# clickable?" so it can switch from white to orange. Every interactive widget
# already calls check_hover() once per frame, so a single module-level flag
# covers every menu screen without each screen knowing the cursor exists.
#
# The cursor CONSUMES the flag (reads + clears) when it draws, which is the
# last thing to happen each frame. Any screen that draws no cursor simply
# leaves it clear for the next one.
_hover_hot = False


def note_hover(hot=True):
    """Mark that the pointer is over an interactive widget this frame."""
    global _hover_hot
    if hot:
        _hover_hot = True


def consume_hover():
    """Return (and clear) whether anything was hovered since the last frame."""
    global _hover_hot
    hot = _hover_hot
    _hover_hot = False
    return hot


def clipboard_text(max_len=512):
    """Best-effort clipboard read, for Ctrl+V paste in text fields.

    Every text box in the game types via ``KEYDOWN.unicode``, but a paste
    is not a keypress - SDL delivers it as a ``TEXTINPUT`` event that no
    field reads, so Ctrl+V silently did nothing. Paste must therefore pull
    the clipboard explicitly. Returns "" on any platform/init failure, and
    strips non-printable characters (clipboards often carry a trailing NUL,
    and a single-line field must not gain newlines/tabs).
    """
    try:
        if not (pygame.scrap.get_init() or pygame.scrap.init()):
            return ""
        data = pygame.scrap.get(pygame.SCRAP_TEXT)
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if not data:
        return ""
    if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)):
        try:
            data = bytes(data).decode("utf-8")
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            data = bytes(data).decode("latin-1", "ignore")
    return "".join(ch for ch in str(data) if ch.isprintable())[:max_len]


class ModernButton:
    """Menu button with dt-based scale, glow, and click feedback.

    Polish layers (applied on top of the existing slide-on-hover behavior):
      - Hover:   text scales up to 1.04x, left accent bar gets a soft orange
                 glow halo, chevron brightens.
      - Click:   button visually dips +2px on Y and emits a brief 180ms white
                 flash overlay.
      - Keyboard selection (arrow keys): same visual as hover, plus a brighter
        left bar so the user can always see which item is focused.

    All animation state is updated with delta time so the feel is identical at
    60Hz, 144Hz, or under frame drops. The lerp constants below are tuned for
    a 60Hz frame; the per-frame coefficient is recomputed from dt so motion
    stays frame-rate independent.
    """

    # Lerp speeds in "fraction of remaining distance per second".
    # Higher = snappier. Tune here, used by _lerp_dt.
    _SLIDE_SPEED = 12.0      # hover slide-in
    _SCALE_SPEED = 14.0      # hover scale-up
    _GLOW_SPEED = 10.0       # left-bar glow ramp
    _PRESS_SPEED = 18.0      # click Y-dip recover
    _FLASH_DECAY = 5.5       # post-click white flash fade

    def __init__(self, x, y, text):

        self.x, self.y, self.text = x, y, text

        self.width, self.height = 300, 40

        self.rect = pygame.Rect(x, y, self.width, self.height)

        self.is_hovered = False
        self.is_selected = False   # keyboard focus (arrow keys)
        self._prev_hover = False

        # Animated state - all updated via dt-based lerp.
        self.anim_offset = 0.0     # horizontal slide on hover
        self.scale = 1.0           # text scale, 1.0 idle → 1.04 hover
        self.glow_alpha = 0.0      # 0..255, left accent bar glow
        self.press_dip = 0.0       # 0..2px Y dip on click
        self.flash_timer = 0.0     # seconds remaining of click flash

        # Pre-rendered glow surface for the left accent bar (regenerated only
        # if the bar geometry changes - currently fixed at 9px wide).
        self._glow_surf = pygame.Surface((24, self.height + 20), pygame.SRCALPHA)

    # ---- public API -------------------------------------------------------

    def update(self, dt):
        """Advance animation state by dt seconds.

        Called once per frame by draw_menu() for every visible button. Idempotent
        when called with dt=0 - safe to skip if the frame is paused.
        """
        active = self.is_hovered or self.is_selected
        # Hover/selected drive the slide + scale + glow in unison so the
        # keyboard-focus and mouse-focus feel identical.
        self.anim_offset = _lerp_dt(self.anim_offset, 20.0 if active else 0.0,
                                    self._SLIDE_SPEED, dt)
        self.scale = _lerp_dt(self.scale, 1.04 if active else 1.0,
                              self._SCALE_SPEED, dt)
        self.glow_alpha = _lerp_dt(self.glow_alpha, 220.0 if active else 0.0,
                                   self._GLOW_SPEED, dt)

        # Click dip recovers on its own.
        if self.press_dip > 0.0:
            self.press_dip = _lerp_dt(self.press_dip, 0.0,
                                      self._PRESS_SPEED, dt)
            if self.press_dip < 0.05:
                self.press_dip = 0.0

        # Flash decays linearly with time.
        if self.flash_timer > 0.0:
            self.flash_timer = max(0.0, self.flash_timer - dt)

    def press(self):
        """Trigger click feedback: 2px Y dip + 180ms white flash."""
        self.press_dip = 2.0
        self.flash_timer = 0.18

    def draw(self, surface):

        text_color = C_WHITE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else C_GREY

        actual_x = self.x + int(self.anim_offset)
        actual_y = self.y + int(self.press_dip)

        # Always-visible tick mark (orange accent bar on the left)
        tick_col = C_ORANGE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else (90, 55, 20)
        pygame.draw.rect(surface, tick_col,
                         (self.x - 25, self.y + 6, 3, self.height - 12))

        # Soft glow halo around the left bar - only when active.
        if self.glow_alpha > 4.0:
            self._glow_surf.fill((0, 0, 0, 0))
            for r, a_mult in [(12, 0.25), (8, 0.45), (5, 0.75)]:
                a = int(self.glow_alpha * a_mult)
                if a <= 0:
                    continue
                pygame.draw.rect(
                    self._glow_surf, (255, 120, 0, a),
                    (12 - r, 10 - r + 2, r * 2, self.height + r * 2 - 4),
                    border_radius=r,
                )
            surface.blit(self._glow_surf, (self.x - 36, self.y - 10))

        # Always-visible chevron prefix
        chevron_col = C_ORANGE if (self.is_hovered or self.is_selected) else (110, 110, 110)
        chevron = font_btn.render(">", True, chevron_col)
        surface.blit(chevron, (self.x - 15, actual_y + 4))

        # Solid orange left bar + hover background - only when active.
        if self.is_hovered or self.is_selected:
            pygame.draw.rect(surface, C_ORANGE,
                             (actual_x - 15, actual_y, 5, self.height))
            surface.blit(_btn_hover_bg, (actual_x - 5, actual_y))

        # Scaled text. Pygame doesn't do sub-pixel scale cleanly on SysFont,
        # so we round to the nearest int. The 1.04x gain is small but reads
        # clearly in motion.
        text_surf = font_btn.render(self.text, True, text_color)
        if self.scale > 1.01:
            new_w = max(1, int(text_surf.get_width() * self.scale))
            new_h = max(1, int(text_surf.get_height() * self.scale))
            text_surf = pygame.transform.smoothscale(text_surf, (new_w, new_h))
        surface.blit(text_surf, (actual_x, actual_y + 4))

        # Click flash overlay - white tint that fades over 180ms.
        if self.flash_timer > 0.0:
            flash_alpha = int(140 * (self.flash_timer / 0.18))
            flash = pygame.Surface((self.width, self.height), pygame.SRCALPHA)
            flash.fill((255, 240, 200, flash_alpha))
            surface.blit(flash, (actual_x - 5, actual_y))

    def check_hover(self, mp):

        self._prev_hover = self.is_hovered

        self.is_hovered = self.rect.collidepoint(mp)

        if self.is_hovered and not self._prev_hover:

            audio.play("menu_hover", volume=0.3)

        # Report to the shared cursor so the custom arrow can switch to its
        # orange "hot" state on ANY menu screen, not just the main menu.
        if self.is_hovered:
            note_hover()

    def is_clicked(self, event, mp):

        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button == 1 and self.is_hovered:

            audio.play("menu_click", volume=0.5)
            self.press()
            return True

        return False

def _lerp_dt(current, target, speed_per_sec, dt):
    """Frame-rate-independent exponential lerp.

    `speed_per_sec` is the approximate "fraction of remaining distance closed
    per second". At 60fps with speed=12, this behaves like the old `* 0.2`
    per-frame lerp but stays correct at any frame rate.
    """
    if dt <= 0:
        return current
    # Equivalent to applying `* k` per-frame where k = 1 - exp(-speed * dt).
    k = 1.0 - math.exp(-speed_per_sec * dt)
    return current + (target - current) * k

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\assemble_final_trailer.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""assemble_final_trailer.py - Post-production assembler for CALL OF ACARISTAN.

Takes the three clean combat acts captured by Terminal 8
(``trailers/fresh_action/act{1,2,3}.mp4``), splices the game's own title /
divider / stamp / end cards between them, and mixes a trailer audio bed
against the in-repo SFX + radio bank.

Design notes
------------
* Title cards are NOT re-implemented. They are rendered headless through the
  game's existing card renderer (``tools/render_trailer_v2.card`` for the
  PLAN_2 title/divider/stamp finish, ``tools/render_trailer.end_card`` for the
  AI-4 CTA lockup), so the cards match the in-game look (Oswald / IBM Plex
  Mono, 255,120,0 accent, vignette, fade finish) instead of being an ffmpeg
  re-creation that drifts.
* The picture is assembled with ffmpeg's ``concat`` *filter* (not the demuxer)
  so a timebase mismatch in the acts cannot silently desync A/V. Every row is
  normalised to 1000x700 @ 30 fps CFR yuv420p and trimmed to its EDL duration
  before the join.
* Final grade follows ``docs/PLAN_3_AUDIO.md`` §5: 1000x700 blur-padded into
  1920x1080 over a darkened blurred background, audio loudnorm'd to
  -14 LUFS / -2 dBTP.
* Audio arrangement follows ``docs/PLAN_3_AUDIO.md`` §1 (arrangement),
  §2.2 (radio filters), §3 (hit stacks) and §4 (beat-sync map), retimed onto
  this assembly's EDL. 100 BPM grid = 0.6 s; every cut lands on the grid.
* **Gunshots are foley-driven, never hand-placed.** The acts are silent -
  ``tools/record_fresh_action.py`` captures with ``SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy`` and
  ``set_master_volume(0)``, so it logs every live shot to an
  ``act<N>.foley.json`` sidecar instead of an audio track. Guessing shot times
  here (the old ``4.2 + i*1.4`` loops) put reports on empty picture and left
  real muzzle flashes dry. ``tools/build_sfx_stem.py`` re-renders the real
  ``sfx_wav/`` stacks at the logged ticks; this script calls it with this EDL's
  act offsets and mixes the result as the diegetic stem.

Usage
-----
    python assemble_final_trailer.py
    python assemble_final_trailer.py --probe          # print the EDL only
    python assemble_final_trailer.py --keep-stems     # keep intermediate wavs

Output
------
    trailer_final_master.mp4
"""

"""App.boot display ownership (ADAPTER A-001)."""
import os
import unittest

from tests.unit import _path  # noqa: F401  (puts src/ on sys.path)


class BootTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_force_mode_and_set_screen(self):
        os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
        import pygame
        from engine.core.app import App
        from engine.core.config import Settings
        app = App(Settings.load(env={"SDL_VIDEODRIVER": "dummy"}))
        try:
            app.boot(display_size=(320, 200), force_mode=True)
            self.assertEqual(app.screen.get_size(), (320, 200))
            self.assertIs(app.services.get("screen"), app.screen)
            self.assertIs(App.current(), app)
            other = pygame.Surface((10, 10))
            app.set_screen(other)
            self.assertIs(app.services.get("screen"), other)
        finally:
            app.shutdown()
        self.assertIsNone(App.current())


class RunSceneTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def _app(self):
        from engine.core.app import App
        from engine.core.config import Settings
        return App(Settings.load(env={}, overrides={"crash_dir": self._tmp}))

    def setUp(self):
        import tempfile
        self._tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()

    def test_runs_until_done(self):
        class S:
            n = 0
            done = False

            def frame(self):
                self.n += 1
                self.done = self.n >= 5
        s = S()
        self.assertEqual(self._app().run_scene(s), 0)
        self.assertEqual(s.n, 5)

    def test_crash_report_then_reraise(self):
        class Boom:
            done = False

            def frame(self):
                raise ValueError("boom")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self._app().run_scene(Boom())
        self.assertTrue(os.listdir(self._tmp))

    def test_system_exit_passes_through(self):
        class Exit:
            done = False

            def frame(self):
                raise SystemExit(0)
        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit):
            self._app().run_scene(Exit())
        self.assertFalse(os.listdir(self._tmp))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Unit tests for engine.core (stdlib unittest; run: python -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -t .)."""
import io
import random
import tempfile
import unittest
from dataclasses import dataclass

from tests.unit import _path  # noqa: F401

from engine.core import (AEError, App, Clock, EventBus, Log, RngStreams, ServiceMissing, Services, Settings,
                         derive_seed, lerp_angle, write_crash_report)


class ClockTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _simulate(self, fps, seconds=1.0):
        c = Clock(60)
        rnd = random.Random(7)
        state = {"x": 0.0, "v": 1.0, "hits": 0}
        per_step = []
        for _ in range(int(round(fps * seconds))):
            for dt in c.steps(1.0 / fps):
                state["v"] += rnd.uniform(-0.1, 0.1)
                state["x"] += state["v"] * dt
                state["hits"] += rnd.random() < 0.2
                per_step.append((round(state["x"], 12), state["hits"]))
        return c, per_step

    def test_identical_sim_state_at_30_60_144_fps(self):
        runs = {fps: self._simulate(fps) for fps in (30, 60, 144)}
        n = min(len(p) for _, p in runs.values())
        self.assertGreaterEqual(n, 59)
        for fps, (c, p) in runs.items():
            self.assertLessEqual(abs(len(p) - 60), 1, fps)
            self.assertEqual(p[:n], runs[60][1][:n], f"diverged at {fps} fps")

    def test_spiral_guard_and_counters(self):
        c = Clock(60, max_steps=5)
        self.assertEqual(c.advance(1.0), 5)
        self.assertEqual(c.dropped_steps, 55)
        self.assertEqual(c.advance(0), 0)
        self.assertEqual(c.advance(-1), 0)

    def test_pause_and_time_scale(self):
        c = Clock(60)
        c.paused = True
        self.assertEqual(c.advance(0.5), 0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(c.real_time, 0.5)
        c.paused = False
        c.time_scale = 0.5
        self.assertEqual(c.advance(2 / 60), 1)

    def test_ticks_ms_is_frame_derived(self):
        c = Clock(60)
        for _ in c.steps(0.5):
            pass
        self.assertEqual(c.frame, 5)       # max_steps=5 caps the 30-step backlog
        self.assertEqual(c.ticks_ms, 83)

    def test_matches_legacy_fixedstep(self):
        try:
            from core.fixedstep import FixedStepClock
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.skipTest(f"legacy clock unavailable: {e!r}")
        a, b = FixedStepClock(), Clock()
        rnd = random.Random(3)
        for _ in range(500):
            d = rnd.uniform(0.001, 0.1)
            self.assertEqual(a.steps(d), b.advance(d))


class RngTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_streams_independent_and_stable(self):
        r = RngStreams(42)
        a1 = [r.stream("ai").random() for _ in range(5)]
        r2 = RngStreams(42)
        r2.stream("fx").random()           # an extra consumer must not shift "ai"
        a2 = [r2.stream("ai").random() for _ in range(5)]
        self.assertEqual(a1, a2)
        self.assertEqual(derive_seed(42, "ai"), derive_seed(42, "ai"))
        self.assertNotEqual(derive_seed(42, "ai"), derive_seed(43, "ai"))

    def test_snapshot_restore(self):
        r = RngStreams(1)
        r.stream("a").random()
        snap = r.snapshot()
        x = [r.stream("a").random() for _ in range(3)]
        r.restore(snap)
        self.assertEqual(x, [r.stream("a").random() for _ in range(3)])


@dataclass
class Hit:
    n: int


class EventTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_queue_flush_scope(self):
        bus, got, scope = EventBus(), [], object()
        bus.subscribe(Hit, lambda e: got.append(e.n), scope=scope)
        bus.emit(Hit(1))
        self.assertEqual(got, [])
        self.assertEqual(bus.flush(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(got, [1])
        bus.emit_now(Hit(2))
        self.assertEqual(got, [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(bus.unsubscribe_scope(scope), 1)
        bus.emit_now(Hit(3))
        self.assertEqual(got, [1, 2])
        self.assertEqual(len(bus.tail()), 3)


class LogServicesSettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_log_ring_and_warn_once(self):
        out = io.StringIO()
        log = Log(capacity=3, stream=out)
        self.assertTrue(log.warn_once("assets", "k", "missing x"))
        self.assertFalse(log.warn_once("assets", "k", "missing x"))
        for i in range(5):
            log.info("core", str(i))
        self.assertEqual(len(log.tail()), 3)
        self.assertIn("[RPE5][assets] WARN: missing x", out.getvalue())
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            log.info("nope", "x")

    def test_services(self):
        s = Services()
        s.register("a", 1)
        self.assertEqual(s.a, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(ServiceMissing):
            s.get("b")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            s.register("a", 2)

    def test_settings_layers(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = f"{d}/s.json"
            open(p, "w").write('{"seed": 5, "width": 800}')
            s = Settings.load(p, env={"ACA_SEED": "9", "ACARISTAN_CUTSCENE3D": "0"}, overrides={"width": 640})
        self.assertEqual((s["seed"], s["width"], s["cutscene3d"], s["height"]), (9, 640, False, 700))
        self.assertEqual(s.source("seed"), "env:ACA_SEED")
        self.assertEqual(s.source("width"), "cli")

    def test_misc(self):
        self.assertAlmostEqual(lerp_angle(350, 10, 0.5), 0.0)
        self.assertIn("asset_id='x'", str(AEError("boom", asset_id="x")))


class AppTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_crash_report_on_injected_exception(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            app = App(Settings({"crash_dir": d}))
            app.log.info("core", "before crash")

            def boom(a, dt):
                if a.clock.frame == 3:
                    raise RuntimeError("injected")
            with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
                app.run_frames([1 / 60] * 10, boom)
            import os
            files = [f for f in os.listdir(d) if f.endswith(".txt")]
            self.assertEqual(len(files), 1)
            txt = open(os.path.join(d, files[0]), encoding="utf-8").read()
            self.assertIn("RuntimeError: injected", txt)
            self.assertIn("frame: 3", txt)
            self.assertIn("before crash", txt)

    def test_write_crash_report_plain(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            try:
                raise ValueError("x")
            except ValueError as e:
                p = write_crash_report(d, e, extra={"seed": 1})
            self.assertTrue(p.exists())

"""M5 finale regressions. Run: python -m unittest tests.unit.test_m5_ending -v.

Executes the production player classes without starting app or touching saves.
"""
import ast
import importlib.util
import math
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))


def load_file(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


meta = load_file('m5_test_meta', ROOT / 'src/missions/m5/meta.py')


def player_harness(shots, fades=True):
    now, routes, ambience, cues = [1000], [], [], []
    pygame = SimpleNamespace(
        KEYDOWN=1, K_SPACE=32,
        time=SimpleNamespace(get_ticks=lambda: now[0]),
        event=SimpleNamespace(Event=lambda typ, **kw: SimpleNamespace(type=typ, **kw)),
        mouse=SimpleNamespace(set_visible=lambda value: None))
    ns = dict(pygame=pygame, GameState=object, KO_CUT_CUES={}, TEXT_SPEED=4,
              audio=SimpleNamespace(play=lambda *a, **kw: cues.append(a)),
              gc=SimpleNamespace(reset_dialogue_slide=lambda: None),
              gsm=SimpleNamespace(transition=routes.append),
              _set_ambience=lambda names: ambience.append(names),
              _play_typewriter_tick=lambda *a, **kw: None,
              mission_complete_timer=0, mission_complete_fade=0)
    tree = ast.parse((ROOT / 'src/app.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef)
             and n.name in ('CutscenePlayer', '_CutsceneState')]
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), 'production_player', 'exec'), ns)
    cp = ns['CutscenePlayer'](shots, 'MISSION5_COMPLETE', use_fades=fades)
    ns['active_cutscene'] = cp
    return cp, ns['_CutsceneState'](), now, routes, ambience, cues


class PlaybackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_silent_gate_advances_once_at_authored_end(self):
        cp, state, now, routes, _, _ = player_harness(meta.mission5_ending_shots)
        now[0] = cp.start_time + 9599
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 0)
        now[0] += 1
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 1)
        self.assertEqual(cp.start_time, now[0])
        self.assertEqual(cp.char_idx, 0)
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 1)
        self.assertEqual(routes, [])

    def test_dialogue_and_legacy_silent_shots_remain_manual(self):
        for shot in (meta.mission5_ending_shots[1],
                     dict(scene='legacy', text='', speaker='', min_ms=100)):
            cp, state, now, routes, _, _ = player_harness([shot])
            cp.char_idx = len(shot['text'])
            cp.fired_cues.add((0, 'vo'))
            now[0] += 20000
            state.update(1/60)
            self.assertEqual(routes, [])

    def test_leaving_advances_without_double_step(self):
        cp, state, now, _, _, _ = player_harness(meta.mission5_ending_shots[3:])
        now[0] += 6800
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 1)
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 1)

    def test_title_completes_only_after_text_and_hold(self):
        cp, state, now, routes, _, _ = player_harness(meta.mission5_ending_shots[-1:])
        now[0] += 2399
        cp.char_idx = len(cp.current_shot['text'])
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(routes, [])
        now[0] += 1
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(routes, ['MISSION_COMPLETE'])

    def test_faded_auto_shot_does_not_skip_successor(self):
        shot = dict(scene='silent', text='', speaker='', min_ms=100,
                    auto_advance=True, quiet_ui=True)
        cp, state, now, routes, _, _ = player_harness([shot, dict(shot, auto_advance=False)])
        now[0] += 100
        state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.transition_timer, 15)
        for _ in range(20):
            now[0] += 17
            state.update(1/60)
        self.assertEqual(cp.shot_idx, 1)
        self.assertEqual(cp.transition_timer, 0)
        self.assertEqual(routes, [])

    def test_entire_finale_reaches_completion(self):
        cp, state, now, routes, _, _ = player_harness(meta.mission5_ending_shots)
        visited = {0}
        for _ in range(800):
            now[0] += 100
            shot = cp.current_shot
            # Only dialogue gets player input. Empty takes and the title must
            # progress by themselves, including the radio-to-title fade.
            if shot['speaker'] and cp.transition_timer == 0:
                cp.fired_cues.add((cp.shot_idx, 'vo'))
                cp.char_idx = len(shot['text'])
                if cp.elapsed_ms >= shot['min_ms']:
                    state.handle_event(SimpleNamespace(type=1, key=32), 0, 0, {})
            state.update(1/60)
            visited.add(cp.shot_idx)
            if routes:
                break
        self.assertEqual(visited, set(range(6)))
        self.assertEqual(routes, ['MISSION_COMPLETE'])

    def test_rain_ambience_and_quiet_radio(self):
        cp, state, _, _, ambience, _ = player_harness(meta.mission5_ending_shots)
        state.set_ambience()
        self.assertEqual(ambience[-1], {'rain', 'wind'})
        cp.shot_idx = 5
        state.set_ambience()
        self.assertEqual(ambience[-1], set())
        self.assertTrue(all(s.get('quiet_ui') for s in meta.mission5_ending_shots))
        self.assertTrue(meta.mission5_ending_shots[4]['radio'])


class BlockingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        # The helper imports only engine3d geometry, not the game's cutscene facade.
        cls.s = load_file('m5_test_blocking', ROOT / 'src/cutscenes/m5ending3d.py')

    def test_maru_turn_is_planted(self):
        s = self.s
        positions = [s.maru_block(t)[0] for t in (3100, 3200, 3300, 3400, 3500)]
        self.assertTrue(all(math.dist(p, positions[0]) < 1e-9 for p in positions))
        self.assertEqual(s.maru_yaw(3100), 90)
        self.assertEqual(s.maru_yaw(3500), 180)
        self.assertEqual(s.maru_move_weight(3300), 0)
        self.assertLess(s.maru_block(5350)[0][2], -2.5)

    def test_ucilev_feet_match_treads_for_entire_exit(self):
        s = self.s
        sniper = (-16, 9.2, 37)
        for t in range(0, 6801, 10):
            pos, _, distance, _ = s.ucilev_block(t, sniper, 156)
            first = s.ROOF_DOOR_Z + .5 - s.STAIR_RUN / 2
            i = max(0, min(s.STAIR_COUNT-1, math.floor((distance-first)/s.STAIR_RUN)))
            self.assertAlmostEqual(pos[1], sniper[1] - i * s.STAIR_DROP)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(s.ucilev_block(6200, sniper, 156)[0][1], 9.2-1.68)

    def test_gait_is_zero_during_holds(self):
        s = self.s
        for t in (0, 650, 3300, 3900, 4300, 6200, 6800):
            self.assertEqual(max(s.move_weight(t,650,2650), s.move_weight(t,4300,1900)), 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Phase 1 checks: legacy rng stream (R6) and m3 import side effects (B-010)."""
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from tests.unit import _path  # noqa: F401

from engine.core import LEGACY, LEGACY_RNG, App, RngStreams

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


class LegacyStreamTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_legacy_is_the_global_random_instance(self):
        # Same object -> game code routed through it keeps legacy seeding/sequence.
        self.assertIs(LEGACY_RNG, random.random.__self__)
        random.seed(1234)
        a = [random.random() for _ in range(3)]
        random.seed(1234)
        b = [LEGACY_RNG.random() for _ in range(3)]
        self.assertEqual(a, b)

    def test_app_adopts_legacy_and_reseed_leaves_it_alone(self):
        app = App()
        self.assertIs(app.rng.stream(LEGACY), LEGACY_RNG)
        random.seed(99)
        before = LEGACY_RNG.getstate()
        app.rng.reseed(5)
        self.assertEqual(LEGACY_RNG.getstate(), before)

    def test_named_streams_still_independent(self):
        r = RngStreams(3)
        self.assertIsNot(r.stream("ai"), LEGACY_RNG)


class M3ImportSideEffectTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_importing_m3_does_not_redirect_saves_or_env(self):
        code = (
            "import os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'src');"
            "from core import save_system as s, settings_store as t, profile_store as p;"
            "before = (s.SAVE_FILE, t.SAVE_FILE, p.PROFILE_FILE, os.environ.get('SDL_VIDEODRIVER'));"
            "import missions.m3;"
            "after = (s.SAVE_FILE, t.SAVE_FILE, p.PROFILE_FILE, os.environ.get('SDL_VIDEODRIVER'));"
            "print('SAME' if before == after else 'CHANGED %r -> %r' % (before, after))"
        )
        env = dict(os.environ, SDL_AUDIODRIVER="dummy", PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT="1",
                   ACA_SAVE_SUFFIX="_aetest")
        env["SDL_VIDEODRIVER"] = "dummy"
        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], cwd=str(ROOT), env=env,
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
        self.assertIn("SAME", r.stdout, r.stdout[-800:] + r.stderr[-800:])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# tools\ae_audit.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""RPE5 Phase 0 audit: static census of src/ and tools/ (read-only, stdlib only).

Usage:  python tools/ae_audit.py [--out docs/engine/audit]

Writes:
  <out>/audit.json            machine-readable everything
  <out>/inventory.md          per-file lines / defs / line endings / encoding
  <out>/imports.md            package graph + shared->mission boundary edges
  <out>/state_census.md       every STATE.<field> read/write, by field and owner
  <out>/duplication.md        normalised-AST duplicate function groups
  <out>/draw_census.md        procedural draw calls per function (static count)
  <out>/cache_census.md       module-level cache dicts and their invalidation
  <out>/hazards.md            import side effects, unseeded random, direct loads,
                              wall-clock time, getattr attribute stuffing, mojibake
Never modifies source files. Deterministic output (sorted).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SRC = ROOT / "src"
TOOLS = ROOT / "tools"
SKIP_DIRS = {"__pycache__", ".git", ".kilo", "node_modules"}

MISSION_RE = re.compile(r"^(missions(\.|$)|cutscenes\.m\d|art\.m\d|cutscenes\.m\d)")
DRAW_FUNCS = {"line", "lines", "aaline", "aalines", "rect", "circle", "ellipse", "polygon",
              "arc", "pixel", "filled_circle", "filled_polygon", "aacircle", "aapolygon",
              "box", "hline", "vline", "filled_ellipse", "aaellipse", "trigon", "filled_trigon",
              "bezier", "textured_polygon", "pie"}
CACHE_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"(cache|CACHE|Cache|_static|_STATIC|SPRITES|_ROT$|_MEMO|_memo)")
RANDOM_FUNCS = {"random", "randint", "uniform", "choice", "choices", "shuffle", "sample",
                "randrange", "gauss", "seed", "triangular", "betavariate", "expovariate"}
MOJIBAKE_RE = re.compile("(\u00e2\u201d|\u00e2\u20ac|\u00c3[\u0080-\u00bf]|\ufffd)")


def iter_py(base: Path):
    for p in sorted(base.rglob("*.py")):
        if any(part in SKIP_DIRS for part in p.parts):
            continue
        yield p


def modname(p: Path) -> str:
    if p.is_relative_to(SRC):
        rel = p.relative_to(SRC).with_suffix("")
    else:
        rel = Path("tools") / p.relative_to(TOOLS).with_suffix("")
    parts = list(rel.parts)
    if parts and parts[-1] == "__init__":
        parts = parts[:-1]
    return ".".join(parts) or "(root)"


def owner_of(mod: str) -> str:
    """Grouping key: mission id for mission code, else top package."""
    m = re.match(r"missions\.(m\d|arena|walking_sim|walking_attack3d)", mod)
    if m:
        return "mission:" + m.group(1)
    m = re.match(r"(cutscenes|art)\.(m\d)", mod)
    if m:
        return "mission:" + m.group(2)
    return mod.split(".")[0]


def rel(p: Path) -> str:
    return p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers
def dotted(node) -> str | None:
    parts = []
    while isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):
        parts.append(node.attr)
        node = node.value
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name):
        parts.append(node.id)
        return ".".join(reversed(parts))
    return None


class Norm(ast.NodeTransformer):
    """Anonymise identifiers (and optionally constants) for duplicate detection."""

    def __init__(self, consts: bool):
        self.consts = consts

    def visit_Name(self, n):
        return ast.copy_location(ast.Name(id="_", ctx=n.ctx), n)

    def visit_arg(self, n):
        return ast.copy_location(ast.arg(arg="_", annotation=None), n)

    def visit_FunctionDef(self, n):
        self.generic_visit(n)
        n.name = "_"
        n.decorator_list = []
        n.returns = None
        if n.body and isinstance(n.body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(getattr(n.body[0], "value", None), ast.Constant) \
                and isinstance(n.body[0].value.value, str):
            n.body = n.body[1:] or [ast.Pass()]
        return n

    def visit_Constant(self, n):
        if self.consts:
            return ast.copy_location(ast.Constant(value=type(n.value).__name__), n)
        return n


def fn_hash(fn, consts: bool) -> str:
    import copy
    t = Norm(consts).visit(copy.deepcopy(fn))
    return hashlib.sha1(ast.dump(t, annotate_fields=False).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]


def stmt_count(fn) -> int:
    return sum(1 for n in ast.walk(fn) if isinstance(n, ast.stmt)) - 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-file pass
def analyse(p: Path, all_mods: set[str]):
    raw = p.read_bytes()
    crlf = raw.count(b"\r\n")
    lf = raw.count(b"\n") - crlf
    cr = raw.count(b"\r") - crlf
    info = {
        "path": rel(p), "module": modname(p), "owner": owner_of(modname(p)),
        "bytes": len(raw), "lines": raw.count(b"\n") + (0 if raw.endswith(b"\n") or not raw else 1),
        "crlf": crlf, "lf": lf, "cr": cr,
        "eol": "mixed" if (crlf and lf) or cr else ("crlf" if crlf else "lf"),
        "bom": raw.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"), "utf8": True, "mojibake_lines": [],
        "defs": 0, "classes": 0, "imports": [], "parse_error": None,
    }
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8-sig")
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        info["utf8"] = False
        text = raw.decode("latin-1")
    for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if MOJIBAKE_RE.search(line):
            info["mojibake_lines"].append(i)
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(text, filename=str(p))
    except SyntaxError as e:
        info["parse_error"] = str(e)
        return info, None, text
    return info, tree, text


def resolve_import(mod: str, is_pkg: bool, node, all_mods: set[str]) -> list[str]:
    out = []
    if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
        for a in node.names:
            out.append(a.name)
    else:
        base = node.module or ""
        if node.level:
            pkg = mod.split(".") if is_pkg else mod.split(".")[:-1]
            pkg = pkg[: len(pkg) - (node.level - 1)] if node.level > 1 else pkg
            base = ".".join([*pkg, base] if base else pkg)
        for a in node.names:
            cand = f"{base}.{a.name}" if base else a.name
            out.append(cand if cand in all_mods else base)
    # trim to the longest known module prefix
    res = []
    for name in out:
        parts = name.split(".")
        while parts and ".".join(parts) not in all_mods:
            parts.pop()
        res.append(".".join(parts) if parts else "ext:" + name.split(".")[0])
    return res


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="docs/engine/audit")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    out = ROOT / args.out
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    files = list(iter_py(SRC)) + list(iter_py(TOOLS))
    all_mods = {modname(p) for p in files}
    inv, edges = [], []
    state = []                      # (field, rw, path, line, owner)
    fns = []                        # duplicate candidates
    draws = []                      # (count, qualname, path, line, owner, breakdown)
    caches = []
    hz = defaultdict(list)          # hazard kind -> [(path, line, detail)]

    for p in files:
        info, tree, text = analyse(p, all_mods)
        inv.append(info)
        if tree is None:
            continue
        mod, is_pkg = info["module"], p.name == "__init__.py"
        in_src = p.is_relative_to(SRC)
        top_level_nodes = set()
        for n in tree.body:
            for sub in ast.walk(n):
                if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and sub is not n:
                    continue
                top_level_nodes.add(id(sub))
        func_nodes = set()
        for n in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                for sub in ast.walk(n):
                    func_nodes.add(id(sub))
        info["defs"] = sum(isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) for n in tree.body)
        info["classes"] = sum(isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) for n in tree.body)

        # imports
        for n in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)):
                lazy = id(n) in func_nodes
                for tgt in resolve_import(mod, is_pkg, n, all_mods):
                    edges.append((mod, tgt, "lazy" if lazy else "top", rel(p), n.lineno))
                    if not lazy:
                        info["imports"].append(tgt)
        info["imports"] = sorted(set(info["imports"]))

        # STATE census (src + tools)
        for n in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(n.value, ast.Name) and n.value.id == "STATE":
                rw = "write" if isinstance(n.ctx, (ast.Store, ast.Del)) else "read"
                state.append((n.attr, rw, rel(p), n.lineno, info["owner"]))
            elif isinstance(n, ast.AugAssign) and isinstance(n.target, ast.Attribute) \
                    and isinstance(n.target.value, ast.Name) and n.target.value.id == "STATE":
                state.append((n.target.attr, "write", rel(p), n.lineno, info["owner"]))
            elif isinstance(n, ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id in ("getattr", "setattr", "hasattr") \
                    and n.args and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Name) and n.args[0].id == "STATE" \
                    and len(n.args) > 1 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant):
                state.append((str(n.args[1].value), "write" if n.func.id == "setattr" else "read",
                              rel(p), n.lineno, info["owner"]))

        if not in_src:
            continue

        # functions: duplicates + draw census
        for n in ast.walk(tree):
            if not isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                continue
            sc = stmt_count(n)
            if sc >= 6:
                fns.append({"name": n.name, "path": rel(p), "line": n.lineno, "owner": info["owner"],
                            "stmts": sc, "h_exact": fn_hash(n, False), "h_struct": fn_hash(n, True)})
            br = Counter()
            for c in ast.walk(n):
                if isinstance(c, ast.Call):
                    d = dotted(c.func) or ""
                    last = d.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
                    if (".draw." in "." + d + "." or ".gfxdraw." in "." + d + "." or d.startswith(("draw.", "gfxdraw."))) \
                            and last in DRAW_FUNCS:
                        br["draw." + last] += 1
                    elif last in ("blit", "blits", "fblits"):
                        br["blit"] += 1
                    elif last == "fill" and isinstance(c.func, ast.Attribute):
                        br["fill"] += 1
            if br:
                draws.append((sum(br.values()), n.name, rel(p), n.lineno, info["owner"], dict(br)))

        # module-level caches + hazards
        for n in tree.body:
            targets, value = [], None
            if isinstance(n, ast.Assign):
                targets, value = n.targets, n.value
            elif isinstance(n, ast.AnnAssign) and n.value is not None:
                targets, value = [n.target], n.value
            for t in targets:
                if isinstance(t, ast.Name) and CACHE_NAME_RE.search(t.id):
                    is_container = isinstance(value, (ast.Dict, ast.List, ast.Set)) or (
                        isinstance(value, ast.Call) and (dotted(value.func) or "").split(".")[-1]
                        in ("dict", "defaultdict", "OrderedDict", "list", "set", "WeakValueDictionary"))
                    if is_container:
                        name = t.id
                        clears = len(re.findall(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\s*\.\s*(clear|pop|popitem)\s*\(", text)) + \
                            len(re.findall(rf"\b{re.escape(name)}\s*=\s*", text)) - 1
                        dels = len(re.findall(rf"del\s+{re.escape(name)}\s*\[", text))
                        caches.append({"name": name, "path": rel(p), "line": n.lineno, "owner": info["owner"],
                                       "kind": type(value).__name__ if not isinstance(value, ast.Call) else dotted(value.func),
                                       "invalidations": max(clears, 0) + dels})
        for n in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
                for dec in n.decorator_list:
                    d = dotted(dec.func if isinstance(dec, ast.Call) else dec) or ""
                    if d.split(".")[-1] in ("lru_cache", "cache"):
                        caches.append({"name": n.name + "()", "path": rel(p), "line": n.lineno,
                                       "owner": info["owner"], "kind": d, "invalidations":
                                       len(re.findall(rf"\b{n.name}\.cache_clear\(", text))})
            if not isinstance(n, ast.Call):
                continue
            d = dotted(n.func) or ""
            top = id(n) in top_level_nodes and id(n) not in func_nodes
            line = n.lineno
            if top and d.endswith(("display.set_mode", "pygame.init", "mixer.init", "font.init",
                                   "image.load", "mixer.Sound", "font.Font", "font.SysFont", "Surface",
                                   "display.init")):
                hz["import_side_effect"].append((rel(p), line, d))
            if d.endswith("image.load") and not mod.startswith("engine.assets"):
                hz["direct_image_load"].append((rel(p), line, d))
            if d.endswith(("mixer.Sound", "mixer.music.load")):
                hz["direct_sound_load"].append((rel(p), line, d))
            if d.startswith("random.") and d.split(".")[-1] in RANDOM_FUNCS:
                hz["global_random"].append((rel(p), line, d))
            if d in ("time.time", "time.perf_counter", "time.monotonic", "pygame.time.get_ticks", "time.get_ticks"):
                hz["wall_clock"].append((rel(p), line, d))
            if d == "getattr" and len(n.args) == 3 and isinstance(n.args[1], ast.Constant) \
                    and isinstance(n.args[1].value, str) and n.args[1].value.startswith("_") \
                    and not (isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Name) and n.args[0].id in ("STATE", "sys", "os")):
                hz["getattr_private_default"].append((rel(p), line, n.args[1].value))
            if d.startswith(("pygame.draw.", "draw.")) and n.args and isinstance(n.args[0], ast.Name) \
                    and n.args[0].id in ("screen", "SCREEN") and owner_of(mod).startswith("mission:"):
                hz["mission_draws_on_screen"].append((rel(p), line, d))
        for i in info["mojibake_lines"]:
