# tools\dev_panel.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""dev_panel.py - clickable dev control panel for jumping into missions.

Run from the repo root::

    python tools/dev_panel.py

Opens a dark, terminal-styled window with one button per dev jump target -
the same registry as ``acaristan.py --jump NAME`` (see
``src/core/dev_jumps.py``). Click a target to launch the game at that
mission; its description sits next to the button so nothing needs hovering.
Anything typed in the "extra args" field (e.g. ``--continue`` for slot-select)
is forwarded to the game. Trailer-bot takes additionally get
``--trailer-bot --trailer-act <act>`` appended automatically.

Layout, top to bottom::

    header   title + live "visible/total targets · running" counts
    filter   type to narrow the list (matches target name or description)
    body     scrollable, grouped target list in mission order
    footer   extra args, Copy command, Stop all games, status line

Keyboard: ↑/↓ walk the visible targets, Enter launches the selected one,
Ctrl+F jumps to the filter, and Esc clears the filter plus the selection.
Handy: right-click any target to copy its command without launching.

Structure notes:
    * ``GROUPS`` defines the display order. The panel self-checks that every
      ``DEV_JUMPS`` entry is filed under exactly one group and reports any
      drift in the status line, so the registry and the panel cannot silently
      fall out of sync as new jumps are added.
    * ``grouped_targets`` / ``build_launch_cmd`` / ``parse_extra_args`` are
      pure and import-safe, so they can be exercised without a Tk root.
"""
import subprocess
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import ttk

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

from core.dev_jumps import DEV_JUMPS

# ── Display groups: (section label, [target names]) ──
# Order here is the panel's order. Keep in sync with DEV_JUMPS - the panel
# warns (in the status line) about any entry that is missing or duplicated.
GROUPS = [
    ("Mission 1", ["m1", "m1-safe"]),
    ("Walking sim", ["walk"]),
    ("Mission 2", ["m2", "m2-game", "m2-sniper", "m2-after-sniper",
                   "m2-flank", "m2-truck", "m2-evidence"]),
    ("Mission 3", ["m3", "m3-game", "m3-comms", "m3-archives",
                   "m3-kill-order", "m3-ledger", "m3-vostral",
                   "m3-archives-cutscene", "m3-broadcast-transition",
                   "m3-broadcast", "m3-upload"]),
    ("Mission 4", ["m4", "m4-game", "m4-station", "m4-tower"]),
    ("Mission 5", ["m5", "m5-hq", "m5-game", "m5-printworks",
                   "m5-tunnel", "m5-ending"]),
    ("Trailer bot", ["trailer-m1", "trailer-m2-killbox", "trailer-m2-evidence",
                     "trailer-m3-breakout", "trailer-m3-comms"]),
    ("Misc", ["slot-select", "audio-parade"]),
    ("Multiplayer", ["mp-host", "mp-join"]),
]

# ── Palette: warm dark ground + terminal green, matching the in-game HUD ──
# (C_BG_GAME = 45,42,38 and C_TERMINAL = 50,255,150 in core/config.py.)
# Trailer takes need the bot driver + act, not just the mission start flag.
# ``build_launch_cmd`` appends these automatically (unless the user already
# typed ``--trailer-bot`` in extra args). Act names from tools/trailer_bot.
TRAILER_ACTS = {
    "trailer-m1": "act1",
    "trailer-m2-killbox": "act2_killbox",
    "trailer-m2-evidence": "act2_evidence",
    "trailer-m3-breakout": "act3_breakout",
    "trailer-m3-comms": "act3_relay",
}
THEME = {
    "app":        "#1a1815",
    "header":     "#232019",
    "panel":      "#272319",
    "button":     "#2f2a20",
    "button_hover": "#3d3628",
    "border":     "#3d372e",
    "text":       "#e8e2d8",
    "muted":      "#9a9186",
    "accent":     "#32ff96",
    "accent_hover": "#6dffb4",
    "on_accent":  "#0b1a12",
    "danger":     "#ff6b5e",
    "danger_hover": "#ff8d82",
    "amber":      "#ffbe4d",
    "warn":       "#ffc266",
}


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pure helpers (import-safe, no Tk required)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def grouped_targets():
    """Yield (group_label, [(name, description), ...]) for the panel.

    Targets missing from ``DEV_JUMPS`` are skipped rather than crashing, so a
    stale name in ``GROUPS`` degrades to a reported drift instead of a
    traceback (see :func:`group_issues`).
    """
    for label, names in GROUPS:
        yield label, [(n, DEV_JUMPS[n][1]) for n in names if n in DEV_JUMPS]


def build_launch_cmd(target, extra_args=()):
    """Pure helper (headless-testable): argv to launch the game at target.

    Trailer takes also get ``--trailer-bot --trailer-act <act>`` appended
    (unless the user already passed ``--trailer-bot``), otherwise the button
    would boot a plain mission start instead of the described bot take.
    """
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "acaristan.py"), "--jump", target]
    cmd.extend(a for a in extra_args if a != "--")
    act = TRAILER_ACTS.get(target)
    if act is not None and "--trailer-bot" not in cmd:
        cmd.extend(["--trailer-bot", "--trailer-act", act])
    return cmd


def parse_extra_args(text):
    """Split the footer's extra-args field into argv tokens (drop bare ``--``)."""
    return [tok for tok in text.split() if tok != "--"]


def group_issues():
    """Report drift between ``GROUPS`` and ``DEV_JUMPS``.

    Returns ``(missing, duplicated, unknown)`` - sorted name lists for
    registry entries filed nowhere, names filed under two groups, and group
    entries that no longer exist in the registry.
    """
    filed = [name for _label, names in GROUPS for name in names]
    duplicated = sorted({n for n in filed if filed.count(n) > 1})
    missing = sorted(n for n in DEV_JUMPS if n not in filed)
    unknown = sorted(n for n in filed if n not in DEV_JUMPS)
    return missing, duplicated, unknown


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Panel
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class DevPanel(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Acaristan - Dev Panel")
        self.minsize(720, 460)
        self.geometry("880x680")

        self._procs = []          # launched game processes (for Stop all games)
        self._entries = []        # one dict per target row (for filtering)
        self._group_widgets = {}  # group key -> header/frame/label widgets
        self._last_target = None  # last hovered/launched target (for Copy)
        self._selected = None     # keyboard-selected target name (↑/↓ + Enter)

        self.font_title = ("Consolas", 13, "bold")
        self.font_group = ("Consolas", 10, "bold")
        self.font_mono = ("Consolas", 10)
        self.font_ui = ("Segoe UI", 9)

        self._apply_theme()
        self._build_header()
        self._build_filter()
        self._build_body()
        self._build_footer()

        self.rowconfigure(2, weight=1)
        self.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self._apply_filter()
        self._set_status(self._default_status())
        self._bind_keys()
        self.after(10, self._enable_dark_titlebar)
        self.after(1000, self._reap)

    def _enable_dark_titlebar(self):
        """Ask Windows to paint a dark caption (no-op off Windows / on failure).

        Tk owns only the client area - the title bar is OS chrome, so it stays
        light by default and breaks the dark theme. Windows 10 20H1+ exposes
        ``DWMWA_USE_IMMERSIVE_DARK_MODE`` (attribute 20); older builds used 19.
        If neither is supported we simply keep the light caption.
        """
        if sys.platform != "win32":
            return
        try:
            import ctypes
            self.update_idletasks()
            hwnd = ctypes.windll.user32.GetParent(self.winfo_id())
            enabled = ctypes.c_int(1)
            for attribute in (20, 19):
                if ctypes.windll.dwmapi.DwmSetWindowAttribute(
                        hwnd, attribute, ctypes.byref(enabled),
                        ctypes.sizeof(enabled)) == 0:
                    break
        except Exception:
            pass  # cosmetic only - never let theming break the panel

    # ── theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _apply_theme(self):
        self.configure(bg=THEME["app"])
        style = ttk.Style(self)
        try:
            style.theme_use("clam")  # clam honours explicit scrollbar colours
        except tk.TclError:
            pass
        style.configure(
            "Dev.Vertical.TScrollbar",
            gripcount=0,
            background=THEME["border"], troughcolor=THEME["app"],
            bordercolor=THEME["app"], arrowcolor=THEME["muted"],
            darkcolor=THEME["border"], lightcolor=THEME["border"],
            relief="flat",
        )
        style.map("Dev.Vertical.TScrollbar",
                  background=[("active", THEME["button_hover"])])
        # Arrowless track+thumb - cleaner than clam's default stepper arrows.
        style.layout("Dev.Vertical.TScrollbar", [
            ("Vertical.Scrollbar.trough", {
                "sticky": "ns",
                "children": [("Vertical.Scrollbar.thumb",
                              {"expand": "1", "sticky": "nswe"})],
            }),
        ])

    def _flat_button(self, parent, text, command, fg=None, bg=None,
                     hover=None, width=None):
        """A consistently styled flat button (classic tk = reliably themable)."""
        fg = fg or THEME["text"]
        bg = bg or THEME["button"]
        hover = hover or THEME["button_hover"]
        btn = tk.Button(
            parent, text=text, command=command, font=self.font_mono,
            width=width, bd=0, relief="flat", highlightthickness=0,
            bg=bg, fg=fg, activebackground=hover, activeforeground=fg,
            padx=10, pady=4, cursor="hand2", anchor="center",
        )
        btn.bind("<Enter>", lambda _e: btn.configure(bg=hover))
        btn.bind("<Leave>", lambda _e: btn.configure(bg=bg))
        return btn

    # ── sections ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _build_header(self):
        head = tk.Frame(self, bg=THEME["header"])
        head.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="ew")
        head.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        tk.Label(head, text="ACARISTAN - DEV PANEL", bg=THEME["header"],
                 fg=THEME["accent"], font=self.font_title).grid(
            row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=14, pady=(10, 0))
        tk.Label(
            head,
            text="Click a target to launch it. Right-click copies the command. "
                 "↑/↓ then Enter to pick.",
            bg=THEME["header"], fg=THEME["muted"], font=self.font_ui,
        ).grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=14, pady=(0, 10))

        self.counts = tk.Label(head, text="", bg=THEME["header"],
                               fg=THEME["muted"], font=self.font_ui)
        self.counts.grid(row=0, column=1, rowspan=2, sticky="e", padx=14)

        tk.Frame(self, bg=THEME["border"], height=1).grid(
            row=0, column=0, sticky="sew")

    def _build_filter(self):
        bar = tk.Frame(self, bg=THEME["app"])
        bar.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="ew", padx=12, pady=(10, 6))
        bar.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        tk.Label(bar, text="Filter", bg=THEME["app"], fg=THEME["muted"],
                 font=self.font_ui).grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")

        self.filter_var = tk.StringVar()
        self.filter_var.trace_add("write", lambda *_: self._apply_filter())
        self.filter_entry = tk.Entry(
            bar, textvariable=self.filter_var, font=self.font_mono,
            bg=THEME["button"], fg=THEME["text"], relief="flat",
            insertbackground=THEME["accent"], highlightthickness=1,
            highlightbackground=THEME["border"],
            highlightcolor=THEME["accent"],
        )
        self.filter_entry.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=8, ipady=4)
        self.filter_entry.bind("<Return>", self._launch_first_visible)
        self.filter_entry.bind("<Escape>", self._on_escape)

        self._flat_button(bar, "Clear", lambda: self.filter_var.set(""),
                          width=6).grid(row=0, column=2, sticky="e")

    def _build_body(self):
        wrap = tk.Frame(self, bg=THEME["app"])
        wrap.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky="nsew", padx=12, pady=(0, 8))
        wrap.rowconfigure(0, weight=1)
        wrap.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(wrap, bg=THEME["app"], bd=0,
                                highlightthickness=0)
        self.canvas.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="nsew")
        bar = ttk.Scrollbar(wrap, orient="vertical",
                            command=self.canvas.yview,
                            style="Dev.Vertical.TScrollbar")
        bar.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ns")
        self.canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=bar.set)

        inner = tk.Frame(self.canvas, bg=THEME["app"])
        inner.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self._inner = inner
        self._body_row = 0
        window = self.canvas.create_window((0, 0), window=inner, anchor="nw")

        inner.bind("<Configure>", lambda _e: self.canvas.configure(
            scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox("all")))
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>",
                         lambda e: self.canvas.itemconfigure(window,
                                                             width=e.width))
        self.canvas.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", self._on_wheel)

        for label, targets in grouped_targets():
            self._add_group(label, targets)

    def _add_group(self, label, targets):
        key = label
        header = tk.Label(
            self._inner, text=f"{label.upper()}   ·   {len(targets)}",
            bg=THEME["app"], fg=THEME["amber"], font=self.font_group,
            anchor="w",
        )
        header.grid(row=self._body_row, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 3))
        self._body_row += 1

        frame = tk.Frame(self._inner, bg=THEME["panel"])
        frame.grid(row=self._body_row, column=0, sticky="ew")
        frame.columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self._body_row += 1

        for index, (name, desc) in enumerate(targets):
            self._add_target_row(frame, index, key, name, desc)

        self._group_widgets[key] = {
            "header": header, "frame": frame, "label": label,
            "total": len(targets),
        }

    def _add_target_row(self, parent, index, group_key, name, desc):
        row = tk.Frame(parent, bg=THEME["panel"])
        row.grid(row=index, column=0, sticky="ew", pady=0, padx=1)
        row.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        button = tk.Button(
            row, text=name, width=21, anchor="w", font=self.font_mono,
            bd=0, relief="flat", highlightthickness=0, cursor="hand2",
            bg=THEME["button"], fg=THEME["accent"],
            activebackground=THEME["accent"],
            activeforeground=THEME["on_accent"],
            padx=10, pady=3, command=lambda n=name: self.launch(n),
        )
        button.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(6, 0), pady=2)

        label = tk.Label(row, text=desc, bg=THEME["panel"], fg=THEME["muted"],
                         font=self.font_ui, anchor="w", justify="left")
        label.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", padx=(12, 10))

        entry = {"name": name, "desc": desc, "row": row, "button": button,
                 "label": label, "group": group_key, "visible": True,
                 "hovered": False}
        for widget in (row, button, label):
            widget.bind("<Enter>", lambda _e, en=entry: self._hover(en, True))
            widget.bind("<Leave>", lambda _e, en=entry: self._hover(en, False))
            widget.bind("<Button-3>", lambda _e, n=name: self._copy_cmd(n))
        self._entries.append(entry)

    def _build_footer(self):
        foot = tk.Frame(self, bg=THEME["header"])
        foot.grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="ew")
        foot.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)

        tk.Label(foot, text="extra args", bg=THEME["header"],
                 fg=THEME["muted"], font=self.font_ui).grid(
            row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(14, 8), pady=(10, 4))

        self.extra = tk.Entry(
            foot, font=self.font_mono, bg=THEME["button"], fg=THEME["text"],
            relief="flat", insertbackground=THEME["accent"],
            highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=THEME["border"],
            highlightcolor=THEME["accent"],
        )
        self.extra.grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 4), ipady=4)
        self.extra.bind("<Return>", self._on_extra_return)

        self._flat_button(foot, "Copy command", self._copy_last).grid(
            row=0, column=2, padx=(8, 4), pady=(10, 4))
        self._flat_button(foot, "Stop all games", self.stop_all,
                          fg=THEME["danger"], hover=THEME["danger_hover"]).grid(
            row=0, column=3, padx=(4, 14), pady=(10, 4))

        self.status = tk.Label(foot, text="", bg=THEME["header"],
                               fg=THEME["muted"], font=self.font_ui, anchor="w")
        self.status.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew",
                         padx=14, pady=(0, 10))

    # ── behaviour ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _on_wheel(self, event):
        """Scroll the body, but only while the pointer is over it."""
        widget = self.winfo_containing(*self.winfo_pointerxy())
        while widget is not None:
            if widget is self.canvas:
                self.canvas.yview_scroll(int(-event.delta / 120), "units")
                return
            widget = getattr(widget, "master", None)

    def _paint_row(self, entry):
        """Repaint one target row for its current hover/selection state.

        Selection outranks hover, so a keyboard-picked row stays visibly
        marked while the pointer wanders across the rest of the list.
        """
        selected = entry["name"] == self._selected
        hovered = entry.get("hovered", False)
        if selected:
            row_bg, btn_bg, btn_fg = (THEME["button_hover"], THEME["accent"],
                                      THEME["on_accent"])
        elif hovered:
            row_bg, btn_bg, btn_fg = (THEME["button"], THEME["button_hover"],
                                      THEME["accent"])
        else:
            row_bg, btn_bg, btn_fg = (THEME["panel"], THEME["button"],
                                      THEME["accent"])
        for widget in (entry["row"], entry["label"]):
            widget.configure(bg=row_bg)
        entry["button"].configure(
            bg=btn_bg, fg=btn_fg,
            activebackground=THEME["accent"],
            activeforeground=THEME["on_accent"],
        )

    def _hover(self, entry, on):
        entry["hovered"] = on
        self._paint_row(entry)
        if on:
            self._last_target = entry["name"]
            self._set_status(f"{entry['name']}   -   {entry['desc']}")
        elif entry["name"] != self._selected:
            self._set_status(self._default_status())

    # ── keyboard navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _bind_keys(self):
        """Panel-wide shortcuts; the header line advertises the main ones."""
        self.bind("<Control-f>", self._focus_filter)
        self.bind("<Escape>", self._on_escape)
        self.bind("<Up>", lambda _e: self._arrow(-1))
        self.bind("<Down>", lambda _e: self._arrow(1))
        self.bind("<Return>", self._on_return)

    def _typing_in_entry(self):
        """True when a text field owns focus, so keys should reach it first."""
        return isinstance(self.focus_get(), tk.Entry)

    def _visible_entries(self):
        return [e for e in self._entries if e["visible"]]

    def _entry_for(self, name):
        for entry in self._entries:
            if entry["name"] == name:
                return entry
        return None

    def _focus_filter(self, _event=None):
        self.filter_entry.focus_set()
        self.filter_entry.select_range(0, "end")
        return "break"

    def _arrow(self, delta):
        if self._typing_in_entry():
            return None      # let the Entry move its own caret
        self._move_selection(delta)
        return "break"

    def _move_selection(self, delta):
        entries = self._visible_entries()
        if not entries:
            return
        names = [e["name"] for e in entries]
        if self._selected in names:
            index = (names.index(self._selected) + delta) % len(names)
        else:
            index = 0 if delta > 0 else len(names) - 1
        self._select(names[index])

    def _select(self, name):
        previous = self._entry_for(self._selected)
        self._selected = name
        current = self._entry_for(name)
        for entry in (previous, current):
            if entry is not None:
                self._paint_row(entry)
        if current is not None:
            self._last_target = name
            self._ensure_visible(current)
            self._set_status(
                f"{name}   -   {current['desc']}   ·   Enter launches")

    def _clear_selection(self):
        entry = self._entry_for(self._selected)
        self._selected = None
        if entry is not None:
            self._paint_row(entry)

    def _ensure_visible(self, entry):
        """Scroll the body just enough to bring a selected row into view."""
        self.canvas.update_idletasks()
        row = entry["row"]
        top = row.winfo_rooty() - self._inner.winfo_rooty()
        bottom = top + row.winfo_height()
        view_top = self.canvas.canvasy(0)
        view_height = self.canvas.winfo_height()
        total = max(1, self._inner.winfo_height())
        if top < view_top:
            self.canvas.yview_moveto(top / total)
        elif bottom > view_top + view_height:
            self.canvas.yview_moveto(max(0.0, (bottom - view_height) / total))

    def _on_return(self, _event=None):
        if self._typing_in_entry():
            return None      # the focused Entry handles its own Return
        self._launch_selected()
        return "break"

    def _on_escape(self, _event=None):
        if self.filter_var.get():
            self.filter_var.set("")
        self._clear_selection()
        return "break"

    def _on_extra_return(self, _event=None):
        self._launch_last()
        return "break"

    def _launch_selected(self):
        if self._selected:
            self.launch(self._selected)
        else:
            self._launch_first_visible()

    def _set_status(self, text, kind="info"):
        colours = {"info": THEME["muted"], "ok": THEME["accent"],
                   "warn": THEME["warn"], "err": THEME["danger"]}
        self.status.configure(text=text, fg=colours.get(kind, THEME["muted"]))

    def _default_status(self):
        running = self._running()
        if running:
            return f"Pick a mission to jump into. ({running} game instance(s) running)"
        return "Pick a mission to jump into."

    def _running(self):
        return sum(1 for p in self._procs if p.poll() is None)

    def _update_counts(self):
        visible = sum(1 for e in self._entries if e["visible"])
        self.counts.configure(
            text=f"{visible}/{len(self._entries)} targets   ·   {self._running()} running")

    def _extra_args(self):
        return parse_extra_args(self.extra.get())

    def _apply_filter(self):
        query = self.filter_var.get().strip().lower()
        per_group = {}
        for entry in self._entries:
            match = (not query
                     or query in entry["name"].lower()
                     or query in entry["desc"].lower())
            entry["visible"] = match
            if match:
                entry["row"].grid()
                per_group[entry["group"]] = per_group.get(entry["group"], 0) + 1
            else:
                entry["row"].grid_remove()

        for key, widgets in self._group_widgets.items():
            shown = per_group.get(key, 0)
            label, total = widgets["label"], widgets["total"]
            widgets["header"].configure(
                text=f"{label.upper()}   ·   {shown}/{total}" if query
                else f"{label.upper()}   ·   {total}")
            for widget in (widgets["header"], widgets["frame"]):
                if shown:
                    widget.grid()
                else:
                    widget.grid_remove()

        # Drop a keyboard selection the filter just hid, so Enter can't fire a
        # target the user can no longer see.
        selected = self._entry_for(self._selected)
        if selected is not None and not selected["visible"]:
            self._selected = None

        self._update_counts()
        self.canvas.yview_moveto(0.0)

    def _launch_first_visible(self, _event=None):
        for entry in self._entries:
            if entry["visible"]:
                self.launch(entry["name"])
                return "break"

    def _launch_last(self):
        target = self._last_target or next(iter(DEV_JUMPS), None)
        if target:
            self.launch(target)

    def _copy_cmd(self, name):
        cmd = " ".join(build_launch_cmd(name, self._extra_args()))
        self.clipboard_clear()
        self.clipboard_append(cmd)
        self._set_status(f"Copied: {cmd}", "ok")

    def _copy_last(self):
        target = self._last_target or next(iter(DEV_JUMPS), None)
        if target:
            self._copy_cmd(target)

    def launch(self, target):
        self._last_target = target
        try:
            proc = subprocess.Popen(build_launch_cmd(target, self._extra_args()),
                                    cwd=str(ROOT))
        except Exception as exc:  # e.g. python not on PATH for the child
            self._set_status(f"Launch failed: {exc}", "err")
            return
        self._procs.append(proc)
        self._set_status(f"Launched {target}   (pid {proc.pid})", "ok")
        self._update_counts()

    def stop_all(self):
        killed = 0
        for proc in self._procs:
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                killed += 1
        self._procs = [p for p in self._procs if p.poll() is None]
        if killed:
            self._set_status(f"Stopped {killed} game instance(s).", "warn")
        else:
            self._set_status("No running game instances.")
        self._update_counts()

    def _reap(self):
        self._procs = [p for p in self._procs if p.poll() is None]
        self._update_counts()
        self.after(1000, self._reap)


def main():
    panel = DevPanel()
    missing, duplicated, unknown = group_issues()
    if missing or duplicated or unknown:
        parts = []
        if missing:
            parts.append("not in any group: " + ", ".join(missing))
        if duplicated:
            parts.append("in two groups: " + ", ".join(duplicated))
        if unknown:
            parts.append("unknown to registry: " + ", ".join(unknown))
        panel._set_status("DEV_JUMPS drift - " + " | ".join(parts), "warn")
    panel.mainloop()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\download_bore.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Fetch the pinned official Windows x64 bore release for PyInstaller builds."""
import hashlib
import io
from pathlib import Path
import urllib.request
import zipfile

VERSION = "0.6.0"
URL = "https://github.com/ekzhang/bore/releases/download/v0.6.0/bore-v0.6.0-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.zip"
ARCHIVE_SHA256 = "01709c64fe2787cdc9a21d7030b0f08ad72dff0c36b7ecb72f4f667a55a34b4f"
# Filled from the verified archive. Prevent reuse of an altered local binary.
BINARY_SHA256 = "e8c1096ea01460ba9dbf30017b5eccf2100f63ef2c701930e56fcaca239b48cc"
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEST = ROOT / "assets" / "bin" / "bore.exe"


def main():
    if DEST.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(DEST.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == BINARY_SHA256:
        print("bore v%s already verified" % VERSION)
        return
    print("Downloading official bore v%s (Windows x64)..." % VERSION)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(URL, timeout=60) as response:
        data = response.read()
    if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != ARCHIVE_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("bore archive checksum mismatch; refusing to bundle")
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data)) as archive:
        names = [n for n in archive.namelist() if Path(n).name == "bore.exe"]
        if len(names) != 1:
            raise RuntimeError("release must contain exactly one bore.exe")
        binary = archive.read(names[0])
    if hashlib.sha256(binary).hexdigest() != BINARY_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("bore executable checksum mismatch")
    DEST.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = DEST.with_suffix(".exe.tmp")
    temp.write_bytes(binary)
    temp.replace(DEST)
    print("Saved " + str(DEST))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\engine3d_check.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""GPU vs software renderer check on the real M2 ambush film.

    python tools/engine3d_check.py            # parity + speed report
    python tools/engine3d_check.py --shots    # also save side-by-side PNGs to outputs/engine3d/
    python tools/engine3d_check.py --stress   # 60-soldier crowd benchmark

Renders the same frames of missions/m2/sniper3d.py with both engine3d
backends, reports per-frame time and how many pixels differ. Exit code 1 if
the GPU backend is unavailable or a frame differs on more than MAX_DIFF of
its pixels (small differences are expected: per-pixel depth/fog instead of
per-face sorting).
"""
import os
import sys
import time

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
os.chdir(ROOT)

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402
import pygame  # noqa: E402

MAX_DIFF = 0.06          # fraction of pixels allowed to differ by > TOL
TOL = 24                 # per-channel tolerance


def main():
    pygame.init()
    from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    import engine3d
    info = engine3d.gl_info()
    print("GL:", info)
    if not info["available"]:
        return 1
    from missions.m2.sniper3d import SniperCinematic
    cines = {}
    for mode in ("software", "gl"):
        os.environ["ACARISTAN_RENDERER"] = mode
        cines[mode] = SniperCinematic()
        print(mode, "->", type(cines[mode].r).__name__)
    os.environ.pop("ACARISTAN_RENDERER", None)
    total = cines["software"].shots[-1][1]
    times = [total * k / 24 for k in range(1, 24)]
    shots = "--shots" in sys.argv
    if shots:
        os.makedirs("outputs/engine3d", exist_ok=True)
    worst, ok = 0.0, True
    tsum = {"software": 0.0, "gl": 0.0}
    for i, t in enumerate(times):
        frames = {}
        for mode, c in cines.items():
            c.t = t
            c.draw(screen)                # warm (first-use caches)
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            for _ in range(3):
                c.draw(screen)
            tsum[mode] += (time.perf_counter() - t0) / 3
            frames[mode] = pygame.surfarray.array3d(c.r.surface).astype(np.int16)
        d = np.abs(frames["software"] - frames["gl"]).max(axis=2)
        frac = float((d > TOL).mean())
        worst = max(worst, frac)
        ok &= frac <= MAX_DIFF
        if shots:
            a = cines["software"].r.surface; b = cines["gl"].r.surface
            out = pygame.Surface((a.get_width() * 2 + 4, a.get_height()))
            out.blit(a, (0, 0)); out.blit(b, (a.get_width() + 4, 0))
            pygame.image.save(out, "outputs/engine3d/frame_%02d.png" % i)
        print("t=%6.2fs  diff=%5.2f%%  tris=%s" % (t, frac * 100, cines["gl"].r.stats.get("tris")))
    n = len(times)
    sw, gl = tsum["software"] / n * 1000, tsum["gl"] / n * 1000
    print("avg frame: software %.1f ms | gl %.1f ms | x%.1f" % (sw, gl, sw / gl))
    print("worst pixel diff: %.2f%%  ->  %s" % (worst * 100, "OK" if ok else "FAIL"))
    return 0 if ok else 1




def stress(n_actors=60, frames=10):
    """Crowd benchmark: n_actors soldiers on the M2 set, both backends."""
    import math
    pygame.init()
    from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
    pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    from engine3d import GLRenderer, SoftwareRenderer, Humanoid, pose_run
    from missions.m2 import sniper3d_set as SET
    from missions.m2.sniper3d import SPECS
    specs = list(SPECS.values())
    res = {}
    for cls in (SoftwareRenderer, GLRenderer):
        r = cls(WIDTH // 2, HEIGHT // 2, fog=(88, 90, 98), fog_start=14.0, fog_end=190.0)
        SET.build(r)
        crowd = [Humanoid(specs[i % len(specs)]) for i in range(n_actors)]
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        for f in range(frames):
            r.set_camera((0, 6, -18), (0, 1, 20), 60)
            r.surface.fill((40, 44, 52))
            r.begin(); r.add_static()
            for i, h in enumerate(crowd):
                x = (i % 10 - 4.5) * 2.2
                z = (i // 10) * 3.0 + f * 0.2
                r.add_humanoid(h, pose_run(f * 0.3 + i), (x, 0, z), 0.0, rifle_on=True)
            r.flush(r.surface)
        res[cls.__name__] = (time.perf_counter() - t0) / frames * 1000
        if cls is GLRenderer:
            pygame.image.save(r.surface, "outputs/engine3d/stress_gl.png")
    print("stress %d actors: software %.1f ms | gl %.1f ms | x%.1f" % (
        n_actors, res["SoftwareRenderer"], res["GLRenderer"],
        res["SoftwareRenderer"] / res["GLRenderer"]))


if __name__ == "__main__" and "--stress" in sys.argv:
    stress()
elif __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# tools\finale_compare.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Side-by-side probe: M2 ambush film (sniper3d) vs M5 finale (m5shadow3d).

    python tools/finale_compare.py   # PNGs + metrics -> outputs/finale_compare/
"""
import os, sys, time
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
os.chdir(ROOT)
import numpy as np
import pygame

OUT = "outputs/finale_compare"


def metrics(surf, rect):
    a = pygame.surfarray.array3d(surf.subsurface(rect)).astype(np.float32)
    luma = a[..., 0] * .299 + a[..., 1] * .587 + a[..., 2] * .114
    mx, mn = a.max(-1), a.min(-1)
    sat = np.where(mx > 0, (mx - mn) / np.maximum(mx, 1), 0)
    lap = np.abs(4 * luma[1:-1, 1:-1] - luma[:-2, 1:-1] - luma[2:, 1:-1] - luma[1:-1, :-2] - luma[1:-1, 2:])
    return dict(mean=luma.mean(), std=luma.std(), p5=np.percentile(luma, 5),
                p95=np.percentile(luma, 95), sat=sat.mean(), edge=lap.mean())


def main():
    pygame.init()
    from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, SCENE_TOP, SCENE_BOT
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    rows = []
    from missions.m2.sniper3d import SniperCinematic, BAR_H
    c = SniperCinematic()
    total = c.shots[-1][1]
    for i in range(1, 9):
        c.t = total * i / 9
        c.draw(screen); t0 = time.perf_counter(); c.draw(screen); dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        pygame.image.save(screen, f"{OUT}/m2_{i}.png")
        rows.append(("M2", round(c.t, 1), dt, metrics(screen, pygame.Rect(0, BAR_H, WIDTH, HEIGHT - 2 * BAR_H))))
    from cutscenes import m5shadow3d as m5
    from missions.m5.finale_script import CUTS
    m5.prepare()
    for i, cut in enumerate(CUTS):
        t = cut + 900
        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        m5.draw(screen, t); t0 = time.perf_counter(); m5.draw(screen, t); dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
        pygame.image.save(screen, f"{OUT}/m5_{i}_{m5._camera(t)[3]}.png")
        rows.append(("M5", t, dt, metrics(screen, pygame.Rect(0, m5.TOP, WIDTH, m5.BOT - m5.TOP))))
    print("film  t       ms   mean   std    p5    p95   sat   edge")
    for film, t, dt, m in rows:
        print(f"{film}  {t:<7} {dt*1000:5.1f} {m['mean']:6.1f} {m['std']:5.1f} {m['p5']:5.1f} {m['p95']:6.1f} {m['sat']:.3f} {m['edge']:5.2f}")
    for film in ("M2", "M5"):
        ms = [m for f, _, _, m in rows if f == film]
        print(film, "AVG", {k: round(float(np.mean([m[k] for m in ms])), 2) for k in ms[0]})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\finale_gait_check.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""M5 finale gait check: Maru timing, footstep contact times, world foot drift.

    python tools/finale_gait_check.py
"""
import os, sys, math
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
os.chdir(ROOT)
from cutscenes import m5shadow3d as m5


def main():
    b, u, m = m5.actors()
    print(f"route {m5._CUM[-1]:.2f} m  stop {m5.MARU_STOP:.2f}  stride {m5.MARU_STRIDE:.3f}"
          f"  t_stop {m5.MARU_T_STOP:.2f}  t_go {m5.MARU_T_GO:.2f}  t_in {m5.MARU_T_IN:.2f}"
          f"  door_open {m5.DOOR_OPEN}  shut {m5.DOOR_SHUT}  gone {m5.MARU_GONE:.2f}  scale {m._scale:.3f}")
    # world foot positions: foot slot origin = ankle (slots 9 / 15)
    prev = None; contacts = []; drift = {"l": [], "r": []}; planted = {"l": None, "r": None}
    for i in range(0, int(m5.MARU_GONE * 1000), 10):
        pose, pos, yaw = m5.maru_pose(m, i)
        places, j, root = m.pose_world(pose, pos, yaw, False)
        feet = {}
        for side, slot in (("l", 9), ("r", 15)):
            M, org = next((M, o) for s, key, M, o, g, fb in places if s == slot)
            feet[side] = (org[0] + root[0] - pos[0] + pos[0], org[1] + root[1], org[2] + root[2])
        if prev:
            for side in "lr":
                low = feet[side][1] - min(feet["l"][1], feet["r"][1]) < .012
                if low and planted[side] is None:
                    planted[side] = feet[side]; contacts.append((i, side))
                elif low:
                    p0 = planted[side]
                    drift[side].append(math.hypot(feet[side][0] - p0[0], feet[side][2] - p0[2]))
                elif not low:
                    planted[side] = None
        prev = feet
    print("contacts ms:", " ".join(f"{t}{s}" for t, s in contacts))
    for side in "lr":
        d = drift[side]
        print(side, "max stance drift cm: %.2f" % (100 * max(d) if d else 0))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\finale_probe.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Render M5 finale frames (optionally from custom cameras) into a JPEG contact sheet.

    python tools/finale_probe.py OUT.jpg COLS THUMB_W spec [spec ...]
    spec = t                      (film camera at t ms)
         | t@ex,ey,ez@tx,ty,tz@fov  (custom camera at t ms)
Prints the sheet path. Frames also saved as outputs/finale_probe/NN.png.
"""
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))
os.chdir(ROOT)
import pygame


def main():
    out, cols, tw = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])
    specs = sys.argv[4:]
    pygame.init()
    from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT
    screen = pygame.display.set_mode((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
    from cutscenes import m5shadow3d as m5
    m5.prepare()
    orig = m5._camera
    os.makedirs("outputs/finale_probe", exist_ok=True)
    film_h = m5.BOT - m5.TOP
    th = int(tw * film_h / WIDTH)
    rows = (len(specs) + cols - 1) // cols
    sheet = pygame.Surface((cols * tw, rows * th))
    for i, spec in enumerate(specs):
        parts = spec.split("@")
        t = float(parts[0])
        if len(parts) == 4:
            eye = tuple(float(v) for v in parts[1].split(","))
            tgt = tuple(float(v) for v in parts[2].split(","))
            fov = float(parts[3])
            m5._camera = lambda _t, e=eye, g=tgt, f=fov: (e, g, f, "probe")
        else:
            m5._camera = orig
        screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        m5.draw(screen, t)
        film = screen.subsurface(pygame.Rect(0, m5.TOP, WIDTH, film_h)).copy()
        pygame.image.save(film, f"outputs/finale_probe/{i:02d}.png")
        sheet.blit(pygame.transform.smoothscale(film, (tw, th)), ((i % cols) * tw, (i // cols) * th))
    m5._camera = orig
    pygame.image.save(sheet, out)
    print("SHEET", out)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\golden.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""golden.py - golden-image regression gate for the reworked renderer.

Renders three deterministic Mission 3 stills (ACA_FREEZE=1 pins every
time-driven term: light flicker, mote drift/twinkle) and compares a tiny
grayscale signature against tools/golden.json.

    GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 python tools/golden.py     # re-baseline after art changes
    python tools/golden.py                     # verify
    (smoke_test.py also calls compare() when the baseline exists)

The signature is 40x28 grayscale quantised to 16 levels with a +/-1 level
per-pixel tolerance and a 2% mismatch budget: enough slack for sub-pixel
animation, far too little for a missing shelf, a broken tile or a dead
light pass.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT", "1")
os.environ["ACA_FREEZE"] = "1"
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

import pygame

from core import config
from core import game_core as gc
from core.state import STATE
from missions import m3

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = HERE / "golden.json"
T = config.TILE_SIZE
TOL = 1
BUDGET = 0.02


class EK:
    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return False


def _cam(tx, ty):
    STATE.player.rect.center = (int(tx * T), int(ty * T))
    return m3._clamp_m3_camera(int(tx * T - config.WIDTH // 2),
                               int(ty * T - config.HEIGHT // 2))


def _scene_archives():
    m3.start_mission3_archives_checkpoint(preserve_timer=True)
    return _cam(12, 27)


def _scene_comms():
    from missions.m3 import world as w
    m3.start_mission3_comms_checkpoint(preserve_timer=True)
    return _cam(w._RELAY_TILE_COL - 2, w._RELAY_TILE_ROW - 2)


def _scene_cell():
    gc.start_mission3_breakout_checkpoint(preserve_timer=True)
    cx, cy = m3._interrogation_chair_pos()
    return _cam(cx // T + 3, cy // T + 2)


SCENES = (("archives", _scene_archives), ("comms", _scene_comms),
          ("cell", _scene_cell))


def _sig():
    small = pygame.transform.scale(config.screen, (40, 28))
    arr = pygame.surfarray.array3d(small)
    gray = (arr[:, :, 0].astype(int) + arr[:, :, 1] + arr[:, :, 2]) // 3
    return (gray // 16).ravel().tolist()


def render_all():
    out = {}
    for name, fn in SCENES:
        fcx, fcy = fn()
        config.screen.fill((0, 0, 0))
        gc.game_draw(fcx, fcy)
        gc.game_draw(fcx, fcy)   # second pass: settle per-frame state
        out[name] = _sig()
    return out


def compare(verbose=True):
    if not BASE.exists():
        if verbose:
            print("golden: no baseline at %s (run GOLDEN_UPDATE=1)" % BASE)
        return True
    base = json.loads(BASE.read_text())
    cur = render_all()
    ok = True
    for name, sig in cur.items():
        b = base.get(name)
        if b is None or len(b) != len(sig):
            print("golden: %s missing/mismatched baseline" % name)
            ok = False
            continue
        bad = sum(1 for a, c in zip(b, sig) if abs(a - c) > TOL)
        ratio = bad / len(sig)
        good = ratio <= BUDGET
        ok = ok and good
        if verbose:
            print("golden: %-9s %4d/%d px off  %s" % (
                name, bad, len(sig), "OK" if good else "FAIL"))
    return ok


def main():
    pygame.display.set_mode((config.WIDTH, config.HEIGHT))
    if os.environ.get("GOLDEN_UPDATE") == "1":
        BASE.write_text(json.dumps(render_all()))
        print("golden: baseline written (%d scenes)" % len(SCENES))
        return 0
    return 0 if compare() else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# tools\k9_pickup_check.py

"""Headless regression checks and optional preview for the K-9 pickup.
Run from the project root: python tools/k9_pickup_check.py [--frames DIR]
The playback harness executes the existing app classes without launching app.
"""
import argparse
import ast
from collections import Counter
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import sys
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT','1')
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'src'))
import pygame
from cutscenes import k9, m3ops
from cutscenes.engine import draw_cutscene_scene
from core.config import WIDTH,HEIGHT,SCENE_TOP,SCENE_BOT,audio
from missions.m3.meta import k9_pickup_shots


def render(fn,ms):
    s=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT));s.fill((5,5,8));fn(s,ms);return s


def rgb(s):return pygame.image.tobytes(s,'RGB')


def playback_check():
    # Use the actual production update/input logic, not a parallel simulation.
    tree=ast.parse((ROOT/'src/app.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    classes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name in ('CutscenePlayer','_CutsceneState')]
    clock=[0];heard=[];ends=[];transitions=[]
    old_ticks=pygame.time.get_ticks
    pygame.time.get_ticks=lambda:clock[0]
    class StubAudio:
        def play(self,name,volume=1):heard.append((name,volume))
        def duck_ambience(self,**kw):pass
    gc=SimpleNamespace(reset_dialogue_slide=lambda:None,active_mission='MISSION3')
    env={'pygame':pygame,'GameState':object,'audio':StubAudio(),'gc':gc,
         'KO_CUT_CUES':{},'TEXT_SPEED':2,'_play_typewriter_tick':lambda *a,**k:None,
         'trigger_transition':transitions.append}
    try:
        exec(compile(ast.Module(body=classes,type_ignores=[]),str(ROOT/'src/app.py'),'exec'),env)
        cp=env['CutscenePlayer'](k9_pickup_shots,'GAME',use_fades=True)
        env['active_cutscene']=cp
        state=env['_CutsceneState']()
        real_end=state._handle_end
        def end():
            real_end();ends.append(clock[0])
        state._handle_end=end
        # Early held/tapped SPACE must not clip the action or emit menu clicks.
        state.handle_event(pygame.event.Event(pygame.KEYDOWN,key=pygame.K_SPACE),0,0,{})
        assert cp.shot_idx==0 and not heard
        for now in range(0,5201,10):
            clock[0]=now;state.update(1/100)
            if ends:break
        assert ends and 4800<=ends[0]<=4830,ends
        assert transitions==['GAME'],transitions
        expected=[(name,vol) for shot in k9_pickup_shots for _,name,vol in shot.get('cues',())]
        assert heard==expected,(heard,expected)
        assert cp.transition_timer==0,'Unexpected shot fade'
        # A suspended window must consume stale cues, not blast a backlog.
        heard.clear();clock[0]=0
        cp=env['CutscenePlayer'](k9_pickup_shots,'GAME',use_fades=True)
        cp.shot_idx=1;env['active_cutscene']=cp
        clock[0]=2000;state.update(1/60)
        assert heard==[('rifle_handle',.18)],heard
        state.update(1/60)
        assert heard==[('rifle_handle',.18)],'Cue repeated'
    finally:pygame.time.get_ticks=old_ticks
    print('PASS: actual player auto-completes, returns to GAME, one-shot cues, early SPACE and stale cues')


def checks():
    assert [s['min_ms'] for s in k9_pickup_shots]==[k9.WALL_MS,k9.GRAB_MS,k9.READY_MS]
    for shot in k9_pickup_shots:
        assert all(shot.get(k) for k in ('quiet_ui','auto_advance','hide_caption','hard_cut'))
        for ms,name,vol in shot.get('cues',()):
            assert 0<=ms<shot['min_ms'] and 0<vol<=1
            assert audio.get_sound(name) is not None,name
    fns=[m3ops._draw_k9_wall_stand,m3ops._draw_k9_firstperson_grab,m3ops._draw_k9_ready_check]
    durations=[k9.WALL_MS,k9.GRAB_MS,k9.READY_MS]
    for i in range(2):
        assert rgb(render(fns[i],durations[i]))==rgb(render(fns[i+1],0)),'Discontinuous cut'
    print('PASS: exact pixel continuity at both shot boundaries and valid sound cues')
    state=random.getstate()
    for fn,dur in zip(fns,durations):
        for ms in (-1,0,dur*.25,dur*.5,dur*.75,dur,dur+300):
            first=render(fn,ms)
            assert rgb(first)==rgb(render(fn,ms)),'Non-deterministic frame'
            assert rgb(first.subsurface((0,0,WIDTH,SCENE_TOP)))==bytes((5,5,8))*(WIDTH*SCENE_TOP)
            assert rgb(first.subsurface((0,SCENE_BOT,WIDTH,HEIGHT-SCENE_BOT)))==bytes((5,5,8))*(WIDTH*(HEIGHT-SCENE_BOT))
    assert state==random.getstate(),'Global RNG mutated'
    clip=pygame.Rect(40,120,180,100);s=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT));s.fill((255,0,255));s.set_clip(clip)
    k9.draw_ready(s,800)
    assert s.get_clip()==clip and s.get_at((500,400))[:3]==(255,0,255)
    print('PASS: deterministic rendering, safe out-of-range clocks, clip restoration and protected letterbox')
    # Both fingers are at their rigid contact before the gun moves.
    pose=k9._pose(k9.WALL_MS+560)
    assert pose==k9._pose(0)
    d,s,pull=k9._hands(k9.WALL_MS+560,pose)
    assert d[2]==s[2]==1 and len((d,s))==2
    print('PASS: two hands reach contact before rack release')
    playback_check()
    timings=[]
    for ms in range(0,k9.TOTAL_MS,20):
        s=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT));start=time.perf_counter();k9._draw(s,ms);timings.append((time.perf_counter()-start)*1000)
    timings.sort()
    print(f'Render cost: median {timings[len(timings)//2]:.2f} ms, p95 {timings[int(len(timings)*.95)]:.2f} ms; transform cache capped at {k9._weapon_transform.cache_info().maxsize} frames')
    print('K9 CHECK: OK')


def frames(directory):
    from core.config import draw_vignette
    directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    shot_idx=0;offset=0
    for frame in range(round(k9.TOTAL_MS/1000*60)):
        ms=frame*1000/60
        while shot_idx<2 and ms>=offset+k9_pickup_shots[shot_idx]['min_ms']:
            offset+=k9_pickup_shots[shot_idx]['min_ms'];shot_idx+=1
        s=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT))
        draw_cutscene_scene(s,k9_pickup_shots[shot_idx],ms-offset)
        draw_vignette(s,strength=80)
        pygame.draw.rect(s,(5,5,8),(0,0,WIDTH,SCENE_TOP))
        pygame.draw.rect(s,(5,5,8),(0,SCENE_BOT,WIDTH,HEIGHT-SCENE_BOT))
        pygame.image.save(s,directory/f'{frame:04d}.png')
    print('Rendered preview frames:',frame+1)


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--frames',type=Path);args=parser.parse_args()
    checks()
    if args.frames:frames(args.frames)
    pygame.quit()

# tools\m5_cinematic_polish_check.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Regression evidence for the M5 noir polish; safe isolated preview only."""
import os,sys,tempfile,math,json
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER','dummy')
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'src'))

def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        from core import save_system,settings_store,profile_store
        save_system.SAVE_FILE=tmp+'/save.json'
        settings_store.SAVE_FILE=tmp+'/settings.json'
        profile_store.PROFILE_FILE=tmp+'/profile.json'
        import pygame,numpy as np
        from core.config import WIDTH,HEIGHT
        from core.state import STATE
        from cutscenes import m5martial3d as f,m5ending3d as s,m5fx3d as fx
        STATE.reduced_motion=False
        out=ROOT/'outputs'/'m5_polish_review';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        screen=pygame.Surface((WIDTH,HEIGHT))
        samples=[('opening',f._river,900),('tracking',f._river,3500),('maru_reach',f._river,4150),
                 ('river',f._river,6000),('guard',f._river,8000),('scope',f._scope,4600),
                 ('reveal_start',f._reveal,1200),('reveal_push',f._reveal,3200),
                 ('reveal_hold',f._reveal,4400),('reveal_carry',f._reveal,6500),
                 ('exit_walk',f._leaves,1900),('exit_reach',f._leaves,3420),
                 ('exit_cut',f._leaves,3570),('radio',f._radio,3000)]
        report=[]
        for label,fn,t in samples:
            fn(screen,t)
            assert not f._cache['failed'],f._cache['err']
            pygame.image.save(screen,str(out/(label+'.png')))
            pixels=pygame.surfarray.array3d(screen)[:,f.SAFE_TOP:f.SAFE_BOT]
            white=np.mean(np.min(pixels,axis=2)>235)
            assert white<.003,(label,'whiteout',white)
            if label=='exit_cut': assert not np.any(pixels)
            report.append((label,round(float(white),6)))
        # The reveal path cannot have the previous discontinuity at 3450/5200.
        cams=[]
        for t in range(0,8401,100):
            f._reveal(screen,t)
            r,_=f._rend();cams.append(r.cam)
            hum=f._hum('ucilev');pose=f._life_pose(s.reveal_pose(hum,t),t,.65,3)
            yaw=f._yaw_to(f._SNIPER,f._BIRIBEL)+10*f._k(t,900,2200)
            p=hum.pose_world(pose,f._SNIPER,yaw)[1]['head']
            proj=r.project(p)
            assert proj is not None
            assert r.h*.10 < proj[1] < r.h*.70,(t,'head framing',proj)
        assert max(math.dist(a,b) for a,b in zip(cams,cams[1:]))<.07
        # Character wetness hook must add NO sprites.
        class Capture:
            cam=(0,1.6,0);fwd=(0,0,1)
            def __init__(self): self.lines=[];self.sprites=[]
            def add_line3d(self,a,b,*args,**kw): self.lines.append((a,b,kw.get('layer')))
            def add_sprite(self,*args,**kw): self.sprites.append(args)
        cap=Capture();f._wet(cap,None,None,None,None,2000)
        assert not cap.sprites
        for t in range(0,2000,41):
            cap=Capture();fx.rain3d(cap,t,44,surface=lambda x,z:0 if abs(x)<9 and abs(z)<9 else None)
            assert not cap.sprites
            for a,b,layer in cap.lines:
                if layer==2: assert abs(a[1]-.016)<1e-6 and abs(b[1]-.016)<1e-6
        assert s.rain_surface(-16,43) is None
        assert s.rain_surface(-18,38)==9.212
        assert s.rain_surface(5,20) is None
        # Idle must move over time and reach must articulate the wrist.
        assert s.idle_pose(0)!=s.idle_pose(1200)
        assert any(s.blink_at(t,4)>.8 for t in range(0,5200,20))
        hum=f._hum('ucilev');initial=f._yaw_to(f._SNIPER,f._BIRIBEL)+10
        pos,yaw,d,reaching=s.ucilev_block(3500,f._SNIPER,initial)
        p=s.door_reach(hum,s.patrol_carry(hum,d,0),pos,yaw,s.door_handle(-16,9.2,41.65,0),reaching)
        assert abs(p['lwr_p'])>6
        (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report))
        print('M5 cinematic polish: OK; camera continuity, no whiteout, ground-only impacts, wrist/idle checks')
        print('REVIEW: '+str(out))
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\m5_contact_sheets.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Build labelled contact sheets + automatic frame stats from previews/m5_encounter_review.
Usage: python tools/m5_contact_sheets.py [cols rows cellw]
Output: previews/m5_encounter_review/sheets/sheet_XX.jpg + stats.json
"""
import sys, json, pathlib
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageStat, ImageChops

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SRC = ROOT / 'previews' / 'm5_encounter_review'
OUT = SRC / 'sheets'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
cols = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4
rows = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 3
cellw = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 480

frames = sorted(SRC.glob('[0-9][0-9][0-9]_*.jpg'))
first = Image.open(frames[0])
cellh = int(cellw * first.height / first.width)
lab = 16
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype('arial.ttf', 13)
except Exception:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()

stats = []
prev = None
for f in frames:
    im = Image.open(f).convert('RGB')
    g = im.convert('L')
    st = ImageStat.Stat(g)
    small = g.resize((64, 36))
    diff = None
    if prev is not None:
        diff = round(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(small, prev)).mean[0], 2)
    prev = small
    stats.append(dict(file=f.name, mean=round(st.mean[0], 1), std=round(st.stddev[0], 1), diff_prev=diff))
(OUT / 'stats.json').write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=1))

per = cols * rows
n_sheets = (len(frames) + per - 1) // per
for s in range(n_sheets):
    chunk = frames[s * per:(s + 1) * per]
    sheet = Image.new('RGB', (cols * cellw, rows * (cellh + lab)), (24, 24, 28))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for i, f in enumerate(chunk):
        x, y = (i % cols) * cellw, (i // cols) * (cellh + lab)
        im = Image.open(f).convert('RGB').resize((cellw - 2, cellh), Image.LANCZOS)
        sheet.paste(im, (x + 1, y + lab))
        d.text((x + 3, y + 1), f.stem, fill=(255, 220, 120), font=font)
    sheet.save(OUT / f'sheet_{s:02d}.jpg', quality=80)
print('frames', len(frames), 'sheets', n_sheets, 'cell', cellw, cellh)
print('size', first.size)

# tools\m5_cut_check.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Round-2 M5 cutscene check: renders every m5x_ take (3D, then 2D fallback)."""
import os
import sys

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("ACARISTAN_RENDERER", "software")
os.environ["ACARISTAN_CUTSCENE3D"] = "1"
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(ROOT, "src"))

import pygame  # noqa: E402

pygame.init()
from core.config import *  # noqa: E402,F401,F403
from cutscenes import m5mid3d, m5martial3d  # noqa: E402
from missions.m5.meta import M5_MID_CUTSCENES  # noqa: E402

"""Count pygame.draw.* calls per function in M5 gameplay + cutscene modules.
    python tools/m5_draw_audit.py [min_calls]"""
import ast
import glob
import os
import sys

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
MIN = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 6
files = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "missions", "m5", "*.py")))
files += sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "cutscenes", "m5*.py")))
rows = []
for f in files:
    tree = ast.parse(open(f, encoding="utf8").read())
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            n = 0
            for sub in ast.walk(node):
                if isinstance(sub, ast.Call) and isinstance(sub.func, ast.Attribute):
                    v = sub.func.value
                    if isinstance(v, ast.Attribute) and v.attr in ("draw", "gfxdraw"):
                        n += 1
                    elif isinstance(v, ast.Name) and v.id in ("draw", "gfxdraw", "pd"):
                        n += 1
            if n >= MIN:
                rows.append((n, os.path.relpath(f, ROOT).replace("\\", "/"), node.name, node.lineno,
                             node.end_lineno - node.lineno))
rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r[1], r[3]))
for r in rows:
    print("%4d  %-38s %-34s L%-5d len%d" % r)
print("total funcs", len(rows), "calls", sum(r[0] for r in rows))

"""Deterministic M5 preview suite. python tools/m5_encounter_review.py [capture|test|export OFFSET]
PNG frames are full delivery resolution; JPEGs and manifests are portable review copies.
"""
import os, sys, json, pathlib, io, base64, zipfile, random
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('ACARISTAN_RENDERER', 'software')
os.environ['ACARISTAN_CUTSCENE3D'] = '1'
OUT = ROOT / 'previews' / 'm5_encounter_review'

def export(offset):
    data = base64.b64encode((OUT / 'review.zip').read_bytes()).decode()
    print(data[offset:offset + 200000])

if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'export':
    export(int(sys.argv[2])); sys.exit(0)

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))
import pygame
pygame.init()
from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, TILE_SIZE, screen, LETTER_H
from core.state import STATE
from missions.m5 import flow, quarter, systems, world, draw, meta
from cutscenes import engine, m5mid3d, m5martial3d


def fresh():
    random.seed(42)
    flow.start_mission5_quarter_checkpoint()
    STATE.player.rect.center = world._tile_world(30, 14)
    STATE.player_dead = False
    STATE.bullets.clear()
    return quarter._faces()


def test():
    faces = fresh()
    assert len(faces) == 2 and all(e.m5_passive for e in faces)
    pos = STATE.player.rect.center
    before = quarter._S['convoy']
    flow._update_stage(None)
    assert STATE.request_m5_cutscene == 'old_faces', STATE.request_m5_cutscene
    assert STATE.mission5_stage == meta.STAGE_QUARTER
    count = quarter._S['convoy']
    assert count == before + 1
    for _ in range(1000):
        systems.game_update(pygame.key.get_pressed())
    assert quarter._S['convoy'] == count and STATE.player.rect.center == pos
    flow.on_m5_cutscene_done('old_faces')
    for _ in range(1000):
        quarter._update_faces(*pos)
    assert STATE.request_m5_cutscene is None
    assert quarter._S['faces_spoken'] == {'KOVAC', 'SANDU'}
    # Walk away and re-enter; still no replay.
    STATE.player.rect.center = world._tile_world(24, 15)
    quarter.update()
    STATE.player.rect.center = pos
    quarter.update()
    assert STATE.request_m5_cutscene is None
    assert all(e.m5_passive for e in faces)
    assert sum(e.hp > 0 and not getattr(e, 'm5_passive', False) for e in STATE.enemies) == 5
    # Arrival is not allowed to replace an unplayed encounter.
    fresh(); STATE.player.rect.center = world._printworks_door_pos()
    flow._update_stage(None)
    assert STATE.request_m5_cutscene == 'old_faces' and STATE.mission5_stage == meta.STAGE_QUARTER
    flow.on_m5_cutscene_done('old_faces'); flow._update_stage(None)
    assert STATE.mission5_stage == meta.STAGE_PRINTWORKS and STATE.request_m5_cutscene == 'arrival'
    # Fresh checkpoint = fresh encounter, but casualties/violence don't get a friendly take.
    faces = fresh(); STATE.m5_guard_kills = 4
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene
    assert any(not e.m5_passive for e in faces)
    faces = fresh(); faces[0].hp = 0
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene
    faces = fresh(); faces[0].m5_hp0 = faces[0].hp; faces[0].hp -= 1
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene and not faces[0].m5_passive
    faces = fresh(); quarter._provoke_faces_by_noise(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene and all(not e.m5_passive for e in faces)
    fresh(); STATE.bullets.append(dict(owner='enemy', x=STATE.player.rect.centerx, y=STATE.player.rect.centery))
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene
    fresh(); STATE.walls.append(pygame.Rect(29*TILE_SIZE, 0, 10, 30*TILE_SIZE))
    # A wall between the camera approach and the cast must suppress the trigger.
    STATE.player.rect.center = world._tile_world(28, 15)
    quarter._update_faces(*STATE.player.rect.center)
    assert not STATE.request_m5_cutscene
    print('M5 ENCOUNTER TEST: OK (repeat, handoff, timer, fresh run, kills, casualty, damage, noise, bullets, wall)')


def capture():
    from PIL import Image
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest = []
    def save(label, **info):
        name = f'{len(manifest):03d}_{label}'
        pygame.image.save(screen, str(OUT / (name + '.png')))
        Image.open(OUT / (name + '.png')).convert('RGB').save(OUT / (name + '.jpg'), quality=82)
        manifest.append(dict(file=name + '.jpg', **info))
    groups = [('intro', meta.mission5_intro_shots)] + list(meta.M5_MID_CUTSCENES.items()) + [('ending', meta.mission5_ending_shots)]
    for group, shots in groups:
        for i, shot in enumerate(shots):
            for frac in (0.08, 0.5, 0.92):
                t = int(shot['min_ms'] * frac)
                engine.draw_cutscene_scene(screen, shot, t)
                pygame.draw.rect(screen, (0,0,0), (0,0,WIDTH,LETTER_H))
                pygame.draw.rect(screen, (0,0,0), (0,HEIGHT-LETTER_H,WIDTH,LETTER_H))
                engine.reset_dialogue_slide()
                if shot['scene'] == 'title_card':
                    engine.draw_typewriter_title(screen, shot['text'].split('\n'), len(shot['text']))
                elif shot.get('text'):
                    engine.draw_dialogue_box(screen, shot.get('speaker',''), shot['text'], len(shot['text']), len(shot['text']))
                if m5martial3d._cache.get('err'):
                    raise RuntimeError(m5martial3d._cache['err'])
                save(f'{group}_{i}_{t}', kind='cutscene', scene=shot['scene'], t=t)
    for i, shot in enumerate(meta.M5_MID_CUTSCENES['old_faces']):
        for frac in (0.08, 0.5, 0.92):
            t = int(shot['min_ms']*frac)
            m5mid3d.draw_m5x_2d(shot['scene'], screen, t)
            pygame.draw.rect(screen,(0,0,0),(0,0,WIDTH,LETTER_H))
            pygame.draw.rect(screen,(0,0,0),(0,HEIGHT-LETTER_H,WIDTH,LETTER_H))
            engine.draw_dialogue_box(screen,shot['speaker'],shot['text'],len(shot['text']),len(shot['text']))
            save(f'fallback_{i}_{t}',kind='fallback',scene=shot['scene'],t=t)
    # Stage snapshots use the real game_draw and camera clamp, not synthetic art.
    flow.start_m5()
    def gameplay(label, pos):
        STATE.player.rect.center = tuple(map(int,pos))
        STATE.dt = 1/60
        flow._snap_camera_safe()
        draw.game_draw(int(STATE.camera_x),int(STATE.camera_y))
        save(label,kind='gameplay',stage=STATE.mission5_stage)
    for c,r in ((4,11),(20,8),(24,5)):
        gameplay(f'hq_{c}_{r}',world._tile_world(c,r))
    flow._enter_quarter()
    for c,r in ((6,15),(9,15),(17,15),(24,15),(29,15),(31,13),(33,15),(16,24)):
        gameplay(f'quarter_{c}_{r}',world._tile_world(c,r))
    gameplay('before_encounter',world._tile_world(30,14))
    flow._update_stage(None)
    assert STATE.request_m5_cutscene == 'old_faces'
    flow.on_m5_cutscene_done('old_faces')
    gameplay('after_encounter',STATE.player.rect.center)
    flow._enter_printworks()
    gameplay('print_entry',STATE.player.rect.center)
    gameplay('print_maru',world._maru_office_pos())
    flow._start_maru_dialogue(); flow.on_m5_cutscene_done('maru')
    for tick in (0,30,90):
        for _ in range(tick):
            systems.game_update(pygame.key.get_pressed())
        gameplay(f'raid_{tick}',world._maru_office_pos())
    flow._enter_tunnel()
    for c,r in ((3,6),(10,6),(20,6)):
        gameplay(f'tunnel_{c}_{r}',world._tile_world(c,r))
    (OUT/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT/'review.zip','w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
        for entry in manifest: z.write(OUT/entry['file'],entry['file'])
        z.write(OUT/'manifest.json','manifest.json')
    print(f'PREVIEW SUITE: OK; {len(manifest)} full-resolution frames; archive bytes={(OUT/"review.zip").stat().st_size}')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'test'
    if mode == 'test': test()
    elif mode == 'capture': capture()
    else: raise ValueError(mode)

"""Ending staging/weapon regressions and native-size visual probes; safe saves."""
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import math
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT','1')
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'src'))

def check_tracking_background(f, config, pygame):
    """Compare geometry-only frames to sky-only frames across the whole turn.

    Exclude actors, rain, glow sprites and grade so they cannot conceal a
    missing set. The upper-central image must contain actual world geometry.
    """
    import numpy as np
    from cutscenes import m5ending3d as s
    r,_=f._rend()
    saved=(r.add_humanoid,r.add_sprite,f._fx.rain3d,f._finish,f._river_world,s.east_quay)
    r.add_humanoid=lambda *a,**kw:{}
    r.add_sprite=lambda *a,**kw:None
    f._fx.rain3d=lambda *a,**kw:None
    f._finish=lambda *a,**kw:None
    def coverage(t):
        f._river_world=saved[4]
        f._river(config.screen,t)
        actual=pygame.surfarray.array3d(config.screen).astype(int)
        f._river_world=lambda *a,**kw:None
        f._river(config.screen,t)
        sky=pygame.surfarray.array3d(config.screen).astype(int)
        f._river_world=saved[4]
        w=config.screen.get_width()
        y0=f.SAFE_TOP+int(f._FILM_H*.05)
        y1=f.SAFE_TOP+int(f._FILM_H*.5)
        mask=np.max(np.abs(actual-sky),axis=2)>3
        return float(mask[int(w*.15):int(w*.85),y0:y1].mean())
    try:
        s.east_quay=lambda *a,**kw:None
        missing=coverage(2800)
        assert missing<.60,('missing-set fixture must fail the coverage gate',missing)
        s.east_quay=saved[5]
        worst=1.0
        for t in list(range(2200,5400,100))+[5399]:
            amount=coverage(t)
            worst=min(worst,amount)
            assert amount>.60,('tracking camera looks off the set',t,amount)
        print('tracking_background_full_turn: OK; minimum geometry coverage %.3f'%worst)
    finally:
        r.add_humanoid,r.add_sprite,f._fx.rain3d,f._finish,f._river_world,s.east_quay=saved


def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='m5_stage_') as tmp:
        from core import save_system,settings_store,profile_store
        save_system.SAVE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'save.json')
        settings_store.SAVE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'settings.json')
        profile_store.PROFILE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'profile.json')
        import pygame
        from core import config
        from cutscenes import m5martial3d as f,m5ending3d as s
        from engine3d.core import m_apply
        from missions.m5.meta import mission5_ending_shots
        hum=f._hum('ucilev')
        worst=0
        from m5_rifle_clearance import penetration
        for pitch in range(14,53,2):
            for d in (0,.25,.5,.75):
                pose=s.rifle_pose(hum,pitch,d,1)
                j=hum.pose_world(pose,(0,0,0),0)[1]
                target=tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(j['rhand'],m_apply(j['rifle_m'],(0,-.025,.24))))
                gap=math.dist(j['lhand'],target)
                worst=max(worst,gap)
                assert gap<.025,(pitch,d,gap)
                assert penetration(hum,pose)==0,('rifle intersects torso/head/pelvis',pitch,d)
        print('two_hand_grip_and_body_clearance: OK; max error %.5f m'%worst)
        for key, pose in ((f._BIRI_GUARD, f._RADIO), ('vasile', dict(f._RADIO, head_y=12))):
            actor = f._hum(key)
            posed = s.radio_pose(actor, pose)
            places, joints, _, _ = actor.placements(posed, rifle_on=False)
            _, _, H, neck, _, _ = next(p for p in places if p[0] == 2)
            ear = tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(neck,m_apply(H,(-.20,.12,.02))))
            # Receiver has a real exterior palm offset, not a slab centred
            # inside the skin fist. Check the actual drawn earpiece frame.
            world_places, world_joints, root = actor.pose_world(posed,(0,0,0),0,rifle_on=False)
            B, origin = s.handset_frame(actor,posed,(0,0,0),0)
            receiver = tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(origin,m_apply(B,(0,.070,0))))
            ear = tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(ear,root))
            assert math.dist(receiver,ear)<.055,(key,receiver,ear)
            assert math.dist(origin,world_joints['lhand'])>.06
        print('radio_receivers_at_ears: OK')
        initial=f._yaw_to(f._SNIPER,f._BIRIBEL)+10
        assert s.ucilev_block(0,f._SNIPER,initial)[0]==f._SNIPER
        assert abs(s.ucilev_block(0,f._SNIPER,initial)[1]-initial)<.001
        assert s.ucilev_block(3300,f._SNIPER,initial)[0]==s.ucilev_block(4200,f._SNIPER,initial)[0]
        assert s.beat(3300,3500,750)==0 and s.beat(4300,3500,750)==1
        assert s.ucilev_block(4300,f._SNIPER,initial)[0][2]<f._SNIPER[2]+s.ROOF_DOOR_Z
        assert s.ucilev_block(6200,f._SNIPER,initial)[0][2]>f._SNIPER[2]+s.ROOF_DOOR_Z+.8
        assert abs(s.maru_block(5350)[0][0]-s.MARU_PORTAL_X)<.001
        assert s.maru_block(5350)[0][2]<-2.5
        assert s.maru_yaw(5350)==180
        assert s.maru_block(3100)[0] == s.maru_block(3500)[0]
        assert s.maru_move_weight(3300) == 0
        for t in range(0,6801,10):
            pos, _, distance, _ = s.ucilev_block(t,f._SNIPER,initial)
            assert abs(pos[1]-f._SNIPER[1]-s.stair_height(distance))<1e-9
        assert abs(s.ucilev_block(6200,f._SNIPER,initial)[0][1]-(f._SNIPER[1]-1.68))<1e-9
        assert mission5_ending_shots[0]['min_ms']>=9600
        # New authored exit cuts on handle contact, before stair descent.
        assert 3550 < mission5_ending_shots[3]['min_ms'] < 4300
        print('turn_pause_open_enter_and_escape: OK')
        out=ROOT/'outputs'/'m5_restage'
        out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        for d in (0, .5, 1.0):
            pose = s.patrol_carry(hum, d, 1.0)
            assert penetration(hum, pose) == 0, ('carry intersects torso/head', d)
            _, j2, R2, _ = hum.placements(pose)
            muz = tuple(a - b for a, b in zip(m_apply(R2, (0, 0, 1)), m_apply(R2, (0, 0, 0))))
            assert muz[1] < -0.5, ('muzzle not down in carry', d, muz)
            guard = tuple(a + b for a, b in zip(j2['rhand'], m_apply(R2, (0, -0.03, 0.34))))
            assert math.dist(j2['lhand'], guard) < .025, ('left hand off handguard', d)
        print('patrol_carry_grip_and_clearance: OK')
        # Test the actual production transition, not only its valid endpoints.
        transition_gap = 0.0
        from engine3d.rig import blend
        fixture = blend(s.rifle_pose(hum,52),s.patrol_carry(hum),.5)
        _, fj, fR, _ = hum.placements(fixture)
        ft = tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(fj['rhand'],m_apply(fR,(0,-.0275,.29))))
        assert math.dist(fj['lhand'],ft)>.04,'Known-bad blend no longer exercises the grip regression'
        for t in range(0,8401,60):
            pose = s.reveal_pose(hum,t)
            fold = s.beat(t,5200,1600)
            _, joints, R, _ = hum.placements(pose)
            target = tuple(a+b for a,b in zip(joints['rhand'],m_apply(R,(0,-.025-.005*fold,.24+.10*fold))))
            gap = math.dist(joints['lhand'],target)
            transition_gap = max(transition_gap,gap)
            assert gap<.025,('production lowering loses hand contact',t,gap)
            assert penetration(hum,pose)==0,('production lowering clips body',t)
        print('production_lowering_grip_and_clearance: OK; max error %.5f m'%transition_gap)
        sx,sy,sz=f._SNIPER
        for t in range(0,6801,60):
            pos,yaw,d,reach=s.ucilev_block(t,f._SNIPER,initial)
            moving=max(s.move_weight(t,650,2650),s.move_weight(t,4300,1900))
            pose=s.patrol_carry(hum,d,moving)
            pose=s.door_reach(hum,pose,pos,yaw,(sx-.46,sy+1.26,sz+s.ROOF_DOOR_Z-.15),reach)
            assert penetration(hum,pose)==0,('production walk/door body clipping',t)
        print('production_walk_and_door_clearance: OK')
        # A populated destination with a genuinely open central route.
        meshes=[]
        from types import SimpleNamespace
        recorder=SimpleNamespace(add_dynamic=lambda *a,**kw:None)
        s.quay_destination(recorder,0,lambda r,m: meshes.append(m),lambda *a:None,f._fx)
        inside=[m for m in meshes if all(v[2]<-5.5 for v in m.verts)]
        assert len(inside)>60,('warehouse storage missing',len(inside))
        for z in (-2,-3,-4,-6,-8,-10):
            for m in meshes:
                lo=[min(v[i] for v in m.verts) for i in range(3)]
                hi=[max(v[i] for v in m.verts) for i in range(3)]
                assert not all(lo[i]<p<hi[i] for i,p in enumerate((10.3,1.0,z))),('warehouse aisle blocked',z)
        print('furnished_warehouse_and_clear_aisle: OK')
        check_tracking_background(f,config,pygame)
        probes=[('ots_0900',f._river,900),('east_2200',f._river,2200),('east_2800',f._river,2800),('turn_3200',f._river,3200),('turn_3400',f._river,3400),('track_3600',f._river,3600),('threshold_6000',f._river,6000),('dot_8600',f._river,8600),
                ('scope_2600',f._scope,2600),('scope_4600',f._scope,4600),
                ('lift_1200',f._reveal,1200),('face_3800',f._reveal,3800),('carry_7200',f._reveal,7200),
                ('turn_0900',f._leaves,900),('otsroof_3000',f._leaves,3000),('door_5000',f._leaves,5000),('seam_6600',f._leaves,6600),
                ('radio_3000',f._radio,3000)]
        for name,draw,t in probes:
            draw(config.screen,t)
            pygame.image.save(config.screen,str(out/(name+'.png')))
        assert not f._cache['failed'],repr(f._cache['err'])
        from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
        sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1600,1920),(8,12,18)); label=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
        for i,(name,_,_) in enumerate(probes):
            image=Image.open(out/(name+'.png')).convert('RGB')
            image.thumbnail((400,280))
            x,y=i%4*400,i//4*320
            sheet.paste(image,(x,y));label.text((x+8,y+288),name,fill=(220,216,205))
        sheet.save(out/'sheet.jpg',quality=90)
        print('M5 ENDING STAGE CHECK: OK; backend='+str(getattr(f._rend()[0],'backend','?')))
        pygame.quit()

if __name__=='__main__':main()
