# ── 1. Ticker ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class Ticker:
    """One ffmpeg rawvideo pipe. stdio back-pressure is the intended throttle;
    the resulting clip length is frame-count driven, not wall-clock driven."""

    def __init__(self, ffmpeg: str, out: Path):
        self.out = out
        self.frames = 0
        self._sigs: set[bytes] = set()
        self._prev_sig: bytes | None = None
        self._changed = 0
        self._samples = 0
        self._lum: list[int] = []
        self.proc = subprocess.Popen(
            [ffmpeg, "-y", "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24",
             "-s", f"{WIDTH}x{HEIGHT}", "-r", str(FPS), "-i", "-", "-an",
             "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-crf", "16",
             "-preset", "medium", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(out)],
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

    def feed(self, sample_every: int = 30) -> None:
        self.proc.stdin.write(pygame.image.tobytes(config.screen, "RGB"))
        self.frames += 1
        if self.frames % sample_every:
            return
        # Liveness probe: a downscaled RGB signature per sample. A dark game
        # has a narrow mean-luma range, so "is it animating" must be answered by
        # frame-to-frame delta, not by absolute brightness.
        self._samples += 1
        small = pygame.transform.smoothscale(config.screen, (40, 28))
        sig = pygame.image.tobytes(small, "RGB")
        self._sigs.add(sig)
        if self._prev_sig is not None and sig != self._prev_sig:
            self._changed += 1
        self._prev_sig = sig
        r, g, b, _a = pygame.transform.average_color(small)
        self._lum.append((r * 299 + g * 587 + b * 114) // 1000)

    def close(self) -> str:
        self.proc.stdin.close()
        self.proc.wait()
        if self.proc.returncode != 0:
            return f"ffmpeg exited {self.proc.returncode}"
        return ""

    @property
    def unique_frames(self) -> int:
        return len(self._sigs)

    @property
    def changed_ratio(self) -> float:
        return round(self._changed / self._samples, 2) if self._samples else 0.0

    @property
    def mean_luma(self) -> float:
        return round(sum(self._lum) / len(self._lum), 2) if self._lum else 0.0


# ── 2. HudPolicy ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Taxonomy: the engine has NO debug labels or FPS overlay (grep-verified), so
# "debug labels" means the scaffolding the legacy trailer scripts drew
# themselves -- which this script simply never draws. What remains is real UI.
#
#   clean (default) remove every overlay, keep gameplay panels
#   bare            also remove the bottom-left HUD cluster
#   full            zero patching (A/B escape hatch)
#
# `bare` uses an adjacent-strip mirror: blit a HUD-free region of the same
# frame over the HUD cluster. A flat plate was measured and rejected -- bright
# green HUD text ghosts through at 5% alpha and reads as a bug.
BARE_RECTS = [
    # (destination, mirror-source)  -- covers M1/M2/M3 ammo+HP+molotov stack
    ((18, 500, 310, 180), (328, 500, 310, 180)),
    # HOSTILES chip, identical in all three missions: bg (20,20,180,26)
    ((18, 18, 190, 32), (208, 18, 190, 32)),
    # M2-only COMMS status, bottom-right
    ((846, 652, 150, 32), (536, 652, 150, 32)),
]

_orig_hud_fns: dict[str, object] = {}


def _rebind_everywhere(name: str, replacer) -> int:
    """Rebind `name` on every module that holds a reference to the original.

    Patching ui.hud alone does nothing: every mission part module did
    `from ui.hud import draw_objective_panel` at import time, binding the
    original function into its own globals -- and the three missions call it
    from three DIFFERENT modules. Sweeping sys.modules is order-independent
    and needs no module list to maintain.
    """
    orig = _orig_hud_fns.get(name)
    n = 0
    for mod in list(sys.modules.values()):
        if mod is not None and getattr(mod, name, None) is orig:
            setattr(mod, name, replacer)
            n += 1
    return n


def apply_hud_policy(policy: str) -> None:
    if policy == "full":
        return
    global _orig_hud_fns
    if not _orig_hud_fns:
        _orig_hud_fns = {
            "draw_objective_panel": _hud.draw_objective_panel,
            "draw_pinned_radio": _hud.draw_pinned_radio,
        }
    _rebind_everywhere("draw_objective_panel", _noop)
    _rebind_everywhere("draw_pinned_radio", _noop)
    # Mission 3's in-world objective nav arrow + label.
    try:
        import missions.m3.draw as m3_draw
        m3_draw._draw_objective_waypoint = _noop
    except Exception:
        pass
    if policy == "bare":
        # Belt-and-braces second layer: M2/M3 consolidate their HUD into one
        # function. M1 does not (its HUD is inline in _game_draw_inner), which
        # is exactly why the mirror-strip above is the uniform code path.
        for modname, attr in (("missions.m2.draw", "_draw_hud"),
                              ("missions.m3.systems", "_draw_mission3_hud")):
            try:
                import importlib
                setattr(importlib.import_module(modname), attr, _noop)
            except Exception:
                pass


def _noop(*a, **k):
    return None


def strip_after_boot() -> None:
    """Re-apply the per-frame-visible switches. start_mission* sets
    show_minimap back to True, so this MUST run after every boot."""
    STATE.show_minimap = False
    interactions.clear_radio_queue()
    # Kills the static startup hint text, e.g. "[G] or RIGHT-CLICK to throw a
    # molotov" (m1/main.py:136). Transient world texts still appear later.
    STATE.floating_texts.clear()


def apply_bare_mask() -> None:
    for dest, src in BARE_RECTS:
        config.screen.blit(config.screen, dest, pygame.Rect(src))


def drop_ghost_texts() -> None:
    """Prevent a world floating text inside a mirror SOURCE rect from ghosting
    into the corner we just painted over."""
    srcs = [pygame.Rect(s) for _d, s in BARE_RECTS]
    cam_x, cam_y = STATE.camera_x, STATE.camera_y
    STATE.floating_texts[:] = [
        ft for ft in STATE.floating_texts
        if len(ft) < 2 or not any(
            r.collidepoint(ft[0] - cam_x, ft[1] - cam_y) for r in srcs)
    ]


# ── 3. Router ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class Router:
    """Walkability grid + the engine's own A*. Only used for APPROACH --
    engage-on-sight is handled by the Driver. Locked doors are stamped out so
    A* cannot route through them; unlocked auto-open doors stay passable."""

    def __init__(self, tmap, solids):
        self.grid = [[ch not in solids for ch in row] for row in tmap]
        for d in getattr(STATE, "doors", []) or []:
            if getattr(d, "locked", False) and getattr(d, "collision_rect", None):
                r = d.collision_rect
                for ty in range(r.y // T, (r.y + r.height) // T + 1):
                    for tx in range(r.x // T, (r.x + r.width) // T + 1):
                        if 0 <= ty < len(self.grid) and 0 <= tx < len(self.grid[0]):
                            self.grid[ty][tx] = False

    def path_to(self, sx, sy, gx, gy):
        try:
            raw = _astar((sx, sy), (gx, gy), self.grid)
        except Exception:
            return []
        return [(x * T + T // 2, y * T + T // 2) for x, y in raw]


# ── 4. Driver ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class Keys:
    """Duck-types pygame.key.get_pressed() for game_update(keys)."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.down: set[int] = set()

    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return k in self.down


class Driver:
    ENGAGE_RADIUS = int(os.environ.get("ACA_ENGAGE", "950"))
    SEEK_RADIUS = 2400
    CLOSE_BELOW, BACKOFF_BELOW = 330, 170
    REPATH_EVERY = 30
    ARRIVE_PX = 26
    STUCK_TICKS = 45        # ~0.75s of no progress before trying another target
    NAV_BLOCK_TICKS = 240   # 4s cooldown before re-attempting a wedged target

    # Trigger discipline: minimum ticks between trigger pulls, per weapon.
    # The engine cooldown (pistol 12f / OS-12 8f / K-9 5f) is the hard rate
    # limit; this sits on top of it so the gun fires at a human rate instead
    # of being held down. Expressed as shots/second: pistol 3.0, OS-12 5.0,
    # K-9 7.5 -- and jittered so it never reads as a metronome.
    MIN_INTERVAL = {"pistol": 20, "os12": 12, "k9_smg": 8}

    def __init__(self, router: Router, crosshair: bool = False,
                 ghost_filter: bool = True):
        self.router = router
        self.keys = Keys()
        self.cam = [0, 0]
        self.crosshair = crosshair
        self.ghost_filter = ghost_filter
        self.prev: dict = {}
        self.path: list = []
        self.pi = 0
        self.repath = 0
        self.tickno = 0
        self.engaged_tick = -1
        self.shots = 0
        self.kills = 0
        self._prev_kills = 0
        self._burst = 0
        self._gap = 0
        self._last_fire = -999
        self.blind_shots = 0      # shots actually fired without confirmed LOS
        self.no_los_ticks = 0     # ticks walking with no visible target
        self.engaged_ticks = 0    # ticks with a confirmed-visible target
        self.los_rects = 0        # size of the LOS wall set actually used
        self._aim = None          # world point the barrel is actually on
        self._walk_face = None    # A* waypoint / approach point while blind
        # foley event log state
        self.events: list = []
        self._foley_last = None
        self._step_acc = 0.0
        self._foley_bullets: set = set()
        self._foley_ehp = None
        self._foley_melee = False
        self._foley_reload = False
        self._nav_eid = None      # enemy we are currently navigating toward
        self._nav_block: dict = {}   # enemy id -> tick until which to ignore
        self._stuck = 0
        self._last_pos = None
        self.repaths = 0

    # -- LOS wall set ---------------------------------------------------
    def _los_walls(self):
        """The authoritative per-mission collision set for line-of-sight.

        weapons._solid_walls() is only STATE.walls + door collision rects.
        M2 keeps FOUR extra families on top of it (vehicle hulls, props, the
        shelter blast crescent, the garden) and M3 keeps mission3_barriers
        (every shelf, cabinet, crate and pillar). Using the base set made the
        bot shoot straight through the IPA truck and every piece of Archives
        furniture -- the "aimbot that ignores walls" artefact.

        These are the same functions the bullet loops use to resolve
        collisions (m2/update.py:46, m3/systems.py:65), so LOS and bullet
        flight now agree.
        """
        mission = getattr(STATE, "active_mission", "MISSION1")
        mod = {"MISSION2": "missions.m2.world",
               "MISSION3": "missions.m3.world"}.get(mission)
        if mod:
            try:
                import importlib
                return list(importlib.import_module(mod)._solid_walls())
            except Exception:
                pass
        return list(weapons._solid_walls())

    # -- perception -----------------------------------------------------
    def _nearest_enemy(self):
        p = STATE.player
        px, py = p.rect.center
        best, bd = None, self.SEEK_RADIUS
        for e in STATE.enemies:
            if getattr(e, "hp", 0) <= 0:
                continue
            d = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py)
            if d < bd:
                best, bd = e, d
        return best

    def _acquire(self, walls):
        """Return (visible_target, navigation_target).

        Picks the nearest enemy we can actually SEE, not merely the nearest
        enemy. Locking onto raw distance makes the bot walk into a shelf to
        reach a body it cannot shoot at while a third of the room is wide open
        -- in the Archives that left line of sight available on only 23% of
        ticks. Candidates are tested nearest-first and the scan short-circuits
        on the first clear segment, so the common case costs one test.

        Falls back to the nearest overall (outside ENGAGE_RADIUS or fully
        blocked) purely as a navigation goal -- never as a shooting target.
        """
        p = STATE.player
        px, py = p.rect.center
        cands = []
        fallback, bd = None, self.SEEK_RADIUS
        for e in STATE.enemies:
            if getattr(e, "hp", 0) <= 0:
                continue
            eid = id(e)
            if self._nav_block.get(eid, -1) > self.tickno:
                continue      # wedged against this one recently; try another
            d = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py)
            if d < bd:
                fallback, bd = e, d
            if d <= self.ENGAGE_RADIUS:
                cands.append((d, e))
        if cands:
            cands.sort(key=lambda t: t[0])
            for _d, e in cands:
                if self._segment_clear(px, py, e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery,
                                       walls):
                    return e, e
            return None, cands[0][1]
        return None, fallback

    def _segment_clear(self, x1, y1, x2, y2, walls) -> bool:
        """Strict segment test against the live collision set, plus a body
        check so we do not lock onto a point sitting inside geometry."""
        for w in walls:
            if w.collidepoint(x1, y1) or w.collidepoint(x2, y2):
                return False
            if w.clipline((x1, y1), (x2, y2)):
                return False
        return True

    def _has_los(self, e, walls) -> bool:
        p = STATE.player
        px, py = p.rect.center
        ex, ey = e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery
        if math.hypot(ex - px, ey - py) > self.ENGAGE_RADIUS:
            return False
        return self._segment_clear(px, py, ex, ey, walls)

    # -- aim ------------------------------------------------------------
    def aim_world(self, wx, wy) -> None:
        """Drive the engine's real aim path. m1/m2/m3 all derive
        STATE.player.angle from get_scaled_mouse() every game_update, and
        pygame.mouse.set_pos() works under SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy."""
        pygame.mouse.set_pos((int(wx - STATE.camera_x),
                              int(wy - STATE.camera_y)))

    # -- movement -------------------------------------------------------
    def _steer_toward(self, tx, ty, px, py) -> None:
        k = self.keys
        if abs(tx - px) > 8:
            k.down.add(pygame.K_d if tx > px else pygame.K_a)
        if abs(ty - py) > 8:
            k.down.add(pygame.K_s if ty > py else pygame.K_w)

    def _move(self, seen, target, px, py) -> None:
        """Set movement intent. Returns nothing -- the face point is resolved
        post-move, because the player has not moved yet and any aim chosen now
        would be a frame stale by the time the bullet leaves the barrel."""
        k = self.keys
        if target is None:
            k.down.clear()
            self._nav_eid = None
            return
        ex, ey = target.rect.centerx, target.rect.centery
        d = math.hypot(ex - px, ey - py)
        self._nav_eid = id(target)
        if seen is None:
            # Not visible: navigate around the geometry with A* rather than
            # beelining into a wall.
            if self.repath <= 0:
                self.path = self.router.path_to(
                    int(px // T), int(py // T),
                    int(ex // T), int(ey // T))
                self.pi = 0
                self.repath = self.REPATH_EVERY
            self.repath -= 1
            while self.pi < len(self.path) - 1 and math.hypot(
                    self.path[self.pi][0] - px,
                    self.path[self.pi][1] - py) < self.ARRIVE_PX:
                self.pi += 1
            if self.pi < len(self.path):
                wp = self.path[self.pi]
                self._steer_toward(wp[0], wp[1], px, py)
                self._walk_face = wp
                return
            self._walk_face = (ex, ey)   # A* failed; walk straight at it
        else:
            self._walk_face = (ex, ey)
        if d > self.CLOSE_BELOW:
            self._steer_toward(ex, ey, px, py)
        elif d < self.BACKOFF_BELOW:
            k.down.add(pygame.K_a if ex > px else pygame.K_d)
        else:
            k.down.add(pygame.K_a if (self.tickno // 25) % 2 else pygame.K_d)

    def _aim_and_fire(self, walls):
        """Post-move phase: re-perceive from where the player NOW is, aim, and
        fire. Doing this after game_update is what makes the LOS gate honest --
        aim, trigger and bullet all derive from the same frame state instead of
        a position the player has already left."""
        p = STATE.player
        px, py = p.rect.center
        seen, _nav = self._acquire(walls)

        if seen is None:
            self.no_los_ticks += 1
            # Face the way we are walking -- never an enemy we cannot see.
            # Aiming at a hidden target is the tell-tale 'shooting through the
            # wall' silhouette even when the trigger is disciplined.
            if self._walk_face is not None:
                self.aim_world(*self._walk_face)
            self._aim = None
            return None

        self.engaged_ticks += 1
        if self.engaged_tick < 0:
            self.engaged_tick = self.tickno
        ex, ey = seen.rect.centerx, seen.rect.centery
        key = getattr(seen, "uid", id(seen))
        pvx, pvy = self.prev.get(key, (ex, ey))
        self.prev[key] = (ex, ey)
        d = math.hypot(ex - px, ey - py)
        lead = d / 30.0   # enemy bullets run 18-24 px/frame; 30 errs long
        ax, ay = ex + (ex - pvx) * lead, ey + (ey - pvy) * lead
        # Only take the lead if the led point is still reachable -- otherwise
        # the barrel drifts a few px into the corner the enemy is hugging and
        # every shot dies on the brick.
        if not self._segment_clear(px, py, ax, ay, walls):
            ax, ay = ex, ey
        self._aim = (ax, ay)
        self.aim_world(ax, ay)
        return seen

    # -- trigger discipline ---------------------------------------------
    def _want_fire(self, engaged: bool) -> bool:
        """Hold the trigger only with a confirmed-visible target, and only at a
        human cadence. handle_shoot() performs no LOS check of its own -- it
        just fires along player.angle -- so an ungated call sprays the whole
        take, which is the 'just shoots and shoots' artefact."""
        if not engaged:
            return False
        gap = self.MIN_INTERVAL.get(getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol"), 20)
        if self.tickno - self._last_fire < gap:
            return False
        self._last_fire = self.tickno - int(gap * random.uniform(-0.12, 0.30))
        return True

    def _audit_shot(self, walls, seen) -> None:
        """Independent post-hoc check on the shot that was just taken: re-test
        the ray the bullet actually travelled (the led aim point, not the
        enemy centre) against the live collision set. This is a regression
        tripwire -- if a future refactor lets the gate leak, it surfaces here
        rather than as a bullet quietly absorbed by a wall."""
        if seen is None or self._aim is None:
            self.blind_shots += 1
            return
        p = STATE.player
        px, py = p.rect.center
        ax, ay = self._aim
        if not self._segment_clear(px, py, ax, ay, walls):
            self.blind_shots += 1

    # -- foley event log -------------------------------------------------
    # The capture runs with SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy, so the engine's own sound
    # is discarded and the master ships silent. This log is the substitute
    # signal: tools/build_sfx_stem.py re-renders the real sfx_wav/*.wav assets
    # at these exact ticks to build trailer_sfx_stem.wav for the audio mux.
    #
    # Only events observable from live state are logged. Footsteps are the one
    # derived value: the engine plays them internally off a distance accumulator
    # (entities/player.py: _step_timer resets to 34 + rand(0,8) px), so this
    # mirrors that cadence rather than inventing a new one.
    FOOTSTEP_PX = 34.0

    def _log(self, kind: str, **kw) -> None:
        self.events.append(dict(t=self.tickno, kind=kind, **kw))

    def _track_foley(self) -> None:
        p = STATE.player
        cx, cy = p.rect.center
        if self._foley_last is not None:
            moved = math.hypot(cx - self._foley_last[0], cy - self._foley_last[1])
            if moved > 0.5:
                # Counts DOWN, exactly like entities/player.py: the engine
                # decrements _step_timer by distance travelled and fires at
                # zero. (An earlier version accumulated upward but tested for
                # <= 0, so no footstep ever logged.)
                self._step_acc -= moved
                if self._step_acc <= 0:
                    self._log("footstep")
                    self._step_acc = 34.0 + random.randint(0, 8)
            else:
                self._step_acc = min(self._step_acc, 6.0)
        self._foley_last = (cx, cy)

        # Enemy fire: new bullets owned by an enemy. Counted by uid so a
        # bullet that survives several ticks is not re-logged.
        live = set()
        for b in getattr(STATE, "bullets", []) or []:
            if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("owner") == "enemy":
                uid = b.get("uid", id(b))
                live.add(uid)
                if uid not in self._foley_bullets:
                    self._log("enemy_shot")
        self._foley_bullets = live

        # Damage: compare total living enemy HP against last tick's total.
        total = sum(max(0, getattr(e, "hp", 0)) for e in STATE.enemies)
        if self._foley_ehp is not None and total < self._foley_ehp:
            self._log("enemy_hit", dmg=round(self._foley_ehp - total, 1))
        self._foley_ehp = total

        # Rising edges only -- a held reload must not log 90 events.
        mel = bool(getattr(STATE, "melee_active", False))
        if mel and not self._foley_melee:
            self._log("melee")
        self._foley_melee = mel
        rld = bool(getattr(STATE, "is_reloading", False))
        if rld and not self._foley_reload:
            self._log("reload")
        self._foley_reload = rld

    # -- capture harness ------------------------------------------------
    def _invulnerable(self) -> None:
        """Keep the operator alive and the active weapon loaded so a 10s take
        is 10s of combat. Only the ACTIVE weapon is topped up -- the legacy
        top_up() only handled K-9 and the M1 fields, so M2 OS-12 takes ran
        dry and stalled."""
        p = STATE.player
        p.hp = p.max_hp
        w = getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol")
        if w == "k9_smg":
            STATE.k9_ammo_in_mag = STATE.k9_mag_size
        elif w == "os12":
            STATE.os12_ammo_in_mag = STATE.os12_mag_size
        else:
            STATE.ammo_in_mag = STATE.mag_size

    def tick(self) -> None:
        self.tickno += 1
        p = STATE.player
        if p is None or STATE.player_dead:
            return
        if self.ghost_filter and BARE_RECTS and _BARE_MODE[0]:
            drop_ghost_texts()

        k = self.keys
        k.down.clear()
        self._walk_face = None

        # -- pre-move: perceive, then set movement intent ------------------
        walls = self._los_walls()
        self.los_rects = len(walls)
        px, py = p.rect.center
        seen, target = self._acquire(walls)
        self._move(seen, target, px, py)
        self._invulnerable()

        cam = gc.game_update(k)
        if cam:
            self.cam[0], self.cam[1] = cam

        # Stuck detection: the Archives is a maze, and a naive "walk at the
        # nearest body" wedges the player against a shelf for seconds while an
        # enemy stands 130px away on the other side. When progress stalls,
        # deprioritise that body and re-path toward the next candidate.
        px2, py2 = p.rect.center
        if self._last_pos is not None:
            if math.hypot(px2 - self._last_pos[0],
                          py2 - self._last_pos[1]) > 1.5:
                self._stuck = 0
            else:
                self._stuck += 1
        self._last_pos = (px2, py2)
        if self._stuck > self.STUCK_TICKS and self._nav_eid is not None:
            self._nav_block[self._nav_eid] = self.tickno + self.NAV_BLOCK_TICKS
            self.repaths += 1
            self._stuck = 0
            self.repath = 0            # force A* re-computation next tick
            self.path = []

        # -- post-move: re-perceive, aim, fire ---------------------------
        # The missions overwrite STATE.player.angle from the mouse during
        # game_update, so aiming before the update is pointless anyway. Doing
        # it here means aim, trigger and bullet all share one frame state.
        walls = self._los_walls()
        self.los_rects = len(walls)
        seen = self._aim_and_fire(walls)

        # Fire only with a confirmed-visible target. handle_shoot() just fires
        # along player.angle and checks nothing, so the gate lives here.
        if self._want_fire(seen is not None):
            before = getattr(STATE, "shots_fired", 0)
            weapons.handle_shoot()
            if getattr(STATE, "shots_fired", 0) != before:
                self.shots += 1
                self._log("player_shot",
                          weapon=getattr(STATE, "current_weapon", "pistol"))
                self._audit_shot(walls, seen)
        self._track_foley()

        gc.game_draw(self.cam[0], self.cam[1])
        if _BARE_MODE[0]:
            apply_bare_mask()
        if self.crosshair:
            try:
                _hud.draw_gameplay_crosshair(config.screen, "GAME")
            except Exception:
                pass
        pygame.event.pump()

        cur = (getattr(STATE, "hostiles_killed", 0)
               + getattr(STATE, "mission3_guards_killed", 0))
        if cur != self._prev_kills:
            self.kills += cur - self._prev_kills
            self._prev_kills = cur


_BARE_MODE = [False]   # mutable single-slot so Driver can read it cheaply


# ── 5. capture_act ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def capture_act(act, args, ffmpeg: str) -> dict:
    print(f"[{act['key']}] {act['label']} -- booting checkpoint", flush=True)
    random.seed(args.seed)
    act["boot"]()
    if STATE.player is None:
        raise RuntimeError("checkpoint produced no player")

    strip_after_boot()
    driver = Driver(Router(act["tmap"], act["solids"]),
                    crosshair=args.crosshair,
                    ghost_filter=not args.no_ghost_filter)

    out = Path(args.out_dir) / f"{act['key']}.mp4"
    tick = Ticker(ffmpeg, out)
    total = int(round(args.seconds * SIM_HZ))
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    for n in range(total):
        driver.tickno = n
        driver.tick()
        if n % 2 == 1:
            tick.feed()
    err = tick.close()
    wall = time.perf_counter() - t0

    rep = dict(
        act=act["key"], label=act["label"],
        frames=tick.frames, seconds=round(tick.frames / FPS, 2),
        ticks=total, contact_tick=driver.engaged_tick,
        contact_sec=round(max(0, driver.engaged_tick) / SIM_HZ, 2),
        shots=driver.shots, kills=driver.kills,
        shots_per_sec=round(driver.shots / max(0.001, args.seconds), 2),
        trigger_duty=round(driver.shots / max(1, driver.engaged_ticks), 3),
        no_los_ticks=driver.no_los_ticks,
        stuck_repaths=driver.repaths,
        blind_shots=driver.blind_shots,
        los_rects=driver.los_rects,
        engaged_ticks=driver.engaged_ticks,
        enemies_left=len(STATE.enemies),
        mean_luma=tick.mean_luma, unique_frames=tick.unique_frames,
        changed_ratio=tick.changed_ratio,
        wall_sec=round(wall, 1), out=str(out),
        bytes=out.stat().st_size if out.exists() else 0,
        foley_events=len(driver.events),
        foley_log=str(out.with_suffix(".foley.json")),
    )
    # Sidecar foley log: the SFX stem generator reads this, not the video.
    out.with_suffix(".foley.json").write_text(json.dumps(
        dict(act=act["key"], label=act["label"], starter=act["starter"],
             hz=SIM_HZ, frames=tick.frames, seconds=round(tick.frames / FPS, 3),
             ticks=total, seed=args.seed,
             stats=dict(shots=driver.shots, kills=driver.kills,
                        blind_shots=driver.blind_shots,
                        enemy_shots=sum(1 for e in driver.events
                                        if e["kind"] == "enemy_shot")),
             events=driver.events), indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
    return rep, err, total, driver


# ── 6. verification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def verify(rep, err, total, driver, args, ffprobe) -> list:
    fails = []
    if err:
        fails.append(err)
    if rep["frames"] != int(round(args.seconds * FPS)):
        fails.append(f'frame count {rep["frames"]} != {int(round(args.seconds * FPS))}')
    if driver.engaged_tick < 0:
        fails.append("no enemy ever acquired line of sight -- clip is not combat")
    elif driver.engaged_tick > 0.6 * total:
        fails.append(f'contact at {driver.engaged_tick / SIM_HZ:.1f}s '
                     f'(> 60% of the {args.seconds:.0f}s take)')
    if driver.kills < 2:
        fails.append(f'only {driver.kills} kill(s) -- gun is not connecting')
    # Wall discipline: the trigger must never be pulled without line of sight.
    if driver.blind_shots > 0:
        fails.append(f'{driver.blind_shots} shot(s) fired without line of sight '
                     f'-- walls are being ignored')
    # Trigger discipline: a gun held down at its cooldown is not a firefight.
    if rep["trigger_duty"] > 0.6:
        fails.append(f'trigger duty {rep["trigger_duty"]} > 0.6 -- '
                     f'firing near-continuously instead of at a human cadence')
    if rep["unique_frames"] < 3 or rep["changed_ratio"] < 0.5:
        fails.append(f'frame liveness: {rep["unique_frames"]} unique / '
                     f'{rep["changed_ratio"]} changed between samples -- '
                     f'frame looks frozen')
    if rep["mean_luma"] < 5:
        fails.append(f'mean luma {rep["mean_luma"]} < 5 -- frame is effectively black')
    if ffprobe:
        meta = probe(ffprobe, Path(rep["out"]))
        if meta.get("pix_fmt") not in (None, "yuv420p"):
            fails.append(f'pix_fmt={meta.get("pix_fmt")} (want yuv420p)')
        if meta.get("nb_frames") and int(meta["nb_frames"]) != rep["frames"]:
            fails.append(f'ffprobe nb_frames={meta["nb_frames"]} != {rep["frames"]}')
    return fails


def probe(ffprobe: str, path: Path) -> dict:
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(
            [ffprobe, "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
             "-show_entries", "stream=codec_name,width,height,pix_fmt,nb_frames",
             "-of", "json", str(path)],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, timeout=60)
        return (json.loads(r.stdout).get("streams") or [{}])[0]
    except Exception:
        return {}


# ── 7. merge ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def merge(ffmpeg: str, paths, out: Path) -> bool:
    lst = out.parent / "_concat.txt"
    lst.write_text("".join(f"file '{p.resolve()}'\n" for p in paths),
                   encoding="utf-8")
    r = subprocess.run(
        [ffmpeg, "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", str(lst),
         "-c", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(out)],
        stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    lst.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"  merge failed: {r.stderr[-500:]}", flush=True)
        return False
    return True


# ── main ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Clean standalone combat capture (3 verified checkpoints).")
    ap.add_argument("--act", default="all",
                    help="1 | 2 | 3 | all (comma list ok)")
    ap.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, default=DEFAULT_SECONDS)
    ap.add_argument("--hud", choices=("clean", "bare", "full"), default="clean")
    ap.add_argument("--out-dir", default="trailers/fresh_action")
    ap.add_argument("--merge", action="store_true",
                    help="also emit combat_<N>s.mp4 via the concat demuxer")
    ap.add_argument("--crosshair", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20260926)
    ap.add_argument("--keep-going", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--no-ghost-filter", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--list", action="store_true", help="print acts and exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    acts = _act_table()
    if args.list:
        print(f"{'act':<6}{'starter':<54}{'equiv CLI':<26}nav solids")
        for a in acts:
            print(f"{a['key']:<6}{a['starter']:<54}{a['cli']:<26}{a['solids']}")
        return 0

    try:
        ffmpeg = ffmpeg_exe()
    except SystemExit as e:
        print(f"PREFLIGHT FAIL: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    ffprobe = ffprobe_exe(ffmpeg)

    want = {"1", "2", "3"} if args.act == "all" else {
        w.strip() for w in str(args.act).split(",") if w.strip()}
    selected = [a for a in acts if str(a["n"]) in want]
    if not selected:
        print(f"PREFLIGHT FAIL: --act {args.act!r} matched no checkpoint",
              file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    out_dir = (ROOT / args.out_dir) if not Path(args.out_dir).is_absolute() \
        else Path(args.out_dir)
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    _BARE_MODE[0] = args.hud == "bare"
    apply_hud_policy(args.hud)
    SETTINGS.show_crosshair = bool(args.crosshair)
    if hasattr(config, "audio"):
        try:
            config.audio.set_master_volume(0)
        except Exception:
            pass

    print(f"ffmpeg   : {ffmpeg}")
    print(f"output   : {out_dir}")
    print(f"hud      : {args.hud}   seconds/act: {args.seconds:g}   seed: {args.seed}")
    print(f"scratch  : {_SCRATCH}  (save_data.json / settings.json sandboxed)")
    print("-" * 72, flush=True)

    report, failed = [], 0
    for act in selected:
        try:
            rep, err, total, driver = capture_act(act, args, ffmpeg)
        except Exception as e:
            failed += 1
            print(f"[{act['key']}] FAILED: {e!r}", flush=True)
            if not args.keep_going:
                break
            continue
        fails = verify(rep, err, total, driver, args, ffprobe)
        rep["verified"] = not fails
        rep["failures"] = fails
        report.append(rep)
        status = "OK" if not fails else "FAIL"
        print(f"  {status}  {rep['frames']}f / {rep['seconds']}s  "
              f"contact {rep['contact_sec']}s  "
              f"{rep['shots_per_sec']}/s ({rep['shots']} shots)  "
              f"kills {rep['kills']}  blind {rep['blind_shots']}  "
              f"los_rects {rep['los_rects']}  "
              f"left {rep['enemies_left']}  wall {rep['wall_sec']}s  "
              f"{rep['bytes'] // 1024} KB", flush=True)
        for f in fails:
            print(f"        - {f}", flush=True)
        if fails:
            failed += 1
            if not args.keep_going:
                break
        # Reset between acts: audio loops, radio queue, RNG.
        if hasattr(config, "audio"):
            for fn in ("stop_all", "stop_mission3_alarm"):
                try:
                    getattr(config.audio, fn)()
                except Exception:
                    pass
        interactions.clear_radio_queue()

    if args.merge and report:
        total_s = round(sum(r["seconds"] for r in report), 2)
        merged = out_dir / f"combat_{int(total_s)}s.mp4"
        print("-" * 72, flush=True)
        if merge(ffmpeg, [Path(r["out"]) for r in report], merged):
            print(f"  merged -> {merged}  {merged.stat().st_size // 1024} KB")

    (out_dir / "report.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"hud": args.hud, "seconds": args.seconds,
                    "seed": args.seed, "acts": report}, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8")
    print("-" * 72)
    print(f"report   : {out_dir / 'report.json'}")
    print(f"result   : {len(report)} act(s) captured, {failed} failed")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\render_ko_video.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Headless cinematic trailer bot, PLAN_2 cut.

Combat-only timeline, zero repeats: M1 warehouse shootout -> card ->
M3 cell breakout -> card -> M3 kill-order lobby gunfight -> outro card.
Each scene pre-rolls UNFED until first contact, so the first captured
frame is already shooting. No bottom text anywhere.

Renders REAL gameplay at 60 ticks/s, captures every 2nd frame to 30fps MP4.
"""
import math
import os
import subprocess
import sys

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT", "1")
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "src"))

import pygame
pygame.init()

import imageio_ffmpeg
from core import game_core as gc
from core.state import STATE
from core.config import WIDTH, HEIGHT, TILE_SIZE as T
from missions.m3 import maps as M
from missions.m3 import sweep
from missions.m3.sweep import _LANE_V, _LANE_H
from entities import weapons
from entities.enemy_ai import _astar

FFMPEG = imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
OUT = os.path.join(os.environ.get("ARENA_WORKSPACE",
                                      os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))),
                       "ko_phase5_preview.mp4")

proc = subprocess.Popen(
    [FFMPEG, "-y", "-f", "rawvideo", "-vcodec", "rawvideo",
     "-s", f"{WIDTH}x{HEIGHT}", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-r", "30",
     "-i", "-", "-an", "-c:v", "libx264", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", "-crf", "20",
     "-movflags", "+faststart", OUT],
    stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)

FONT_CAP = pygame.font.Font(None, 18)
FONT_BIG = pygame.font.Font(None, 64)
FONT_MID = pygame.font.Font(None, 28)

LOCKED = {(13, 12), (13, 20), (31, 32), (32, 32)}
WGRID = [[M.MISSION3_KILL_ORDER_MAP[y][x] not in ("C", "g", "B")
          and not (M.MISSION3_KILL_ORDER_MAP[y][x] == "D" and (x, y) in LOCKED)
          for x in range(40)] for y in range(40)]
PILLARS = [(15, 13), (15, 20), (19, 16), (24, 12), (21, 24)]


class Keys:
    def __init__(self):
        self.down = set()
    def __getitem__(self, k):
        return k in self.down


KEYS = Keys()
cam = [0, 0]
frame = [0]
CUM = [0]  # absolute sim ticks (preroll + capture) for the scene log
PREV = {}


def feed(surface):
    proc.stdin.write(pygame.image.tostring(surface, "RGB"))


def card(lines, seconds):
    for _ in range(int(seconds * 30)):
        s = pygame.Surface((WIDTH, HEIGHT))
        s.fill((6, 7, 6))
        y = HEIGHT // 2 - 40 * len(lines)
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
            f = FONT_BIG if i == 0 else FONT_MID
            col = (220, 210, 180) if i == 0 else (140, 160, 140)
            t = f.render(ln, True, col)
            s.blit(t, (WIDTH // 2 - t.get_width() // 2, y + i * 64))
        feed(s)


class Router:
    def __init__(self, goals, grid=None, door_map=None):
        self.goals = list(goals)
        self.grid = grid if grid is not None else WGRID
        self.door_map = door_map  # char-grid for straight-through "D" filter (KO only)
        self.wps = []
        self.i = 0
        self.stuck = 0
        self.last = None
        self.jit = 0
    def _route(self):
        if not self.goals or STATE.player is None:
            return
        gx, gy = self.goals.pop(0)
        px, py = STATE.player.rect.center
        try:
            path = _astar((int(px // T), int(py // T)), (gx, gy), self.grid)
        except Exception:
            path = []
        kept = []
        for idx, (x, y) in enumerate(path):
            if (0 < idx < len(path) - 1
                    and self.door_map is not None
                    and self.door_map[y][x] == "D"):
                (ax, ay), (bx, by) = path[idx - 1], path[idx + 1]
                if (ax - x, ay - y) == (x - bx, y - by):
                    continue
            kept.append((x * T + T // 2, y * T + T // 2))
        self.wps = kept or [(gx * T + T // 2, gy * T + T // 2)]
        self.i = 0
        self.stuck = 0
    def done(self):
        return not self.goals and self.i >= len(self.wps)
    def step(self):
        if self.i >= len(self.wps) and self.goals:
            self._route()
        if self.i >= len(self.wps):
            KEYS.down.clear()
            return
        px, py = STATE.player.rect.center
        tx, ty = self.wps[self.i]
        if math.hypot(tx - px, ty - py) < 24:
            self.i += 1
            self.stuck = 0
            return
        moved = self.last and math.hypot(px - self.last[0], py - self.last[1]) > 1.5
        self.stuck = 0 if moved else self.stuck + 1
        self.last = (px, py)
        KEYS.down.clear()
        if self.stuck > 40:
            self.jit = 30
            self.stuck = 0
        dx, dy = tx - px, ty - py
        if self.jit > 0:
            self.jit -= 1
            if abs(dy) >= abs(dx):
                KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_s if dy > 0 else pygame.K_w)
                KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_a if (self.jit // 15) % 2 else pygame.K_d)
            else:
                KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_d if dx > 0 else pygame.K_a)
                KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_w if (self.jit // 15) % 2 else pygame.K_s)
            return
        if abs(dx) > 6:
            KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_d if dx > 0 else pygame.K_a)
        if abs(dy) > 6:
            KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_s if dy > 0 else pygame.K_w)


def nearest_enemy(max_d=560):
    if not STATE.player:
        return None
    px, py = STATE.player.rect.center
    best, bd = None, max_d
    for e in STATE.enemies:
        if e.hp <= 0:
            continue
        d = math.hypot(e.rect.centerx - px, e.rect.centery - py)
        if d < bd:
            best, bd = e, d
    return best


def combat(shoot=True):
    """Aim with leading, burst-fire, strafe. Returns True if engaged."""
    e = nearest_enemy()
    if e is None:
        return False
    px, py = STATE.player.rect.center
    ex, ey = e.rect.centerx, e.rect.centery
    pvx, pvy = PREV.get(e.uid, (ex, ey))
    evx, evy = ex - pvx, ey - pvy
    PREV[e.uid] = (ex, ey)
    dist = math.hypot(ex - px, ey - py)
    lead_t = dist / 24.0
    ax, ay = ex + evx * lead_t, ey + evy * lead_t
    STATE.player.angle = math.atan2(ay - py, ax - px)   # real aim, real gun
    if dist < 52:  # PLAN_2: knife/shiv range - stab immediately, no wind-up
        try:
            weapons.handle_melee()
        except Exception:
            pass
    # PLAN_2: fire EVERY tick on target - weapon cooldowns gate the true
    # rate (pistol 12f / OS-12 8f / K-9 5f), so this clears immediately
    # instead of pausing inside a burst window.
    if shoot:
        weapons.handle_shoot()
    if (frame[0] // 25) % 2:
        KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_a)
    else:
        KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_d)
    return True


def seek_cover():
    """If the overwatch laser is painting us in a lane, hug nearest pillar."""
    st = getattr(STATE, "m3_sweep", None)
    if not st or st["overwatch"]["telegraph"] <= 0 or STATE.player is None:
        return False
    px, py = STATE.player.rect.center
    if not (_LANE_V.collidepoint(px, py) or _LANE_H.collidepoint(px, py)):
        return False
    cx, cy = min(PILLARS, key=lambda p: math.hypot(p[0] * T - px, p[1] * T - py))
    tx, ty = cx * T + T // 2, cy * T + T // 2 + 40
    KEYS.down.clear()
    dx, dy = tx - px, ty - py
    if abs(dx) > 8:
        KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_d if dx > 0 else pygame.K_a)
    if abs(dy) > 8:
        KEYS.down.add(pygame.K_s if dy > 0 else pygame.K_w)
    return True


def tick(router=None, fight=False, cap_text=None, cover=True, capture=True):
    """Advance one sim tick. capture=False pre-rolls WITHOUT feeding frames
    (used to skip dead walking so scene 1st fed frame is already combat)."""
    if STATE.player:
        STATE.player.hp = STATE.player.max_hp
        STATE.k9_ammo_in_mag = STATE.k9_mag_size
    if router:
        router.step()
    c = gc.game_update(KEYS)
    if c:
        cam[0], cam[1] = c
    engaged = False
    if fight:
        if not (cover and seek_cover()):
            engaged = combat()
    gc.game_draw(cam[0], cam[1])
    # PLAN_2: bottom phase label KILLED - no text at the bottom, ever.
    # (cap_text args at call sites are now no-ops; signature kept so the
    # run section needs no edits.)
    frame[0] += 1
    CUM[0] += 1
    if capture and frame[0] % 2 == 0:
        feed(screen)
    return engaged


# ═══ run - PLAN_2 trailer timeline: combat only, no repeats ═══
def _grid_from_chars(rows, solids):
    return [[ch not in solids for ch in row] for row in rows]


def stage_breakout_flags():
    """Post-craft breakout state (same flags the game sets on shiv finish).
    Without staging the cell door stays shut and the bot shuffles inside."""
    S = STATE
    S.mission3_weapon = "shiv"
    S.mission3_cell_open = True
    S.mission3_chair_broken = True
    S.mission3_chair_break_anim = -1
    S.mission3_doorway_blocked = False
    S.mission3_crafting_progress = 1.0
    S.mission3_crafting_active = False
    S.player_disarmed = False
    S.request_chair_break_cutscene = False


def preroll_until_contact(router, label, max_ticks=600):
    """Advance UNFED until the bot is firing. Returns ticks burned (not fed)."""
    for used in range(max_ticks):
        if tick(router, fight=True, capture=False):
            print(f"  {label}: contact after {used} preroll ticks (unfed)", flush=True)
            return used
    print(f"  {label}: NO CONTACT in {max_ticks} preroll ticks - capturing anyway", flush=True)
    return max_ticks


def capture(router, ticks, label):
    start = CUM[0]
    for _ in range(ticks):
        tick(router, fight=True)
    print(f"  {label}: fed ticks {start}-{CUM[0]} ({ticks} ticks = {ticks / 60:.1f}s)", flush=True)


print("TRAILER SCENES (60 ticks = 1s; preroll ticks are UNFED dead-time kills):")

# tools\render_m4_ending.py

"""Render the real M4 cutscene player safely, without importing app's loop.

Outputs a sound-on MP4 and camera contact sheet. Save/settings/profile paths
are isolated before imports. Uses native game art, captions, timeline and audio.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import wave

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT", "1")
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--stills-only", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = ROOT / "outputs"
    out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="acaristan_m4_preview_") as tmp:
        from core import save_system, settings_store, profile_store
        save_system.SAVE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / "save.json")
        settings_store.SAVE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / "settings.json")
        profile_store.PROFILE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / "profile.json")
        import pygame
        import numpy as np
        from core import config, game_core as gc
        from core.state import STATE
        from cutscenes import engine
        from missions.m4.meta import mission4_ending_shots
        from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

        STATE.reduced_motion = False
        W, H = config.WIDTH, config.HEIGHT
        shots = mission4_ending_shots
        audio = config.audio
        # Compile exact production player classes; do not execute application
        # startup, load the user's settings, or enter an interactive main loop.
        names = {"CutscenePlayer", "_CutsceneState", "_set_ambience", "_play_typewriter_tick"}
        tree = ast.parse((ROOT / "src" / "app.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
        nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef)) and n.name in names]
        now = [1000]
        saved_ticks = pygame.time.get_ticks
        pygame.time.get_ticks = lambda: now[0]
        namespace = dict(vars(config))
        done = []
        namespace.update(GameState=type("PreviewState", (), {}), gc=gc, audio=audio,
                         KO_CUT_CUES={}, TEXT_SPEED=4, active_cutscene=None,
                         _current_ambience=set(), _advance_grain=lambda: None,
                         gsm=type("PreviewFSM", (), {"transition": lambda self, target: done.append(target)})(),
                         mission_complete_timer=0, mission_complete_fade=0)
        exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), "app_cutscene_preview", "exec"), namespace)
        player_state = namespace["_CutsceneState"]()
        try:
            sheet = Image.new("RGB", (1500, 960), (9, 13, 21))
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
            font = ImageFont.truetype(str(ROOT / "assets" / "fonts" / "IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf"), 15)
            samples = [(0, 500, "01  PUBLIC BROADCAST"), (0, 3300, "02  THE PRESIDENT"),
                       (0, 6000, "03  REALIZATION"), (0, 8100, "04  CUFFS / SLOW INSERT"),
                       (0, 10800, "05  ESCORT"), (0, 14800, "06  POWER REMAINS"),
                       (1, 4200, "07  MARU / WRONG NAME"), (2, 5400, "08  ROOFTOP / FIRST LIGHT"),
                       (3, 5000, "09  THE CHOICE TO STAY")]
            for i, (idx, ms, label) in enumerate(samples):
                cp = namespace["CutscenePlayer"]([shots[idx]], "MISSION4_COMPLETE", use_fades=False)
                namespace["active_cutscene"] = cp
                now[0] = cp.start_time + ms
                cp.char_idx = len(cp.current_shot["text"])
                engine.reset_dialogue_slide()
                player_state.render(config.screen)
                image = Image.frombytes("RGB", (W, H), pygame.image.tobytes(config.screen, "RGB"))
                image.thumbnail((500, 284), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
                x, y = i % 3 * 500, i // 3 * 320
                sheet.paste(image, (x + (500 - image.width) // 2, y))
                draw.text((x + 17, y + 286), label, fill=(208, 201, 179), font=font)
            sheet.save(out / "ending_camera_sheet.png")
            print("CAMERA SHEET: " + str(out / "ending_camera_sheet.png"))
            if args.stills_only:
                return

            import imageio_ffmpeg
            ffmpeg = imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe()
            video = Path(tmp) / "picture.mp4"
            proc = subprocess.Popen([ffmpeg, "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-f", "rawvideo",
                                     "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-s", f"{W}x{H}", "-r", "30",
                                     "-i", "-", "-an", "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast",
                                     "-crf", "19", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p", str(video)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            # Capture the real player's cue/ambience calls and mix the same PCM
            # offline; wall-clock headless speed cannot reliably record SDL audio.
            sr = pygame.mixer.get_init()[0]
            events, active_loops = [], {}
            current_tick = [0]
            original_play, original_stop = audio.play, audio.stop

            def record_play(name, volume=1.0, loops=0, channel=None):
                sound = audio.get_sound(name)
                if sound is not None:
                    pcm = pygame.sndarray.array(sound).astype(np.float64) / 32768
                    if pcm.ndim == 1:
                        pcm = np.repeat(pcm[:, None], 2, axis=1)
                    pcm *= audio._effective_volume(name, volume)
                    event = [current_tick[0] / 60, name, pcm, loops, None]
                    events.append(event)
                    if loops:
                        active_loops[name] = event
                return None

            def record_stop(name=None, channel=None):
                if name in active_loops:
                    active_loops.pop(name)[4] = current_tick[0] / 60
                original_stop(name, channel)

            for shot in shots:
                for _, name, _ in shot.get("cues", ()):
                    audio.get_sound(name)
            for name in ("room_tone", "elec_hum", "m4_roof_air"):
                audio.get_sound(name)
            audio.play, audio.stop = record_play, record_stop
            cp = namespace["CutscenePlayer"](shots, "MISSION4_COMPLETE", use_fades=True)
            namespace["active_cutscene"] = cp
            origin = now[0]
            last_idx, readable_since = -1, None
            frame_count = 0
            space = pygame.event.Event(pygame.KEYDOWN, key=pygame.K_SPACE)
            try:
                for tick in range(60 * 120):
                    current_tick[0] = tick
                    now[0] = origin + round(tick * 1000 / 60)
                    pygame.event.pump()
                    player_state.update(1 / 60)
                    player_state.set_ambience()
                    if cp.shot_idx != last_idx:
                        last_idx, readable_since = cp.shot_idx, None
                    if cp.char_idx >= len(cp.current_shot["text"]) and readable_since is None:
                        readable_since = tick
                    if readable_since is not None and tick - readable_since >= 100 and cp.elapsed_ms >= cp.current_shot["min_ms"] and cp.transition_timer == 0:
                        player_state.handle_event(space, 0, 0, {})
                        readable_since = None
                    if done:
                        break
                    if tick % 2 == 0:
                        player_state.render(config.screen)
                        proc.stdin.write(pygame.image.tobytes(config.screen, "RGB"))
                        frame_count += 1
                else:
                    raise RuntimeError("Cutscene did not reach its completion route")
                player_state.exit()
            finally:
                audio.play, audio.stop = original_play, original_stop
                proc.stdin.close()
                code = proc.wait()
                if code:
                    raise RuntimeError("Video encoder failed: " + str(code))
            duration = frame_count / 30
            mix = np.zeros((round(duration * sr), 2), dtype=np.float64)
            for start, name, pcm, loops, stop in events:
                offset = round(start * sr)
                length = min(len(mix) - offset, round(((stop if stop is not None else duration) - start) * sr)) if loops else min(len(pcm), len(mix) - offset)
                if length <= 0:
                    continue
                if loops:
                    data = np.tile(pcm, (int(np.ceil(length / len(pcm))), 1))[:length]
                    edge = min(round(.08 * sr), length // 2)
                    data[:edge] *= np.linspace(0, 1, edge)[:, None]
                    data[-edge:] *= np.linspace(1, 0, edge)[:, None]
                    # Match the production brief ambience duck under cuff contact.
                    if name == "room_tone":
                        a, b = max(0, round(7.6 * sr) - offset), min(length, round(9.4 * sr) - offset)
                        if b > a:
                            data[a:b] *= .16
                else:
                    data = pcm[:length]
                mix[offset:offset + length] += data
            peak = float(np.max(np.abs(mix)))
            if peak > .92:
                mix *= .92 / peak
            wav_path = Path(tmp) / "mix.wav"
            with wave.open(str(wav_path), "wb") as wav:
                wav.setnchannels(2)
                wav.setsampwidth(2)
                wav.setframerate(sr)
                wav.writeframes((mix * 32767).astype("<i2").tobytes())
            result = out / "ending_cinematic_preview.mp4"
            subprocess.run([ffmpeg, "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", str(video), "-i", str(wav_path),
                            "-c:v", "copy", "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-shortest", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(result)], check=True)
            print(f"ENDING PREVIEW: {duration:.2f}s, {frame_count} frames, {len(events)} audio cues/loops, mix peak {peak:.3f}")
            print("VIDEO: " + str(result))
        finally:
            pygame.time.get_ticks = saved_ticks
            pygame.quit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# tools\render_m5_ending.py

"""Render M5 with the production cutscene player, using the safe M4 capture kit.

Usage: python tools/render_m5_ending.py --label before [--stills-only]
       python tools/render_m5_ending.py --label before --export-video
No app startup, save/profile writes, or replacement of the game's renderer.
"""
import ast
import base64
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent


def main():
    label = "review"
    if "--label" in sys.argv:
        idx = sys.argv.index("--label")
        label = sys.argv[idx + 1]
        del sys.argv[idx:idx + 2]
    if not label.replace("_", "").replace("-", "").isalnum():
        raise ValueError("Label must be a simple filename component")
    if "--export-video" in sys.argv:
        p = ROOT / "outputs" / ("m5_ending_" + label + ".mp4")
        data = p.read_bytes()
        index = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--chunk") + 1]) if "--chunk" in sys.argv else 0
        offset, length = index * 160000, 160000
        if offset < 0 or offset >= len(data):
            raise ValueError("Chunk outside video")
        print(json.dumps({"name": p.name, "offset": offset, "total": len(data),
                          "b64": base64.b64encode(data[offset:offset + length]).decode()}))
        return
    source = (ROOT / "tools" / "render_m4_ending.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    source = source.replace("missions.m4.meta", "missions.m5.meta").replace(
        "mission4_ending_shots", "mission5_ending_shots").replace(
        "MISSION4_COMPLETE", "MISSION5_COMPLETE").replace(
        "acaristan_m4_preview_", "acaristan_m5_preview_").replace(
        "ending_camera_sheet.png", "m5_ending_" + label + "_sheet.png").replace(
        "ending_cinematic_preview.mp4", "m5_ending_" + label + ".mp4")
    source = source.replace("_current_ambience=set(),", "_current_ambience=set(), _ambience_epoch=0,")
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    samples = [(0, 900, "01  OTS / LAMP"), (0, 3600, "02  TRACK MARU"),
               (0, 6000, "03  THRESHOLD"), (0, 8600, "04  BIRIBEL / DOT"),
               (1, 2600, "05  SCOPE / SETTLE"), (1, 4600, "06  SCOPE / HOLD"),
               (2, 1200, "07  LIFT OFF"), (2, 3800, "08  FACE / LINE"), (2, 7200, "09  CARRY"),
               (3, 900, "10  TURN"), (3, 1900, "11  ROOF TRACK"), (3, 3500, "12  HANDLE"),
               (3, 3570, "13  CUT TO BLACK"), (4, 3000, "14  RADIO"), (5, 2400, "15  TITLE")]
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "samples" for t in node.targets):
            node.value = ast.parse(repr(samples), mode="eval").body
        # Fifteen samples in three columns need five rows (no cropped beats).
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and node.value == (1500, 960):
            node.value = (1500, 1600)
    # Tuples are AST Tuple nodes, not Constants.
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple) and ast.unparse(node) == "(1500, 960)":
            node.elts[1] = ast.Constant(1600)
    ast.fix_missing_locations(tree)
    ns = {"__file__": str(ROOT / "tools" / "render_m4_ending.py"), "__name__": "m5_capture_kit"}
    exec(compile(tree, "m5_capture_kit", "exec"), ns)
    ns["main"]()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Capture the production M5 finale at 30 fps with native ambience/foley.
Requires ffmpeg on PATH. Does not launch the app or write campaign saves.
Usage: python tools/render_m5_shadow.py --output outputs/M5_Shadow.mp4
Recorded dialogue is not mixed into this review export; the game plays named
VO_192..197 takes through the normal radio voice system when added.
"""
import argparse
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import wave
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER','dummy');os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER','dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT','1')
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'src'));sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=ROOT/'outputs/M5_Shadow.mp4')
    ap.add_argument('--stills-only',action='store_true')
    args=ap.parse_args();out=args.output.resolve();out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    # Isolate persistence before importing game config and sound synthesis.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='m5_shadow_preview_') as tmp:
        from core import save_system,settings_store,profile_store
        save_system.SAVE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'save.json');settings_store.SAVE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'settings.json')
        profile_store.PROFILE_FILE=str(Path(tmp)/'profile.json')
        import pygame,numpy as np
        from m5_shadow_check import Harness
        from core.config import audio
        from missions.m5.finale_script import CUES,DURATION_MS
        pygame.init();h=Harness();stills=out.parent/(out.stem+'_stills');stills.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        samples=(1500,4500,7100,8500,10700,12400,15500,19500,24500,28000,29700,30900,32500,33800,34800,37000,41000)
        try:
            for t in samples:pygame.image.save(h.frame(t),str(stills/f'{t:05}.png'))
            if args.stills_only:print('Stills rendered:',len(samples));return
            # Same game sound generators and effective gains, captured offline.
            pcm={}
            for name in {n for _,n,_ in CUES}|{'rain','wind'}:
                snd=audio.get_sound(name)
                if snd is None:raise RuntimeError('Missing sound '+name)
                arr=pygame.sndarray.array(snd).astype(np.float64)/32768
                if arr.ndim==1:arr=np.repeat(arr[:,None],2,axis=1)
                pcm[name]=arr
            h.fresh();duration=DURATION_MS/1000;sr=pygame.mixer.get_init()[0]
            mix=np.zeros((round(duration*sr),2),np.float64)
            for name in ('rain','wind'):
                arr=pcm[name]*audio._effective_volume(name,.3)
                data=np.tile(arr,(int(np.ceil(len(mix)/len(arr))),1))[:len(mix)]
                edge=round(.10*sr);data[:edge]*=np.linspace(0,1,edge)[:,None];data[-edge:]*=np.linspace(1,0,edge)[:,None]
                mix+=data
            raw=Path(tmp)/'picture.mp4'
            proc=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-y','-loglevel','error','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24','-s','1000x700','-r','30','-i','-','-an','-c:v','libx264','-preset','fast','-crf','18','-pix_fmt','yuv420p',str(raw)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
            frames=0
            try:
                for idx in range(1260):
                    pygame.event.pump();s=h.frame(round(idx*1000/30));proc.stdin.write(pygame.image.tobytes(s,'RGB'));frames+=1
                h.at(DURATION_MS);assert h.ends==['MISSION_COMPLETE'],'Production scene did not complete'
            finally:
                proc.stdin.close();code=proc.wait()
            if code:raise RuntimeError('Encoder failed')
            for ms,name,gain in h.audio_events:
                start=round((ms-h.cp.start_time)*sr/1000);arr=pcm[name]*audio._effective_volume(name,gain)
                length=min(len(arr),len(mix)-start)
                if start>=0 and length>0:mix[start:start+length]+=arr[:length]
            peak=float(np.max(np.abs(mix)))
            if peak>.97:mix*=.97/peak
            wav=Path(tmp)/'sound.wav'
            with wave.open(str(wav),'wb') as w:
                w.setnchannels(2);w.setsampwidth(2);w.setframerate(sr);w.writeframes((np.clip(mix,-1,1)*32767).astype('<i2').tobytes())
            subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-y','-loglevel','error','-i',str(raw),'-i',str(wav),'-c:v','copy','-c:a','aac','-b:a','192k','-shortest','-movflags','+faststart',str(out)],check=True)
            print(f'Production preview: {frames} frames, {duration:g}s, {len(h.audio_events)} cues; audio peak {peak:.3f}; completion once')
        finally:h.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\render_m5_stair.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""Export the complete updated M5 stair shot with its production sound cues."""
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import wave
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT', '1')
os.environ.setdefault('ACARISTAN_RENDERER', 'gl')
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))


def main():
    import numpy as np
    import pygame
    ffmpeg = shutil.which('ffmpeg')
    if not ffmpeg:
        raise RuntimeError('ffmpeg is required')
    output = ROOT / 'outputs' / 'Biribel_Maru_Stairwell.mp4'
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='m5_stair_export_') as tmp:
        from core import save_system, settings_store, profile_store
        save_system.SAVE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / 'save.json')
        settings_store.SAVE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / 'settings.json')
        profile_store.PROFILE_FILE = str(Path(tmp) / 'profile.json')
        from core import config
        from cutscenes import m5mid3d as mid, m5martial3d as film
        from missions.m5.meta import M5_MID_CUTSCENES
        shot = M5_MID_CUTSCENES['descent'][0]
        duration = shot['min_ms'] / 1000
        fps = 30
        frames = math.ceil(duration * fps)
        screen = pygame.Surface(config.screen.get_size())
        w, h = screen.get_size()
        raw = Path(tmp) / 'picture.mp4'
        encoder = subprocess.Popen([ffmpeg, '-y', '-loglevel', 'error', '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24', '-s', f'{w}x{h}', '-r', str(fps), '-i', '-', '-an', '-c:v', 'libx264', '-preset', 'fast', '-crf', '18', '-pix_fmt', 'yuv420p', str(raw)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
        try:
            for i in range(frames):
                pygame.event.pump()
                mid.M5X_SCENES[shot['scene']](screen, round(i * 1000 / fps))
                encoder.stdin.write(pygame.image.tobytes(screen, 'RGB'))
        finally:
            encoder.stdin.close()
            code = encoder.wait()
        if code:
            raise RuntimeError('Picture encoding failed')
        sr = pygame.mixer.get_init()[0]
        mix = np.zeros((round(duration * sr), 2), np.float64)
        for ms, name, gain in shot.get('cues', []):
            sound = config.audio.get_sound(name)
            if sound is None:
                raise RuntimeError('Missing production sound: ' + name)
            pcm = pygame.sndarray.array(sound).astype(np.float64) / 32768
            if pcm.ndim == 1:
                pcm = np.repeat(pcm[:, None], 2, axis=1)
            pcm *= config.audio._effective_volume(name, gain)
            start = round(ms * sr / 1000)
            n = min(len(pcm), len(mix) - start)
            if n > 0:
                mix[start:start+n] += pcm[:n]
        peak = float(np.abs(mix).max())
        if peak > .97:
            mix *= .97 / peak
        wav = Path(tmp) / 'sound.wav'
        with wave.open(str(wav), 'wb') as audio:
            audio.setnchannels(2)
            audio.setsampwidth(2)
            audio.setframerate(sr)
            audio.writeframes((np.clip(mix, -1, 1) * 32767).astype('<i2').tobytes())
        subprocess.run([ffmpeg, '-y', '-loglevel', 'error', '-i', str(raw), '-i', str(wav), '-c:v', 'copy', '-c:a', 'aac', '-b:a', '192k', '-t', str(duration), '-movflags', '+faststart', str(output)], check=True)
        print(f'RENDER OK: {frames} frames, {duration:.1f}s, {w}x{h}, {fps}fps, {type(film._rend()[0]).__name__}, {len(shot.get("cues", []))} production sound cues')
        print(output)
    pygame.quit()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""render_trailer.py - 75-90s MP4 game trailer (headless real gameplay).

PLAN_4_VISUALS implementation: zero debug labels, no menu capture.
  Cold Open  - KRAPNET boot typewriter -> broadcast card -> title slam
  Act I      - M1 warehouse (establish the world)
  Act II     - M2 Route 12 + sniper ambush (escalation)
  Act III    - M3 Vostral breakout + kill-order (climax)
  End Card   - Steam wishlist lockup (no COMING SOON)

Video: native 1000x700 @30fps (60 game ticks, feed every 2nd) piped as
rawvideo to system ffmpeg (libx264, yuv420p, faststart). A second ffmpeg
pass upscales/pads to 1920x1080 and muxes the music track (-shortest),
plus an optional 9:16 center-crop vertical export.

Usage:
    python tools/render_trailer.py            # full trailer -> trailers/trailer_60s.mp4
    python tools/render_trailer.py --smoke    # ~15s fast check -> trailers/trailer_smoke.mp4
    python tools/render_trailer.py --no-audio # skip music mux
"""
import argparse
import math

import sys

from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")

FFMPEG = (
    shutil.which("ffmpeg")
    or r"C:\ffmpeg\bin\ffmpeg.exe"
