SKULL = {2: [(10, 13)]}                         # bare scalp for bald / covered heads


def _hair_pts(hs):
    """Style -> {(x, y): mark} from the pixel map."""
    return {(x, y): ch for y, row in HAIR_MAPS[hs].items() for x, ch in enumerate(row) if ch != "."}


def head_px(c, spec, dy=0):
    """Skin mass (face, ears, neck) with a five-step ramp; returns the mask."""
    skin = spec["skin"]
    S = P.ramp(skin)
    S[2] = tuple(skin)                         # exact SPECS skin survives (smoke likeness check)
    rows = {y + dy: [r] for y, r in face_rows(spec).items()}
    if spec.get("hair_style") in ("bald_white", "none") or spec.get("cap") or spec.get("hat"):
        rows.update({y + dy: s for y, s in SKULL.items()})
    face = _mask(rows)
    # neck first so the chin casts onto it
    for y in range(16 + dy, 18):
        c.span(y, 10, 13, S[1])
        c.p(10, y, S[2])
    c.span(16 + dy, 10, 13, mix(S[0], S[1], .4))
    _shade_mass(c, face, S)
    # sculpt: soft forehead + cheek light on the key side, a gentle jaw shade
    # on the far side (no hollow-cheek diagonal - that is what read as a skull)
    for x, y in ((7, 6), (8, 6), (7, 7), (7, 10), (8, 11), (10, 14)):
        if (x, y + dy) in face:
            c.p(x, y + dy, S[3])
    c.p(8, 5 + dy, S[4])
    c.p(9, 4 + dy, S[3])
    for x, y in ((16, 12), (15, 14), (14, 15)):
        if (x, y + dy) in face:
            c.p(x, y + dy, mix(S[1], S[2], .4))
    for y in range(9 + dy, 12 + dy):             # ears
        c.p(5, y, S[2])
        c.p(18, y, S[1])
    c.p(5, 10 + dy, S[1])
    c.p(18, 10 + dy, S[0])
    return S, face


def hair_px(c, spec, dy=0, S=None, face=None):
    """Hair from HAIR_MAPS: ramp-shaded clumps, sheen, and a cast shadow on
    the forehead under the hairline (the bit that seats hair on the head)."""
    hs = spec.get("hair_style")
    if hs not in HAIR_MAPS or spec.get("beanie") or spec.get("scarf"):
        return None
    marks = {(x, y + dy): ch for (x, y), ch in _hair_pts(hs).items()}
    if spec.get("cap") or spec.get("hat"):      # only the sideburns show under headgear
        marks = {(x, y): ch for (x, y), ch in marks.items() if y >= 6 + dy}
    pts = set(marks)
    R = P.ramp(spec["hair"], contrast=1.3 if sum(spec["hair"]) < 120 else 1.05)
    R[2] = tuple(spec["hair"])
    for (x, y), ch in marks.items():
        col = R[2]
        if ch == "#":
            if (x + 1, y) not in pts:
                col = R[0] if y >= 5 + dy else R[1]
            elif (x + 2, y) not in pts or (x, y + 1) not in pts:
                col = R[1]
            elif (x - 1, y) not in pts:
                col = R[3]
        else:
            col = {"+": R[3], "*": R[4], "-": R[1], "=": R[0]}[ch]
        c.p(x, y, col)
    if S is not None and face is not None:      # hairline shadow on the skin
        for x, y in pts:
            if (x, y + 1) in face and (x, y + 1) not in pts:
                c.p(x, y + 1, mix(S[1], S[2], .35) if x < 12 else S[1])
    return pts


def headgear_px(c, spec, dy=0):
    """Peaked cap, flat hat, beanie, headscarf - all off SPECS colours."""
    if spec.get("cap"):
        crown, band, visor = (19, 29, 46), (129, 133, 126), (12, 14, 20)
        R = P.ramp(crown)
        pts = _mask({1: [(8, 15)], 2: [(6, 17)], 3: [(5, 18)], 4: [(5, 18)]})
        _shade_mass(c, pts, R, [(7, 2), (8, 2), (9, 1), (6, 3)], [(8, 1)])
        c.span(5, 5, 18, band)
        c.p(5, 5, lite(band, .25))
        c.p(18, 5, dark(band, .3))
        c.span(6, 5, 18, visor)
        c.p(6, 6, lite(visor, .2))
        c.span(7, 7, 16, mix(spec["skin"], (30, 20, 30), .45))          # visor shadow
        c.p(11, 3, (190, 160, 90))
        c.p(12, 3, P.GOLD_HI)
        c.p(11, 2, P.GOLD_LO)
        c.p(12, 2, (190, 160, 90))
    if spec.get("hat"):
        h = spec["hat"]
        R = P.ramp(h)
        R[2] = tuple(h)
        pts = _mask({1: [(8, 15)], 2: [(7, 16)], 3: [(6, 17)], 4: [(6, 17)]})
        _shade_mass(c, pts, R, [(8, 2), (9, 2), (7, 3)], [(9, 1)])
        c.span(5, 4, 19, dark(h, .35))
        c.span(5, 4, 8, dark(h, .2))
        c.span(6, 7, 16, mix(spec["skin"], (30, 20, 30), .4))
    if spec.get("beanie"):
        b = spec["beanie"]
        R = P.ramp(b)
        pts = _mask({1: [(9, 14)], 2: [(7, 16)], 3: [(6, 17)], 4: [(5, 18)]})
        _shade_mass(c, pts, R, [(8, 2), (7, 3), (9, 1), (6, 4)], [(8, 2)])
        for x in range(5, 19):
            c.p(x, 5, R[1] if x % 2 else R[2])
            c.p(x, 6, R[0] if x % 2 else R[1])
        c.p(5, 5, R[3])
        c.p(5, 6, R[2])
    if spec.get("scarf"):
        s = spec["scarf"]
        R = P.ramp(s)
        rows = {2: [(8, 15)], 3: [(6, 17)], 4: [(5, 18)], 5: [(5, 18)], 6: [(5, 7), (16, 18)]}
        for y in range(7, 15):
            rows[y] = [(5, 7), (16, 18)]
        rows[14] = [(6, 8), (15, 17)]
        rows[15] = [(7, 9), (14, 16)]
        rows[16] = [(9, 14)]
        pts = _mask(rows)
        _shade_mass(c, pts, R, [(7, 3), (8, 3), (6, 4), (6, 8)], [(8, 3)])
        for x, y in ((9, 4), (12, 4), (15, 4), (6, 10), (17, 10)):    # cloth folds
            c.p(x, y, R[1])
        c.r(11, 16, 2, 2, R[1])                                         # knot
        c.p(11, 16, R[3])
        c.span(6, 8, 15, mix(spec["skin"], (30, 20, 30), .3))


def features_px(c, spec, S, face, dy=0):
    """Brows, eyes, nose, mouth, beard, stubble, scar, cigarette, rim."""
    skin, hair, hs = spec["skin"], spec["hair"], spec.get("hair_style")
    by, ey, my = BROW_Y + dy, EYE_Y + dy, MOUTH_Y + dy
    bw = spec.get("brow", 2)
    bc = dark(hair, .15) if hs != "bald_white" else (190, 190, 185)
    if spec.get("scarf"):
        bc = mix(skin, (40, 30, 25), .55)
    for x0, x1 in ((8, 10), (13, 15)):
        for x in range(x0, x1 + 1):
            outer = x == (x0 if x0 < 12 else x1)
            if bw >= 3 or not outer:
                c.p(x, by, bc if not outer else mix(bc, S[1], .35))
    if bw >= 4:                                     # heavy brows: frown pixels
        c.p(10, by, dark(bc, .3))
        c.p(13, by, dark(bc, .3))
    lid = mix(skin, (30, 15, 15), .6)
    sclera = mix(SCLERA, skin, .3)
    for x in (9, 13):
        c.p(x, ey, sclera if bw < 4 else mix(sclera, lid, .45))
        c.p(x + 1, ey, spec["iris"])
    c.p(8, ey, mix(S[2], lid, .15))                 # lid corner (soft, not a socket)
    c.p(15, ey, mix(S[1], S[2], .5))
    # nose: lit bridge, shadow cast to the right
    c.p(11, ey + 1, S[3])
    c.p(12, ey + 1, S[2])
    c.p(12, ey + 2, S[1])
    c.p(13, ey + 2, mix(S[1], S[0], .5))
    c.p(11, ey + 2, S[2])
    # mouth
    lip = mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .55)
    c.span(my, 10, 12, lip)
    c.p(13, my, mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .35))
    c.p(11, my + 1, S[3])
    if spec.get("stubble"):
        sc = mix(skin, (16, 14, 14), .32)
        for x, y in ((9, 12), (13, 12), (8, 13), (15, 13), (9, 14), (14, 14), (10, 15), (12, 15),
                     (13, 14)):
            if (x, y + dy) in face:
                c.p(x, y + dy, mix(sc, tuple(c.get(x, y + dy))[:3], .45))
    if spec.get("beard"):
        b = spec["beard"]
        R = P.ramp(b)
        R[2] = tuple(b)
        rows = {10 + dy: [(6, 6), (17, 17)], 11 + dy: [(6, 7), (16, 17)], 12 + dy: [(6, 17)],
                13 + dy: [(6, 9), (14, 17)], 14 + dy: [(7, 16)], 15 + dy: [(8, 15)],
                16 + dy: [(9, 14)], 17 + dy: [(10, 13)]}
        pts = _mask(rows)
        _shade_mass(c, pts, R, [(8, 14 + dy), (9, 15 + dy)], [(8, 12 + dy)])
        c.span(my, 10, 13, dark(b, .45))
        for x, y in ((10, 15), (13, 15), (11, 16), (12, 14)):
            c.p(x, y + dy, R[1])
    if spec.get("scar"):
        for x, y in ((8, 6), (9, 7), (9, 8), (10, 11), (10, 12)):
            c.p(x, y + dy, lite(skin, .22))
        for x, y in ((9, 6), (10, 7), (11, 12)):
            c.p(x, y + dy, dark(skin, .3))
    if spec.get("cig"):
        c.p(13, my, (196, 140, 80))
        c.p(14, my, (232, 230, 222))
        c.p(15, my + 1, (232, 230, 222))
        c.p(16, my + 1, (255, 96, 30))
        c.p(16, my, (255, 170, 90))
    # rim light: cool (or the spec's own) edge on the shaded side
    rim = spec.get("rim", (137, 168, 191) if not spec.get("president") else (248, 202, 128))
    for y in range(6 + dy, 9 + dy):              # short temple glint, not a cheek line
        xs = [x for x, yy in face if yy == y]
        if xs and not spec.get("scarf"):
            c.p(max(xs), y, mix(rim, S[1], .8))


# -- 2D-sampled face (polish pass T6d) ---------------------------------------
# The cutscene face (cutscenes.figure_kit._face) is replayed through a
# recording pen and its geometry - skull/jaw outline, key-light and shade
# planes, neck, ear, every hair polygon, beard and headgear - is rasterised
# straight onto the 24 px grid by pixel-centre coverage (no supersampled
# colour averaging, so no blotches). The fine features (lids, irises, nose,
# creases, mouth, stubble) collapse below one pixel at this size, so they are
# re-placed per pixel at the SAME 2D coordinates through the same mapping.
# Result: the 3/4 view, ear, angular jaw, tired heavy-lidded eyes and the
# actual hair shapes of the cutscenes, at portrait scale.
FU = 4.5                      # 2D face units per portrait pixel
FX0, FY0 = 12.0, 9.3          # portrait pixel position of face unit (0, 0)


def fpx(x, y, dy=0):
    """2D face units -> portrait pixel cell."""
    return int((x / FU) + FX0), int((y / FU) + FY0 + dy)


class _RecPen:
    """Stand-in for figure_kit._Pen that records primitives in face units."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.ops, self.ox, self.oy, self.k = [], 0.0, 0.0, 1.0
        import pygame
        self.s = pygame.Surface((4, 4))          # stubble rects land here (ignored)

    def p(self, x, y, light=False):
        return (0, 0)

    def w(self, v):
        return 1

    def poly(self, col, pts, light=False):
        self.ops.append(("poly", tuple(col[:3]), [(x + self.ox, y + self.oy) for x, y in pts]))

    def line(self, col, pts, width=1, light=False):
        self.ops.append(("line", tuple(col[:3]), [(x + self.ox, y + self.oy) for x, y in pts], width))

    def ell(self, col, x0, y0, x1, y1, width=0):
        self.ops.append(("ell", tuple(col[:3]), (x0, y0, x1, y1)))

    def circ(self, col, x, y, r, width=0):
        self.ops.append(("circ", tuple(col[:3]), (x, y, r)))


def _inside(pts, x, y):
    n, hit = len(pts), False
    for i in range(n):
        x1, y1 = pts[i]
        x2, y2 = pts[(i + 1) % n]
        if (y1 > y) != (y2 > y) and x < x1 + (y - y1) * (x2 - x1) / (y2 - y1):
            hit = not hit
    return hit


_SUB = [((i + .5) / 4, (j + .5) / 4) for i in range(4) for j in range(4)]


def _cover(test, dy, thresh=.5):
    """Cells whose 4x4 sub-samples pass ``test(ux, uy)`` at least ``thresh``."""
    cells = set()
    for py in range(SIZE):
        for px in range(SIZE):
            hits = sum(test((px + sx - FX0) * FU, (py + sy - FY0 - dy) * FU) for sx, sy in _SUB)
            if hits >= thresh * len(_SUB):
                cells.add((px, py))
    return cells


def _line_cells(pts, dy):
    cells = []
    for (x1, y1), (x2, y2) in zip(pts, pts[1:]):
        n = max(2, int(max(abs(x2 - x1), abs(y2 - y1)) / FU * 4) + 1)
        for i in range(n + 1):
            t = i / n
            c_ = fpx(x1 + (x2 - x1) * t, y1 + (y2 - y1) * t, dy)
            if c_ not in cells:
                cells.append(c_)
    return cells


def _record_face(spec):
    fk = _figure_kit()
    pen = _RecPen()
    sp = dict(spec)
    if sp.get("beanie") or sp.get("scarf"):    # portrait-only headgear: no 2D hair under it
        sp["hair_style"] = "none"
    sp.pop("cap", None) if sp.get("beanie") else None
    fk._face(pen, sp, 0, 0, look=.8, cig=False)
    return pen.ops


HEAD_TOP, CHIN_ROW, FU_MIN = 1.0, 17.4, 4.6   # crown leaves a row for the outline


def _fit_frame(ops):
    """Scale/offset so the tallest point (hair, curls, cap crown) sits inside
    the frame with room for the outline, and the chin stays above the collar.
    Big hair (mop, shag) gets a slightly smaller head instead of a cropped one."""
    global FU, FY0
    top = 0.0
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == "poly":
            top = min(top, min(y for _, y in op[2]))
        elif op[0] == "circ":
            top = min(top, op[2][1] - op[2][2])
    chin = 34.0
    FU = max(FU_MIN, (chin - top) / (CHIN_ROW - HEAD_TOP))
    FY0 = HEAD_TOP - top / FU


def face_2d(c, spec, dy=0):
    """Head, hair and face sampled from the 2D cutscene face. Returns (S, face)."""
    skin = tuple(spec["skin"])
    S = P.ramp(skin)
    S[2] = skin
    hair = tuple(spec["hair"])
    R = P.ramp(hair, contrast=1.3 if sum(hair) < 120 else 1.05)
    R[2] = hair
    fk = _figure_kit()
    shade2d, light2d = fk._mix(skin, (60, 30, 30), .38), fk._lite(skin, .22)
    neck2d = fk._mix(skin, (40, 20, 20), .5)
    ops = _record_face(spec)
    _fit_frame(ops)
    # colour map: 2D flat tones -> portrait ramps (exact SPECS skin/hair survive)
    cmap = {skin: S[2], shade2d: mix(shade2d, S[1], .3), light2d: mix(light2d, S[3], .4),
            neck2d: mix(neck2d, S[0], .3), hair: R[2]}
    geo_cols = {hair}
    for key in ("beard", "hat", "bandana"):
        if spec.get(key):
            geo_cols |= {tuple(spec[key])}
    cap_cols = {(19, 29, 46), (129, 133, 126), (12, 14, 20), (190, 160, 90)}
    if spec.get("cap"):
        geo_cols |= cap_cols
    if spec.get("hat"):
        geo_cols |= {fk._dark(tuple(spec["hat"]), .35)}
    face, hair_px_, phase = set(), set(), "geo"
    for op in ops:
        kind, col = op[0], op[1]
        if kind == "ell":                         # the ear closes the geometry pass
            x0, y0, x1, y1 = op[2]
            cx_, cy_, rx, ry = (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, abs(x1 - x0) / 2, abs(y1 - y0) / 2
            cells = _cover(lambda ux, uy: ((ux - cx_) / rx) ** 2 + ((uy - cy_) / ry) ** 2 <= 1, dy, .4)
            xmin = min(p_[0] for p_ in cells) if cells else 0
            for x, y in cells:
                if (x, y) not in hair_px_ and (x, y) not in face:
                    c.p(x, y, mix(col, S[1], .35) if x == xmin else mix(col, skin, .4))
            for x, y in cells:
                face.add((x, y))
            phase = "feat"
            continue
        if phase == "feat" and col not in geo_cols:
            continue                              # fine features are re-placed below
        is_hair = col == hair or (col in cap_cols and spec.get("cap"))
        if kind == "poly":
            pts = op[2]
            cells = _cover(lambda ux, uy: _inside(pts, ux, uy), dy)
        elif kind == "circ":
            x_, y_, r_ = op[2]
            cells = _cover(lambda ux, uy: (ux - x_) ** 2 + (uy - y_) ** 2 <= r_ * r_, dy, .45)
        else:                                     # line: 1 px stroke
            cells = _line_cells(op[2], dy)
            if col == fk._lite(hair, .35) or col == fk._lite(hair, .45) or col == fk._lite(hair, .3) \
                    or col == fk._lite(hair, .4):
                for x, y in cells:
                    if (x, y) in hair_px_:
                        c.p(x, y, R[3])
                continue
            if col == fk._dark(hair, .35) or col == fk._dark(hair, .3):
                for x, y in cells:
                    if (x, y) in hair_px_:
                        c.p(x, y, R[1])
                continue
        out = cmap.get(col, col)
        for x, y in cells:
            if 0 <= x < SIZE and 0 <= y < SIZE:
                c.p(x, y, out)
                if col in (skin, shade2d, light2d):
                    face.add((x, y))
                    hair_px_.discard((x, y))
                if col == hair:
                    hair_px_.add((x, y))
    # drop stray single hair pixels (sub-pixel tips that survived sampling)
    for x, y in sorted(hair_px_):
        if not any((x + ax, y + ay) in hair_px_ for ax, ay in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1))):
            c.s.set_at((x, y), (0, 0, 0, 0))
            hair_px_.discard((x, y))
    # hair volume: shade the far side and the under-edge, sheen on the crown,
    # clump breaks along the hairline so the mass reads as hair, not a cap
    for x, y in hair_px_:
        if (x, y + 1) in face and (x, y + 1) not in hair_px_ and x % 3 == 1 \
                and tuple(c.get(x, y))[:3] == R[2]:
            c.p(x, y, R[1])
    for x, y in hair_px_:
        if (x + 1, y) not in hair_px_ or (x, y + 1) not in hair_px_ and (x, y + 1) in face:
            if tuple(c.get(x, y))[:3] == R[2]:
                c.p(x, y, R[1])
        if (x, y - 1) not in hair_px_ and x <= 11 and tuple(c.get(x, y))[:3] == R[2]:
            c.p(x, y, R[3])
    for x, y in face:                             # hairline shadow on the skin
        if (x, y - 1) in hair_px_ and (x, y) not in hair_px_:
            c.p(x, y, mix(tuple(c.get(x, y))[:3], S[0], .35))
    face -= hair_px_
    return S, face


def features_2d(c, spec, S, face, dy=0):
    """Lids, eyes, nose, creases, mouth, stubble, scar, cig, rim - each at its
    2D face coordinate, drawn as the pixel cluster that reads at 24 px."""
    fk = _figure_kit()
    skin, hair, hs = tuple(spec["skin"]), spec["hair"], spec.get("hair_style")

    def put(x, y, col, only_face=True):
        cx_, cy_ = fpx(x, y, dy)
        if not only_face or (cx_, cy_) in face:
            c.p(cx_, cy_, col)

    def tone(x, y, col, t):
        cx_, cy_ = fpx(x, y, dy)
        if (cx_, cy_) in face:
            c.p(cx_, cy_, mix(tuple(c.get(cx_, cy_))[:3], col, t))

    bw = spec.get("brow", 2)
    bc = fk._dark(hair, .1) if hs != "bald_white" else (190, 190, 185)
    lid = fk._mix(skin, (30, 15, 15), .65)
    sclera = (219, 203, 173)
    # brows: 2D y -10 (one row above the lid), weight from ``brow``
    for x0 in (-19, 7):
        for i, x in enumerate(range(x0, x0 + 12, 5)):
            outer = (i == 0 and x0 < 0) or (i == 2 and x0 > 0)
            if bw >= 3 or not outer:
                put(x, -12, bc if not outer else mix(bc, S[2], .35))
    if bw >= 4:
        put(-8, -12, fk._dark(bc, .3))
        put(7, -12, fk._dark(bc, .3))
    # eyes: heavy upper lid across the eye, sclera + iris under it (2D y -4 / -3)
    for ex in (-13, 13):
        for dx in (-5, 0, 5):
            put(ex + dx, -7, lid)
        put(ex - 5, -2, mix(sclera, skin, .45))
        put(ex, -2, sclera)
        put(ex + 5, -2, mix(sclera, skin, .2))
        put(ex + 2, -2, spec["iris"])            # looking toward frame right, as in the cutscenes
    # under-eye fatigue + nose (lit bridge, shadow, nostril) + cheek crease
    for x in (-15, -10):
        tone(x, 3, (90, 40, 50), .25)
    for x in (10, 16):
        tone(x, 3, (60, 30, 40), .3)
    put(-1, 0, S[3])
    put(-2, 5, S[3])
    put(3, 0, mix(S[1], S[2], .4))
    put(3, 5, S[1])
    put(1, 10, fk._mix(skin, (60, 30, 30), .5))
    put(6, 10, mix(S[1], S[0], .5))
    tone(-9, 17, (70, 30, 40), .4)
    # mouth (2D y 21-22) and lower-lip light
    if not spec.get("beard"):
        for x in (-9, -4, 1, 6):
            put(x, 21, fk._mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .6))
        put(11, 22, fk._mix(skin, (40, 20, 25), .4))
        tone(0, 27, (255, 240, 220), .18)
    else:
        for x in (-6, 0, 6):
            put(x, 23, fk._dark(tuple(spec["beard"]), .45), False)
    if spec.get("stubble"):
        sc = fk._mix(skin, (12, 10, 10), .55)
        for sx, sy in fk._STUBBLE:
            tone(sx, sy, sc, .4)
    if spec.get("scar"):
        for x, y in ((-15, -24), (-12, -17), (-9, -12), (-6, -3), (-4, 6)):
            put(x, y, fk._lite(skin, .32))
        for x, y in ((-11, -24), (-8, -17), (-5, -8)):
            put(x, y, fk._dark(skin, .35))
    if spec.get("cig"):
        cx_, cy_ = fpx(11, 22, dy)
        c.p(cx_, cy_, (196, 140, 80))
        c.p(cx_ + 1, cy_, (232, 230, 222))
        c.p(cx_ + 2, cy_ + 1, (232, 230, 222))
        c.p(cx_ + 3, cy_ + 1, (255, 96, 30))
        c.p(cx_ + 3, cy_, (255, 170, 90))
    # rim light: the 2D rim stroke down the shaded cheek, kept soft
    rim = tuple(spec.get("rim", (137, 168, 191) if not spec.get("president") else (248, 202, 128)))
    for x, y in _line_cells([(23, -15), (24, 9), (17, 24)], dy):
        row = [p_ for p_ in face if p_[1] == y]
        if row and not spec.get("scarf"):
            xm = max(p_[0] for p_ in row)
            c.p(xm, y, mix(tuple(c.get(xm, y))[:3], rim, .2))


def bust(c, spec):
    """Shoulders + tailoring at portrait scale, key light from the left."""
    coat = spec["coat"]
    R = P.ramp(coat, contrast=1.2)
    R[2] = tuple(coat)
    wide = 1 if spec.get("bulk", 1) >= 1.08 else 0
    kid = spec.get("kid")
    rows = {18: (6, 17), 19: (4 - wide, 19 + wide), 20: (3 - wide, 20 + wide)}
    for y in range(21, SIZE):
        rows[y] = (2 - wide, 21 + wide)
    if kid:
        rows = {y: (x0 + 2, x1 - 2) for y, (x0, x1) in rows.items()}
    for y, (x0, x1) in rows.items():
        c.span(y, x0, x1, coat)
        c.span(y, x0, x0 + 1, R[3])
        c.span(y, x1 - 1, x1, R[1])
        c.p(x1, y, R[0])
    c.span(18, rows[18][0] + 1, rows[18][1] - 2, R[3])                 # shoulder ridge
    c.span(19, rows[19][0] + 1, rows[19][0] + 3, R[4])
    for y in range(21, SIZE):                                          # sleeve seams
        c.p(rows[y][0] + 2, y, R[1])
        c.p(rows[y][1] - 3, y, R[0])
    hood = spec.get("neck") == "hood"
    if hood:                                                          # hood bunched behind the neck
        hc = lite(coat, .12)
        c.span(17, 8, 15, hc)
        c.span(18, 7, 16, hc)
        c.p(8, 17, lite(coat, .25))
        c.r(10, 18, 4, 1, dark(coat, .25))
        st = spec.get("strings")
        if st:
            for x in (10, 13):
                c.r(x, 19, 1, 3, st)
                c.p(x, 21, lite(st, .3))
    else:
        lapel, shirt = spec.get("lapel", dark(coat, .25)), spec.get("shirt", coat)
        c.p(9, 17, lapel)                                             # collar hugging the neck
        c.p(14, 17, dark(lapel, .2))
        for y in range(18, SIZE):
            half = max(0, 2 - (y - 18) // 2)
            x0, x1 = 12 - half - 1, 11 + half + 1
            if y >= 22 and not spec.get("tie"):
                x0, x1 = 11, 12
            c.span(y, x0, x1, shirt)
            c.p(x0, y, dark(shirt, .2) if y == 18 else shirt)
            c.p(x0 - 1, y, lite(lapel, .15))
            c.p(x1 + 1, y, dark(lapel, .15))
            if spec.get("long_coat") and y <= 19:                     # collar stands up
                c.p(x0 - 2, y - 1, lapel)
                c.p(x1 + 2, y - 1, dark(lapel, .2))
        if spec.get("vest"):
            v = spec["vest"]
            for y in range(20, SIZE):
                c.span(y, 7, 9, v)
                c.span(y, 14, 16, dark(v, .15))
            c.span(20, 7, 9, lite(v, .2))
        if spec.get("tie"):
            t = spec["tie"]
            c.r(11, 18, 2, 1, dark(t, .2))
            c.r(11, 19, 2, SIZE - 19, t)
            c.p(11, 19, lite(t, .25))
            c.p(12, 21, dark(t, .25))
    if spec.get("epaulets"):
        e = spec["epaulets"]
        c.span(19, rows[19][0] + 1, rows[19][0] + 3, lite(e, .2))
        c.span(19, rows[19][1] - 3, rows[19][1] - 1, dark(e, .2))
    if spec.get("buttons") and not hood:
        for y in (21, 23):
            c.p(14, y, spec["buttons"])
    if spec.get("medal"):
        c.p(7, 21, spec["medal"])
        c.p(7, 22, lite(spec["medal"], .3))
    if spec.get("patch"):
        c.r(16, 21, 2, 2, spec["patch"])
        c.p(16, 21, lite(spec["patch"], .3))
    straps = spec.get("straps")
    if straps:
        for y in range(19, SIZE):
            c.p(6, y, straps)
            c.p(17, y, straps)
    # Keep the small chest identifiers that make the shared 2D/3D cast
    # recognisable at radio scale. At 24 px a sparse, high-contrast mark
    # reads better than a miniature texture.
    plaid = spec.get("plaid")
    if plaid and not hood:
        for y in (20, 22):
            c.p(7, y, plaid)
            c.p(16, y, plaid)
        for x in (8, 15):
            c.p(x, 21, plaid)
    print_spec = spec.get("print")
    if print_spec and not hood:
        kind, col = print_spec
        if kind == "stripe":
            c.span(21, 8, 15, col)
            c.span(22, 9, 14, dark(col, .18))
        elif kind == "drip":
            c.span(21, 8, 15, col)
            for x, ln in ((9, 2), (11, 3), (13, 2), (15, 1)):
                c.r(x, 22, 1, ln, col)
    armband = spec.get("armband")
    if armband:
        c.span(22, rows[22][0], rows[22][0] + 2, armband)
        c.span(22, rows[22][1] - 2, rows[22][1], armband)
    if spec.get("accent"):
        c.p(rows[20][0] + 2, 20, spec["accent"])
    rim = spec.get("rim", (137, 168, 191) if not spec.get("president") else (248, 202, 128))
    c.p(rows[19][1], 19, mix(rim, R[1], .5))                          # rim on the far shoulder
    c.p(rows[20][1], 20, mix(rim, R[1], .65))
    return c


def face_portrait(key):
    spec = portrait_spec(key)
    dy = 1 if spec.get("kid") else 0
    c = C()
    bust(c, spec)
    S, face = face_2d(c, spec, dy)
    features_2d(c, spec, S, face, dy)
    if spec.get("beanie") or spec.get("scarf"):   # portrait-only headgear (no 2D version)
        headgear_px(c, spec, dy)
    return finish(c)


FACES = ("biribel", "vasile", "volkov", "commander", "fisherman", "balaceanu", "president",
         "maru", "bodi", "alex", "ucilev", "krap_command", "ipa_dispatch", "old_squadmate",
         "gabi", "seby", "darius", "old_woman", "hungry_kid")


def unknown():
    """Generic caller: shadowed head with a headset - identity withheld."""
    spec = dict(skin=(78, 82, 88), hair=(40, 42, 46), hair_style="crop", coat=(54, 58, 62),
                lapel=(40, 43, 47), shirt=(44, 47, 51), jaw=1.0, brow=2, iris=(30, 32, 36),
                rim=(120, 140, 160))
    c = C()
    bust(c, spec)
    S, face = face_2d(c, spec)
    for ex in (-13, 13):                         # eyes lost in shadow
        for dx in (-5, 0, 5):
            for ey in (-7, -2):
                x, y = fpx(ex + dx, ey)
                c.p(x, y, (40, 42, 46))
    headset(c)
    return finish(c)

# -- insignia (no face) -------------------------------------------------------
def disc(c, col, rim):
    for y in range(2, 22):
        dy = y - 11.5
        half = int((100 - dy * dy) ** 0.5) if dy * dy < 100 else 0
        if half:
            c.span(y, 12 - half, 11 + half, col)
            c.p(12 - half, y, rim)
            c.p(11 + half, y, rim)
    c.span(2, 9, 14, rim)
    c.span(21, 9, 14, rim)


def narrator():
    """Ribbon microphone on a stand."""
    c = C()
    M = P.ramp((150, 150, 156))
    c.r(9, 3, 6, 11, M[2])
    c.r(9, 3, 2, 11, M[3])
    c.r(14, 3, 1, 11, M[1])
    for y in range(4, 13, 2):
        c.span(y, 10, 13, M[0])
    c.span(2, 10, 13, M[2])
    c.span(14, 10, 13, M[1])
    c.r(11, 15, 2, 5, M[1])
    c.span(20, 7, 16, M[2])
    c.span(21, 6, 17, M[1])
    c.p(6, 7, P.BRASS)
    c.p(17, 7, P.BRASS)
    return finish(c)


def pa_system():
    """Horn loudspeaker on a pole with sound arcs."""
    c = C()
    H = P.ramp((170, 170, 160))
    rows = {7: (4, 6), 8: (4, 8), 9: (4, 10), 10: (4, 12), 11: (4, 13), 12: (4, 13), 13: (4, 12),
            14: (4, 10), 15: (4, 8), 16: (4, 6)}
    for y, (x0, x1) in rows.items():
        c.span(y, x0, x1, H[2])
        c.p(x1, y, H[4])
        c.p(x0, y, H[1])
    c.r(2, 10, 2, 4, H[0])
    c.r(3, 17, 2, 7, H[0])
    for r, col in ((3, (230, 70, 70)), (6, (200, 60, 60))):
        for y in range(12 - r, 12 + r):
            c.p(15 + r - abs(y - 11) // 2, y, col)
    return finish(c)


def intercept():
    """Satellite dish + waveform: an eavesdropped transmission."""
    c = C()
    D = P.ramp((150, 170, 190))
    for y, (x0, x1) in {3: (5, 7), 4: (4, 9), 5: (4, 11), 6: (4, 12), 7: (5, 13), 8: (6, 13),
                        9: (7, 12), 10: (9, 11)}.items():
        c.span(y, x0, x1, D[2])
        c.p(x0, y, D[3])
    c.p(12, 4, D[4])
    c.p(13, 3, D[4])
    c.r(8, 11, 2, 5, D[1])
    c.span(16, 5, 12, D[1])
    wave = (2, 1, 0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 0, 2, 4, 1, 2)
    for i, h in enumerate(wave):
        x = 10 + i
        if x < 23:
            c.r(x, 19 - h, 1, 1 + h * 2, (110, 230, 140))
    return finish(c)


def radio_tower():
    """Lattice mast with broadcast rings."""
    c = C()
    T = P.ramp((150, 156, 166))
    for y in range(5, 22):
        w = (y - 5) // 3
        c.p(11 - w, y, T[2])
        c.p(12 + w, y, T[1])
        if y % 3 == 0:
            c.span(y, 11 - w, 12 + w, T[1])
    c.p(11, 4, (230, 60, 50))
    c.p(12, 4, (230, 60, 50))
    for r, col in ((4, (200, 220, 240)), (7, (140, 160, 190))):
        c.p(11 - r, 5, col)
        c.p(12 + r, 5, col)
        if r > 4:
            c.p(10 - r, 4, col)
            c.p(13 + r, 4, col)
        c.p(11 - r + 1, 3, col)
        c.p(12 + r - 1, 3, col)
    c.span(22, 6, 17, T[0])
    return finish(c)


def system():
    """Terminal: CRT monitor with a prompt."""
    c = C()
    B = P.ramp(P.CASE_BEIGE)
    c.r(3, 3, 18, 14, B[2])
    c.r(3, 3, 18, 1, B[3])
    c.r(20, 3, 1, 14, B[1])
    c.r(5, 5, 14, 10, P.CRT_GLASS)
    c.span(7, 7, 9, P.PHOSPHOR)
    c.span(9, 7, 13, P.PHOSPHOR)
    c.span(11, 7, 8, P.PHOSPHOR_HI)
    c.r(9, 11, 2, 1, P.PHOSPHOR_HI)
    c.r(9, 17, 6, 2, B[1])
    c.span(19, 5, 18, B[2])
    c.span(20, 4, 19, B[1])
    return finish(c)


def loyalist_comms():
    """Loyalist net: red shield with a white tower and two stars."""
    c = C()
    red = P.ramp((200, 70, 60))
    for y in range(3, 20):
        half = 8 if y < 13 else max(1, 8 - (y - 12))
        c.span(y, 12 - half, 11 + half, red[2])
        c.p(12 - half, y, red[3])
        c.p(11 + half, y, red[1])
    c.span(3, 4, 19, red[4])
    W = (230, 222, 200)
    c.r(10, 7, 4, 9, W)
    c.span(6, 9, 14, W)
    c.p(9, 5, W)
    c.p(11, 5, W)
    c.p(14, 5, W)
    c.p(11, 10, red[0])
    c.p(12, 10, red[0])
    for x in (6, 17):
        c.p(x, 9, P.GOLD_HI)
        c.p(x - 1, 9, P.BRASS)
        c.p(x + 1, 9, P.BRASS)
        c.p(x, 8, P.BRASS)
        c.p(x, 10, P.BRASS)
    return finish(c)


CAST = tuple((k, None) for k in FACES) + (
    ("unknown", unknown), ("narrator", narrator), ("pa_system", pa_system),
    ("intercept", intercept), ("radio", radio_tower), ("system", system),
    ("loyalist_comms", loyalist_comms),
)


def build():
    sh = kit.Sheet("spr_portraits", FAMILY)
    sh.meta = {"size": SIZE, "display_scale": 2,
               "note": "radio caller-ID busts; ui.radio maps speakers to keys"}
    for key, fn in CAST:
        img = fn() if fn else face_portrait(key)
        sh.add(key, img, (0, 0), kind="emblem" if fn in EMBLEMS else "face")
    return [sh]


EMBLEMS = (narrator, pa_system, intercept, radio_tower, system, loyalist_comms)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(kit.run(FAMILY, build))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\sprites\props.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""props.py - Mission 2 story props + the upload terminal as sprites (Polish T7).

Replaces the static parts of ``missions/m2/draw.py::_draw_story_prop`` and
``_draw_upload_computer``. Animated bits that depend on live state stay
procedural on top of the sprite (spark bursts, flare glow, glint flashes,
charred-prop ember pulses); the upload terminal's phosphor pulse, cursor
blink and LEDs are baked as 8 frames (4 pulse levels x cursor on/off).

Anchor = the prop's world position (the procedural code's (sx, sy)):
blit at (sx - ax, sy - ay).

    python tools/sprites/props.py [--preview] [--out DIR]
"""
import math
import os
import random
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import kit  # noqa: E402
import palette as P  # noqa: E402
import pygame  # noqa: E402

FAMILY = "props"
PULSES = (0.0, 0.33, 0.67, 1.0)


def _frame(w, h):
    return kit.new(w, h), w // 2, h // 2


def cone(charred=False):
    s, cx, cy = _frame(40, 44)
    if charred:
        kit.ellipse_shadow(s, (cx - 15, cy + 2, 34, 12))
        b = kit.new(40, 44)
        C = [(18, 14, 12), (30, 24, 20), (44, 36, 30), (60, 50, 42)]
        pygame.draw.ellipse(b, C[1], (cx - 16, cy - 4, 32, 12))     # melted puddle of cone
        pygame.draw.ellipse(b, C[2], (cx - 12, cy - 3, 22, 7))
        b.fill(C[3], (cx - 9, cy - 3, 10, 1))
        kit.rrect(b, C[0], (cx - 15, cy + 6, 30, 5), 1)
        b.fill(C[2], (cx - 14, cy + 6, 28, 1))
        s.blit(kit.outline(b, (8, 6, 5)), (0, 0))
        return s, (cx, cy)
    kit.ellipse_shadow(s, (cx - 14, cy + 9, 34, 10))
    b = kit.new(40, 44)
    O = P.ramp(P.CONE_ORANGE)
    kit.rrect(b, P.ramp((92, 62, 38))[2], (cx - 15, cy + 10, 30, 6), 1)       # rubber base
    b.fill(P.ramp((92, 62, 38))[3], (cx - 14, cy + 10, 28, 1))
    b.fill(P.ramp((92, 62, 38))[1], (cx - 14, cy + 15, 28, 1))
    pygame.draw.polygon(b, O[3], [(cx, cy - 17), (cx - 12, cy + 12), (cx, cy + 12)])   # lit left face
    pygame.draw.polygon(b, O[1], [(cx, cy - 17), (cx + 12, cy + 12), (cx, cy + 12)])   # shaded right face
    pygame.draw.line(b, O[4], (cx - 1, cy - 15), (cx - 6, cy + 2))
    for y, wdt in ((cy - 4, 6), (cy + 3, 9)):                                         # reflective bands
        b.fill((248, 226, 160), (cx - wdt, y, wdt, 3))
        b.fill((196, 176, 120), (cx, y, wdt, 3))
    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def barrel(charred=False):
    s, cx, cy = _frame(40, 48)
    kit.ellipse_shadow(s, (cx - 12, cy + 10, 32, 12))
    b = kit.new(40, 48)
    if charred:
        C = [(14, 11, 9), (22, 18, 15), (34, 28, 23), (50, 42, 34)]
        kit.rrect(b, C[1], (cx - 13, cy - 15, 26, 30), 5)
        kit.rrect(b, C[2], (cx - 12, cy - 15, 8, 29), 3)
        for y0, y1 in ((cy - 4, cy - 2), (cy + 6, cy + 4)):
            pygame.draw.line(b, C[0], (cx - 12, y0), (cx + 12, y1), 2)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(b, C[0], (cx - 11, cy - 17, 22, 7))
        b.fill(C[3], (cx - 6, cy - 17, 8, 1))
        s.blit(kit.outline(b, (8, 6, 5)), (0, 0))
        return s, (cx, cy)
    R = P.ramp(P.BARREL_RUST)
    kit.rrect(b, R[2], (cx - 13, cy - 15, 26, 32), 5)
    b.fill(R[3], (cx - 11, cy - 14, 7, 30))           # lit left of the drum
    b.fill(R[4], (cx - 9, cy - 13, 2, 28))
    b.fill(R[1], (cx + 6, cy - 14, 6, 30))            # shade right
    b.fill(R[0], (cx + 10, cy - 12, 2, 26))
    for hy in (cy - 5, cy + 7):                        # rolling hoops
        b.fill(R[0], (cx - 12, hy, 24, 2))
        b.fill(R[4], (cx - 12, hy + 2, 24, 1))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(b, R[3], (cx - 13, cy - 19, 26, 8))   # lid
    pygame.draw.ellipse(b, R[1], (cx - 9, cy - 18, 18, 6), 1)
    b.fill(R[0], (cx + 6, cy - 16, 2, 2))             # bung
    b.fill(P.shade(R[2], 0.8), (cx - 8, cy - 11, 1, 24))   # weld seam
    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def sign(charred=False):
    s, cx, cy = _frame(64, 56)
    oy = 4
    if charred:
        kit.ellipse_shadow(s, (cx - 22, cy + 8, 44, 12))
        b = kit.new(64, 56)

        s.blit(kit.outline(b, (8, 6, 5)), (0, 0))
        return s, (cx, cy)
    kit.ellipse_shadow(s, (cx - 20, cy + 11, 40, 10))
    b = kit.new(64, 56)

    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))

def broken_camera():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(64, 52)
    kit.shadow(s, (cx - 16, cy - 9, 32, 18), r=3, alpha=(60, 30))
    b = kit.new(64, 52)
    B = P.ramp((40, 44, 46))
    pygame.draw.line(b, (80, 84, 82), (cx - 14, cy - 8), (cx - 28, cy - 24), 2)     # snapped mount
    pygame.draw.line(b, (125, 40, 35), (cx - 12, cy + 2), (cx - 25, cy + 12), 2)    # torn red lead
    kit.rrect(b, B[2], (cx - 16, cy - 9, 32, 18), 3)
    kit.inner_line(b, (cx - 15, cy - 9, 30, 18), B[3], B[1])
    b.fill(B[4], (cx - 13, cy - 9, 18, 1))
    for i in range(4):
        b.fill(B[1], (cx - 12 + i * 3, cy - 4, 1, 9))  # vents
    pygame.draw.circle(b, (5, 7, 8), (cx + 8, cy), 7)
    pygame.draw.circle(b, (40, 52, 60), (cx + 8, cy), 7, 1)
    pygame.draw.line(b, (120, 140, 150), (cx + 4, cy - 3), (cx + 11, cy + 3))          # cracked lens
    b.set_at((cx + 6, cy - 3), (170, 190, 200))
    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def spark_box():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(44, 48)
    kit.shadow(s, (cx - 14, cy - 16, 28, 32), r=3, alpha=(60, 30))
    b = kit.new(44, 48)
    B = P.ramp((52, 56, 50))
    kit.rrect(b, B[2], (cx - 14, cy - 16, 28, 32), 3)
    b.fill(B[3], (cx - 13, cy - 15, 9, 30))
    b.fill(B[4], (cx - 13, cy - 15, 1, 30))
    b.fill(B[1], (cx + 8, cy - 15, 5, 30))
    b.fill(B[0], (cx + 2, cy - 14, 1, 28))                     # door seam
    b.fill(B[4], (cx + 3, cy - 14, 1, 28))
    b.fill((120, 104, 40), (cx - 11, cy + 6, 14, 4))           # hazard label
    b.fill((30, 30, 26), (cx - 11, cy + 9, 14, 1))
    for x in range(cx - 10, cx + 3, 4):
        b.fill((30, 30, 26), (x, cy + 6, 2, 3))
    b.fill((180, 60, 40), (cx - 9, cy - 11, 3, 3))            # dead status lamp
    b.set_at((cx - 9, cy - 11), (230, 120, 90))
    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def puddle():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(88, 46)
    ox, oy = cx - 42, cy - 21
    pts = [(10, 22), (20, 10), (40, 5), (62, 9), (76, 18), (70, 30), (48, 36), (24, 33)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (22, 32, 42, 120), [(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in pts])
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (60, 76, 92, 80), [(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in pts], 1)
    inner = [(20, 22), (28, 14), (44, 10), (60, 14), (66, 20), (56, 28), (38, 30)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(s, (16, 24, 34, 140), [(ox + x, oy + y) for x, y in inner])
    for (x1, y1, x2, a) in ((26, 16, 44, 110), (50, 20, 62, 80)):   # sky reflection streaks
        s.fill((150, 172, 190, a), (ox + x1, oy + y1, x2 - x1, 1))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def puddle_scorch():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(100, 54)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (8, 6, 5, 140), (cx - 48, cy - 25, 96, 50), 4)
    return s, (cx, cy)


def soot():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(100, 64)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (8, 7, 6, 110), (cx - 48, cy - 30, 95, 60))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (8, 7, 6, 60), (cx - 36, cy - 22, 70, 44))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(s, (55, 42, 28, 50), (cx - 38, cy - 22, 76, 42), 2)
    return s, (cx, cy)


def flare():
    s, cx, cy = _frame(32, 16)
    b = kit.new(32, 16)
    R = P.ramp((95, 35, 25))
    kit.rrect(b, R[2], (cx - 10, cy - 3, 20, 6), 2)
    b.fill(R[3], (cx - 9, cy - 3, 18, 1))
    b.fill(R[1], (cx - 9, cy + 2, 18, 1))
    b.fill(P.CREAM, (cx - 4, cy - 2, 3, 4))           # paper band
    s.blit(kit.outline(b), (0, 0))
    return s, (cx, cy)


def upload_pc(pulse, cursor):
    W, H = 60, 52
    s = kit.new(W, H)
    sx, sy = 24, 26
    led = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(pulse * 5.0)
    B = P.ramp(P.CASE_BEIGE)
    OUT = (78, 70, 50)
    kit.shadow(s, (sx - 18, sy - 19, 36 + 12, 36), r=3, alpha=(60, 30))
    b = kit.new(W, H)
    # tower (right): slim, vents, power LED
    tx, ty = sx + 17, sy - 17
    kit.rrect(b, B[2], (tx, ty, 10, 28), 1)
    b.fill(B[3], (tx + 1, ty + 1, 1, 26))
    b.fill(B[1], (tx + 8, ty + 1, 1, 26))
    b.fill((50, 48, 42), (tx + 2, ty + 3, 6, 2))
    for i in range(3):
        b.fill(B[1], (tx + 2, ty + 8 + i * 2, 6, 1))
    led_c = P.clamp((80 + 120 * led, 220 + 35 * led, 80 + 40 * led))
    b.fill(led_c, (tx + 4, ty + 23, 2, 2))
    # monitor
    mx, my = sx - 18, sy - 19
    kit.rrect(b, B[1], (mx + 2, my + 3, 36, 28), 3)
    kit.rrect(b, B[2], (mx, my, 36, 26), 3)
    b.fill(B[4], (mx + 2, my + 1, 32, 1))
    b.fill(B[3], (mx + 1, my + 2, 1, 22))
    bz = (mx + 4, my + 4, 28, 17)
    kit.rrect(b, (40, 38, 30), bz, 2)
    gx, gy, gw, gh = bz[0] + 1, bz[1] + 1, bz[2] - 2, bz[3] - 2
    phos = P.mix(P.CRT_GLASS, P.PHOSPHOR, 0.45 + 0.4 * pulse)
    b.fill(phos, (gx, gy, gw, gh))
    b.fill(P.mix(phos, P.PHOSPHOR_HI, 0.35 + 0.25 * pulse), (gx + 1, gy + gh // 4, gw - 2, gh // 2))
    for ly in range(gy, gy + gh, 2):
        b.fill(P.mix(phos, (40, 110, 60), 0.6), (gx, ly, gw, 1))
    b.set_at((gx, gy), P.mix(phos, (230, 255, 235), 0.5))    # glass glint upper-left
    b.set_at((gx + 1, gy), P.mix(phos, (230, 255, 235), 0.3))
    if cursor:
        b.fill(P.PHOSPHOR_HI, (gx + 2, gy + gh - 4, 2, 2))
    b.fill(led_c, (bz[0] + bz[2] - 2, bz[1] + bz[3] + 2, 1, 1))
    # keyboard (trapezoid, two key rows + spacebar)
    ky = sy + 11
    pts = [(sx - 14, ky), (sx + 14, ky), (sx + 17, ky + 8), (sx - 17, ky + 8)]
    pygame.draw.polygon(b, B[1], pts)
    pygame.draw.polygon(b, B[2], [(sx - 13, ky + 1), (sx + 13, ky + 1), (sx + 15, ky + 6), (sx - 15, ky + 6)])
    for k in range(6):
        kx = sx - 12 + k * 4 + 1
        b.fill((78, 72, 58), (kx, ky + 2, 3, 2))
        b.fill((158, 150, 122), (kx, ky + 2, 3, 1))
    b.fill((78, 72, 58), (sx - 7, ky + 5, 14, 2))
    b.fill((158, 150, 122), (sx - 7, ky + 5, 14, 1))
    pygame.draw.lines(b, (45, 42, 35), False, [(mx + 35, my + 16), (tx - 1, ty + 13), (tx + 1, ty + 14)], 1)
    b = kit.outline(b, OUT)
    s.blit(b, (0, 0))
    return s, (sx, sy)


def build():
    sh = kit.Sheet("spr_props_m2", FAMILY, max_w=512)
    sh.meta = {"anchor": "prop world position (procedural sx, sy)",
               "upload_pc": {"frames": "upload_pc_<pulse 0..3>_<cursor 0|1>",
                             "pulse_from": "0.5+0.5*sin(t_ms*0.005)", "cursor_period_ms": 1000}}
    for key, fn in (("cone", lambda: cone(False)), ("cone_charred", lambda: cone(True)),
                    ("barrel", lambda: barrel(False)), ("barrel_charred", lambda: barrel(True)),
                    ("sign", lambda: sign(False)), ("sign_charred", lambda: sign(True)),
                    ("broken_camera", broken_camera), ("spark_box", spark_box),
                    ("puddle", puddle), ("puddle_scorch", puddle_scorch), ("soot", soot),
                    ("flare", flare)):
        surf, anc = fn()
        sh.add(key, surf, anc)
    for i, p in enumerate(PULSES):
        for c in (0, 1):
            surf, anc = upload_pc(p, c)
            sh.add("upload_pc_%d_%d" % (i, c), surf, anc, pulse=p, cursor=bool(c), duration_ms=500)
    return [sh]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(kit.run(FAMILY, build))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\sprites\t7_probe.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""t7_probe.py - before/after shots + draw-time probe for Polish T7.

    python tools/sprites/t7_probe.py            # sprite tier  -> after.png
    python tools/sprites/t7_probe.py --no-t7    # T7 sheets off -> before.png
    ACA_ART=legacy python tools/sprites/t7_probe.py   # whole art tier off -> legacy.png
    ... --frames 120  --no-shots  --json out.json

Shots go to shots/polish_pass/07/<family>/{before,after}.png with the same
camera both runs (ACA_FREEZE=1 pins time-driven terms). The probe times
gc.game_draw over N frames per scene with the dummy video driver, so the
numbers are CPU draw cost (ms/frame -> FPS ceiling), not vsynced FPS.
"""
import json
import os
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("SDL_AUDIODRIVER", "dummy")
os.environ.setdefault("PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT", "1")
os.environ["ACA_FREEZE"] = "1"
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

import pygame  # noqa: E402

from core import config  # noqa: E402
from core import game_core as gc  # noqa: E402
from core.state import STATE  # noqa: E402

from core import artpack  # noqa: E402

T = config.TILE_SIZE
LEGACY = os.environ.get("ACA_ART", "") in ("legacy", "off")
NO_T7 = "--no-t7" in sys.argv
if NO_T7:
    # Pre-T7 look: rest of the art tier on, T7 sheets reported missing so
    # every T7 call site takes its procedural fallback.
    artpack.frame = lambda *_a, **_k: None
MODE = "legacy" if LEGACY else ("pre_t7" if NO_T7 else "t7")
SHOT = {"legacy": "legacy.png", "pre_t7": "before.png", "t7": "after.png"}[MODE]


def _cam(tx, ty):
    STATE.player.rect.center = (int(tx * T), int(ty * T))
    return int(tx * T - config.WIDTH // 2), int(ty * T - config.HEIGHT // 2)


def _m2_road():
    gc.start_mission2(preserve_timer=True)
    return _cam(46, 33)                     # tanker + IPA truck + cars


def _m2_props():
    gc.start_mission2(preserve_timer=True)
    return _cam(13, 70)                     # spawn-road flares / cones


def _m2_blast():
    from missions.m2 import sniper
    gc.start_mission2(preserve_timer=True)
    sniper._explode_tanker()
    STATE.mission2_tanker_blast_timer = 520  # settled aftermath
    STATE.mission2_stage = "evidence"        # past the blackout overlay
    return _cam(46, 37)


def _m3_archives():
    from missions import m3
    m3.start_mission3_archives_checkpoint(preserve_timer=True)
    STATE.player.rect.center = (12 * T, 27 * T)
    return m3._clamp_m3_camera(12 * T - config.WIDTH // 2, 27 * T - config.HEIGHT // 2)


def _m4_tower():
    gc.start_mission4_tower_checkpoint(preserve_timer=True)
    p = STATE.player.rect.center
    return p[0] - config.WIDTH // 2, p[1] - config.HEIGHT // 2


SCENES = (("m2_road", _m2_road), ("m2_props", _m2_props), ("m2_blast", _m2_blast),
          ("m3_archives", _m3_archives), ("m4_tower", _m4_tower))


def _lineup(fam):
    """Isolated family shot: the real m2 draw entry points on flat asphalt,
    so before/after differ only by the T7 sprite path (no HUD / grading)."""
    from missions.m2 import draw as d
    surf = pygame.Surface((config.WIDTH, config.HEIGHT))
    surf.fill((58, 56, 52))
    gc.start_mission2(preserve_timer=True)
    STATE.mission2_tanker_blast_timer = 520
    if fam == "vehicles":
        sizes = ((118, 44), (126, 48), (110, 42), (112, 44), (116, 44), (126, 46), (112, 42))
        for i, (w, h) in enumerate(sizes):
            x = 16 + i * 140
            d._draw_vehicle(surf, pygame.Rect(x, 40, w, h), "car", 0, 0, {})
            d._draw_vehicle(surf, pygame.Rect(x, 150, w, h), "burned", 0, 0, {})
        d._draw_vehicle(surf, pygame.Rect(40, 270, 160, 54), "ipa_truck", 0, 0, {})
        d._draw_vehicle(surf, pygame.Rect(260, 270, 160, 54), "ipa_truck", 0, 0,
                        {"blast_charred": True})
        STATE.mission2_tanker_inspected = True
        t = STATE.mission2_tanker_rect
        d._draw_tanker(surf, t.x - 480, t.y - 260)
    elif fam == "props":
        kinds = ("cone", "barrel", "sign", "broken_camera", "spark_box", "puddle", "soot", "flare")
        for i, k in enumerate(kinds):
            x = 70 + i * 118
            d._draw_story_prop(surf, {"kind": k, "pos": (x, 120), "age": 5, "life": -1}, 0, 0)
            d._draw_story_prop(surf, {"kind": k, "pos": (x, 300), "age": 5, "life": -1,
                                      "charred": True, "scorched": True}, 0, 0)
        for i in range(4):
            d._draw_upload_computer(surf, 140 + i * 220, 520, 0, 0)
    else:
        import random
        random.seed(7)                       # same debris / spot fires both runs
        _m2_blast()
        t = STATE.mission2_tanker_rect
        d._draw_tanker_blast_fx(surf, t.centerx - config.WIDTH // 2, t.centery - config.HEIGHT // 2)
    return surf


def main():
    # core.config already opened the display; a second set_mode would leave
    # config.screen (imported by name all over src/) pointing at a dead surface.
    frames = int(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--frames") + 1]) if "--frames" in sys.argv else 120
    shots = "--no-shots" not in sys.argv
    res = {"mode": MODE, "frames": frames, "scenes": {}}
    if shots:
        for fam in ("vehicles", "props", "fx"):
            out = ROOT / "shots" / "polish_pass" / "07" / fam
            out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            pygame.image.save(_lineup(fam), str(out / SHOT))
    for name, fn in SCENES:
        try:
            fcx, fcy = fn()
        except Exception as exc:  # report and keep probing the other scenes
            print("%-12s SKIP (%s: %s)" % (name, type(exc).__name__, exc))
            continue
        for _ in range(3):                     # warm caches / settle state
            gc.game_draw(fcx, fcy)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        for _ in range(frames):
            gc.game_draw(fcx, fcy)
        ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0 / frames
        res["scenes"][name] = round(ms, 2)
        print("%-12s %6.2f ms/frame  (%5.0f fps ceiling)" % (name, ms, 1000.0 / max(ms, 1e-6)))
    if "--json" in sys.argv:
        Path(sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--json") + 1]).write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    print("T7 PROBE: OK (%s)" % res["mode"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# tools\sprites\vehicles.py
# ------------------------------------------------------------

"""vehicles.py - Mission 2 road vehicles as authored sprite sheets (Polish T7).

Replaces the per-frame polygon soup in ``missions/m2/draw.py``
(``_draw_civilian_car``, ``_draw_burned_car``, ``_draw_ipa_truck``,
``_draw_ipa_truck_charred``, ``_draw_tanker``). Those renderers stay as the
fallback; ``core.artpack.vehicle(key)`` returns ``None`` when this sheet is
absent or ``ACA_ART=legacy``.

Frames (all face EAST, hood right, like the procedural cars):
  car_<paint>_<w>x<h>         intact sedan, one per palette x rect size used
  burned_<paint>_<w>x<h>      charred wreck of the same car
  smoulder_<w>x<h>_<0..3>     glow overlay (cabin + engine bay), 4 levels
  ipa_truck / ipa_truck_charred / ipa_glow_<0..3>
  tanker / tanker_wreck       (tanker LED + fuel pool stay procedural: they
                               animate with mission state)

Every frame's ``anchor`` is the offset of the vehicle's collision-rect
top-left inside the frame: blit at (rect.x - ax, rect.y - ay).

    python tools/sprites/vehicles.py [--preview] [--out DIR]
"""
import math
import os
import random
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import kit  # noqa: E402
import palette as P  # noqa: E402
import pygame  # noqa: E402

FAMILY = "vehicles"
PAD = 24
# Every civilian rect size placed by missions/m2/world.py. A car whose size
# is not listed simply falls back to the procedural renderer.
CAR_SIZES = ((118, 44), (126, 48), (110, 42), (112, 44), (116, 44), (126, 46), (112, 42))
TRUCK = (160, 54)
TANKER = (64 * 5 - 12, 64 * 3 - 16)
SMOULDER_LEVELS = (0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0)
# Charred metal: warm-neutral ramp (the generic ramp() drifts cool, which
# read as blue paint on burnt steel). deep -> hi.
CHAR_RAMP = [(10, 8, 7), (21, 17, 14), (36, 30, 25), (54, 45, 37), (74, 62, 50)]


def _car_layout(w, h):
    trunk_w = int(w * 0.22)
    hood_w = int(w * 0.26)
    return trunk_w, hood_w, trunk_w, w - trunk_w - hood_w, w - hood_w


def _tyres(s, ox, oy, w, h, xs, tw=16, th=9, col=P.TYRE, hi=P.TYRE_HI, melt=False):
    for ax in xs:
        for ty in (oy - 4, oy + h - th + 4):
            if melt:
                pygame.draw.ellipse(s, col, (ox + ax - tw // 2, ty + 1, tw, th - 1))
                continue
            kit.rrect(s, col, (ox + ax - tw // 2, ty, tw, th), 2)
            s.fill(hi, (ox + ax - tw // 2 + 2, ty, tw - 4, 1))
            for gx in range(ox + ax - tw // 2 + 3, ox + ax + tw // 2 - 2, 3):   # tread
                s.fill(P.mix(col, hi, 0.35), (gx, ty + 2, 1, th - 3))
            s.fill(P.mix(col, hi, 0.5), (ox + ax - 1, ty + 1, 2, th - 2))


def car(paint, w, h):
    R = P.ramp(paint)
    deep, shd, base, lit, hi = R
    roof = P.shade(paint, 0.84)
    RR = P.ramp(roof, 5, 0.8)
    G = P.ramp(P.GLASS, 5, 0.9)
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2
    ox = oy = PAD
    trunk_w, hood_w, cab_x, cab_w, hood_x = _car_layout(w, h)
    body = kit.new(fw, fh)
    _tyres(body, ox, oy, w, h, (trunk_w + 8, hood_x + 6))
    # mirrors (stick out of the cabin just behind the windshield)
    for my in (oy - 2, oy + h):
        body.fill(shd, (ox + cab_x + cab_w - 7, my, 4, 2))
    # hull: base, lit top band, shaded lower band, rounded nose/tail
    kit.rrect(body, base, (ox, oy, w, h), 8)
    kit.rrect(body, lit, (ox + 1, oy, w - 2, 4), 4)
    body.fill(hi, (ox + 6, oy, w - 12, 1))
    kit.rrect(body, shd, (ox + 1, oy + h - 5, w - 2, 5), 4)
    body.fill(deep, (ox + 6, oy + h - 1, w - 12, 1))
    body.fill(lit, (ox, oy + 6, 1, h - 12))                 # lit tail edge
    body.fill(shd, (ox + w - 1, oy + 6, 1, h - 12))         # shaded nose edge
    # hood: crease lines catch the light, cowl seam
    body.fill(deep, (ox + hood_x, oy + 3, 1, h - 6))
    for cy, c in ((oy + h // 3, lit), (oy + 2 * h // 3, shd)):
        body.fill(c, (ox + hood_x + 4, cy, hood_w - 9, 1))
    # trunk seam + lid highlight
    body.fill(deep, (ox + trunk_w, oy + 3, 1, h - 6))
    body.fill(lit, (ox + 3, oy + 5, trunk_w - 6, 1))
    # glass surround (windshield front, rear window back) with selective inner edge
    gx, gy, gw, gh = ox + cab_x + 2, oy + 4, cab_w - 4, h - 8
    kit.rrect(body, G[1], (gx, gy, gw, gh), 4)
    kit.rrect(body, G[2], (gx + 1, gy + 1, gw - 2, gh - 2), 3)
    # windshield reflection: two warm diagonal glints, upper-left lit
    for k, c in ((0, G[4]), (4, G[3])):
        for i in range(min(gh - 4, 9)):
            x = gx + gw - 4 - k - i // 2
            body.set_at((x, gy + 2 + i), c)
    body.fill(G[3], (gx + 1, gy + 2, 1, gh - 4))             # rear window edge
    # roof panel
    rx, ry, rw, rh = ox + cab_x + 7, oy + 7, cab_w - 14, h - 14
    kit.rrect(body, RR[2], (rx, ry, rw, rh), 3)
    kit.inner_line(body, (rx + 1, ry, rw - 2, rh), RR[3], RR[1])
    body.fill(RR[4], (rx + 2, ry, rw - 4, 1))
    body.fill(RR[1], (rx + rw // 2 + 2, ry + 2, 1, rh - 4))  # sunroof seam
    # door seams only on the exposed body strip above/below the glass
    for dx in (cab_x + cab_w // 3, cab_x + 2 * cab_w // 3):
        body.fill(deep, (ox + dx, oy + 1, 1, 3))
        body.fill(deep, (ox + dx, oy + h - 4, 1, 3))
        body.fill(lit, (ox + dx + 1, oy + 1, 1, 2))
    # lights, grille, plate
    for hy in (oy + 4, oy + h - 8):
        body.fill(P.mix(P.HEADLIGHT, deep, 0.45), (ox + w - 4, hy, 3, 4))
        body.fill(P.HEADLIGHT, (ox + w - 3, hy, 2, 3))
        body.fill(P.TAILLIGHT, (ox + 1, hy, 2, 4))
    body.fill((20, 18, 16), (ox + w - 7, oy + h // 2 - 4, 3, 8))
    body.fill(P.PLATE, (ox - 1, oy + h // 2 - 3, 3, 7))
    body.fill(P.shade(P.PLATE, 0.6), (ox - 1, oy + h // 2 + 3, 3, 1))
    body = kit.outline(body)
    out = kit.new(fw, fh)
    kit.shadow(out, (ox, oy - 2, w, h + 4), r=8)
    out.blit(body, (0, 0))
    return out


def burned(paint, w, h, seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    C = CHAR_RAMP
    deep, shd, base, lit, hi = C
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2
    ox = oy = PAD
    trunk_w, hood_w, cab_x, cab_w, hood_x = _car_layout(w, h)
    out = kit.new(fw, fh)
    # ground scorch: flat two-step, wider than the car, offset with the wind
    lay = kit.new(fw, fh)
    pygame.draw.ellipse(lay, (*P.SOOT, 120), (ox - 20, oy - 10, w + 40, h + 26))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(lay, (4, 3, 3, 110), (ox - 6, oy - 2, w + 14, h + 10))
    out.blit(lay, (0, 0))
    body = kit.new(fw, fh)
    _tyres(body, ox, oy, w, h, (trunk_w + 8, hood_x + 6), 14, 7, (12, 10, 9), deep, melt=True)
    kit.rrect(body, base, (ox, oy, w, h), 8)
    kit.rrect(body, lit, (ox + 1, oy, w - 2, 3), 4)
    kit.rrect(body, shd, (ox + 1, oy + h - 4, w - 2, 4), 4)
    # blistered paint remnants - flat blotches of the original colour
    rem = P.mix(paint, P.CHAR, 0.55)
    rem_hi = P.mix(paint, P.CHAR, 0.35)
    for _ in range(5):
        bx = rng.randint(4, w - 22)
        by = rng.choice((rng.randint(2, 6), rng.randint(h - 12, h - 8)))
        bw, bh = rng.randint(10, 20), rng.randint(4, 7)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(body, rem, (ox + bx, oy + by, bw, bh))
        body.fill(rem_hi, (ox + bx + 2, oy + by, max(1, bw - 6), 1))
    # soot smears (flat, darkest step)
    for _ in range(3):
        sx, sy = rng.randint(0, w - 26), rng.randint(0, h - 12)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(body, shd, (ox + sx, oy + sy, rng.randint(14, 26), rng.randint(6, 10)))
    # cabin cavity: roof collapsed, glass gone
    cx, cy, cw, ch = ox + cab_x + 2, oy + 4, cab_w - 4, h - 8
    kit.rrect(body, (8, 6, 5), (cx, cy, cw, ch), 3)
    kit.rrect(body, (16, 13, 11), (cx + 3, cy + 3, cw - 6, ch - 6), 2)   # ash-covered seats
    for _ in range(6):
        body.fill(P.ASH, (rng.randint(cx + 4, cx + cw - 6), rng.randint(cy + 4, cy + ch - 5), 2, 1))
    body.fill(lit, (cx + 1, cy, cw - 2, 1))                   # sill catches the key light
    for _ in range(4):                                        # twisted roof ribs
        x1 = rng.randint(cx + 3, cx + cw - 4)
        y1 = rng.randint(cy + 2, cy + ch - 3)
        x2, y2 = x1 + rng.randint(-8, 8), y1 + rng.randint(-5, 5)
        pygame.draw.line(body, base, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), 2)
        pygame.draw.line(body, hi, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), 1)
    for dx in (cab_x + cab_w // 3, cab_x + 2 * cab_w // 3):
        body.fill(deep, (ox + dx, oy + 1, 1, 3))
        body.fill(deep, (ox + dx, oy + h - 4, 1, 3))
    body.fill(deep, (ox + hood_x, oy + 3, 1, h - 6))
    body.fill(deep, (ox + trunk_w, oy + 3, 1, h - 6))
    body.fill((4, 3, 3), (ox + hood_x + hood_w - 8, oy + h // 2 - 3, 6, 6))
    for hy in (oy + 5, oy + h - 8):
        body.fill((14, 11, 9), (ox + w - 3, hy, 2, 3))
        body.fill((40, 12, 10), (ox + 1, hy, 2, 3))
    body = kit.outline(body, (6, 5, 4))
    out.blit(body, (0, 0))
    return out


def _glow(surf, cx, cy, rings, level, clip=None):
    lay = kit.new(*surf.get_size())
    for r, col, a in rings:
        pygame.draw.circle(lay, (*col, int(a * level)), (cx, cy), r)
    if clip is not None:
        x, y, w, h = clip
        m = kit.new(*surf.get_size())
        m.fill((255, 255, 255, 255), clip)
        lay.blit(m, (0, 0), special_flags=pygame.BLEND_RGBA_MIN)
    surf.blit(lay, (0, 0))


def smoulder(w, h, level):
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2
    ox = oy = PAD
    trunk_w, hood_w, cab_x, cab_w, hood_x = _car_layout(w, h)
    s = kit.new(fw, fh)
    cab = (ox + cab_x + 5, oy + 7, cab_w - 10, h - 14)
    F = P.FIRE
    _glow(s, cab[0] + cab[2] // 2, cab[1] + cab[3] // 2,
          ((22, F[1], 90), (14, F[2], 120), (7, F[3], 150)), level, cab)
    _glow(s, ox + hood_x + 14, oy + h // 2, ((10, F[1], 130), (5, F[3], 90)), level)
    return s


def _font_label(surf, s, x, y, col, scale=1):
    kit.text(surf, s, x, y, col, sx=scale, sy=scale)


def ipa_truck(charred=False, seed=0):
    w, h = TRUCK
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2
    ox = oy = PAD
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    cargo_w = int(w * 0.68)
    if charred:
        CG = CHAR_RAMP
        CB = CG
    else:
        CG = P.ramp(P.IPA_CARGO)
        CB = P.ramp(P.IPA_CAB)
    out = kit.new(fw, fh)
    kit.shadow(out, (ox, oy - 2, w, h + 4), r=5, alpha=(90, 50) if charred else (75, 40))
    b = kit.new(fw, fh)
    axles = (16, cargo_w // 2, w - 14)
    if charred:
        for ax in axles:
            for ty in (oy - 3, oy + h - 3):
                if rng.random() > 0.25:
                    kit.rrect(b, (8, 8, 10), (ox + ax - 7, ty, 14, 6), 2)
                else:
                    b.fill(CG[0], (ox + ax - 3, ty + 2, 6, 3))
    else:
        _tyres(b, ox, oy, w, h, axles, 16, 7)
    # cargo box
    deep, shd, base, lit, hi = CG
    kit.rrect(b, base, (ox, oy, cargo_w, h), 4)
    kit.rrect(b, lit, (ox + 1, oy, cargo_w - 2, 4), 3)
    b.fill(hi, (ox + 4, oy, cargo_w - 8, 1))
    kit.rrect(b, shd, (ox + 1, oy + h - 5, cargo_w - 2, 5), 3)
    b.fill(lit, (ox, oy + 4, 1, h - 8))
    rx = ox + cargo_w // 2
    if charred:
        for bx, bw in ((6, cargo_w // 3), (cargo_w // 2 - 10, 28), (cargo_w - cargo_w // 3, cargo_w // 4)):
            kit.rrect(b, shd, (ox + bx, oy + 3, bw, h - 8), 3)
            b.fill(deep, (ox + bx + 1, oy + h - 6, bw - 2, 1))
        for _ in range(5):
            sx, sy = rng.randint(4, cargo_w - 30), rng.randint(2, h - 16)
            pygame.draw.ellipse(b, P.SOOT, (ox + sx, oy + sy, rng.randint(16, 30), rng.randint(10, 18)))
        off = rng.randint(-3, 3)
        pygame.draw.line(b, P.SOOT, (rx, oy + 3), (rx + off, oy + h - 5), 3)
        b.fill(hi, (rx + 1, oy + 3, 1, h - 8))
    else:
        # tarp ridge: folded crest lit on the left face
        b.fill(deep, (rx - 1, oy + 3, 2, h - 8))
        b.fill(hi, (rx + 1, oy + 3, 1, h - 8))
    for frac in (0.33, 0.66):
        sy = oy + int(h * frac)
        b.fill(deep, (ox + 2, sy, cargo_w - 4, 1))
        if not charred:
            b.fill(lit, (ox + 2, sy + 1, cargo_w - 4, 1))
            for x in range(ox + 8, ox + cargo_w - 6, 16):
                b.fill(deep, (x, sy - 1, 2, 2))
                b.set_at((x, sy - 1), hi)
    sten = (70, 58, 42) if charred else P.IPA_STENCIL
    tw = kit.text_w("IPA", 1, 2)
    _font_label(b, "IPA", rx - tw // 2, oy + 6, sten, 2)
    if not charred:
        _font_label(b, "CGO-12", rx - kit.text_w("CGO-12") // 2, oy + h - 14, P.shade(P.IPA_STENCIL, 0.8))
    b.fill(deep, (ox + 1, oy + 2, 2, h - 4))                 # tailgate
    b.fill(lit, (ox + 3, oy + 2, 1, h - 4))
    # cab
    cx = ox + cargo_w
    cw = w - cargo_w
    d2, s2, b2, l2, h2 = CB
    kit.rrect(b, b2, (cx, oy, cw, h), 4)
    kit.rrect(b, l2, (cx + 2, oy + 2, cw - 22, 3), 2)
    b.fill(d2, (cx, oy, 2, h))
    kit.rrect(b, s2, (cx + 1, oy + h - 4, cw - 2, 4), 3)
    wx, wy, ww, wh = cx + cw - 18, oy + 4, 12, h - 8
    if charred:
        kit.rrect(b, (5, 4, 3), (wx, wy, ww, wh), 2)
    else:
        G = P.ramp(P.GLASS)
        kit.rrect(b, G[2], (wx, wy, ww, wh), 2)
        b.fill(G[4], (wx + 1, wy, ww - 2, 1))
        for i in range(6):
            b.set_at((wx + ww - 3 - i // 2, wy + 3 + i), G[3])
        for hy in (oy + 6, oy + h - 11):
            b.fill(P.mix(P.HEADLIGHT, d2, 0.4), (ox + w - 4, hy, 3, 5))
            b.fill(P.HEADLIGHT, (ox + w - 3, hy + 1, 2, 3))
    b = kit.outline(b, (8, 6, 5) if charred else None)
    out.blit(b, (0, 0))
    return out


def ipa_glow(level, seed):
    w, h = TRUCK
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2
    ox = oy = PAD
    cargo_w = int(w * 0.68)
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    s = kit.new(fw, fh)
    F = P.FIRE
    _glow(s, ox + 10 + (cargo_w - 20) // 2, oy + 8 + (h - 16) // 2,
          ((26, F[1], 80), (16, F[2], 110), (8, F[3], 140)), level, (ox + 6, oy + 4, cargo_w - 12, h - 8))
    lay = kit.new(fw, fh)
    for i in range(6):                     # glowing fissures, own phase each
        x, y = rng.randint(ox + 6, ox + cargo_w - 6), rng.randint(oy + 4, oy + h - 4)
        pts = [(x, y)]
        for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 4)):
            px = max(ox + 4, min(ox + cargo_w - 5, pts[-1][0] + rng.randint(-18, 18)))
            pts.append((px, max(oy + 3, min(oy + h - 4, pts[-1][1] + rng.randint(-10, 10)))))
        ph = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.sin(level * 6.0 + i * 1.9)
        pygame.draw.lines(lay, (*F[1], int(200 * ph)), False, pts, 3)
        pygame.draw.lines(lay, (*F[3], int(230 * ph)), False, pts, 1)
    s.blit(lay, (0, 0))
    _glow(s, ox + w - 12, oy + h // 2, ((11, F[1], 140), (6, F[3], 100)), level)
    return s


def tanker(wreck=False):
    w, h = TANKER
    fw, fh = w + PAD * 2, h + PAD * 2 + 40            # valve hangs below the tank
    ox = oy = PAD
    out = kit.new(fw, fh)
    if wreck:
        lay = kit.new(fw, fh)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(lay, (0, 0, 0, 200), (ox - 15, oy + 22, w + 30, h + 30 - PAD))
        out.blit(lay, (0, 0))
        b = kit.new(fw, fh)
        C = CHAR_RAMP
        kit.rrect(b, C[1], (ox, oy, w, h), 22)
        kit.rrect(b, C[2], (ox + 3, oy + 2, w - 6, h // 2), 20)
        pygame.draw.ellipse(b, (12, 10, 9), (ox + 20, oy + 10, w - 40, h - 20))
        pygame.draw.ellipse(b, C[0], (ox + 34, oy + 20, w - 68, h - 40))
        rng = random.Random(4517)
        for i in range(7):
            x = ox + 40 + i * (w - 80) // 6 + rng.randint(-4, 4)
            y1, y2 = oy + 18 + rng.randint(0, 10), oy + h - 18 - rng.randint(0, 10)
            pygame.draw.line(b, C[3], (x, y1), (x + rng.randint(-6, 6), y2), 2)
        kit.rrect(b, (60, 45, 35), (ox, oy, w, h), 22, 2)
        out.blit(kit.outline(b, (8, 6, 5)), (0, 0))
        return out
    kit.shadow(out, (ox, oy - 2, w, h + 4), r=18, alpha=(80, 42))
    b = kit.new(fw, fh)
    cab_w = int(w * 0.18)
    tx, tw = ox + cab_w, w - cab_w
    _tyres(b, ox, oy, w, h, (14, cab_w + int(tw * 0.35), cab_w + int(tw * 0.75)), 18, 8)
    # cab (faces WEST here, like the procedural tanker)
    CB = P.ramp(P.TANK_CAB)
    kit.rrect(b, CB[2], (ox, oy, cab_w, h), 5)
    kit.rrect(b, CB[3], (ox + 2, oy + 2, cab_w - 4, 4), 2)
    kit.rrect(b, CB[1], (ox + 1, oy + h - 5, cab_w - 2, 5), 3)
    b.fill(CB[0], (ox + cab_w - 2, oy, 2, h))
    G = P.ramp(P.GLASS)
    kit.rrect(b, G[2], (ox + 3, oy + 6, 11, h - 12), 2)
    b.fill(G[4], (ox + 4, oy + 6, 9, 1))
    for i in range(10):
        b.set_at((ox + 5 + i // 3, oy + 9 + i), G[3])
    for hy in (oy + 6, oy + h - 11):
        b.fill(P.HEADLIGHT, (ox + 1, hy, 2, 4))
    # tank: a horizontal cylinder - lit crown band, shaded belly, steel ramp
    T = P.ramp(P.TANK_STEEL)
    kit.rrect(b, T[2], (tx, oy, tw, h), 18)
    belly = P.mix(T[1], T[0], 0.45)
    bands = ((0.00, 0.14, T[3]), (0.05, 0.09, T[4]), (0.72, 0.88, T[1]), (0.88, 1.0, belly))
    for a, z, c in bands:
        y0, y1 = oy + int(h * a), oy + int(h * z)
        kit.rrect(b, c, (tx + 2, y0, tw - 4, max(1, y1 - y0)), 10)
    # dither the crown-to-body and body-to-belly transitions (broad, reads)
    kit.dither(b, (tx + 10, oy + int(h * 0.14), tw - 20, 3), T[3])
    kit.dither(b, (tx + 10, oy + int(h * 0.69), tw - 20, 3), T[1])
    # end cap + rivets
    pygame.draw.ellipse(b, T[1], (tx + tw - 26, oy + 2, 24, h - 4))
    pygame.draw.ellipse(b, T[3], (tx + tw - 26, oy + 2, 24, h - 4), 1)
    for ry in range(oy + 10, oy + h - 6, 12):
        b.fill(T[0], (tx + tw - 15, ry, 2, 2))
    # hoop bands
    for frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
        bx = tx + int(tw * frac)
        b.fill(T[0], (bx, oy + 4, 2, h - 9))
        b.fill(T[4], (bx + 2, oy + 4, 1, h - 9))
    # hazard diamonds with class "3"
    for hx in (tx + int(tw * 0.35), tx + int(tw * 0.65)):
        d = [(hx, oy + 10), (hx + 10, oy + 20), (hx, oy + 30), (hx - 10, oy + 20)]
        pygame.draw.polygon(b, P.HAZARD, d)
        pygame.draw.polygon(b, P.mix(P.HAZARD, P.INK, 0.8), d, 1)
        pygame.draw.line(b, P.mix(P.HAZARD, (255, 255, 220), 0.5), (hx - 8, oy + 20), (hx, oy + 12))
        kit.text(b, "3", hx - 2, oy + 17, (20, 16, 8), sy=1)
    cxm = tx + tw // 2
    _font_label(b, "IPA", cxm - kit.text_w("IPA", 1, 2) // 2, oy + 40, P.IPA_STENCIL, 2)
    _font_label(b, "FUEL", cxm - kit.text_w("FUEL") // 2, oy + 58, P.CREAM)
    # manifold: outlet flange, pipe, valve body + red hand-wheel, outlet 2
    M = P.ramp(P.MANIFOLD)
    y0 = oy + h - 3
    def flange(y):
        kit.rrect(b, M[1], (cxm - 11, y, 22, 6), 1)
        b.fill(M[3], (cxm - 10, y, 20, 1))
        for bx in (cxm - 8, cxm - 3, cxm + 3, cxm + 8):
            b.fill((20, 22, 24), (bx - 1, y + 2, 2, 2))
    b.fill(M[0], (cxm - 5, y0, 10, 17))
    b.fill(M[2], (cxm - 3, y0, 6, 17))
    b.fill(M[4], (cxm - 1, y0, 1, 17))
    flange(y0)
    vy = oy + h + 14
    kit.rrect(b, M[1], (cxm - 11, vy, 22, 16), 2)
    b.fill(M[3], (cxm - 10, vy + 1, 20, 1))
    V = P.ramp(P.VALVE_RED)
    pygame.draw.circle(b, V[1], (cxm, vy + 8), 10)
    pygame.draw.circle(b, V[3], (cxm, vy + 8), 10, 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(b, (30, 10, 8), (cxm, vy + 8), 8)
    for a in (0, 45, 90, 135):
        r = math.radians(a)
        pygame.draw.line(b, V[2], (cxm + int(2 * math.cos(r)), vy + 8 + int(2 * math.sin(r))),
                         (cxm + int(9 * math.cos(r)), vy + 8 + int(9 * math.sin(r))), 2)
    pygame.draw.circle(b, M[2], (cxm, vy + 8), 3)
    b.set_at((cxm - 1, vy + 7), M[4])
    y2 = vy + 16
    b.fill(M[0], (cxm - 5, y2, 10, 12))
    b.fill(M[2], (cxm - 3, y2, 6, 12))
    b.fill(M[4], (cxm - 1, y2, 1, 12))
    flange(y2 + 10)
    b = kit.outline(b)
    out.blit(b, (0, 0))
    return out


def build():
    sh = kit.Sheet("spr_vehicles", FAMILY, max_w=1400)
    sh.meta = {"facing": "east", "anchor": "collision-rect top-left",
               "smoulder_levels": list(SMOULDER_LEVELS),
               "smoulder_timing": "pick level from the procedural pulse 0.55+0.45*sin(...)",
               "car_sizes": [list(s) for s in CAR_SIZES],
               "paints": [n for n, _c in P.CAR_PAINTS]}
    for pi, (pname, paint) in enumerate(P.CAR_PAINTS):
        for (w, h) in CAR_SIZES:
            sh.add("car_%s_%dx%d" % (pname, w, h), car(paint, w, h), (PAD, PAD),
                   variant=pi, rect_size=[w, h])
            sh.add("burned_%s_%dx%d" % (pname, w, h), burned(paint, w, h, 9001 + pi * 131 + w * 7 + h),
                   (PAD, PAD), variant=pi, rect_size=[w, h], state="burned")
    for (w, h) in CAR_SIZES:
        for i, lv in enumerate(SMOULDER_LEVELS):
            sh.add("smoulder_%dx%d_%d" % (w, h, i), smoulder(w, h, lv), (PAD, PAD),
                   level=lv, overlay=True)
    sh.add("ipa_truck", ipa_truck(False), (PAD, PAD), rect_size=list(TRUCK))
    sh.add("ipa_truck_charred", ipa_truck(True, 7311), (PAD, PAD), rect_size=list(TRUCK), state="charred")
    for i, lv in enumerate(SMOULDER_LEVELS):
        sh.add("ipa_glow_%d" % i, ipa_glow(lv, 7312), (PAD, PAD), level=lv, overlay=True)
    sh.add("tanker", tanker(False), (PAD, PAD), rect_size=list(TANKER),
           dynamic="LED + fuel pool drawn procedurally on top")
    sh.add("tanker_wreck", tanker(True), (PAD, PAD), rect_size=list(TANKER), state="exploded")
    return [sh]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(kit.run(FAMILY, build))

# tools\test_multiplayer_ui.py

"""Small presentation regression suite; no live networking or external service."""
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

os.environ.setdefault('SDL_VIDEODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('SDL_AUDIODRIVER', 'dummy')
os.environ.setdefault('PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT', '1')
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'src'))
from core import settings_store, profile_store
_TMP = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mp_ui_')
settings_store.SAVE_FILE = str(Path(_TMP.name) / 'settings.json')
profile_store.PROFILE_FILE = str(Path(_TMP.name) / 'profile.json')
import pygame
from core import config
from missions import arena as AR
from ui import mp
from ui.match_screen import MatchScreen, PANEL_X, PANEL_Y, PANEL_W, PANEL_H


class PresentationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.ui = MatchScreen()
        self.ui.open_panel()
        self.screen = config.screen
        self.panel = pygame.Rect(PANEL_X, PANEL_Y, PANEL_W, PANEL_H)

    def test_setup_targets_and_map_data(self):
        before = {name: tuple(rows) for name, rows in AR.ARENAS.items()}
        for name in self.ui.maps():
            self.ui.map_name = name
            self.ui.draw_panel(self.screen)
            targets = list(self.ui._map_rects.values()) + list(self.ui._mode_rects.values()) + list(self.ui._pl_rects.values()) + list(self.ui._btn_rects.values())
            targets += [self.ui._name_rect, self.ui._addr_rect]
            self.assertTrue(all(self.panel.contains(r) for r in targets))
            self.assertEqual(len(self.ui._pl_rects), self.ui.max_players() - 1)
        self.assertEqual(before, {name: tuple(rows) for name, rows in AR.ARENAS.items()})

    def lobby(self, host=True, empty_side=False):
        self.ui.mode = 'hosting' if host else 'playing'
        self.ui.players = 8
        teams = {i: 0 if empty_side else i % 2 for i in range(8)}
        self.ui._match_state = {'roster': [(i, 'OPERATOR_%d' % i) for i in range(8)], 'teams': teams, 'mode': AR.MODE_TDM, 'room_capacity': 8}
        if host:
            self.ui.sim = SimpleNamespace(
                players={i: {'nick': 'OPERATOR_%d' % i} for i in range(8)},
                rules=SimpleNamespace(mode=AR.MODE_TDM, teams=teams,
                    team_counts=lambda: {t: list(teams.values()).count(t) for t in (0, 1)}))
        self.ui.room_code = 'ACAR-A974P-K39GWZ'
        self.ui.join_token = '12345678'
        self.ui.share_host = '192.168.0.5'
        self.ui.share_port = 27017
        self.ui._draw_waiting(self.screen)

    def test_host_controls_and_full_roster(self):
        self.lobby()
        self.assertIn('start', self.ui._lobby_rects)
        self.assertIn('copy', self.ui._wait_rects)
        self.assertIn('balance', self.ui._lobby_rects)
        self.assertEqual(sum(k.startswith('swap_') for k in self.ui._lobby_rects), 7)
        self.assertTrue(all(self.panel.contains(r) for r in self.ui._lobby_rects.values()))

    def test_unbalanced_team_disables_start(self):
        self.lobby(empty_side=True)
        self.assertNotIn('start', self.ui._lobby_rects)
        self.assertEqual(sum(k.startswith('swap_') for k in self.ui._lobby_rects), 7)

    def test_joiner_has_no_admin_targets(self):
        self.lobby(host=False)
        self.assertEqual(set(self.ui._lobby_rects), {'team_0', 'team_1'})
        self.assertEqual(self.ui._wait_rects, {})
        self.assertTrue(self.ui.input_frozen())

    def test_arena_entry_and_keyboard_contract(self):
        mp.draw_server_browser(-1, False, '')
        self.assertTrue(pygame.Rect(mp.SERVER_PANEL_X, mp.SERVER_PANEL_Y, mp.SERVER_PANEL_W, mp.SERVER_PANEL_H).contains(mp.enter_arena_rect()))
        self.assertTrue(mp.enter_arena_hit(mp.enter_arena_rect().center))
        self.ui.draw_panel(self.screen)
        before = self.ui.selected_field
        self.assertTrue(self.ui.handle_event(pygame.event.Event(pygame.KEYDOWN, key=pygame.K_TAB), (0, 0)))
        self.assertNotEqual(before, self.ui.selected_field)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
